<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的文本到3D实体检索方法存在信息损失或缺乏明确的不变性保证的问题，为此，研究提出了一种新的框架来解决这个问题。

Method: 研究基于群作用和谱几何不变量，通过描述子的有效构造，以及多重正集合和几何属性监督来实现精确的3D实体检索。

Result: 该方法在Text-to-3D实体检索任务上实现了88.6%的召回率，比之前的最佳方法高13.6个百分点。

Conclusion: 该研究有效证明了明确的几何不变量对精确3D实体检索的重要性。

Abstract: Text-to-3D solid retrieval requires aligning natural language with precise geometry despite variations in pose, scale, and recording conventions. Existing methods discretize Boundary Representation (B-rep) models into point clouds or meshes, or learn features from faces, edges, and topology, risking information loss or lacking explicit invariance guarantees. We propose a text-to-B-rep retrieval framework based on group actions and spectral geometric invariants, making invariance an explicit constraint on descriptor construction. Specifically, we use group actions to characterize equivalence transformations induced by translation, rotation, reflection, uniform scaling, and contour recording conventions. For sketch-extrusion solids, we construct a fixed 280-dimensional spectral geometric descriptor by integrating geometric information from three complementary levels, including cross-sectional regions, contour boundaries, and extrusion structures. Furthermore, we use descriptor-consistent multi-positive sets and geometric attribute supervision to promote structural alignment between text and solids. On Text-to-3D solid retrieval, our method achieves 88.6% Recall@5, exceeding the previous state of the art by 13.6 percentage points and demonstrating the effectiveness of explicit geometric invariants for precise 3D solid retrieval.

</details>


### [54] [Explicit Frictional Contact Modeling in Neural Garment Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33492)
*Thanh-Nguyen Truong,Vu-Hoang Tran,Ching-Chun Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一个模块化的接触算子，用于在预测后的显式计算摩擦力，该算子无需重新训练或迭代求解，能够在较低的运行时间下获得与引用求解器类似的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的GNN方法在处理服装接触时忽略了摩擦力或将其包含在训练能量中，没有提供在推理时设置摩擦系数μ的方法；基于优化的求解器虽然能动态决定每一步的粘滑状态，但在预测后无法直接应用于摩擦力的显式处理。

Method: 通过引入一个模块化的接触算子来显式处理摩擦力。该模块不会重新训练预测器或执行迭代求解，而是接收预测结果，计算法向载荷，应用封闭形式的库仑修正，沿着身体三角形路径传播产生的运动。这是一个基于线性化膜波传播的非迭代方法。

Result: 在HOOD和ContourCraft数据集上，该模块化接触算子在摩擦系数μ的单调性方面超过了现有的方法，同时保持较低的穿透和参考一致的拉伸。相比引用求解器，其运行时间减少了八分之一。

Conclusion: 该研究方法提供了一种有效处理服装接触问题的新思路，能够在较低计算成本下实现摩擦力的显式计算，具有广泛的应用前景。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) simulate garments efficiently through physics-based self-supervision, but leave body-garment friction implicit or inside training energies, with no friction coefficient $μ$ to set at inference; retraining the tested GNNs with a coefficient-specific friction term barely responds to $μ$. Optimization-based solvers decide each contact's stick-slip state from the reaction that governs it, but only by re-optimizing the garment state at every step; a friction term in a one-pass training objective acts as a fixed-weight penalty on sliding, and the trained weights apply no per-contact Coulomb condition at inference. We therefore resolve friction explicitly after prediction: a Modular Contact Operator, attached to a frozen predictor without retraining or an iterative solve, estimates the normal load, applies a closed-form Coulomb correction along a path across body triangles, and propagates the induced motion through the cloth as a linearized membrane wave. On HOOD and ContourCraft, it raises sticking and lowers slip monotonically in $μ$, tracking a reference solver's response while coefficient-specific retraining stays flat, with low penetration and reference-consistent stretching at an eighth of the solver's runtime.

</details>


### [55] [FreqPKC: Frequency-Aware PeakConv for Radar Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33504)
*Yangyong Deng,Pengyu Zhang,Shaoqiu Song,Xiaotao Huang,Jian Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了Frequency-Aware PeakConv (FreqPKC) 方法和 FreqPKC-Net 框架，通过频率域视角重新审视 PKC，使其能够更好地捕捉雷达图像的频率特性，从而改善目标分割精度，特别是在包含多视角数据的环境下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的 PeakConv (PKC) 方法虽然提高了雷达图像分割的准确性，但没有充分考虑其频率响应特性。鉴于此，研究团队提出了 Frequency-Aware PeakConv (FreqPKC)，以更全面地利用 PKC 的谱特性。这一创新性地方法通过网络自动推断适宜的保护带宽，实现高频细节增强和低频噪声抑制，进一步提升了目标分割的精度。

Method: FreqPKC 方法从频率域的角度重新审视 PKC，提出了一个频率感知的模块。在此基础上，研究团队开发了 FreqPKC-Net 框架，将频率导向的自适应调制与多视图融合相结合，适用于多视图和单视图输入数据。

Result: 实验结果表明，FreqPKC-Net 在公共数据集 CARRADA、CARRADA-RAC 和自建数据集 RS-SAR 上的表现优于现有最先进的方法，特别是在范围多普勒视图（range-Doppler）和范围角度视图（range-angle）方面。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的方法及框架在多视图雷达语义分割中取得了显著成果，验证了频率域视角在处理雷达图像中的高精度和噪声抑制方面的有效性，为自动驾驶中的雷达数据处理提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Automotive millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar has attracted increasing attention for semantic segmentation in autonomous driving, owing to its robustness under adverse weather and lighting conditions. Recent works have introduced radar-specific neural operators such as PeakConv (PKC), inspired by constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detection, to better model the peak-dominated characteristics of radar images. However, existing methods typically treat the guard bandwidth as learnable parameters, without explicitly characterizing the frequency response of the PKC operator. In this work, we revisit PKC from a frequency-domain perspective and propose Frequency-Aware PeakConv (FreqPKC), which explicitly models and exploits its underlying spectral characteristics. By analyzing the frequency response of PKC, FreqPKC enables the network to capture a broader range of frequency components and adaptively adjust its effective bandwidth. With the proposed Frequency-Aware (FA) module, the network can infer appropriate guard bandwidths to balance high- and low-frequency information: it enhances high-frequency components in target regions for more precise segmentation while suppressing noise through low-frequency filtering in background areas. Building on FreqPKC, we further develop FreqPKC-Net, a radar semantic segmentation (RSS) framework that integrates frequency-guided adaptive modulation with cross-view fusion for multi-view inputs, and can also be adapted to single-view data. Experiments on the public datasets CARRADA, CARRADA-RAC, and a self-built dataset named RS-SAR demonstrate that FreqPKC-Net consistently outperforms existing SoTA methods on both range-Doppler and range-angle views.

</details>


### [56] [Component Pooling Trained Across Orientations for Few-Shot Remote Sensing Scene Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33518)
*Bingchen Yan,Wenheng Guo,Yuye Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RoCoP通过非参数组件聚合网络和随机旋转视角训练，在 Few-shot 远景场景分类中提高了性能，特别在NWPU-RESISC45和AID数据集上表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FSRSSC方法普遍使用全局均值池化，没有考虑高分辨率遥感图像的无规轴问题。

Method: RoCoP网络包括特征提取器、非负分解模块和组件评分模块，通过旋转视图训练和组件池化来处理遥感图像。

Result: RoCoP在5-way 1-shot准确率上相较于基准模型提高了约2.5个点，在NWPU-RESISC45和AID数据集上表现优异，且在相同协议下优于其他已实现的度量和任务适应性方法。

Conclusion: 组件池化和旋转视图训练是互补的改进措施，RoCoP在网络架构中提供了更强的旋转不变性，特别是在大规模遥感场景分类中表现良好。

Abstract: Few-shot remote sensing scene classification (FSRSSC) aims to recognize novel scene categories from only a few labeled images. Most FSRSSC methods summarize the feature map of an image by global average pooling, which treats the few objects that define an aerial scene and the large background around them alike, and they rarely consider that aerial images have no canonical orientation. To address these issues, we propose RoCoP, a parameter-free component pooling network trained across orientations. RoCoP consists of a feature extractor, a non-negative decomposition module (NDM) and a component scoring module (CSM). NDM factorizes the local descriptors of each image into a few additive components with a deterministic initialization and a single multiplicative update, so that the positions of one object are grouped together. CSM weights each component by its activation magnitude and converts the weights into a soft mask for pooling. Because both modules are invariant to permutations of feature positions, the only rotation-sensitive part of the pipeline is the backbone, which we train to classify randomly rotated views of every image. Experiments on NWPU-RESISC45, AID and UC Merced show that component pooling and rotated-view training are complementary: together they improve a strong transfer-learning baseline by about 2.5 points in 5-way 1-shot accuracy on NWPU-RESISC45 and AID, without adding parameters at inference. Under an identical protocol, RoCoP outperforms re-implemented metric-based and task-adaptive methods, and NDM and CSM also improve existing methods when plugged into them. We further identify the regime in which the method does not apply, namely very small base sets.

</details>


### [57] [Promise and Limits of Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation for Lightweight Medical Vision Transformers (LiteMed-ViT)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33520)
*Shuaibu Shehu,Elijah M. Flomo,Mohammad Safiya,Anurodh Kumar,Subodh Kumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LiteMed-ViT 是LiteMed-ViT Transformer模型，采用双令牌蒸馏方法，参数量为0.234M，仅为ResNet18教师模型的47.8倍，占用0.89MB的内存。在多种医学图像数据集上，LiteMed-ViT 的准确率优于大多数紧凑的CNN基线模型，特别是在血液图像和病理学图像方面表现出色。然而，在皮肤图像数据集上，LiteMed-ViT 的平衡精度接近最大紧凑型CNNs，且不从更高的输入分辨率中获益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医学现场护理中，对卷积神经网络（CNNs）和视觉变换器（ViTs）进行深度模型分析。标准架构的CNNs通常过重，而ViTs需要大量训练数据才能补偿缺乏的归纳偏差。本文研究了如何通过教师-学生双令牌蒸馏方法将数据高效ViTs的训练应用到不同架构中，以解决这些挑战。

Method: 研究采用了一种全新的模型结构，结合了CNNs的卷积先验和ViTs的深度学习能力，提出了LiteMed-ViT，该模型包括一个卷积茎和一个类平衡的蒸汽目标。并且该研究具体地对模型的表现进行了测试，评估了其在复杂医学图像数据集上的性能。

Result: LiteMed-ViT 在三种紧凑的CNN基线模型上的血液图像子集（BloodMNIST）上取得了95.05%的准确率，并在两种病理图像子集（PathMNIST）上达到了89.15%的准确率，其在所有子集下的鲁棒性不低于所有的紧凑型CNNs，且在不同程度的扰动下未出现精度下降。然而，它在皮肤图像数据集DermaMNIST的表现则接近最强的紧凑型CNNs，且未从更高分辨率的输入中获益。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，LiteMed-ViT 是一种在保持相对高性能的情况下，能有效解决标准架构模型在医学图像分析中的问题的创新模型框架，同时通过实验证明了其在各种医学图像数据集上的优越性能。

Abstract: Running deep models for medical image analysis at the point of care is challenging with standard architectures: convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are often too heavy for edge devices, while Vision Transformers (ViTs) require massive training datasets to compensate for missing inductive biases. This study investigates how far the dual-token distillation used to train data-efficient ViTs can be pushed when applied across architectures, from a CNN-based teacher into a lightweight ViT student. LiteMed-ViT is introduced as a dual-token ViT featuring a convolutional stem and a class-balanced distillation objective; at 0.234M parameters, LiteMed-ViT carries 47.8x fewer parameters than its ResNet18 teacher at a memory footprint of just 0.89 MB. Evaluated against three compact CNN baselines on three MedMNIST subsets of varying modality and class balance, LiteMed-ViT attains higher accuracy than all three baselines on BloodMNIST (95.05%) and two on PathMNIST (89.15%). Under MedMNIST-C corruptions, it is at least as robust as every compact CNN across all subsets, outperforming them on BloodMNIST and PathMNIST without declining in relative standing as severity increases. Particular attention is devoted to identifying the exact conditions where performance plateaus. On DermaMNIST, LiteMed-ViT's balanced accuracy remains up to 1.9 points below the strongest compact CNNs and does not benefit from higher input resolutions up to 224 pixels, where ResNet18 gains 12.6 points. Stronger teachers do not yield a more accurate student, and overconfident ones lower its DermaMNIST balanced accuracy unless calibrated.

</details>


### [58] [Patch-Derived or Register Tokens? Comparing Variable-Length Image Tokenizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33540)
*Philipp Schenkel,Tobias Schürmann,Omer Sahin Tas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究比较了两种变长图像令牌化策略，发现patches-derived令牌在极端压缩下表现出色，而register令牌在中等预算下重建质量稍优。注册令牌在下游生成任务中优于patches-derived令牌，但通过与外部预训练视觉编码器的表示对齐，patches-derived令牌的表现可以接近或超越注册令牌。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像令牌化是用于高效生成建模的关键步骤。现有方法通常将潜空间组织在下采样网格上，研究旨在探索无固定空间布局的令牌（register令牌）与显式保持空间组织的patches-derived令牌之间的表现差异。

Method: 研究通过比较两种变长令牌化方法，即patches-derived令牌（保持空间组织）和register令牌（无预定义空间布局），评估了在不同压缩预算下的重建质量和对下游生成任务的影响。引入了外部预训练视觉编码器对表示进行对齐以改进生成性能。

Result: 研究表明，在极端压缩条件下，patches-derived令牌在重建质量上表现出色；而在中等预算下，register令牌效果稍好。对于下游生成任务，注册令牌优于patches-derived令牌；通过对表示进行对齐，patches-derived令牌的性能有所提高，可以达到与注册令牌相近或更好的效果。

Conclusion: 研究的结果表明，patches-derived令牌在极端压缩条件下有优势，而注册令牌在中等预算下性能较好。通过表示对齐，可以改进patches-derived令牌的性能，使其在某些情况下游性能超越注册令牌。两种方法都学到了局部化的表示，贴图衍生的令牌保留了其预设的空间组织，而注册令牌发展出了隐式的二维空间结构。

Abstract: Image tokenizers convert pixels into compact latent sequences for efficient generative modeling. Most approaches arrange latents on a downsampled two-dimensional grid, tying sequence length to image resolution. We compare two variable-length strategies: computationally efficient patch-derived tokens, which inherit explicit spatial organization, and more demanding register tokens, which have no predefined spatial layout. Our reconstruction results reveal that patch-derived tokens perform substantially better under extreme compression, whereas register tokens achieve slightly better reconstruction quality at intermediate budgets. At high token budgets, both approaches achieve similar reconstruction quality. For downstream generative tasks, register tokens outperform patch-derived tokens. Adding representation alignment with external pretrained visual encoders substantially improves the generative performance of patch-derived tokens, allowing them to match or outperform register tokens depending on the token budget.   <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 在大规模公开数据集和新构建的M³RRSIS-D数据集上，CSSAM展示了在准确率、精细推理和高IoU定位指标上的竞争力。

Abstract: High-resolution remote sensing (RS) imagery provides fine spatial detail over large areas, making it essential for fine-grained scene understanding. Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation (RRSIS) aims to segment regions described by natural language, yet many existing methods rely on sequential alignment--fusion pipelines with limited joint modeling of cross-scale visual hierarchies and linguistic dependencies. Moreover, dense attention mechanisms struggle with the sparsity and wide spatial dispersion of RS targets, while current datasets offer limited structured evaluation of multi-target references, multi-hop relational reasoning, and multi-granularity descriptions, limiting both model development and evaluation. To address these challenges, we propose a Cross-Scale Sparse Attention Model (CSSAM), which aligns multiscale visual features with complex referring expressions through two key modules. The Cross-scale Modality-aligned Fusion Module (CMFM) performs unified cross-scale cross-modal fusion, while the Dynamic Multimodal Sparse Hybrid Attention (DMSHA) selectively attends to informative visual--textual tokens, reducing dense visual interactions. Furthermore, we introduce M$^{3}$RRSIS-D, a RRSIS dataset explicitly designed around three core reasoning dimensions: multi-target (M$^{1}$), reference-dependent multi-hop (M$^{2}$), and multi-granularity (M$^{3}$) expressions. Extensive experiments on M$^{3}$RRSIS-D and two public RRSIS benchmarks demonstrate that CSSAM achieves competitive performance across accuracy, fine-grained reasoning, and high-IoU localization metrics, validating its effectiveness for complex semantic reasoning in realistic RS scenarios. </details>

Abstract: Automated prostate lesion detection from diffusion-weighted MR imaging (DWI) conventionally relies on reconstructed images and does not fully use all acquisition information. We present an end-to-end network that uses complex multicoil DWI data and coil sensitivity information for prostate lesion segmentation.

The proposed network, VarNet-Seg, consists of a k-space variational network (VarNet) with six variational cascades and an image-space 3D segmentation U-Net. Comparator models used the same segmentation architecture with fully coil-combined images (CC-Seg), fixed root-sum-of-squares reconstruction (RSS-Seg), or fixed SENSE reconstruction (SENSE-Seg). We performed ablations with end-to-end training and data consistency (DC) enabled or disabled. We evaluated lesion segmentation using Dice and patient-level detection using AUROC in five-fold cross-validation with full sampling, simulated undersampling, added noise, or both.
  VarNet-Seg achieved the highest Dice at every undersampling level. At eight-fold acceleration, Dice was 0.22 for VarNet-Seg, 0.14 for SENSE-Seg and 0.16 for VarNet-Seg (no DC). The paired difference from SENSE-Seg was 0.08 (95% CI, 0.04-0.11). With full sampling, VarNet-Seg and RSS-Seg performed similarly (0.40 vs 0.39). Patient-level AUROC decreased from 0.75 with full sampling to 0.63 at eight-fold acceleration; corresponding RSS-Seg AUROCs were 0.76 and 0.64.
  The proposed multicoil network improved prostate lesion segmentation under simulated undersampling compared to conventional models. Prospective evaluation is needed to establish whether this approach can be used clinically in accelerated prostate DWI.

</details>


### [61] [GeoLift: Grounding Video Spatial Reasoning in Explicit 3D Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33558)
*Xinglin Li,TingTing Long,Jingzhi Zhou,Jiajing Chen,Jian Yang,Jin Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为GeoLift的框架，用于视频场景中的空间推理，通过将单一帧中的对象映射到共享的3D场景中，增强了对象在不同视角间的连接，显著提升了路线规划的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型在处理需要多个转弯的路线规划任务时表现不佳，表明单帧对象识别不足以解决复杂的空间推理问题。因此，需要一种方法来跨视角关联观察结果，保持地标间的空间排列。

Method: GeoLift框架利用事先冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）进行2D对象锁定，并结合预训练的几何模型重建3D场景。使用共享的几何区域（超点）跨视角关联相同对象的观察结果，无需学习匹配器。重建的3D地图可以明确计算空间关系和多步路线，提供几何证据估计距离和大小。

Conclusion: GeoLift框架通过共享3D地图连接帧级对象的推理，提高了复杂的空间理解能力，无需特定任务的训练。

Abstract: Video spatial reasoning requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to understand how objects are arranged and related across viewpoints. While these models can recognize objects in individual frames, integrating these observations to solve complex spatial tasks remains challenging. We examine route planning as a representative task and observe that existing models become substantially less accurate as the number of required turns increases, with several models achieving accuracy close to random guessing on routes requiring three or more turns. This finding suggests that recognizing landmarks alone is insufficient: models must also connect observations across viewpoints and track how landmarks are arranged in a shared space. Motivated by this observation, we introduce GeoLift, a training-free framework that uses feed-forward 3D reconstruction to map objects detected in individual frames into a shared metric 3D scene. GeoLift combines a frozen MLLM for 2D grounding with pretrained geometry models for scene reconstruction. It then uses shared geometric regions, called superpoints, to associate observations of the same object across views without a learned matcher. The reconstructed 3D map enables explicit computation of spatial relations and multistep routes, and provides geometric evidence for estimating distances and sizes. With all model weights frozen, GeoLift improves Qwen3-VL-4B's average score on VSI-Bench from 55.4% to 64.1%, including an increase in route-planning accuracy from 30.9% to 53.6%, and achieves 59.8% accuracy on MindCube. These results show that connecting frame-level object grounding through a shared 3D map can improve complex spatial reasoning without task-specific training.

</details>


### [62] [What Remains OOD? OODConceptBench for Open-World Concept Recognition in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33564)
*Zhiran Luo,Zhiyong Yang,Zitai Wang,Sicong Li,Qianqian Xu,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过构建OODConceptBench基准测试集，评估了37种视觉-语言模型在开放世界概念识别上的表现，发现不同模型对此类任务的识别能力存在差异，而模型的较大规模预训练并未减轻开放世界问题的挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究指出当前的评估方法难以直接揭示不同视觉-语言模型在开放世界识别上的能力，因此作者构建了OODConceptBench基准测试集来专门研究这个问题。

Method: 1. 构建了包含30,752张图片的全集和14,285张图片的更难集；2. 覆盖了7个开放世界类别共计560个概念短语；3. 评估了37种视觉-语言模型在不同层次上的表现。

Result: 1. 全集和更难集的识别率存在差异；2. 后期发布的模型不一定有更好的开放世界概念识别能力；3. 提高的整体识别率不意味着各类别都有一致的改进。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明在大规模视觉-语言预训练时代的开放世界概念识别依然是一个挑战。

Abstract: In the era of large-scale pretrained models, zero-shot generalization has increasingly blurred the boundary between known and unknown concepts. However, current evaluations do not directly reveal which open-world concepts different vision-language models can recognize. To study this problem, we introduce OODConceptBench, a hierarchical benchmark for open-world concept recognition on image-concept pairs. The full benchmark set (L1) contains 30,752 images, and the harder subset (L2) contains 14,285 images. The benchmark covers 560 concept phrases across seven open-world categories. We evaluate 37 vision-language models across release year, model family, and variant. We obtain three main findings. First, target-concept recognition is lower on L2 than on L1 across all 37 evaluated models. Second, later-released models do not necessarily achieve stronger open-world concept recognition. Third, an increase in overall recognition does not imply consistent improvement across all benchmark categories. Together, these results show that OOD remains a challenge even in the era of large-scale vision-language pretraining.

</details>


### [63] [Distilling Dense Trajectory Teachers For Large-Motion Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33566)
*Shuofeng Sun,Linqing Zhao,Haibin Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DTTD 通过生成能力从密集轨迹迁移到大镜头移动，解决了解决密集训练和稀疏推断之间的视角变化不匹配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型在处理稀疏、大步长的摄像机轨迹时，往往会生成冻结帧、不准确的摄像机运动和严重的几何漂移。

Method: DTTD 通过在稀疏轨迹上构造一个密集的轨迹，并利用这个熟悉且密集的轨迹生成可靠的教师视频。然后利用这些教师观察来评估在原始稀疏轨迹下的候选视频。这种方法利用了模型自身作为生成教师的优势，无需额外的视频数据或更强的外部视频生成器。

Result: 通过 DTTD，模型能够更好地生成匹配给定稀疏摄像机轨迹的视频，保持一致的3D结构并减少了几何漂移。

Conclusion: 该研究通过密集教师监督和几何感知奖励优化，稳定地扩展了模型的运动范围，同时保留了更简单轨迹来减小能力遗忘。

Abstract: Video world models are expected to generate videos that accurately follow specified camera trajectories while maintaining consistent 3D structures. However, existing models are predominantly trained on densely sampled videos with small inter-frame camera motions. When applied to sparse, large step trajectories, they often produce frozen frames, inaccurate camera motion, and severe geometric drift. We attribute this degradation to a mismatch between the gradual viewpoint transitions seen during training and the large viewpoint changes required at inference time. To address this problem, we propose Dense Trajectory Teacher Distillation (DTTD), a post-training framework that transfers a model's generation capability from dense trajectories to large camera motions. Given a sparse trajectory, DTTD interpolates additional camera poses to construct a dense trajectory covering the same path. The frozen base model then generates reliable teacher videos along this familiar dense trajectory, and pose aligned teacher observations are used to evaluate candidate videos generated under the original sparse trajectory. In this way, the model serves as its own generation teacher, requiring neither additional video data nor a stronger external video generator. We further combine dense teacher supervision with geometry aware rewards that assess cross frame consistency and camera trajectory following, and use the resulting preferences for offline preference optimization. To stably expand the model's motion range, we introduce a cumulative curriculum that progressively incorporates larger motion steps while retaining simpler trajectories to reduce capability forgetting.

</details>


### [64] [CADonatello: Towards Real-World Multi-Part 3D CAD Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33575)
*Ahmet Serdar Karadeniz,Dimitrios Mallis,Parsa Akbari Chianeh,Kseniya Cherenkova,Anis Kacem,Djamila Aouada*

TL;DR: 该研究提出了CADonatello框架，用于从真实3D扫描重构参数化CAD模型。通过使用3D部件分割模型将输入几何分解为结构化的组件，再使用基于截面的管道独立重构每个组件。引入CC3D截面数据集，实现从干净的CAD草图图像到扫描截面图像的有效域适应。实验表明，该方法在噪声扫描和复杂多部件对象的通用化方面表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在标准基准上的表现强劲，但在现实场景中，由于物体由多个部分组成且有扫描噪声，这些方法的有效性往往会降低。因为现有的CAD重建数据集大多包含单一部件模型和干净的几何输入，限制了学习模型在实际场景中的泛化能力。

Method: 该方法首先通过基础规模的3D部件分割模型将输入几何分解为结构化的组件，然后通过基于截面的管道独立重构每个组件。使用CC3D截面数据集进行从干净CAD草图图像到扫描截面图像的有效域适应。

Result: 该框架证明了在有噪声扫描和复杂多部件对象重建方面的改进和可靠性。

Conclusion: 研究展示了通过CADonatello框架，可以实现更多现实情况下多组件物体的可靠重建，同时也证明了CC3D截面数据集的有效性。

Abstract: Existing methods for CAD reconstruction from 3D scans achieve strong performance on standard benchmarks, yet their effectiveness often degrades in real-world scenarios where objects consist of multiple parts and scan artifacts such as noise. A key reason is that current CAD reconstruction datasets predominantly contain single-part models and clean geometric inputs, limiting the ability of learned models to generalize to realistic settings. In this work, we introduce CADonatello, a part-aware framework for reconstructing parametric CAD models from real-world 3D scans. Our approach first decomposes the input geometry into structurally meaningful components using a foundation-scale 3D part segmentation model, and then reconstructs each component independently through a cross-section-driven pipeline that performs sketch parameterization followed by an extrusion. To improve the robustness of sketch parameterization to scan-derived cross-sections, we further introduce CC3D Cross-Sections, a dataset of paired rasterized cross-section images from realistic scans and their corresponding parametric sketches derived from aligned CAD models. This dataset enables effective domain adaptation from clean CAD sketch images to scan-derived cross-section images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach improves generalization to noisy scans and enables reliable reconstruction of complex multi-part objects across multiple real-world CAD reverse engineering benchmarks.

</details>


### [65] [ZoomSEM: accelerating large-scale brain connectomics with intelligent SEM super-resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33580)
*Jiateng Shou,Zhiwei Xiong,Ruikang Xu,Zhicheng Wang,Peiyao Shi,Te Shi,Haiqun Jin,Chunying Yin,Jun Guo,Manfred Auer,Hanchuan Peng,Ruobing Zhang,Feng Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ZoomSEM是一种基于深度学习的超分辨率方法，能够在保持神经元结构完整性的同时，从快速低分辨率扫描中恢复4倍、8倍甚至16倍的高分辨率图像，实现30倍的有效加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的深度学习超分辨率方法在放大因子小或依赖合成数据方面存在局限性，无法满足大型生物成像和连接组学的需求。因此，需要一种能够处理大规模数据的深度学习超分辨率方法，以加速扫描电子显微镜（SEM）成像。

Method: ZoomSEM使用真实的低分辨率和高分辨率SEM图像对进行训练，能够从快速低分辨率扫描中恢复高分辨率图像。它能够处理不同生物样本的数据集，在低分辨率采集过程中具有鲁棒的一般化能力。

Result: ZoomSEM实现了30倍的有效加速，能够提供4倍、8倍和高达16倍的分辨率提升，同时保持神经元结构的完整性，适用于多种生物样本数据集。

Abstract: Serial electron microscopy (EM) is essential for large-volume biological imaging and connectomics, yet its throughput remains a major bottleneck, with cubic-millimeter-scale brain imaging requiring months or years. Existing deep learning-based EM super-resolution methods are limited to small upscaling factors or rely on synthetic data, offering modest acceleration and limited practical impact. We introduce ZoomSEM, a deep learning-based super-resolution method to dramatically accelerate SEM imaging. Trained on real low- and high-resolution scanning electron microscopy (SEM) pairs, ZoomSEM enables reliable recovery of 4$\times$, 8$\times$, and up to 16$\times$ higher-resolution images from fast low-resolution scans while preserving fine neuronal structures critical for connectomic analysis, achieving up to 30-fold effective acceleration. Extensive experiments across datasets of diverse biological samples demonstrate robust generalization under realistic low-resolution acquisition. This advance enables high-resolution, large-volume serial EM imaging at unprecedented speed, poised to transform connectomics and related fields.

</details>


### [66] [UltraFlash: Accelerating Megapixel Visual Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33581)
*Phuc Lai,Anh Nguyen,Phong Nguyen,Anh Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UltraFlash 提出了一种在级联生成过程中加速基于 VAE 的操作的方法，通过减少像素空间过渡和稀疏像素解码优化了生成效率和图像质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 级联生成管道中的下采样-上采样过程和逐像素解码导致重复的 VAE 编码解码，成为效率瓶颈。

Method: UltraFlash 通过重建中间潜空间快捷方式和稀疏像素解码解决了效率瓶颈。

Result: UltraFlash 将 4K 生成延迟减少了约 2 倍，同时提高了图像质量。

Conclusion: 通过优化像素空间过渡，UltraFlash 提高了生成效率和图像质量，为快速高质量的兆像素视觉合成提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Megapixel visual synthesis with latent diffusion models requires operating far beyond the resolutions at which these models are typically trained. Cascade refinement is a leading strategy for this setting: it starts from a base image at a native resolution and progressively upsamples it to the target resolution through multiple refinement stages. Each stage typically performs a pixel-space resolution transition followed by latent-space denoising. While prior acceleration efforts mainly focus on reducing denoising cost, we identify a complementary and underexplored bottleneck: the repeated movement of representations through the VAE. We call these operations pixel-space transitions. In cascade pipelines, intermediate latents are often decoded to RGB, resized, and re-encoded before refinement, while final latents are decoded patch by patch with dense overlap to suppress boundary artifacts. We propose UltraFlash, a transition-efficient approach that accelerates these VAE-heavy operations. UltraFlash has two components. Latent Hyperloop replaces intermediate RGB round trips with a learned latent-space shortcut that approximates the decode-resize-encode transformation without repeated VAE decoding and encoding. Sparse Patch-based Decoding accelerates final reconstruction by addressing patch seams caused by inconsistent GroupNorm statistics and reusing cached statistics across patches, enabling sparse VAE decoding with much smaller overlap. Integrated into a state-of-the-art cascade baseline, UltraFlash reduces 4K generation latency by approximately 2x while improving image quality. These results show that optimizing pixel-space transitions can improve both efficiency and fidelity, offering an effective route toward fast, high-quality megapixel visual synthesis.

</details>


### [67] [Mix Forcing: Causal Pre-Training via Mixture Attention for Interactive World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33589)
*Zelin Gao,Hao Ouyang,Jiapeng Zhu,Qiuyu Wang,Jingye Chen,Zichen Liu,Xing Zhu,Yujun Shen,Yinghao Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种称为Mix Forcing的因果预训练范式，通过混合双向和自回归注意力机制，在保持模型视觉先验的同时，实现高效且高质量的互动视频世界模型生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的交互式视频世界模型需要自回归生成，直接将预训练的双向视频扩散模型转化为自回归模型可能会破坏视觉先验，从而降低生成质量。因此，为了在保持视觉先验的同时，实现高效的交互式视频生成，作者提出了一种称为Mixture-of-Bidirectional-and-Autoregressive(MoBA)注意力机制的因果预训练方法。

Method: Mix Forcing通过将视频扩散模型与教师强加和双向训练相结合，在自注意力机制中，充分利用教师强加机制学习因果预测，而双向注意力机制则保留预训练的视觉先验。此外，通过块级交叉注意力设计，支持实时文本交互，避免将未来指令暴露给当前块。预训练后，使用一致性与分布匹配蒸馏得到四步自回归生成器。

Result: 在内部基准和公共基准（包括Wbench和SANA-WM-Bench）上进行的实验表明，本文方法在视觉质量和事件跟随精度方面达到了最先进的效果，即使在一个小时的生成过程中，也能保持高质量的高精度长视距生成。

Conclusion: 本研究提出的方法能够在保持视觉先验的同时，通过混合双向和自回归训练实现高效的自回归生成，从而在交互式视频生成中取得了显著的性能提升。

Abstract: While interactive video world models require autoregressive generation, directly adapting pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into autoregressive ones with teacher forcing can disrupt their visual priors and degrade autoregressive generation quality. In this paper, we introduce Mix Forcing, a causal pre-training paradigm for interactive video world models, implemented with the Mixture-of-Bidirectional-and-Autoregressive (MoBA) attention. Mix Forcing jointly trains a video diffusion model with both teacher forcing and bidirectional training, yielding a strong causal initialization for few-step post-training. In self-attention, Mix Forcing leverages teacher forcing to learn causal next-chunk prediction for autoregressive rollout, while using bidirectional attention to preserve pretrained visual priors. To support online text interaction, Mix Forcing further adopts a chunk-wise cross-attention design that conditions each video chunk on a shared environment prompt and its own local prompt, without exposing future instructions to the current chunk. Following causal pre-training on a 14B image-to-video model, we apply consistency and distribution matching distillation to obtain a four-step autoregressive generator. Experiments on our internal benchmark and public benchmarks, including WBench and SANA-WM-Bench, show that our model achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and timely event following with precise camera control. Notably, our model supports high-fidelity long-horizon generation without quality degradation even over one-hour rollouts. Project page is here: https://zelingao98.github.io/mixforcing

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究目的在于更精确地理解《英雄联盟》专业比赛中的战术决策过程，尤其是落后队伍的策略选择和领先队伍的差异，以及这些决策如何影响比赛结果。

Method: 该研究采用了新颖的方法论，应用图网络嵌入、地理唯德尔图分割及量化响应均衡分析。具体包括：1) 将战术布局视为地图上的排列组合；2) 利用地理唯德尔图分割控制地图上的区域；3) 使用博弈论中的量化响应均衡解决问题，解决方法中融入了胜率作为定价因素。

Result: 研究结果表明，处于劣势的队伍在初期更倾向于放弃坑口，领先队伍的行为与落后队伍存在显著差异。模型分析表明队伍的决策主要基于战斗力、旅行和参与的玩家，而不是具体目标。通过调整权重，该模型可以显著表现出更优的统计显著性。

Conclusion: 本研究对《英雄联盟》专业比赛中的战术布局进行了深入分析，建立了一个新的模型HASSE-QRE，并提供了对队伍决策模式的新见解。这些发现可能有助于未来研究进一步优化战术策略，并为数据驱动的竞技分析提供理论基础。

Abstract: Before every neutral objective in professional League of Legends, each team decides which of its five players walk to the pit, which hold a lane, and when to commit. The leading analysis of such setups, TAGNet for Counter-Strike 2, clusters graph-network embeddings of player positions and reads cluster win rates as tactical quality. We treat a setup as an allocation on a walled map: formations are set partitions on the lattice $Π_5$, control is a geodesic Voronoi split of a navigation graph, and commitment is an allocation game solved as a quantal response equilibrium priced in win probability. On all 164 games of MSI and Worlds 2025 (2,994 team-setups, minimap tracks validated against Riot positions), trailing teams leave the pit empty far more often than leading teams, by +34.8 percentage points at the first baron and +30.4 percentage points at Atakhan. Our model, HASSE-QRE, finds six setup patterns that whole-model series-bootstrap refits reproduce (ARI 0.819, comparable to 0.813 for TAGNet's $K$-Means step alone) and indicates that teams price fights, travel and committed players, not the objective itself (weight 0.018; fixing it to one costs 59.9 log-likelihood points). The equilibrium reproduces a quarter of the commitment gap, almost all of it through state variables rather than its strategic channels. Weighting a team-level contrast by exposure moves it across $p=0.05$ (0.046 against 0.052). We release the tracks, setups and code.

</details>


### [69] [ONOT/TONO-Print: A Paired Benchmark for Identity-Document Portrait Quality under Document Production Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33627)
*Alexander Vinogradov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文引入了一种名为ONOT/TONO-Print的小型配对基准，用于评估在身份文件制作过程中面部图像质量模型的变化。该基准基于ONOT和TONO肖像，包含模拟五种常见制作技术的合成变体：油墨喷射、喷墨、染料升华、激光雕刻和热转移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 身份文件的制作过程中，打印、刻蚀和整合到文档模板可能会改变图像的纹理、对比度、颜色和其他视觉属性。这些变化可能会影响面部图像的质量评估模型，而不会改变生物特征或呈现信息。因此，研究者需要一个基准来评估不同的图像质量模型在经过文件制作过程后表现的稳定性。

Method: 该方法构建了一个名为ONOT/TONO-Print的基准，包括基于ONOT和TONO的合成变体，代表五种常见的生产技术。较小的身体子集包括使用喷墨和油墨设备打印和扫描的肖像。该基准用于比较在制作前后生物特征和ICAO相关的面部质量组件的行为。

Result: 研究结果显示，某些质量估计器在制作过程中会引入显著的领域变化，而其他模型则相对稳定。

Conclusion: 总的来说，ONOT/TONO-Print基准能够有效评估面部图像质量模型在身份文件制作过程中的变化，为后续研究提供了基础。

Abstract: Identity-document portraits are modified during document production by printing, engraving, and integration into the document template. These transformations may change image texture, contrast, colour, and other visual properties without necessarily changing the underlying biometric or presentation information. In this work, we introduce ONOT/TONO-Print, a small paired benchmark for evaluating face-image quality models under identity-document production shift. The benchmark is based on ONOT and TONO portraits and contains synthetic variants representing five common production techniques: toner, inkjet, dye sublimation, laser engraving, and thermal transfer. A smaller physical subset contains portraits printed and scanned using inkjet and toner devices. The benchmark is used to compare the behaviour of biometric and ICAO-related face-quality components before and after production. Results show that production can introduce substantial domain shift for some quality estimators, while other models remain comparatively stable.

</details>


### [70] [DROA-CLIPSeg: Prompt-Guided Thin Crack Segmentation in Low-Light Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33635)
*Vinita Shukla,Partibha Jangra,Vinayak Pathak,Praful Hambarde,Amit Shukla*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为DROA-CLIPSeg的轻量化框架，用于在低光照条件下进行裂缝分割。该方法通过两轻量模块适应冻结的CLIPSeg视觉语言背部，结合QKV低秩适应和域残差正交适配器，显著提升了裂缝特定图像文本对齐，无需对全模型进行细调。基于提出的CrackLingo-9K和CrackLingo-12K数据集，并采用裂缝意识提示，实验结果表明DROA-CLIPSeg在两种视语言基准线上的表现优于9个零样本和4个微调模型，并且在MVTec AD中具有较好的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有裂缝分割方法主要假设良好的光照条件，而实际应用中低光照条件却很常见。低光照会降低对比度，造成阴影、车灯眩光、接缝、污渍和湿接缝等问题，影响裂缝的准确分割。因此，本文旨在解决这些问题，旨在提出一种在低光照条件下适应的方法。

Method: 本文提出了一种参数高效的DROA-CLIPSeg框架。DROA-CLIPSeg包含两个轻量模块，分别是QKV低秩适应模块和域残差正交适配器。QKV低秩适应模块注入到视觉和文本编码器的Q/K/V投影中，以提高裂缝特定图像文本对齐，并保留了细、弱和分裂的裂缝证据。域残差正交适配器将中间特征分解为主导裂缝域分支和正交残差分支，以更好地捕捉低光照条件下的裂缝模式。

Result: DROA-CLIPSeg使用约1.93M个参数（约占完整模型的1.3%）进行训练，优于9个零样本和4个微调视语言基准线，且在MVTec AD中具有较好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种针对低光照条件下裂缝分割的新方法DROA-CLIPSeg，该方法在两个基准线和MVTec AD中均表现出良好的性能，验证了其在实际应用中的有效性。

Abstract: Pavement crack segmentation under low light is degraded by reduced contrast, shadows, headlight glare, joints, stains, and wet seams. Existing crack segmentation methods mostly assume good illumination. Low-light enhancement methods improve visual quality, but they do not explicitly preserve crack topology. To address these limitations, we formulate low-light crack segmentation as a degradation-aware, prompt-grounded structural defect segmentation problem and propose DROA-CLIPSeg, a parameter-efficient framework that adapts a frozen CLIPSeg vision language backbone using two lightweight modules. QKV Low-Rank Adaptation is injected into the Q/K/V projections of the vision and text encoders to improve crack-specific image text alignment without backbone fine-tuning. The proposed Domain Residual Orthogonal Adapter (DROA) decomposes intermediate features into a dominant crack-domain branch, which captures recurring low-light crack patterns, and an orthogonal residual branch, which preserves faint, thin, and fragmented evidence usually suppressed by noise, shadow, or over-smoothing. We also introduce CrackLingo-9K and CrackLingo-12K, text augmented versions of Crack9k and Crack12k with crack-aware prompts. Training only approximately 1.93 M parameters, corresponding to 1.3% of the full model, DROA-CLIPSeg outperforms 9 zero-shot and 4 fine-tuned vision language baselines on both splits, generalises zero-shot to MVTec AD across textures and defect morphologies, and is supported by extensive ablations. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/VShuklacode/DROA-CLIPSeg

</details>


### [71] [UniQuery: Unifying Vision Models with a Joint Query Head for Cross-Domain Pedestrian Attribute Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33639)
*Nguyen Dang Duy Tan,Linh T. T. Tran,Huynh Nguyen Phat,Vo Thanh Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniQuery通过联合微调两个独立训练的编码器DINOv3和CLIP，并引入联合查询头以融合两个编码器的输出，表现优于独立集成方法，尤其在未见过的数据集上，Challenge_Avg得分达到0.8001。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法采用独立训练编码器并将它们的 logits 用固定融合权重结合，导致性能受限。UniQuery旨在改进这一过程，通过联合微调两个编码器并引入多头机制以获取更好的属性融合效果。

Method: UniQuery通过引入两个查询头（每个编码器一个），并加入一个联合查询头，该头可以关注来自两个编码器的 Tokens，以此来融合编码器输出。

Result: 在UPAR Challenge 2027的基准测试上，UniQuery在hold-out数据集上超过了独立集成方法（独立训练的编码器）。与冻结编码器相比，UniQuery的Challenge_Avg分数更高，且在隐藏测试集上表现优异，Challenge_Avg达到了0.8001。

Conclusion: UniQuery通过联合微调方法实现了对基础编码器的更好性能提升，尤其是通过引入多头机制和联合查询头来融合编码器输出，成功提高了属性识别的精度。

Abstract: Pedestrian Attribute Recognition (PAR) predicts semantic attributes of individuals, such as gender, age, clothing and accessories, and its descriptions support attribute-based person retrieval and person re-identification. However, accurately recognizing fine-grained attributes across domains remains challenging due to occlusion, appearance variations, and shifts in image distributions. Ensembles of independently trained foundation encoders combine their logits with fixed fusion weights, so every attribute uses the same mix and the encoders are never trained together. We propose UniQuery, which instead jointly fine-tunes DINOv3 and CLIP for attribute-specific fusion. It combines two query heads, one for each encoder, with a joint query head whose attribute queries attend to tokens from both encoders, and the prediction is the average of the logits of the three query heads. We evaluate UniQuery on the benchmark of the UPAR Challenge 2027 at the WACV 2027 Real-World Surveillance workshop, where models are trained on PA100k, PETA and Market-1501 with a shared set of attributes. In leave-one-dataset-out experiments, UniQuery outperforms the independent ensemble in Challenge_Avg on both held-out datasets. Ablations show that learning fusion over independently trained encoders does not improve upon logit averaging in the mean over the two held-out datasets, while freezing the encoders lowers the Challenge_Avg of UniQuery. On the hidden test set of the benchmark, UniQuery achieves a Challenge_Avg of 0.8001.

</details>


### [72] [LENS: Likelihood Evaluation and Neighbor Smoothing for Attribute-Based Person Retrieval on Unseen Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33641)
*Nguyen Dang Duy Tan,Vo Thanh Nguyen,Linh T. T. Tran,Huynh Nguyen Phat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LENS通过引入特定的训练机制和评分与平滑方法，在属性查询的安防图像检索中显著提升了未见摄像头的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在不同摄像头上的表现不尽如人意，尤其是在新的摄像头上，而且后处理校准方法无法很好地泛化。

Method: LENS结合了微调后的DINOv3和CLIP模型与一个提炼的学生模型。通过组交叉熵正则化共享属性组，评分通过查询的对数似然估计实现，并利用DINOv3的视觉特征平滑邻近图像的逻辑。

Conclusion: LENS显著提高了基于属性的人员检索在未见摄像头上的表现，并且展示了其在不同图像集上泛化的潜力。

Abstract: Attribute-based person retrieval ranks surveillance images from a binary query of semantic attributes, but mean Average Attribute Degree of Match (mADM) drops on unseen cameras as predicted probabilities shift. Common pipelines rank gallery images by their L1 distance to the query, which penalizes a confident single-attribute mismatch no more than small uncertainties across many attributes, while post-hoc recalibration fitted on source validation data fails to transfer because the per-attribute maps fitted on source data do not match those of new cameras. We propose LENS (Likelihood Evaluation and Neighbor Smoothing), combining fine-tuned DINOv3 and CLIP models with a distilled student. LENS regularizes mutually exclusive attribute groups with group cross-entropy in training, scores gallery images by the log-likelihood of the exact query, and smooths gallery logits over nearest neighbors using DINOv3 appearance features from the same forward pass. On held-out datasets, all three changes raise mADM: the likelihood score improves all six retrieval metrics for the main ensemble and mADM for all 48 development models, and training-free kNN smoothing improves all 46 tested development models. On the hidden test set of the UPAR 2027 benchmark, LENS reaches 68.17 mADM.

</details>


### [73] [PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33645)
*Wenjun Hou,Kaishuai Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PreView 提出了一种辅助预处理方法，通过提供任务相关的视图和候选特定的提示来提高现有图像理解模型的控件定位准确度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提高现有图像理解模型对杂乱屏幕截图中小控件的识别和定位能力，并减轻现有模型进一步训练的需求。

Method: PreView 方法包括预测和细化中心点、裁剪截图和放大局部视图进行放大定位，并为候选控件准备视觉和文本提示。

Result: PreView 在五个基准上提高了 Qwen3-VL-2B, OS-Atlas-4B, 和 Qwen3-VL-4B 的平均控件定位准确度。

Conclusion: 实验分析表明，任务相关视图、候选特定提示以及中心点细化对性能提升有显著贡献。

Abstract: GUI grounding requires locating small controls in cluttered screenshots and identifying which control a natural-language instruction refers to. Cropping and enlargement can expose local detail, but the resulting image may still leave ambiguity about the intended target. We propose PreView, an auxiliary preprocessor that improves the inputs to an existing grounding model without further training that model. PreView prepares two complementary types of input features: task-relevant views for localization and candidate-specific cues for target understanding. A trained lightweight auxiliary model predicts and refines a center, crops the screenshot into a local view, and enlarges that view for zoomed-in grounding. It also prepares a visual cue (i.e., a red-circle marker with a location hint) and a textual cue describing the candidate's identity or function. The frozen grounding model uses the prepared inputs to predict the final click. Across five benchmarks, PreView improves the average grounding accuracy of Qwen3-VL-2B, OS-Atlas-4B, and Qwen3-VL-4B without further training these grounding models. Extensive analyses examine the contributions of views and cues, center refinement, and visual input budgets.

</details>


### [74] [FreeView: Robust 3D Reconstruction from Uncurated Views](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33656)
*Junho Kim,Hyunyoung Choi,Seongwon Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FreeView 是一种无需训练的框架，能够从未编目的图像集中选择过滤参考并拒绝干扰视图，通过集合级别的共识确定代表视图，结合视觉和几何证据适应性调整视图拒绝，从而在显著外观和视点变化下保留有用视图，高效率地进行无监督的3D重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的前馈重建模型虽然包含内部视图一致性信号，支持排除干扰视图，但是这些模型依赖于一个受控且干净的参考集合，而在实际的图像集中难以保证。因此，研究引入FreeView来解决这个问题，使无需特定的参考集合也能进行有效的视图滤除。

Method: FreeView 通过计算整个图像集合级别的共识，选择一个作为过滤参考的代表视图，然后根据每个输入集合的互补视觉和几何证据来适应性地调整视图拒绝策略。

Result: 实验结果显示，FreeView 能够有效地保留清洁视图并剔除干扰视图，适用于多个数据集，能可靠地从未编目的视图中进行3D重建。

Conclusion: FreeView 提供了一种无需特定参考数据即可高效执行视图筛选，适用于大量未编目的图像集的无监督3D重建方法。

Abstract: Reconstructing a coherent 3D scene from uncurated image collections remains challenging due to the presence of irrelevant or non-overlapping views. Recent work has shown that feed-forward reconstruction models contain internal view-consistency signals that support distractor rejection. However, reference-conditioned filtering relies on a curated clean reference, which is not guaranteed in practical image collections. To address this limitation, we introduce FreeView, a training-free framework that jointly selects a filtering reference and rejects distractor views from an uncurated collection. FreeView leverages collection-level consensus to identify a representative view that serves as a reliable reference for filtering. It then adapts view rejection to each input collection by combining complementary visual and geometric evidence. This approach preserves useful views under substantial appearance and viewpoint variations while rejecting distractors. FreeView integrates with both VGGT and pi^3, removing the need for a manually curated reference or manual calibration of view rejection. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate high clean-view retention and distractor rejection rates, leading to reliable 3D reconstruction from uncurated views.

</details>


### [75] [Tracking Is Not Sensing: Artifact-Aware Thermal Video Respiration Estimation in Head-Free Marmosets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33661)
*Penghao Wang,Sen Yang,Fenghua Xie,He Wang,Xindong Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究采用同步热视频和接触呼吸记录，展示了在无头束缚条件下，虽然鼻部视觉追踪合理，但所得到的呼吸率与接触式记录不符，提出了一种Selective Temporal Attenuation Regularization（STAR）方法，通过在训练期间局部时间插值衰减高运动的热不连续性，提高了无头呼吸率估计的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究的动机是解决在非接触式热视频呼吸率监测中，尽管视觉追踪看似合理，但生理测量结果可能不一致的问题，特别是在非人为束缚的行为实验中。

Method: 研究使用同步热视频和接触式呼吸录制数据，首先观察到鼻部视追踪与接触式呼吸记录的一致性问题。然后提出了一种Selective Temporal Attenuation Regularization（STAR）方法，在训练过程中通过局部时间插值衰减高运动的热不连续性，以使模型倾向于与呼吸运动一致的动力学。

Result: 研究结果表明，STAR 方法在多种深度学习模型下提高了无头束缚条件下呼吸频率估计的准确性，与固定区域直方图分析相比，平均绝对误差从 20.76 bpm 降低到了 2.23 bpm。

Conclusion: 研究结论是，虽然热视频可以帮助非接触式监测呼吸频率，但在无头束缚条件下，需要改进数据处理方法以获得可靠的生理测量结果。提出的 STAR 方法是一种有效的方法，可以更好地估计无头束缚条件下的呼吸频率。

Abstract: Continuous physiological monitoring is essential for linking behavior, internal state, and neural activity in neuroscience and translational research. In common marmosets, a key nonhuman primate model for social neuroscience, respiratory rate provides a basic readout of arousal, stress, and physiological regulation. Contact sensors can provide accurate measurements, but they add preparation burden and may interfere with head-free behavioral protocols. Thermal video offers a noncontact alternative by capturing breathing-related temperature changes around the nose and mouth. However, in head-free marmosets, these cues are weak, localized, and easily corrupted by head motion, pose changes, and fur. Here we show that this setting exposes a broader challenge in video-based physiological sensing: visually reliable tracking does not necessarily imply physiologically valid measurement. Using synchronized thermal video and contact respiration recordings, we show that marmoset respiration is recoverable from thermal video but strongly ROI-sensitive. Under head-free motion, visually plausible nasal tracking can still produce traces inconsistent with contact respiration, demonstrating that tracking is not sensing. We therefore estimate respiratory rate from learned temporal signals extracted from thermal clips and introduce Selective Temporal Attenuation Regularization (STAR). STAR selectively attenuates high-motion thermal discontinuities through local temporal imputation during training, regularizing models toward respiration-consistent dynamics while leaving inference unchanged on raw video. Across multiple deep-learning backbones, STAR improves head-free estimation, reaching 2.23 bpm MAE compared with 20.76 bpm for tracked ROI analysis.

</details>


### [76] [Rescuing Your Pruning: Rethinking Visual Token Pruning and Post-Training Recovery in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33688)
*Peiran Yin,Hao Wu,Zihao Yang,Haozhe Hu,Xudong Wang,Xiaoyu Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究重新审视了视觉标记修剪对模型性能的影响，通过后训练救援大部分损失，并发现视觉编码器在多模态大语言模型中的填充时间占主导地位，从而提出了联合视觉标记压缩的新策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技术在视觉标记修剪方面追求更复杂的规则，而忽视了后训练救援的可能性，作者希望通过研究探索后训练机会的潜力和联合压缩的有效性。

Method: 作者创建了包含282K样本的后训练混合数据集，涵盖了普遍的VQA、推理、OCR和数据建模，并进行了36种配置的后训练实验，以评估修剪的效果。此外，作者研究了不同模块的裁剪对模型性能的影响。

Result: 研究发现，后训练方法可以大幅恢复被修剪模型的性能，特别是在OCR和数据建模任务上。对于联合压缩，视觉编码器的去除比投影器更具优势。最优配置在编码器轻量修剪、投影器强烈修剪的同时保持LLM未受损，从而实现了LLM阶段加速3.49倍但端到端时间加快1.54倍的成果。

Conclusion: 研究建议今后的研究应关注联合视觉标记压缩，尤其是视觉编码器的重要性，并提供了包括数据、协议和代码的开源资源以供参考和验证。

Abstract: Visual token pruning substantially reduces the inference cost of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet existing methods are mostly training-free and plug-and-play. They treat the resulting performance drop as an inevitable cost of compression and pursue increasingly complex pruning rules. We rethink this view through two questions: how much of the loss can post-training rescue, and, building on this recovery, how can joint compression push pruning to its limit? We curate a 282K-sample post-training mixture covering general VQA, reasoning, OCR, and grounding, and post-train 36 configurations that drop or merge tokens under a unified protocol. Post-training rescues most of the loss, even for OCR and grounding, and its adaptation gain in closing the gap between the pruned and the dense model grows as the budget tightens. For joint compression, we find that the vision encoder, not the LLM, dominates prefill time in native-resolution MLLMs, so where tokens are removed matters more than how many: keeping 40% of tokens at the encoder runs faster than keeping 10% at the projector. Our best configuration prunes the encoder lightly and the projector aggressively, leaves the LLM intact, and keeps general understanding and reasoning at the dense level. It accelerates the LLM stage by 3.49x but the end-to-end time-to-first-token by only 1.54x, showing that LLM-stage speedups overstate end-to-end gains. We hope these findings offer insights for future research on joint visual token compression. Our data, protocol, and code will be released.

</details>


### [77] [PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33691)
*Nadun Rajapaksha,Sandun Herath,Devnith Wijesinghe,Isiri Amani Withanawasam,Hasindri Watawana,Ranga Rodrigo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PathKGen 是一种利用知识图谱协助的多模态大型语言模型，用于病理报告生成。它有两个分支：视觉路径和知识路径。视觉路径使用病理基础模型学习视觉标记输入，知识路径通过查询病理特定知识图谱提取关键结构特征。PathKGen 在 WSI-Bench 数据集上的评估表明，它超越了之前的 SOTA 方法，并以直观的图表揭示了诊断推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态大型语言模型在病理报告生成中存在黑盒推理和知识注入不足的问题，PathKGen 旨在通过引入知识图谱增强模型的推理能力并使其更加透明。

Method: PathKGen 使用了两个分支来生成病理报告：视觉路径和知识路径。视觉路径通过学习视觉标记输入来利用病理基础模型，而知识路径则通过查询特定于病理的知识图谱来学习知识标记输入。知识图谱被用于部分外部化医疗知识的存储。

Result: PathKGen 在 WSI-Bench 数据集上的评估表明，它超越了之前的 SOTA 方法，能够以直观的图表揭示诊断推理。

Conclusion: PathKGen 为病理报告生成提供了一种新的模块化方法，知识路径可以配合视觉对齐的多模态大型语言模型并用于其他应用，通过构建特定领域的知识图谱来生成知识标记。

Abstract: Whole Slide Image (WSI) analysis serves as the fundamental method for the clinical diagnosis of cancer in digital histopathology. Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled state-of-the-art (SOTA) automated histopathology report generation. However, MLLMs reason purely through distributions encoded in their neural parameters, limiting the amount of knowledge and reasoning logic they can contain given the model scale. Their black-box reasoning poses another challenge to the human interpretation of intermediate reasoning. We address these issues by utilizing knowledge graphs to inject external structured knowledge for MLLMs to reason over, while making this reasoning component visible. Knowledge graphs are capable of partially externalizing the containment of medical knowledge, an area that remains underexplored in pathology report generation. We introduce PathKGen, a knowledge graph-assisted MLLM for histopathology report generation. PathKGen has two main branches: (1) a visual path that learns visual token inputs to the MLLM using pathology foundation models, and (2) a knowledge path that learns knowledge token inputs by extracting key morphological features of WSIs through querying a pathology-specific knowledge graph. A comprehensive evaluation on WSI-Bench dataset shows that PathKGen surpasses previous SOTA methods while revealing diagnostic reasoning as visually intuitive graphs. Due to its modular design, the proposed knowledge path is complementary to vision-aligned MLLMs and can be extended to other applications by curating domain-specific knowledge graphs to generate knowledge tokens.

</details>


### [78] [Scalable Unrolled Chains for MRI Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33695)
*Emiljo Mëhillaj,Ender Konukoglu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种内存高效训练框架，该框架在保持最终重建损失监督的同时更新随机采样的级联，通过激活轻量级反向传播避免存储整个级联的激活，从而解耦训练内存与级联长度，并通过共享时间条件网络使参数数量与级联长度独立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对加速MRI重建中的变分网络训练问题，当级联数量和宽度增加时，标准端到端训练变得内存密集型。本文提出了一种解决方案，旨在保持训练效率的同时减少内存消耗。

Method: 该方法通过激活轻量级反向传播避免存储整个级联的激活，从而减少内存使用。同时，时间条件网络的共享使得参数数量与级联长度无关。此外，反向传播通过冻结归一化统计进行近似，但训练精确的梯度控制表明，这种近似不会影响重建的质量。

Result: 在快MRI单线圈膝盖和多线圈大脑重建上，该方法在多种加速下均优于其他局部训练方法。在高信噪比膝盖切片上，该方法在8倍加速下超过E2E-VarNet，在4倍加速下与之相当。对于完整的大脑验证集，该方法在8倍加速下超过E2E-VarNet，并在4倍加速下达到类似的表现。实验结果还显示，该方法具有更少的参数、更低的峰值内存和更快的每迭代训练速度。

Conclusion: 综合而言，本文提出的方法有效解决了变分网络在加速MRI重建中的内存问题，提供了更高的效率和性能，同时具有更少的参数和更少的内存占用。

Abstract: Unrolled variational networks achieve state-of-the-art performance for accelerated MRI reconstruction, but standard end-to-end training becomes prohibitively memory intensive as the number and width of cascades increase. We propose a memory-efficient training framework that updates a randomly sampled cascade while retaining supervision from the final reconstruction loss. The error signal is propagated from the end of the chain to the sampled cascade using an activation-light backward pass that avoids storing full chain activations, thereby decoupling training memory from chain length. A time-conditioned network shared across cascades further keeps the parameter count independent of chain length. The backward pass is approximate only through frozen normalization statistics, and a trained exact gradient control shows the approximation leaves reconstruction quality unchanged. The framework remains trainable at chain lengths and cascade widths where standard end-to-end backpropagation exhausts GPU memory. On fastMRI single-coil knee and multi-coil brain reconstruction, our method consistently outperforms other local training approaches. On high-SNR knee slices, our method surpasses E2E-VarNet at $8\times$ and matches it at $4\times$, while on the complete brain validation set it surpasses E2E-VarNet at $8\times$ and achieves comparable performance at $4\times$, with fewer parameters, lower peak memory, and faster per-iteration training. Code is available at https://github.com/emehillaj/scalable-unrolled-mri.

</details>


### [79] [E3tereo: Improving Stereo Matching at Depth Boundaries with Learned Geometric Edges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33704)
*Qi Xiong,Qinghua Zhao,Yongqiang Xi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: E3Stereo通过学习几何边缘并结合边缘和图像细节，提高了场景流数据集上深度边界处的视差精度，同时整体视差误差也降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度边界是立体匹配中的主要误差来源，现有方法如IGEV和MonSter对此处理效果不佳。E3Stereo通过结合几何边缘信息及其他细节改善了边界区域和整体视差精度。

Method: E3Stereo通过使用视差监督信息学习几何边缘，将这些边缘信息与骨干模型预测的视差结果及图像细节相结合，预测高分辨率的视差修正。在训练过程中，边缘图也被用来强化边界错误，通过联合优化使边缘预测器适应视差细化。

Result: E3Stereo在场景流数据集上，相较于RAFT-Stereo、IGEV和MonSter在深度边界处降低了9.5%-14.3%的端点误差(EPE)，同时也减少了总体EPE。经过微调后，基于IGEV的模型在所有ETH3D、KITTI 2012和KITTI 2015的11个报告指标上都优于IGEV。

Conclusion: E3Stereo提供了一种有效的方法来改善深度边界处的立体匹配精度，展示了该方法在多个基准数据集上的优越性。

Abstract: Depth boundaries remain a major source of error in stereo matching. For IGEV on Scene Flow, geometric edge pixels account for only 6% of evaluated pixels but about half of the total absolute disparity error. Photometric edges can respond to texture changes without corresponding depth discontinuities, making them unreliable cues for boundary refinement. We propose E3Stereo, which learns geometric edges from disparity supervision and combines these boundary cues with the backbone disparity and image details to predict full-resolution disparity corrections. The same edge map also emphasizes boundary errors during training, while joint optimization allows the edge predictor to adapt to disparity refinement. On the Scene Flow dataset, E3Stereo reduces end-point error (EPE) at depth boundaries by 9.5%-14.3% across RAFT-Stereo, IGEV, and MonSter, while also reducing overall EPE. After fine-tuning, our IGEV-based model improves upon IGEV on all eleven reported metrics across ETH3D, KITTI 2012, and KITTI 2015. The source code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [80] [Traffic-Context-Aware Driver Emotion Recognition with Expectation-Deviation-Driven Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33713)
*Longhao Yan,Jinhao Liang,Kaidi Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为TADER的交通情境感知驾驶员情绪识别框架，该框架结合了车内视觉信号和外部交通场景，以提高情绪识别的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的驾驶员情绪识别方法主要依赖于车内图像，忽视了外部交通情境对驾驶员情绪反应的影响，因此提出TADER框架来弥补这一不足。

Method: TADER框架包含两个关键组件：1) 一种基于视觉的基本识别器，从车内面部图像中提取时空表示以推断驾驶员情绪；2) 一种交通情境感知融合模块，量化从外部交通情境获得的期望偏差，并通过基于注意力的嵌入融合将其集成到基本识别器中。

Result: 通过引入一种基于预测模型的迁移学习策略来解决车内和车外数据配对稀缺的问题。实验表明，TADER在自然驾驶和模拟驾驶环境中均优于现有方法，情绪识别准确率提高了5%。

Conclusion: TADER框架通过结合车内视觉信号和外部交通场景信息，可以更准确地进行驾驶员情绪识别，对改善人车交互具有重要意义。

Abstract: Driver emotion provides an important indication of how drivers perceive and evaluate ongoing traffic situations, making reliable emotion recognition an important capability for effective human-vehicle interaction. Yet, most existing driver emotion recognition approaches rely primarily on in-cabin images and overlook how surrounding traffic interactions shape driver emotional responses. To address this limitation, we propose a traffic-context-aware driver emotion recognition (TADER) framework that integrates in-cabin signals with out-of-cabin traffic scenarios, modeling driver emotions as arising from expectation deviation represented by the discrepancy between predicted and observed vehicle trajectories. The proposed framework comprises two key components: (1) a vision-based base recognizer that extracts spatiotemporal representations from in-cabin facial images to infer driver emotions, and (2) a traffic-context-aware fusion module that quantifies expectation deviation from external traffic scenarios and integrates it into the base recognizer via attention-based embedding fusion. To overcome the scarcity of paired in-cabin and out-of-cabin data, we introduce a transfer learning strategy that transfers a trajectory prediction model trained on large-scale naturalistic datasets to smaller paired datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TADER consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across both naturalistic and simulated driving environments by incorporating traffic context information into emotion recognition, resulting in improvements of 5% in accuracy on the AIDE and manD datasets.

</details>


### [81] [A SegFormer-based model for spatial Daylight Factor prediction with comprehensive obstruction encoding and regulatory validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33737)
*Stanislava Fedorova,Alejandro Pacheco Diéguez,Christoph Berkmiller,Alberto Floris,Libny Pacheco,Marie-Claude Dubois*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种机器学习方法，可在BIM环境中预测日光因子的空间分布，无需导出模型或手动整理，实现快速评估白天光线合规性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前对于住宅建筑的白天光线合规性评估，需要耗时的射线追踪模拟和专业的模型准备，限制了其在迭代建筑设计中的应用。

Method: 开发了两个机器学习模型：默认材料模型和自定义材料模型，分别针对初步设计评估和项目特定的材料进行优化。通过约20,000个合成Radiance仿真房间和实际建筑模型校准。

Result: 默认材料模型在合成数据上的DF相关性为83.4%，MAE为0.11%；预测能效比（Swedish）合规面积的平均绝对误差为4.85 pp，偏差为+2.31 pp；预测TEK17（Norwegian）房间平均DF的MAE为0.304%，偏差为+0.287% DF。自定义材料模型在所有指标上显示1.7-2.4倍的较高误差。两个模型在DF<1%的合规关键区域内表现优异，误差为0.105%，一致性面积指数为0.883。过度估算的合规情况较为边缘，误差在阈值附近。

Conclusion: 默认材料模型适用于初步设计检查，自定义材料模型需要进一步开发后才能用于最终的合规验证。

Abstract: Daylight compliance assessment in residential buildings requires time-consuming raytracing simulations and specialist model preparation, limiting its integration into iterative architectural design. We present a machine learning-based methodology for predicting the spatial distribution of the Daylight Factor (DF) directly within Building Information Modelling (BIM) environments, delivering results in seconds without model export or manual curation. The approach addresses five gaps not jointly covered by any existing model: external obstruction encoding including balconies, own building height, variable material reflectances, non-orthogonal room geometries, and regulatory validation. Two models are developed: a default-materials model with fixed reflectances for preliminary design checks, and a custom-materials model with variable project-specific reflectances. Both are trained on about 20,000 synthetic Radiance-simulated rooms and validated on a held-out synthetic dataset and 102 rooms from 18 real building models. The default-materials model achieves $δ_1$ = 83.4% and MAE = 0.11% DF on synthetic data, and on real buildings predicts BBR (Swedish) compliance area within 4.85 pp MAE (bias +2.31 pp) and TEK17 (Norwegian) mean room DF within 0.304% DF MAE (bias +0.287% DF). The custom-materials variant shows 1.7-2.4$\times$ higher error across all metrics. Both models concentrate accuracy in the BBR compliance-critical zone (DF < 1%), achieving a sub-1% DF MAE of 0.105% DF and Compliance IoU of 0.883 on real buildings. All cases where compliance is overestimated are borderline, within 10.7 pp of the BBR threshold (median 3.2 pp) and 0.36% DF of the TEK17 threshold (median 0.10% DF). The default-materials model is recommended as a replacement for preliminary daylight simulations; the custom-materials variant requires further development before use in final compliance verification.

</details>


### [82] [Computer Vision Navigation for an Autonomous Vehicle Model Using Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33755)
*Dinis Fernandes,Tiago Ribeiro,António Ribeiro,Carolina Lopes,Gil Lopes,A. Fernando Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文旨在评估一种强化学习算法（PPO）在控制车辆模型行进速度和转向角度方面的潜力，以在模拟道路上行驶。算法在模拟环境中经过训练与测试，表现出了在简化环境中的导航能力，未来研究将集中在增强系统在复杂场景中的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发高效的强化学习算法以提高自动驾驶车辆的控制精度和环境适应性。

Method: 使用Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)算法进行训练，算法接收车辆摄像头的图像帧，通过特征提取算法处理后，生成控制车辆速度和方向的指令。

Result: PPO算法成功生成了能够在模拟环境中有效导航的策略，在某些场景中优于传统算法，且更容易实施，需要调优的超参数较少。

Conclusion: 本研究提供了一个框架，用于测试和比较不同的强化学习方法，并展示了PPO算法在自动驾驶中的应用潜力。

Abstract: This work aims to assess the capabilities of the reinforcement learning algorithm, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), in developing a policy capable of controlling the speed and steering angle of a vehicle model to navigate within simulated road lines.
  The control system's input is a camera, and its outputs are the rotational speed of the rear wheels and the steering angle of the front wheels, controlling the vehicle's speed and direction, respectively. The algorithm is trained and tested in a simulated environment, where it receives image frames from the vehicle's camera, processes them through a feature extraction algorithm, and feeds them into the policy. For each frame, the policy outputs speed and direction commands for the vehicle. The policy is iteratively updated to enhance its performance.
  The reinforcement learning algorithm successfully generates a policy capable of navigating the vehicle in a simplified environment. Potential improvements are suggested to enhance the system's robustness in more complex scenarios.
  Creating a simulation environment suitable for testing an advanced reinforcement learning algorithm is a complex task. This project offers a framework for other developers to test different approaches and algorithms. The tested algorithm, PPO, uses proximity intervals - an innovative approach in reinforcement learning. In some scenarios, the algorithm achieved better performance than predecessor algorithms, which are typically harder to implement and require tuning more hyperparameters.

</details>


### [83] [Road Infrastructure Perception for Autonomous Driving: Taxonomy, Representations, Tasks, and Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33758)
*Guoyang Zhao,Weiqing Qi,Kai Zhang,Zhihai Bi,Tianshuai Hu,Zeying Gong,Dezong Zhao,Jun Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述了道路基础设施感知领域，将其划分为几何结构、功能空间和法规语义三大类，并探讨了传感模态、场景表示、代表性方法、基准测试和评估协议，强调了从图像空间识别向度量、矢量化、拓扑意识、占用率基础和基于规则的场景建模的领域演变。还讨论了当前基准测试的局限性，以及统一基础设施表示、开放环境通用化、关系和规则感知推理以及任务导向评估的未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鉴于道路基础设施感知在自动驾驶中的重要性，该文献旨在通过统一基础设施表示、开放环境通用化、关系和规则感知推理以及任务导向评估等研究方向，推动该领域的进步，从而提升自动驾驶车辆在复杂环境下的安全性和可靠性。

Method: 文献通过划分几何结构、功能空间和法规语义三大类来对道路基础设施感知领域的现状进行概述，并探讨了传感模态、场景表示、代表性方法、基准测试和评估协议，强调了从图像空间识别向度量、矢量化、拓扑意识、占用率基础和基于规则的场景建模的领域演变。

Result: 文献揭示了当前基准测试在相关推理、时间一致性、鲁棒性及面向推理的评估方面的局限性，进一步讨论了未来研究方向，推动道路基础设施感知领域的进步，为自动驾驶技术的发展提供了重要参考。

Conclusion: 综上所述，该文献为道路基础设施感知领域的未来研究提供了有价值的洞察，强调了统一基础设施表示、开放环境通用化、关系和规则感知推理以及下游评估的重要性，以支持更安全、更可靠的自动驾驶自主驾驶场景理解。

Abstract: Road infrastructure perception is a fundamental component of autonomous driving, as it recovers the structured road elements that define roadway geometry, delimit operational space, and encode traffic regulations. Although individual tasks such as lane detection, drivable-space estimation, traffic-sign recognition, and online map construction have been extensively studied, the field remains fragmented across task definitions, sensing assumptions, output representations, datasets, and evaluation protocols. This survey provides a function-oriented synthesis of road infrastructure perception. We first clarify its scope and organize existing studies into three complementary categories: geometric-structural, functional-spatial, and regulatory-semantic infrastructure. Based on this taxonomy, we review sensing modalities, scene representations, representative methods, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols, emphasizing the field's evolution from image-space recognition toward metric, vectorized, topology-aware, occupancy-based, and rule-grounded scene modeling. We further examine how representation choices affect evaluation and downstream usability, revealing limitations of current benchmarks in relation reasoning, temporal consistency, robustness, and planning-oriented assessment. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future directions toward unified infrastructure representation, open-environment generalization, relation- and rule-aware reasoning, and downstream-oriented evaluation. By connecting tasks, representations, and evaluation under a common functional framework, this survey aims to establish road infrastructure perception as a coherent foundation for map-compatible and behavior-relevant autonomous-driving scene understanding.

</details>


### [84] [C-DFF: Concept-Level Diagnostics for Mechanism Parity in Simulation-Based Validation of Autonomous Driving Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33760)
*Danial Safaei,Siddartha Khastgir,Matthew Higgins,Jeroen Ploeg,Mohsen Alirezaei,Son Tong,Ludo Gielen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种概念级机制一致性诊断方法C-DFF，通过将现实和合成的证据投影到共享语义概念空间中进行比较，不仅提供了机制一致性分数，还识别了哪种场景概念在模拟中变得更具或更不具决定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的验证方法依赖于真实和合成图像之间的任务输出匹配，但未必基于相同的视觉证据，特别是在安全关键的感知功能的迁移验证方面存在缺口。C-DFF旨在解决这一问题。

Method: C-DFF方法首先从冻结的系统下测试（SUT）中提取决定性证据，然后将其投影到共享的语义概念空间，通过现成的分割技术将真实和合成的概念重要性向量进行对比。

Result: 在KITTI与虚拟KITTI 2的2126对匹配数据上，C-DFF对三个冻结的SUT进行了评估。结果显示C-DFF具有SUT鉴别能力，并且提供了可解释的概念级概要，支持验证优先级和模拟器调试。将C-DFF与特定任务的输出值上下文度量一起报告时，它表明输出一致性并不能独立地表明机制一致性。

Conclusion: C-DFF作为一种实际的语义诊断层，能够为基于模拟的AV测试提供验证和验证工作流的支持。

Abstract: Simulation is widely used in autonomous-driving validation, but matching task outputs between real and synthetic images does not guarantee that a system relies on the same visual evidence. This creates a validation gap for transfer, especially in safety-critical perception functions. We present Concept-Decisive Feature Fidelity (C-DFF), a concept-level mechanism-parity diagnostic for paired real-synthetic evaluation. Starting from decisive evidence extracted from a frozen system-under-test (SUT), C-DFF projects that evidence into a shared semantic concept space using off-the-shelf segmentation and compares real and synthetic concept-importance vectors. The result is not only a scalar mechanism-parity score, but also a concept-shift diagnostic that identifies which scene concepts become more or less decisive in simulation. We evaluate C-DFF on KITTI $\leftrightarrow$ Virtual KITTI 2 with 2126 matched pairs across three frozen SUTs (steering regression, YOLOP drivable-area, YOLOP lane-line). Across these tasks, C-DFF is SUT-discriminative and yields interpretable concept-level summaries that support validation triage and simulator debugging. When reported alongside task-specific output-value context metrics, C-DFF shows that output agreement does not by itself establish mechanism parity. These results position C-DFF as a practical semantic diagnostic layer for validation and verification workflows in simulation-based AV testing.

</details>


### [85] [Segmentation of Moving Objects During Camera Motion Using the OWL Function](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33789)
*Daniel Raviv,Juan D. Yepes*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种基于OWL感知函数的分析框架，用于单摄像头场景中多独立运动刚体的分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于OWL能够编码视觉运动线索，作者希望直接利用OWL构建分割框架，无需额外训练数据或深度信息，以实现对多刚体运动的精确分析。

Method: 研究基于OWL的2D复数形式，通过引入四元数推导了3D框架，利用每点方向$oldsymbol{ar{t}}$的聚类来实现分割，该方法平行且对于摄像机旋转具有不变性。

Result: 该方法可以不依赖于深度信息、无需训练数据和语义先验，实现对单摄像头下多独立运动刚体的有效分割。

Conclusion: 这种方法提供了一种新颖的分割准则，使得运动物体的识别更加精细和直接。

Abstract: We present a principled, analytical framework for segmenting multiple independently moving rigid objects during single camera motion, built directly upon the OWL perception function. OWL encodes two fundamental visual motion cues, perceived looming $L$ and perceived rotation $ω$, into a single closed-form representation of relative 3D structure. A key consequence of this structure is that the unit direction of relative translation $\hat{t}$ is analytically recoverable per image point from $L$ and $ω$ alone. All points belonging to a non-rotating rigid body share the same $\hat{t}$, whereas points on different rigid bodies generally yield distinct values. This furnishes a natural segmentation criterion: clustering per-point $\hat{t}$ estimates partitions the visible scene into independently moving rigid bodies. Building on the 2D complex form of OWL, we derive the framework in 3D using quaternions, for a single moving camera. The approach is parallel, camera rotation-invariant, and requires no training data, no depth information, and no semantic priors.

</details>


### [86] [Whispers from the Neighbors: Rethinking Caption Consensus as Inference-Time Evidence for Vision-Language Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33798)
*Khang Nhat Hoang Vo,Belal Shoer,Abhirama Subramanyam Penamakuri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了在冻结编码器进行推理时利用图片其他相似描述对于文本到图像检索的影响。使用来自同一标注来源的描述可以显著提升性能，而来自不同来源的描述则几乎没有帮助。进一步研究指出，这种改进来源于正确的候选描述与负样本在支持集大小和查询去除方面的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的图像描述匹配方法通常仅评估图像与单个描述文本对，而忽略了其他描述信息可能带来的贡献。本文研究了这些相邻描述在冻结编码器推理时的作用，以提升图像描述匹配的效果。

Method: 研究通过对比使用相同标注来源的描述、不同标注来源的描述，以及采用特定场景方法（如删除未经解释的部分）的性能差异，分析了利用相邻描述对性能的提升机制。

Result: 研究发现了来自相同标注来源的描述在文本到图像检索中可显著提升性能，提升幅度在3.4%至16.8%之间；而来自不同来源的描述只有轻微的提升（1.9%至7.2%），甚至在某些情况下没有帮助。进一步研究显示，利用描述匹配原始图像的未解释部分可以进一步增强性能。

Conclusion: 研究得出了文本到图像检索表征学习的新方法，认为正确的候选描述与负样本描述在支持集大小和查询去除上的差异是性能提升的主要原因，并且调整了对描述的利用方式（如删除未解释的部分）能够进一步优化效果。这一发现为改进文本到图像检索系统的性能提供了一个潜在的新途径。

Abstract: An image is rarely described only once. Retrieval benchmarks and many collections attach several captions to each picture, yet dual encoders still judge every image-caption pair in isolation. We ask what these neighboring captions contribute when a frozen encoder consults them at inference time. Fusing image similarity with similarity to an image's own captions improves text-to-image R@1 by 3.4 to 16.8 points across nine frozen encoders when the captions come from the same annotators as the queries. The gain falls to 1.9 to 7.2 points when an off-the-shelf captioner writes them, and to at most one point when they come from a different annotation source; a paraphrase-trained text encoder strengthens the text side further. A natural refinement, scoring the part of the image that the captions leave unexplained, appears to add much more under a leave-one-out evaluation. We show that this advantage arises because the correct candidate's supports are built differently from those of the negative candidates, with set size and query removal each contributing about half, and that under a fixed support index the residual reduces to a reweighting of what the captions already provide. On compositional benchmarks, the captions help by matching candidates to human descriptions of the image, without improving image-text grounding. The code is available at: https://github.com/nhatkhangcs/clip_consensus

</details>


### [87] [ProMo3D: Probing Motion Cues in Frozen 3D Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33802)
*Xiaoang Zhang,Mert Kiray,Yordanka Velikova,Manoj Biswanath,Benjamin Busam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了基于探针的运动蒸馏(PMD)方法，利用冻结的3D基础模型令牌提取运动相关线索，实现无监督的4D理解，仅使用少量数据便能显著提高多视图的动态理解任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然3D基础模型在多视角重建方面表现出色，但在动态4D理解中仍然依赖于大规模运动监督或手工地学习解码器，本文探索是否可以从冻结的3D基础模型令牌中提取运动相关信息，以实现更轻量的运动解码。

Method: 通过在三个代表性骨干网络上进行探针分析，发现静态与动态信息可以在冻结的令牌表示中解码。基于此，提出了一种名为PMD的方法，将运动状态兼容性评分转换为密集的运动掩码，无需大规模数据也能实现零样本迁移。

Result: PMD仅使用160个YouTube-VOS视频，在多个数据集上实现了零样本迁移，并且优于不借助基准微调的启发式方法，接近需要更多数据和计算资源的监督和自监督方法。

Conclusion: 证明了从冻结的3D基础模型中提取运动信息的方法是轻量且数据高效的，为动态场景理解提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D foundation models have recently reshaped multi-view reconstruction, yet dynamic 4D understanding still often relies on large-scale motion supervision or hand-crafted, architecture-specific heuristics. We ask whether frozen 3D foundation model tokens already encode motion-relevant information that can be exposed by lightweight readout functions, rather than re-learning motion-specific features with high-capacity decoders. Through probing on three representative backbones, we find that static--dynamic separation is decodable from frozen token representations. Our rank-restricted and spectral analyses on $π^3$X reveal that the recovered motion cues are concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace. Building on this, we propose Probing-based Motion Distillation (PMD), which converts pairwise motion-state compatibility scores against a fixed anchor token into dense motion masks. Trained on only 160 YouTube-VOS videos using a single 16 GB GPU, PMD transfers zero-shot to DAVIS, SegTrackv2, and FBMS-59 without target-benchmark fine-tuning. With multi-view pretrained geometric backbones, PMD outperforms training-free heuristics and approaches substantially heavier supervised and self-supervised methods, suggesting that motion decoding from frozen 3D foundation models can be lightweight and data-efficient.

</details>


### [88] [Grounded Exploration for Open-Ended Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33810)
*Jieyu Zhou,Mehdi Ben Ayed,Shubham Gupta,Zhenyu Tan,Jiajing Xu,Dmitry Kislyuk,Eric Tzeng,Christopher J. MacLellan,Charles Rosenberg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种双阶段框架，首先识别多种可行的编辑范围，然后将其实现为可执行的编辑指令，这种方法在多项测试中表现出了更高的语义多样性和实际相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对开放性图片编辑请求可能导致的不现实变化或表面差异问题，为加强编辑任务的实际相关性和合理性设计了该框架。

Method: 该框架分为两个阶段：第一阶段识别多种可能的、可行的编辑范围；第二阶段将这些范围转化为可执行的编辑指令。

Result: 在300项开放性图片编辑任务中，该方法在语义多样性和实际相关性方面分别比直接多样性提示高出24.6%和17.1%，生成的实现更加有效和独特。

Conclusion: 在实施前对可行的编辑方向进行结构化可以支持更有用的有实际意义的探索。

Abstract: Open-ended image-editing requests, such as ``decorate this room,'' admit multiple valid realizations. Direct sampling may produce ungrounded variation, whereas explicit diversity prompting often produces superficial differences. We study how to ground these requests without prematurely eliminating their legitimate ambiguity. We introduce a two-stage framework that first identifies diverse, feasible edit scopes and then realizes them as executable edit instructions. Across 300 open-ended image-editing tasks, our approach achieves 24.6% higher mean semantic dispersion and 17.1% higher mean groundedness than direct diversity prompting, while producing more valid and distinct realizations. These results show that structuring feasible edit directions before realization supports more useful grounded exploration.

</details>


### [89] [Grounding on Request: Learning Modality Control in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33841)
*Maxime Dassen,Alexander Martin,Andrew Yates,Reno Kriz,William Walden*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过冲突保留的反事实干预评估了视觉-语言模型的模态接地控制能力，发现可以通过学习新词汇并使用反事实监督来提高控制能力，实验证明视觉控制在新闻视频场景下可以得到改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的图像和说明存在争议时，需要一种方法来验证用户是否能够可靠地控制模型遵循哪个模态。常规准确度无法完全解答此问题，因此需要通过反事实干预来评估模态控制能力。

Method: 研究通过引入新的视觉和文本模态词汇，并仅训练其嵌入，保持预训练模型不变。在此基础上，使用配对干预训练方法（CTM）来指导模型如何在请求证据变化时调整答案概率。

Result: 研究发现，通过学习模态词汇和使用反事实监督的方法提高了自然语言指令下的模态控制效果。单个模态的学习嵌入提供了强大的轻量级视觉控制，并且在某些情况下，反事实监督优于标准监督方法。

Conclusion: 这些结果表明，可靠的模态控制不仅需要验证答案是否正确，还需要确保在选择模态的变化时其答案是否保持一致。视觉控制在新闻视频场景下可以得到改善。

Abstract: When an image and its caption disagree, can a user reliably control which one a vision-language model (VLM) follows? Accuracy alone cannot answer this question, since a model might give the correct answer from parametric knowledge without following the requested evidence. We therefore evaluate modality grounding control through conflict-preserving counterfactual interventions. Specifically, Flip measures whether an initially correct answer follows an edit to the requested modality, while Stay measures whether it remains stable when the competing modality is edited. To learn this control, we build on neologism learning by introducing new words for visual and textual grounding, training only their embeddings while keeping the pretrained model fixed.
