We also introduce Counterfactual Twin-Margin (CTM) supervision, which uses paired interventions to teach how answer probabilities should change when the requested evidence changes. Across three VLMs on three existing benchmarks and our multi-attribute Ground-CF benchmark, we find that learned modality words improve control over natural-language instructions. Surprisingly, a single learned embedding per modality provides strong lightweight visual control and shows little average degradation on held-out values. LoRA remains strongest overall, although its visual advantage narrows under held-out evaluation. Moreover, counterfactual supervision improves control in several settings where standard supervision is weaker. Finally, we test our method on real-world news video and find that visual control improves when the relevant evidence is made easier to access. Overall, our results show that reliable modality control requires testing not only whether an answer is correct, but whether it continues to follow edits to the modality of choice.

</details>


### [90] [TrackTok: Object-Centric Video Tokenization with Semantically Persistent Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33857)
*Nhi Pham,Christopher Wewer,Bernt Schiele,Jonas Fischer,Jan Eric Lenssen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TrackTok 通过引入物体中心化的视频分词框架，生成能够跨时间一致编码同一语义对象的令牌，显著减少了所需的潜在令牌数量，并在多种任务中优于传统贴片或现有整体分词器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的基于贴片或现有的整体分词器生成的令牌身份通常与固定图像位置相关联。但是，TrackTok 通过学习跨帧稳定的物体中心化表示，将视觉特征绑定到稳定语义单元上，为下游生成建模提供了更高质量和更高效之间的权衡。

Method: TrackTok 通过学习跨帧稳定的物体中心化表示，并生成可以跨时间一致编码同一语义对象的令牌，实现了比现有方法更紧凑、连续的潜在视频表示。

Result: TrackTok 在 UCF-101 数据集上实现了与条件的生成FVD相当的结果，但只需四分之一的潜在令牌数量，并且在 Kinetics-600 数据集上的帧预测任务中展示了更好的延迟性能并且优于现有的1D分词基线。

Conclusion: 因此，物体对齐和时间持久的分词为可扩展的视频生成提供了一条前景广阔的路径，其中减少潜在令牌数量对于高效的建模至关重要。

Abstract: We introduce TrackTok, an efficient video tokenization framework that produces object-centric tokens, i.e., tokens that consistently encode the same semantic objects across time, even as it moves, deforms, or undergoes partial occlusion. Conventional patch-based or existing holistic tokenizers produce token identities often tied to fixed image locations. In contrast, our approach learns temporally persistent object-centric representations that bind visual features across frames into stable semantic units. This enables substantially more compact, continuous latent video representations, reducing the number of tokens required for downstream generative modeling with state-of-the-art flow models, while preserving the semantic structure needed for high-quality synthesis. Our tokenizer offers a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off. TrackTok achieves comparable class-conditional generative FVD on UCF-101 dataset at 8 times fewer latent tokens and better latency, and outperforms existing 1D tokenization baselines on frame prediction task on Kinetics-600 across low token budgets. These results suggest that object-aligned and temporally persistent tokenization is a promising direction for scalable video generation, where reducing latent token counts is critical for efficient modeling. Our code for this work is available at https://github.com/phamleyennhi/tracktok.

</details>


### [91] [Late Breaking Results: Audio-Language-Action Models with Direct Speech Conditioning for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33866)
*Enfu Nan,Pu Zhao,Yixiao Chen,Lin Zhao,Juyi Lin,Chen Wang,Weiwei Chen,Yanzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了Speech-$π_{0.5}$，一种直接将原始语音映射到运动命令的方法，无需显式的文本转录。此方法减少了响应延迟，同时保持了任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的将语音识别前置到VLA的方法会增加额外的延迟并传播错误，因此需要一种新的方法来直接处理语音并减少延迟。

Method: 基于$π_{0.5}$构建，通过跨模态投影将语音帧直接转换为音频标记，采用两阶段训练并引入分割LoRA适应，其中包括专门的音频和任务适配器。

Result: 在LIBERO中，Speech-$π_{0.5}$相较于ASR管道降低了3倍的响应延迟，并保持了竞争力的任务成功率。此外，该方法在未见过的口音上表现出较好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: Speech-$π_{0.5}$展示了在不需要显式文本转换的情况下，直接处理语音的优势，并在多个方面实现了性能的提升。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to follow instructions in typed text, limiting broader deployment in natural speech. The traditional solution by prepending a speech recognition before VLA to convert speech into texts would incur additional latency and propagate errors. To address this, we present Speech-$π_{0.5}$, which maps raw speech directly to motor commands without explicit textual transcriptions. Specifically, built on $π_{0.5}$, we use a cross-modal projection to convert voice frames directly into audio tokens with significant response latency reduction. To further improve the accuracy, we adopt split LoRA adaptation with dedicated audio and task adapters, under a two-stage training. Speech-$π_{0.5}$ achieves $3\times$ lower response latency than ASR pipeline while maintaining competitive task success on LIBERO, and generalizes robustly to unseen accents where a single adapter degrades significantly.

</details>


### [92] [RelateGS: Reliable Semantic and Relational Evidence for 3D Scene Understanding with Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33868)
*Seongjun Choi,Sangyoun Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RelateGS 是一种结构化的语言感知高斯表示，它有选择地细化语义和关系证据以进行 3D 视觉定位。该方法在处理不可靠观察和补充稀观察对象关系方面表现出色，从而提高了现有的最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的 3D 背景建模方法不足以提供可靠的证据来解决目标消歧问题，特别是当对象关系在可用的摄像头路径下未能被良好观察时。

Method: RelateGS 方法首先对语义特征进行升级，并抑制不可靠观察，然后将多视角的观测对象整合到一个持久的 3D 图中，并识别未观察到的对象关系，以引导查询补充信息。

Result: 实验结果表明，RelateGS 的 3D 定位性能具有竞争力，分别在 Sr3D+ 和 Nr3D 上将之前的最好结果提高了 7.9 和 1.7 个百分点，准确率分别为 Acc@0.25。

Conclusion: RelateGS 成功地通过对语义和关系证据的选择性细化提高了 3D 定位的准确性，能够处理不可靠观察并补充未观察到的对象关系，从而改进了以往的方法。

Abstract: Language-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has advanced language-driven 3D scene understanding by incorporating semantic and relational cues into reconstructed scenes. However, relation-aware grounding depends not only on representing such information, but also on whether the underlying scene-side evidence is reliable and sufficient. Multi-view semantic aggregation can incorporate weak observations, while object relations can remain under-observed along the available camera trajectory, leading to ambiguous evidence for target disambiguation. We present RelateGS, a structured language-aware Gaussian representation that selectively refines semantic and relational evidence for 3D visual grounding. RelateGS suppresses unreliable observations during semantic feature uplifting and consolidates multi-view object observations into a persistent 3D graph. The graph further identifies under-observed object relations and guides targeted re-querying of informative existing frames to complement their evidence. Experiments on Sr3D+ and Nr3D demonstrate competitive 3D grounding performance, improving the previous best by 7.9 and 1.7 percentage points at Acc@0.25, respectively.

</details>


### [93] [Semantic Concept Steering Breaks the Explanation Drift Loop in Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33877)
*Yehonatan Elisha,Oren Barkan,Noam Koenigstein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究解决了连续学习中未被识别的结构缺陷，通过引入C$^3$L方法，消除自我参考偏移循环，实现了对概念的一致正则化，从而提高了模型的解释质量、减少了灾难性遗忘，并增强了对异常分布的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为解决连续学习中存在但未被充分认识的解释偏差问题，该研究旨在提升模型的解释能力和对抗灾难性遗忘。

Method: 该研究提出了一种基于概念一致性的连续学习方法（C$^3$L），利用了跨实例的语义一致性，并借助近似归因方法（LRP）来减少无用的相关性，从而增强了模型的稳定性和解释性。

Result: 实验结果显示，相较于20个基线方法，C$^3$L在准确度、解释质量、消除无用相关性以及分布外鲁棒性方面均取得了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的方法能够在保持较高准确度的同时，有效减轻解释偏差和灾难性遗忘，提高了连续学习模型的鲁棒性和解释性，为该领域的深入研究提供了新思路。

Abstract: Catastrophic forgetting in continual learning (CL) manifests not only as accuracy degradation but also as \emph{explanation drift}: models maintain predictive accuracy while silently shifting attention from diagnostic features to spurious correlations. This work identifies and resolves a previously overlooked structural flaw in explanation-aware CL: pixel-level saliency regularization derives supervision targets from the model's own frozen saliency maps, creating a \emph{self-referential drift loop} that actively reinforces spurious attention across tasks. We introduce \textbf{C$^3$L} (Concept-Consistent Continual Learning), which breaks this loop by anchoring regularization to class-consistent semantic concepts (e.g., ``curved beak'', ``striped pattern'') discovered offline, independent of model state, providing (i) target independence from model drift, and (ii) cross-instance semantic consistency across every instance of a class. We identify that our concept-based objective, combined with approximate LRP relevance conservation, induces a \emph{crowding-out effect}: since concept and background regions compete for the relevance of the same prediction, enforcing high relevance within concept regions implicitly suppresses spurious background correlations without explicit penalization. \method does not require human-annotated concept sets, as it employs a fully automated concept discovery and spatial grounding. Extensive evaluation across five benchmarks and over 20 baselines demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in accuracy, forgetting, explanation quality, spurious correlation mitigation, and out-of-distribution robustness.

</details>


### [94] [WMEval: Evaluating Interactive World Models Grounded on Physical Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33894)
*Lanxiang Hu,Yixin Huang,Abhilash Shankarampeta,Zilin Dai,Yuyuan Wu,Kun Qian,Junze Liu,Arvind Srinivasan,Mingjia Huo,Will Lin,Kai Zhong,Weiqi Zhang,Tian Wang,Qingjun Cui,Tajana Rosing,Hao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WMEval 是一个全新的基准测试，用于评估交互式世界模型与Unity物理模拟的对比，强调物理因果一致性，而非仅关注感知相似性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基准测试主要关注感知相似性而不是真实的物理因果一致性，这在实际应用中至关重要。WMEval 的引入旨在填补这一空白。

Method: WMEval 使用 Unity 作为高保真度的基准，执行匹配的动作序列来评估模型，同时从模拟器中获取状态作为参考，以实现对感知和物理因果层面的评估。

Result: 实验发现，现阶段最先进的模型在保留真实功能方面仍有显著改进空间，尤其是那些标准感知指标未能揭示的领域。

Conclusion: WMEval 提供了一种新的方法来评估交互式世界模型的实际应用能力，并期待借此促进相关领域的技术进步。

Abstract: Interactive world models hold immense potential for high-stakes applications in robotics, game engines, and immersive digital twins, yet existing benchmarks primarily focus on perceptual similarity rather than the physical-causal coherence essential for real-world utility. We introduce WMEval, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates interactive world models against Unity-based physical simulations. By leveraging Unity as a high-fidelity ground-truth oracle, we shift evaluation beyond perceptual visual assessment toward the objective state-based verification required for downstream applications. Spanning 9 diverse scenes, WMEval assesses action controllability, scene and character consistency, prompt adherence, kinematics, fluid mechanics, physical causality, and lighting. By executing matched action sequences in both the simulator and the world model, WMEval enables evaluation at both the perceptual level and the physical-causal level, using simulator-derived states as reference. Experiments on state-of-the-art models reveal significant room for improvement in dimensions that remain hidden by standard perceptual metrics but are vital for real-world deployments. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/WMEval.

</details>


### [95] [Rank-1 Weight-Corrected Trainable Weight Averaging for Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33909)
*Akito Shinohara,Hiroaki Aizawa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为TWA的方法，它通过使用SVD提取的领先秩一权重组件作为校正方向，来改进模型的泛化能力，从而提高OUD检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于权重平均直接在参数空间进行操作并提高模型泛化，因此从主导成分的角度考虑权重平均用于OUD检测。

Method: 引入了TWA方法，通过为每个检查点分配单一系数以限制对主导权重组件的独立控制，同时利用SVD提取的领先秩一权重组件作为校正方向，这些方向的贡献是通过分类目标进行学习的。

Result: 该方法在ResNet50上，在不同的数据集和评价值体系（如MSP和RankWeight）下，比微调和标准TWA具有更好的表现。

Conclusion: Mahalanobis基的评估显示结果具有不确定性，表明其倚赖于OUD评分协议；基于MSP和Energy的目标层分析结果显示校正更接近于分类器。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection identifies inputs outside the training distribution. Rank-based analyses such as RankFeat and RankWeight suggest that OOD overconfidence is closely related to dominant low-rank components in feature and weight spaces. Since weight averaging operates directly in parameter space and improves model generalization, we consider it for OOD detection from a dominant-component perspective. Trainable Weight Averaging (TWA) assigns a single coefficient to each checkpoint, limiting independent control of dominant weight components. We extend TWA with leading rank-one weight components extracted by Singular Value Decomposition as correction directions, whose contributions are learned through the in-distribution classification objective. On ResNet50, our method improves over fine-tuning and standard TWA across the evaluated datasets with MSP and RankWeight, both with and without Outlier Exposure. Mahalanobis-based evaluation yields mixed results, indicating that the benefit depends on the OOD scoring protocol. Target-layer analyses with MSP and Energy favor correction near the classifier.

</details>


### [96] [Texture-Aware Strategies for Subregion Style Transfer Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33910)
*Cheng Ji,Yu Zhao,Xiaochong Jiang,Wenting Yang,Shiqi Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种纹理感知的子区域风格增强框架，该框架优先选择具有强烈纹理响应的区域进行风格替换，并结合纹理驱动区域和辅助随机区域的混合策略，以实现更多的样式变化。实验表明，该方法在分类准确性和鲁棒性上优于现有的基于风格的增强方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的数据增强方法依赖于均匀随机区域选择或固定的几何约束，这可能导致重要纹理模式的遗漏，从而限制了增强的多样性。

Method: 该研究首先通过采用纹理感知的子区域选择策略，识别出具有较强纹理响应的区域进行风格替换。进一步地，提出了混合区域策略，结合了纹理驱动区域和随机区域，从而增加了风格变换的多样性。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提出的方法在分类精度和鲁棒性方面均优于现有的基于风格的数据增强方法。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了一种创新的纹理感知风格增强框架，通过识别具有强纹理响应的区域进行风格替换，并通过混合区域策略增强了增强的多样性，从而提高了模型的性能。

Abstract: A common strategy for data augmentation is to apply style transfer on training images to enrich appearance variations. Recent approaches have combined style augmentation with random erasing by selectively replacing image subregions with style-transferred patches. However, existing methods rely on uniformly random region selection or fixed geometric constraints, which may fail to cover informative texture patterns and limit augmentation diversity. To address these limitations, we propose a texture-aware subregion style augmentation framework that prioritizes regions with strong texture responses for style replacement. Furthermore, we extend this framework with a hybrid region strategy that combines a texture-driven region with an auxiliary random region, implicitly enabling more diverse style perturbations. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves higher classification accuracy and improves robustness compared with existing style-based augmentation methods.

</details>


### [97] [TurboWAM: Learning What Matters for Fast World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33941)
*Guile Wu,Shuangzhi Li,Xingxin Chen,Chengjie Huang,Sam Hosseini,Tongtong Cao,Yingxue Zhang,Dongfeng Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TurboWAM是一种高效聚合结构化世界表示的动作模型，它通过自适应融合不同世界模型层的相关性，减少执行的层数并缓存相关表示，实现了低推理延迟，同时保持与先进方法相当的任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对世界动作模型在实际部署中因高推理延迟带来的瓶颈问题，TurboWAM通过自适应融合不同世界模型层的相关性、减少执行的层数并缓存相关表示，来降低计算开销，提高推理效率。

Method: TurboWAM采用了结构化的世界表示聚合模块和有结构的动作监督机制。聚合模块根据不同世界模型层与动作预测相关性自适应地融合表示；监督机制则在反向传播过程中自适应地调节来自不同世界模型层的动作监督梯度，促进世界表示的学习。在推理阶段，通过减少执行的层数和缓存相关表示，进一步降低计算开销。

Result: 实验结果表明，TurboWAM在多个机器人操纵基准测试中实现了低推理延迟，同时保持了与现有最佳方法相近的任务成功率。

Conclusion: TurboWAM提出了一种改进世界动作模型推理效率的方法，通过自适应聚合和监督机制，以及缓存相关表示，显著减少了计算开销，在实际应用中展现了良好的潜在应用前景。

Abstract: World action models have demonstrated promising performance in robot policy learning, yet their high inference latency remains a critical bottleneck for real-world deployment. Recent approaches have sought to improve inference efficiency by reducing test-time future-frame imagination or accelerating action prediction. However, these methods often leverage representations from all video world model layers without explicitly considering their varying relevance to action prediction, leading to redundant computation and suboptimal representation utilization. In this work, we propose TurboWAM, a fast world action model that efficiently aggregates structured world representations conditioned on action predictions. Specifically, TurboWAM introduces a structured world representation aggregation module that adaptively fuses representations from different world model layers according to their relevance to the evolving action denoising state. Furthermore, TurboWAM employs a structured action supervision mechanism that adaptively modulates gradients from action supervision across different world model layers during backward propagation, facilitating world representation learning. During inference, by reducing the number of world model layers executed and caching relevant representations across action denoising steps, TurboWAM substantially reduces computational overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple robot manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that TurboWAM achieves low inference latency while maintaining competitive task success rates compared with state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [98] [Accuracy Is Not Enough: An Efficiency- and Statistics-Aware Benchmark of ResNet50 and Vision Transformer for Explainable Multi-Class Gastrointestinal Diseases Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33965)
*Akwasi Asare*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究比较了在公共Kvasir数据集上使用ResNet50和ViT-B/16进行八类胃肠分类的性能，结果显示两者在准确性和效率上存在差异，但效果较为接近。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本研究旨在通过公开数据集对现有的图像识别模型进行系统性评估，在自动早期诊断领域寻找高效、准确且适合资源受限环境的模型。

Method: 研究利用Kvasir数据集开展5折交叉验证实验，统计模型准确率、参数量、计算复杂度、延迟及吞吐量等指标，对比ResNet50和ViT-B/16的区别。

Result: 研究发现，ResNet50和ViT-B/16在八类胃肠分类任务上的准确率相似，但ViT-B/16在参数和计算上更为高效。MobileViT-S在未遮挡时具有最高准确度，但在遮挡特定干扰时表现下降。

Conclusion: 本研究表明，ResNet50由于其高效性成为资源受限场景下的首选模型，但所有模型在不同数据集上的表现存在差异，需依赖具体环境进行验证后方能投入使用。

Abstract: Automated classification of gastrointestinal (GI) findings in endoscopic images could support early diagnosis, but architectures are often chosen on accuracy alone. We present a controlled, reproducible benchmark of ResNet50 and ViT-B/16 for eight-class GI classification on the public Kvasir dataset (4,000 images), using a stratified split (400 test images) and stratified group 5-fold cross-validation over all images. In cross-validation, ResNet50 and ViT-B/16 reached 92.12% and 91.70% accuracy, and a two one-sided tests (TOST) procedure showed equivalence within a +/-3 percentage-point margin (difference +0.43 points, 90% CI -0.33 to +1.18; p < 0.001). The architectures differed mainly in cost: ResNet50 had 3.6 times fewer parameters and 4.3 times fewer operations, 2.5-fold lower single-image CPU latency (69 vs. 177 ms) and 3.8-fold higher GPU throughput. Cross-validated calibration was similar (expected calibration error 0.021 vs. 0.023). An edge-oriented transformer, MobileViT-S, was most accurate on the test split (95.5%) but lost 9.4 points when an acquisition artefact present in some classes (the ScopeGuide inset) was occluded, whereas ResNet50 was not significantly affected. On 500 unseen polyp images with expert masks, both models' Grad-CAM maps focused on the lesion (3.6 times chance). On a de-duplicated external subset of GastroVision (1,998 images), accuracy fell to 78-80% for all three models and differences between them remained small. Accuracy differences between architectures were thus small relative to the effects of shortcut learning and domain shift, whereas efficiency differences were large. An efficient CNN is a defensible default for resource-constrained screening, but no model is deployment-ready without local validation.

</details>


### [99] [Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Network for Single-Shot 3D Reconstruction from Fringe Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33988)
*Xinjie Zhou,XiaoLei Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为Mamba Transformer的新网络，用于条形到高度回归。该网络采用了Swin基于U形架构，并在中间分辨率编码阶段引入了视觉状态空间建模。进一步开发了轴向和扩张视觉状态空间(ADVSS)块，增强了前扫描特征编码，同时保留了四向选择性扫描，从而实现了准确的一次成像FPP重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了克服现有的基于卷积和基于窗口的Transformer的单帧三维重构中的局限性，该论文提出了一种新的网络方法以提高表面高度的恢复精度。

Method: 研究提出了一种混合Mamba Transformer网络，结合了基于Swin的U形架构和视觉状态空间建模。并在中间分辨率编码阶段采用轴向和扩张视觉状态空间(ADVSS)块，通过局部、扩张和轴向深度卷积来增强前扫描特征编码。

Result: 在公共可用的FPP数据集上进行的实验表明，该方法在平均绝对误差(MAE)、均方根误差(RMSE)、绝对相对误差、结构相似性指数测量(SSIM)方面优于hNet、SwinConvUNet、UHRNet和HiDNet。使用单一变形条形图，该方法实现了RMSE为0.548毫米和SSIM为0.9985，分别比UHRNet和HiDNet减少了65.2%和59.6%。

Conclusion: 研究表明，结合选择性的状态空间建模与分层窗口基于的注意力可用于准确的一次成像FPP重构。

Abstract: Deep learning facilitates rapid single shot three dimensional (3D) reconstruction using fringe projection profilometry (FPP), but recovering accurate surface height from a single high frequency fringe image remains challenging because both long-range spatial consistency and fine geometric details must be preserved. Convolutional networks are limited in modeling long range dependencies, whereas window-based Transformers establish global interactions only progressively with increasing depth. To address these limitations, a hybrid Mamba Transformer network is proposed for fringe to height regression. The network adopts a Swin based U shaped architecture and introduces visual state space modeling at the intermediate resolution encoder stage. An axial and dilated vision state space (ADVSS) block is further developed to enhance prescan feature encoding through local, dilated, and axial depthwise convolutions while retaining four directional selective scanning. This design combines linear complexity long range modeling with direction aware preservation of local fringe structures. Experiments on a publicly available FPP dataset show that the proposed method outperforms hNet, SwinConvUNet, UHRNet, and HiDNet in mean absolute error(MAE), root mean square error (RMSE), absolute relative error, and structural similarity index measure (SSIM). Using only one deformed fringe image, the proposed method achieves an RMSE of 0.548 mm and an SSIM of 0.9985, reducing RMSE by 65.2% and 59.6% relative to UHRNet and HiDNet, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining selective state space modeling with hierarchical window based attention for accurate single-shot FPP reconstruction.

</details>


### [100] [Explaining Navigation Decisions: Stage-Aware Visual Attribution for Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34028)
*Yiyuan Yao,Xinpeng Ding,Minglei Chen,Fei Gao,Lihuo He,Jie Yuan,Aijun Li,Nannan Wang,Xinbo Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种阶段感知的归因框架，以提升Vision-Language Navigation（VLAN）模型的解释质量，并展示了其在实际导航任务中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着Vision-Language Models（VLMs）在机器人执行语言指令方面的应用越来越广泛，研究其导航决策的可解释性变得尤为重要。

Method: 研究通过构建基于行动的阶段感知时间指令-视觉归因，将这些归因投影到指令空间以估计阶段关联，指导相关历史证据的聚合以优化当前解释。此外，使用指令引导的空间过滤器抑制孤立响应，保留与指令相关的紧凑区域。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法在多个VLAN策略和基准测试中提高了归因质量。此外，还证明了该方法可以作为诊断工具来分析失败案例，并已在Unitree G1机器人上的真实导航任务中得到验证。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的方法在解释VLAN模型的导航决策方面表现出色，并提高了实际导航任务的鲁棒性和可靠性。

Abstract: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly enable robots to follow language instructions, understanding their navigation decisions becomes important for reliable deployment. Existing explainability methods overlook a key challenge in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN): evidence for the current action may be distributed across historical and current observations and associated with different instruction stages. We identify instruction-stage insensitivity, where existing methods produce similar explanations despite changes across different navigation stages. To address this issue, we propose a stage-aware attribution framework for VLN. We first construct action-conditioned temporal instruction--visual attributions across observations. These attributions are projected into instruction space to estimate stage associations, which guide the aggregation of relevant historical evidence for refining the current explanation. An instruction-guided spatial filter further suppresses isolated responses while preserving compact, instruction-relevant regions. Experiments across multiple VLN policies and benchmarks show improved attribution quality over existing methods. We further demonstrate that our method acts as a diagnostic tool for analyzing failure cases, and validate its applicability to real-world navigation on a Unitree G1 robot.

</details>


### [101] [Fovea-JEPA: Overcoming Geometric Blind Spots in V-JEPA for Camera Motion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34033)
*Xiangkun Shi,Hanhui Li,Shiyue Zhang,Chang Liu,Junwen Pan,Zhenbang Sun,Xiaodan Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Fovea-JEPA通过使用V-JEPA和VGGT模型的预测误差来识别并干预几何盲点，从而改进相机运动识别任务的几何线索，相比之前的技术表现更佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于视频-语言模型难以处理几何信息，而现有模型如V-JEPA虽然提供强时空表示，但在某些区域几何线索不足。因此提出Fovea-JEPA模型来解决此问题。

Method: 使用V-JEPA作为基础模型及VGGT作为几何专家，从其预测错误中生成干预伪标签，构造盲点预测器。该预测器产生token级响应图，最终汇集成剪辑级干预评分，指导视觉和几何特征的适配性融合。

Result: Fovea-JEPA模型在CameraMotionDataset、CameraBench和ShotBench上的表现显著提高，分别超过之前SOTA基准9.67%、8.67%和24.38%。

Conclusion: Fovea-JEPA模型通过识别和弥补几何盲点，有效提高了相机运动识别任务中的几何线索，展现了其在该任务中的优越性能。

Abstract: Camera motion recognition requires separating viewpoint changes caused by camera translation, rotation, or zoom from object motion and scene dynamics. Video-language models often rely on semantic cues and struggle with the geometric evidence needed for this task. Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures such as V-JEPA offer strong spatio-temporal representations, but our experiments suggest that they underrepresent geometric cues in some regions. Under temporal-reversal supervision, V-JEPA improves overall but degrades on several motion families, whereas a weaker geometry-oriented VGGT predictor improves across all families. We refer to these geometrically underrepresented regions as geometric blind spots and propose Fovea-JEPA to identify and address them. Using V-JEPA as the base model and VGGT as a geometry expert, we construct intervention pseudo-labels from their prediction errors to weakly supervise a blind-spot predictor. The predictor produces token-wise response maps, which are aggregated into a clip-level intervention score to guide adaptive fusion of visual and geometric features. This selective intervention introduces complementary geometric information while preserving reliable visual predictions. Experiments on CameraMotionDataset, CameraBench, and ShotBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Fovea-JEPA, with gains of 9.67, 8.67, and 24.38 percentage points over previously reported state-of-the-art baselines, respectively. Code and models will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [102] [What Sketches Tell Us about LVLMs: Conventions, Grounding, and Localisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34037)
*Chaitat Utintu,Ahmed Bourouis,Arkaprabha Basu,Yi-Zhe Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 文章提出了一个无需微调的草图探针，通过三个输出：时间部分构建顺序、基于空间注意力的定位和接地机制层/头所在地，评估了九个LVLM和五个LVLM在部分顺序及注意力读数上的表现，发现了LVLM遵循人类绘制的顺序、部分级别的接地在草图抽象中存活、接地信号集中在网络的中间区域等三个主要发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LVLM基准只能告诉我们模型回答是否正确，但无法显示模型保留了哪些视觉策略以及这些策略存在于哪里。通过引入草图探针，可以揭示隐藏的结构，帮助深入理解模型的视觉处理过程。

Method: 研究中设计了一个无需训练的草图探针，包含三个读取模块：时间部分构建顺序、基于空间注意力的定位和接地机制层/头所在地。实验使用了两个部分标注的草图数据集来评估九个LVLM的部分顺序以及五个LVLM的注意力读数。

Result: 结果表明LVLM的部分顺序与人类绘制法相吻合，部分定位在草图抽象中仍保持存活，定位信号集中在网络的中间区域，该结果提供了一种实用的用于评估LVLM的诊断方法，无需调优且层区间集本身可作为头选择先验。

Conclusion: 总之，研究证明了草图探针的有效性，不仅可以帮助发现LVLM的视觉策略，还可以提高模型的地面真值准确性，这为后续研究LVLM中的视觉策略提供了新的视角。

Abstract: LVLM benchmarks tell us whether a model answers correctly, but not which visual conventions it has retained, nor where those conventions live. Sketches expose this hidden structure. A sketch removes texture, lighting, and photographic context while preserving the strokes humans judged sufficient for recognition. If an LVLM can operate on that abstraction, the surviving signal is structural rather than merely photometric. We introduce a training-free sketch probe with three readouts: temporal part-construction order, spatial attention-based grounding, and the mechanistic layer/head locus of grounding. We evaluate nine LVLMs on part order and five on the attention readouts, over two part-annotated sketch datasets. Three findings emerge. First, LVLM part order tracks human convention: models reproduce canonical orderings where human drawings converge, and become correspondingly variable where human orderings vary. Controls that blank, withhold, and mismatch the sketch locate this convention in the language model. Second, part-level grounding survives the abstraction: attention heads selected from the frozen model with an existing recipe recover part and object regions on object and scene sketches, with no grounding supervision. Third, the grounding signal concentrates in a narrow mid-network band whose location follows the base language model rather than parameter count in the two families we compare, and remains stable across object and scene sketches. The result is a practical diagnostic for sketch-driven LVLMs: no fine-tuning, no auxiliary segmenter, and a layer band that doubles as a head-selection prior, matching or improving grounding mAcc@0.1 in every model and dataset we tested.

</details>


### [103] [Learning the Autoregressive: Direct Score-Difference Estimation with Amortized Future Credit for Video Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34092)
*Zixuan Duan,Yabo Chen,Xunzhi Xiang,Xin Zhang,Haibin Huang,Yin Chen,Chi Zhang,Qi Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Leta提出了一种新的多步骤蒸馏框架，通过ScoreDelta和FutureCredit直接估计教师-学生修正并学习跨帧更新信号，从而提高了AR视频生成的质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的多步蒸馏方法通过间接估计全学生分数来获得修正方向，且使用断开的历史训练，这限制了生成器对当前部分对其后续部分影响的归因能力。Leta旨在解决这些问题，以提升模型性能。

Method: Leta引入了ScoreDelta和FutureCredit两个组件：ScoreDelta直接从去噪残差估计教师-学生修正，而FutureCredit学习从下一个部分教师残差的向量-雅可比产品中获取跨帧更新的辅助信号。这两种信号在生成器更新时合并成一个联合教师引导的更新场。教师评估和信用雅可比产品仅用于估算器训练。

Result: 在控制实验中，Leta在VideoAlign和VBench上的性能提高了0.9点和0.66点，即使在更高的生成器更新频率（生成器与估计器更新比为1:1）下，Leta在VideoAlign上提高了1.6点，VBench提高了0.35点。

Conclusion: Leta展示了直接估计教师-学生修正和学习跨帧更新信号的有效性，为自动驾驶场景中的视频帧间一致性提供了改进的方法。

Abstract: Few-step distillation for autoregressive (AR) video generation commonly first initializes an AR student and then refines it with distribution matching distillation (DMD). This refinement process faces two challenges. First, although initialization already yields a reasonably capable student, DMD obtains the refinement direction indirectly by estimating the full student score before forming the teacher-student correction. Second, detached-history training prevents the generator from assigning credit to a current chunk for its influence on subsequent chunks. We introduce Leta, a few-step distillation framework that addresses these challenges with ScoreDelta and FutureCredit. ScoreDelta directly estimates the teacher-student correction from denoising residuals, while FutureCredit learns an auxiliary cross-chunk update signal from vector-Jacobian products (VJPs) of next-chunk teacher residuals. Leta combines these signals into a joint teacher-guided update field in a single forward pass during generator updates. Teacher evaluations and credit VJPs are used only for estimator training. For ScoreDelta, we establish population equivalence to score-difference estimation and a conditional approximation advantage under limited capacity in a fixed-feature linear model. In our controlled experiments, Leta improves over DMD by 0.9 points on VBench and 0.66 on VideoAlign. This advantage persists at a higher generator update frequency (a generator-to-estimator update ratio of G:E=1:1), where Leta improves over DMD by 1.6 on VBench and 0.35 on VideoAlign. Project page: https://scdzx.github.io/Leta/.

</details>


### [104] [LegoOcc++: Towards Consistent Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34093)
*Changqing Zhou,Yueru Luo,Han Zhang,Zeyu Jiang,Changhao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种在无需昂贵体素级语义注释的情况下预测开放词汇3D占用的方法。通过利用语言嵌入的高斯表示连接3D几何与对齐的语义，该研究引入了几何感知的体积聚合及语义学习中的渐进温度衰减等技术，提升了室内和室外场景中开放词汇3D占用预测的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前3D占用预测往往依赖于昂贵的体素级语义注释，这对复杂环境中的开放词汇预测构成挑战。该研究旨在探索一种只需二元占用标签的几何监督方法，以减少对体素级语义注释的需求，提高在室内和室外复杂环境中的预测性能。

Method: 该研究构建了语言嵌入的高斯表示作为统一表示，结合3D几何与对齐的语言语义。对于几何学习，引入了几何感知的Poission高斯到占用的公式，实现二元占用监督下的稳定体积聚合。对于语义学习，将高斯特征渲染成图像并与冻结的开放词汇模型对齐，使用渐进温度衰减减少高斯插值中的特征混合。此外，进一步引入实例级语义一致性及共视支持视图选择技术，以提供更具信息量且冗余性较低的多视图语义监督。同时将方法扩展到户外驾驶场景以评估其在不同环境中的一般性。

Result: 在室内和室外基准数据集上进行的大量实验表明，该方法在开放词汇3D占用预测方面取得了强大的性能。实验证明了该框架的有效性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了一种无需昂贵体素级语义注释的开放词汇3D占用预测方法，该方法在几何和语义学习中的新颖技术和对现有数据集的扩展验证了其在不同环境中的优越性能，为复杂环境中开放词汇的预测开辟了新的途径。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction is important for embodied agents operating in complex environments whose semantic categories extend beyond fixed taxonomies. While recent studies have explored open-vocabulary occupancy in outdoor driving scenarios, indoor environments remain challenging due to dense occlusions, complex geometry, and fine-grained long-tailed semantics. To reduce the need for expensive voxel-level semantic annotations, we study a geometry-only supervision setting requiring only binary occupancy labels. We build upon Language-Embedded Gaussians as a unified representation coupling 3D geometry with language-aligned semantics. For geometry learning, we introduce an opacity-aware Poisson-based Gaussian-to-Occupancy formulation that enables stable volumetric aggregation under binary occupancy supervision. For semantic learning, we render Gaussian features into images and align them with a frozen open-vocabulary model, together with Progressive Temperature Decay to reduce feature mixing during Gaussian splatting. Building on this framework, we further introduce Instance-Level Semantic Consistency to alleviate fragmented object predictions, and Covisibility-Aware Support-View Selection to provide informative and less redundant multi-view semantic supervision. We also extend our framework to outdoor driving scenarios to evaluate its generality across substantially different environments. Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves strong open-vocabulary occupancy performance, validating the effectiveness and generality of our framework. Code will be available at https://github.com/JuIvyy/LegoOcc.

</details>


### [105] [StickFigure: Enabling Pose-Only IoT Cameras for Privacy-Preserving Edge Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34130)
*Aveline Xiaoyuan Han,Chenshu Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StickFigure 是一种仅导出色点流的物联网相机系统，可在保护隐私的同时实现实时人体动作识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的室内物联网（IoT）相机可能会暴露敏感信息，而StickFigure旨在仅导出色点流以减少对隐私的影响。

Method: StickFigure采用了激活感知的姿势骨干网，这是一种在空间下采样后，根据通道能力分配资源的设计。同时，还提出了一种轻量级的分层MLP细化器，用于根据中间视觉特征和运动学上下文选择性地纠正肘部和手腕坐标。

Result: 与现有的微型控制器（MCU）姿势模型相比，StickFigure在NTU RGB+D 和 Penn Action 数据集上实现了最高的姿势准确度和下游人体活动识别（HAR）的实用价值，同时使用了大量的参数和MACs，其实时性能也十分出色。

Conclusion: StickFigure 在物联网相机上实现了隐私保护与高效动作识别的平衡，并初步证明了其在大规模物联网摄像头上的可行性。

Abstract: Indoor IoT cameras can support assisted living and activity-aware spaces, but exporting raw RGB frames raises privacy concerns by exposing facial, clothing, and household details that body-motion tasks often do not require. We present StickFigure, a pose-only IoT camera system that, during real-time monitoring, keeps raw frames local and ephemeral while exporting only compact skeleton streams sufficient for downstream human activity recognition (HAR). While pose estimation has matured on GPUs, extracting accurate pose streams on resource-constrained IoT cameras remains difficult. To overcome these challenges and enable on-device pose streams on (almost) any IoT camera, we present two core designs in StickFigure: an activation-aware pose backbone that allocates channel capacity after spatial downsampling and a lightweight hierarchical MLP refiner that selectively corrects elbow and wrist coordinates using intermediate visual features and kinematic context. We fully implement StickFigure and evaluate it on public benchmarks and real-world deployment. Compared with state-of-the-art MCU pose models, StickFigure achieves the highest pose accuracy and downstream HAR utility on both NTU RGB+D and Penn Action, while using 96.5% fewer parameters and 99.3% fewer MACs per frame than RTMPose-S-based baselines, achieving 0.107 s p95 latency on a representative STM32H753 MCU. We believe StickFigure establishes a new operating point for privacy-aware edge vision on massive IoT cameras.

</details>


### [106] [Reversion, Retention, and Semantic Intervention: Measuring Functional Content in CLIP Fine-Tuning Deltas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34144)
*Chih-Ting Liao,Kezhen Bao,Xin Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 通过将微调过程中的撤销和保留操作结合，研究者分析了CLIP模型在多种数据集上的微调行为。实验证明，基于注意力值-输出的更新能够显著提高模型性能，但单独撤销这些更新对特定任务（如图表识别）并无帮助。同时，与随机层匹配的权重相比，基于注意力值-输出的权重更新能够更好地恢复预训练模型中的错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究细调过程中的可解释性问题，旨在理解哪些微调权重变化对任务性能的实际贡献。

Method: 研究者使用了CLIP模型对多种数据集进行微调，对比分析了不同权重更新方法对性能的影响。具体实验包括对不同预训练模型（ViT-L/14, ViT-B/16）在特定任务（合成金融图表，Flowers102，EuroSAT，FGVCAircraft）上的表现进行评估。

Result: 实验证明，基于注意力值-输出的权重更新能够显著提高模型的性能，但单独撤销这些更新对任务性能的影响不大。通过与随机选择的层匹配权重对比，该方法能够更好地恢复预训练模型中的错误，表明其在恢复模型关键功能方面表现出色。此外，去除有意义的选择方向会比匹配随机去除对基于注意力值-输出的权重更新保留的恢复效果影响更大。

Conclusion: 研究展示了基于注意力值-输出的权重更新对CLIP模型微调过程中性能提升的关键作用，揭示了这些更新背后的操作冗余，并指出了在不同方向上去除权重更新时的不同影响，为评估微调权重的贡献提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Fine-tuning adapts pretrained models to new tasks, but identifying which weight changes support the resulting behavior remains difficult. Weight-space interpretability assigns semantic descriptions to these changes, called fine-tuning deltas. Such descriptions leave open how much task performance depends on the identified updates, particularly when other updates can support the same predictions. We address this gap by pairing reversion, which restores selected parameters to their pretrained values, with retention, which keeps only selected fine-tuning updates. We evaluate Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) models on synthetic financial charts, Flowers102, EuroSAT, and FGVCAircraft with ViT-L/14, and on Flowers102 with ViT-B/16, using a shared recipe that tunes the final six visual blocks. Our contributions are threefold. First, attention value-output (VO) updates alone recover 43-87% of the accuracy improvement, although reverting them leaves chart accuracy unchanged. Cross-entropy loss preserves this contrast on Charts and EuroSAT, while correct-class score margins reveal additional contributions. Second, VO weights recover more loss improvement than all ten equally sized, layer-matched random subsets in each setting. VO and multilayer perceptron (MLP) retentions jointly correct 25-81% of pretrained errors, demonstrating overlapping recovered behavior, which we call operational redundancy. Third, removing semantically selected directions reduces VO-retained recovery more than matched-random removal in all five settings. Together, these results distinguish semantic alignment, removal cost, and retained recovery as complementary evidence about the functional role of fine-tuning updates within the evaluated CLIP recipe.

</details>


### [107] [MuSTEL: A Large-Scale Multilingual Synthetic Text-Line Image Dataset for OCR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34148)
*Majid Adibian,Hossein Saberi,Hossein Zeinali*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MuSTEL是一个包含1450万条合成多语言OCR数据集，旨在用于训练和评估多语言行级OCR系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前OCR系统的训练数据需要规模和多样性，特别是处理多语言文本行级识别时，MuSTEL的数据集能够解决由此带来的挑战。

Method: MuSTEL利用自然语言语料库并融入了字体选择、字体和样式变化、混合方向文本渲染、高亮和下划线等功能，还提供了来自711个字体家族的2009个验证字体库支持广泛的类型覆盖，并且通过多样性的背景、模糊、几何扭曲、倾斜等条件增加了数据集的多样性。

Result: MuSTEL提供了1450万条合成的多语言文本线图像，涵盖英语、波斯语和阿拉伯语，以及不同的书写方向和视觉条件，这些数据在语言组成、转录长度和种类多样性等方面做了统计分析。

Conclusion: MuSTEL为训练和评估多语言行级OCR系统以及研究跨语言、书写方向和视觉条件的识别鲁棒性提供了一个资源。

Abstract: Optical character recognition (OCR) systems depend strongly on the scale and diversity of their training data. One approach to document OCR first analyzes the page layout and extracts text-line images, which are then transcribed by a recognition model. Multilingual line-level recognition involving Persian, Arabic, and English presents additional challenges because different writing directions, fonts, and styles may coexist within a single line. This paper introduces MuSTEL, a large-scale synthetic multilingual OCR dataset containing more than 14.5 million annotated text-line images, organized into a training partition and predefined small and large test sets. Samples are generated from natural-language corpora, including multilingual content already present in the source texts. The generation framework incorporates capability-aware font selection, within-line font and style changes, mixed-direction text rendering, highlighting, and underlining. A validated repository of 2,009 font files from 711 families supports broad typographic coverage, while varied backgrounds, blur, geometric distortion, skew, stroke width, and image save quality provide diverse document-like appearances. Statistical analysis characterizes the dataset's language composition, transcription lengths, lexical and character-sequence diversity, image dimensions, typography, and rendering conditions. MuSTEL provides a resource for training and evaluating multilingual line-level OCR systems and investigating recognition robustness across languages, writing directions, and visual conditions.

</details>


### [108] [Humans in Space: Can MLLMs Construct Human-Centric Spatial Understanding via Active Exocentric Exploration?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34149)
*Tianchen Guo,Tengyue Zhang,Chen Liu,Ling Chen,Xin Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该基准通过引入交互式评测，评估模型在复杂场景中的视觉自意识和主动视角探索能力，揭示了当前先进模型难以进行详细的3D几何任务，并通过细粒度政策优化展示了奖励视角探索的优势和挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的多模态大语言模型在零样本推理中表现出色，但在复杂场景中，由于遮挡导致的视觉证据隐藏问题，使得被动基准评测无法准确评估模型的视觉自认识能力和主动探索视角的能力。

Method: 通过创建一个新的交互式基准SATE-Bench，包含316个真实场景和2,525个多回合问答对，结合被动的多视角控制与主动探索设置，使模型从严重遮挡的视角开始，通过查询相邻视角收集足够证据，直到能够完全回答问题。

Result: 评估结果显示，最先进的模型过早终止了探索，并且高估了自己对某些任务的信心；另外，通过匹配视角控制进一步证明了主动--被动差距主要是由于不足的证据获取。

Conclusion: 这项研究强调，仅仅扩大被动多视角感知并不必然能够提升活跃的空间推理能力，因此模型需要具备知道去哪里看、如何整合所看到的内容和何时停止的能力。

Abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at zero-shot reasoning, their spatial capabilities are primarily evaluated through static, passive observation. In complex, human-centric scenes, occlusion often hides crucial geometric evidence, and passive benchmarks force models to guess rather than recognize their own visual uncertainty. To bridge this gap, we introduce SATE-Bench, a novel interactive benchmark comprising 316 real-world scenes and 2,525 multi-turn QA pairs to evaluate visual self-awareness and active exocentric view-exploration. It combines a Passive multi-view control with an Active exploration setting, where models start from a severely occluded view and must iteratively query adjacent viewpoints until they gather enough evidence to fully ``sate'' the question, scored by a step-penalized efficiency reward. Evaluating state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that they terminate exploration prematurely while reporting high confidence, and struggle with fine-grained 3D geometric tasks; matched-view controls further attribute the Active--Passive gap primarily to insufficient evidence acquisition. Moreover, fine-tuning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) shows that rewarding view-seeking increases active exploration but lowers overall accuracy, as models over-explore and fail to fuse expanding multi-view contexts across turns. These findings indicate that scaling passive multi-view perception does not intrinsically yield active spatial reasoning, highlighting the need for models that know where to look, how to integrate what they see, and when to stop. Code and data are available at https://gtc-gh.github.io/SATE-Bench/

</details>


### [109] [Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Crowd Flow Control Using Dynamic Barriers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34163)
*Alhanof Alolyan,He Wang,Amani Alonayzan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种基于仿真强化学习框架来优化人群屏障配置，通过构建模拟环境，训练Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）代理调整屏障位置，提高行人流动效果，实验表明该方法优于现有手动设计的屏障配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有固定屏障布局可能导致不必要的停留和局部拥堵，研究旨在通过引入无需标注数据的仿真驱动强化学习框架解决该问题。

Method: 该研究利用分割后的群众场景构建了一个现实的仿真环境，然后使用该环境训练Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）代理，不断调整屏障位置以优化行人流动。

Result: 研究结果表明，在未见过的行人数量的情况下，学习到的策略能够持续优于现有的手动设计屏障配置，同时减少行人停滞并保持有效的流量控制。

Conclusion: 将计算机视觉人群模拟与强化学习结合，为优化人群控制基础设施提供了一个有效的框架。

Abstract: Crowd barriers are widely used to regulate pedestrian movement during large public events such as pilgrimages. However, fixed barrier layouts often create unnecessary stopping and local congestion even when they successfully control the overall crowd flow. Finding better barrier configurations is difficult because there is no dataset that provides the best barrier placement for a given crowd scene. We address this challenge by introducing a simulation-driven reinforcement learning framework that learns barrier configurations without requiring labelled training data. Starting from a segmented crowd scene, we construct a realistic simulation environment that reproduces the observed pedestrian distribution. This environment is then used to train a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent that continuously adjusts barrier positions to improve pedestrian movement. Unlike supervised approaches the proposed framework allows the agent to explore barrier configurations that have never been observed in real data. We evaluate the learned policy under unseen numbers of pedestrians. The learned policy consistently outperforms the existing manually designed barrier configuration by reducing pedestrian stops while maintaining effective flow regulation. These results demonstrate that combining computer vision crowd simulation and reinforcement learning provides an effective framework for optimizing crowd control infrastructure.

</details>


### [110] [Freeze What Is Settled, Cache What Is Smooth: Spatial Freezing Keeps Step Caching in Its Low-Error Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34177)
*Baiyan Li,Ganxuan Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究评估了两个加速策略（区域冻结和步骤缓存）的最佳分配方式，在Qwen-Image-2.1上，区域冻结不仅减少了跳过的步骤数量，还降低了每步的成本，从而使得缓存策略能达到相同的速度提升效果。研究开发了一种基于成本的模型来预测加速效果，并提出了名为FreezePlan的新方法，该方法结合了两者的优势，提高了处理速度，同时保持了高质量的输出和评估分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究已经分别探讨了区域冻结（Region Freezing）和步骤缓存（Step Caching）这两种加速策略。该论文旨在探讨在固定加速目标的情况下，如何合理分配这两种策略，以实现最大化的速度提升，同时保证图像编辑质量。

Method: 研究首先分析了Qwen-Image-2.1模型中，区域冻结策略对模型成本的影响。然后，建立了一种基于成本的模型来预测不同策略组合下的延迟时间。研究团队还开发了一种名为FreezePlan的新方法，该方法结合了区域冻结和步骤缓存，并在预注册的测试集上进行了全面评估。

Result: 研究发现，在Qwen-Image-2.1模型上，与区域冻结相结合的步骤缓存策略，即使设定更为保守的缓存阈值，也能实现在保留一定质量前提下的显著加速效果。FreezePlan方法在保持29.8 dB PSNR的同时实现了5.05倍的加速，即使在5.99倍加速时，PSNR依然保持在28.0 dB的水平。同时，该方法与之前的区域选择方法配合使用时，并未显著影响图像质量。这些结果表明，FreezePlan能够在有效加速图像编辑处理过程的同时，维持高精度。

Conclusion: 研究证明，合理分配区域冻结和步骤缓存策略可以显著提高图像编辑系统的处理速度，同时保证输出质量。新提出的FreezePlan方法为未来的研究提供了有力的验证和参考。

Abstract: Instruction-based image editors built on diffusion transformers run tens of denoising steps. Training-free acceleration either reuses features across steps (step caching) or stops computing the regions an edit leaves untouched (region freezing), and the two have been combined before. We ask how a high speed-up target should be split between them. On Qwen-Image-2.1, freezing does more than remove tokens: it lowers the cost of every step, so the step cache can reach the same overall speed-up with a conservative threshold that keeps its error small. A per-step cost model fitted on development runs predicts held-out latency with a median error of 4.0% and reproduces the speed ceilings of the region methods we re-implemented (2.73$\times$ predicted vs. 2.70$\times$ measured for RegionE). Driving frozen tokens to the model's one-step $x_0$ estimate beats returning them to the reference image on every development sample, and in 90% of measured cases the composed error stays below the sum of the two individual errors. The resulting method, FreezePlan, keeps five full steps and gives the rest of the budget to TaylorSeer. On a pre-registered test split it runs 5.05$\times$ faster end to end at 29.8 dB PSNR to the original output, with no significant drop in a VLM judge score; TaylorSeer at 5.02$\times$ reaches 23.5 dB. The curve extends to 5.99$\times$ at 28.0 dB. Swapping in the region selectors of prior methods under our schedule lowers median PSNR by only 0.5--0.6 dB, which places the gain in the schedule and budget split rather than in the selector.

</details>


### [111] [GeoPrompt: Geometry-Conditioned Prompt Learning for Underwater Open-Vocabulary Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34190)
*Shanshan Han,Yuxi Wang,Can Qin,Yujie Chen,Cong Pan,Haitao Li,Guoqiang Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoPrompt提出了一种对于海洋中的开放词汇实例分割，通过几何结构信息增强视觉特征，从而解决传统方法在低对比度和颜色衰减等环境变化下的识别问题。该方法在MARIS-OpenIS基准数据集上取得了当前最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的基于视觉-语言对齐的方法在海洋环境下表现不佳，因为颜色衰减、散射、浑浊和对比度低等因素会破坏视觉特征与语义概念之间的对应关系，特别是对于未见的海洋类别的识别困难。

Method: GeoPrompt提出了一种几何条件下的提示学习框架。方法包括几何指导的视觉适应模块（GVAM）和几何条件下的提示学习模块（GCPL）。GVAM从深度信息中提取几何结构先验，并将其注入多尺度视觉特征中。GCPL则基于几何结构生成的几何感知文本分类器对固定和图像条件下的文本分类器进行增强。

Result: GeoPrompt在MARIS-OpenIS基准数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在开放词汇实例分割任务上达到了当前最先进水平，带来了持续的性能改进。

Conclusion: GeoPrompt通过利用几何结构的稳定性来提高海洋环境中的开放词汇实例分割性能，为该领域的研究提供了新的思路和解决方案。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary instance segmentation (OVIS) provides a promising solution for marine perception by recognizing and segmenting categories beyond predefined label spaces. Existing OVIS methods usually rely on vision-language alignment, where visual region features are matched with textual category embeddings to recognize both seen and unseen classes. However, this alignment assumption becomes fragile in underwater environments. Color attenuation, scattering, turbidity, and low contrast distort visual appearance, causing region features to deviate from their corresponding semantic concepts. As a result, the similarity between degraded visual features and textual classifiers becomes unreliable, which particularly weakens the recognition of unseen underwater categories that cannot be corrected by category-specific supervision. To address these issues, we propose GeoPrompt, a geometry-conditioned prompt learning framework for underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation. Our key insight is that geometric structure is more stable than visual appearance in degraded underwater scenes. Specifically, GeoPrompt introduces a geometry-guided visual adaptation module (GVAM) to extract depth-derived structural priors and inject them into multi-scale visual features. It further develops a geometry-conditioned prompt learning (GCPL) that generates geometry-aware textual classifiers from structural representations. These geometry-aware classifiers are integrated with fixed and image-conditioned textual classifiers to improve open-vocabulary semantic alignment. Experiments on the MARIS-OpenIS benchmark show that GeoPrompt achieves state-of-the-art performance and brings consistent improvements on underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation.

</details>


### [112] [Timing Matters Twice: When to Query and When to Skip in Flow-Matching On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34191)
*Renye Yan,Junyi Zhan,Jikang Cheng,Wei Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhaseOPD 通过识别生成阶段来实时调整查询教师的时间，从而精简 rollout 置位，减少计算冗余，提高效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于时间分布选择监督状态的方法可能忽视了生成过程中的阶段依赖性差异，导致不必要的计算负担。

Method: PhaseOPD 使用现有的学生速度预测来在线识别生成阶段，并选择适合教师阶段偏好的监督状态，同时在所有查询决策完成后丢弃未使用的 rollout 后缀。

Result: 在 SD3.5-M 上，PhaseOPD 每个本地批次仅执行 16 个 rollout 位置中的 5.56 位，相比 DanceOPD 减少了 41.3% 的训练时间，同时提高了美学、GenEval 和 OCR 评分。

Conclusion: PhaseOPD 提供了一种有效的查询和省略框架，通过识别生成阶段来优化 distillation 程序，从而提高图像生成和编辑任务的效率和性能。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) enables flow-matching models to acquire complementary capabilities from specialized teachers through supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, different evaluation dimensions, such as aesthetics and OCR accuracy, and different tasks, such as image generation and editing, emphasize different aspects of the denoising process, suggesting that their effective supervision may occur at different stages. Existing methods typically select supervision states from predefined timestep distributions, which may overlook these phase-dependent differences and incur unnecessary computational overhead. This motivates two critical timing decisions: when to adaptively query teachers for effective supervision based on the evolving generative process, and when to skip the remaining rollout to avoid redundant computation.
  In this paper, we introduce PhaseOPD, a phase-aware query-and-skip framework that identifies generative phases online from revisions of predicted-clean latents, using existing student velocity predictions without additional model evaluations. For each task-assigned teacher, PhaseOPD selects a supervision state based on its phase preference and skips the unused rollout suffix once all query decisions are finalized, preserving the single-query velocity-distillation objective. On SD3.5-M, PhaseOPD executes only 5.56 of 16 rollout positions per local batch, reducing training time by 41.3% relative to DanceOPD while improving Aesthetic, GenEval, and OCR scores.

</details>


### [113] [MIS-VQA: An Annotation-Driven Surgical Vision-Language Dataset for Complex Surgical Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34210)
*Mohamed Hamdy,Iheb Zouari,Fatmaelzahraa Ahmed,Muraam Abdel-Ghani,Muhammed Arsalan,Ponnuthurai Suganthan,Khalid Al-Jalham,Abdulaziz Al-Ali,Shidin Balakrishnan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MIS-VQA引入了一种新的手术视觉语言数据集，通过注释驱动的流程将不同类型的手术注解转化为结构化的文本场景表示，支持详细的描述、感知级定位和多步推理，提供了多层次的评估，并通过LLaVA-SurgXpert模型验证了其在手术视觉语言理解中的优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的医疗VQA资源受限于单一任务监督、合成模板、缺乏自然描述监督或稀疏注释，这限制了对空间关系和程序上下文的理解，MIS-VQA旨在解决这些限制，提供更全面的监督和评估。

Method: MIS-VQA使用EndoVis18和CholecT50数据集，将其阶段、器械、互动、三元组和分割标签转化为统一的上下文，以指导大规模语言模型生成临床相关的问答对。为了应对注释稀疏性，MIS-VQA引入了置信过滤分割和跨注释一致性检查，以实现大规模的空间定位监督。

Result: MIS-VQA成为了一种统一的基准测试，支持多层次评估，包括原子视觉定位和组合推理。LLaVA-SurgXpert模型证实了MIS-VQA在视觉语言理解中的优越性，并在实验中展示了相对于现有手术VQA基线的持续改进。

Conclusion: MIS-VQA为手术视觉语言理解的发展提供了新的数据集和框架，强调了空间监督和多层次推理的重要性。

Abstract: Modern surgical AI increasingly requires multimodal understanding rather than isolated perception, yet existing datasets remain largely limited to single-task supervision such as recognition or templated question answering. Current medical VQA resources often rely on synthetic templates, lack natural descriptive supervision, or provide sparse annotations that hinder reasoning about spatial relations and procedural context. We introduce MIS-VQA, a surgical vision-language dataset generated through an annotation-driven pipeline that converts heterogeneous surgical annotations into structured textual scene representations. Using EndoVis18 and CholecT50, we transform phase, instrument, interaction, triplet, and segmentation labels into unified contexts that guide large language models to generate clinically coherent question-answer pairs. MIS-VQA supports four response types-concise and detailed descriptions, perception-level grounding, and multi-step reasoning-enabling hierarchical evaluation from atomic visual grounding to compositional reasoning. To address annotation sparsity, we incorporate confidence-filtered segmentation and cross-annotation consistency checks, enabling spatially grounded supervision at scale. MIS-VQA establishes a unified benchmark for surgical vision-language understanding with spatial supervision and multi-tier reasoning evaluation. To demonstrate its utility, we introduce LLaVA-SurgXpert, a family of surgical vision-language models with visual encoders to analyze how visual representations influence multimodal reasoning. Experiments show consistent improvements over existing surgical VQA baselines while revealing capability gaps between perceptual grounding and higher-level reasoning hidden in prior benchmarks.

</details>


### [114] [StaX-Net: Stackelberg Interleaved Asymmetric Network for Cross-Modality Medical Image Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34214)
*Amin Golnari,Saeid Sanei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了StaX-Net网络，该网络通过结合部分耦合的编码-判别结构和一种在学习使用特权信息范式下的二维特征聚合和空间变换层（FAST层），解决了跨模态医学图像翻译中的解剖不一致合成问题。该网络通过增强生成器和判别器之间的架构特征对齐，并采用一种斯塔克尔贝格启发式的非对称优化方案，以稳定领导者-跟随者训练。FAST层在训练中提取目标域的先验知识，在推理时仅使用源域变换，从而通过目标导向的特征表示约束合成过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的跨模态医学图像翻译方法在合成过程中存在解剖不一致的问题，这可能影响临床诊断。StaX-Net旨在解决这一问题，通过引入部分耦合的编码-判别结构和二维特征聚合与空间变换层，可以在合成过程中引入目标域的先验知识，提升合成图像的质量。

Method: StaX-Net通过结合部分耦合的编码-判别结构和二维特征聚合与空间变换层（FAST层），来实现跨模态医学图像的翻译。该网络还提出了一种斯塔克尔贝格启发式的非对称优化方案，以稳定训练过程中的领导者-跟随者机制。生成器和判别器之间的共享模块进一步增强了架构特征对齐。

Result: 实验结果表明，StaX-Net在跨模态医学图像翻译中取得了较好的性能，合成图像的质量明显提高。特别是与标准生成架构相比，通过目标导向的特征表示，约束了合成过程，使得合成图像更加接近目标域先验知识。

Conclusion: 研究提出了StaX-Net网络，通过部分耦合的编码-判别结构和二维特征聚合与空间变换层解决了跨模态医学图像翻译中的解剖不一致合成问题。这种方法在临床应用中具有较高的潜力，能够提高图像翻译的质量，辅助医学诊断。

Abstract: Cross-modality medical image translation is challenged by anatomically inconsistent synthesis that can compromise clinical diagnosis. We propose StaX-Net, a Stackelberg interleaved asymmetric network that incorporates a partially coupled encoder-discriminator structure, and a 2D feature aggregation and spatial transformation (FAST) layer that distills target-supervised priors under the learning using privileged information paradigm. The shared blocks between the generator and discriminator enhance architectural feature alignment. To stabilize the leader-follower training, a Stackelberg-inspired asymmetric optimization scheme employs explicit shared-parameter freezing and asymmetric learning rates. The FAST layer distills target-domain priors during training and applies a source-only transform at inference. This constrains the synthesis process through target-informed feature representations relative to standard generative architectures. The code is available on GitHub for public use.

</details>


### [115] [From Presence Labels to Bounding Boxes: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Scale Surgical Instrument Localization?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34218)
*Mohamed Hamdy,Muraam Abdel-Ghani,Fatmaelzahraa Ahmed,Sifna Nasar,Mariam Ahmed,Khalid Al-Jalham,Abdulaziz Al-Ali,Shidin Balakrishnan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究设计了一种基于可扩展的MLLM标注框架，通过手术帧和现有器械存在标签生成准确的边框，分析其可靠性和成本，证明该方法的mIoU为0.784，相比于单次调用的最佳基线0.735和人与人的一致性0.814，表现出较好的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前的手术器械标注存在时间耗时、依赖专家以及弱监督和基于检测器的伪标签需要特定任务训练等问题，本研究旨在提出一套可扩展的MLLM标注框架，以提高标注的准确性和效率。

Method: 研究使用六种不同的MLLM和多步调用配置，对胆囊切除术的手术帧进行标注，采用分层标注方案，由两名标注员独立标注1000帧，专家审核一个标注集以建立参考集。

Result: 实验结果表明，不同仪器集的F1评分从88.2到92.7不等，mIoU评分从0.180到0.735不等。使用最优准确度流程创建了一个包含所有80个视频中共285,977个边框的边界扩展集Cholec80，并公开发布。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一种高效、精确的 surgical instruments 边界标注新方法，并验证了其效果，为手术场景理解提供了重要支持。

Abstract: Spatial localization of surgical instruments through bounding-box annotations is a foundational component of surgical scene understanding, supporting detection, tracking, interaction analysis, and grounded vision-language applications. Yet existing annotations often cover selected frames, video subsets, or dataset variants rather than complete procedures. Manual extension is time-consuming and expert-dependent. Additionally, weakly supervised and detector-based pseudo-labels require task-specific training and may be imprecise. In this study, we design a scalable MLLM-based annotation framework that converts surgical frames and existing instrument-presence labels into accurate bounding boxes, and systematically analyze its reliability, cost, and design sensitivity. We instantiate the framework using six MLLMs and a multi-call configuration on laparoscopic cholecystectomy in Cholec80. Using a carefully designed stratification scheme, two annotators independently label 1,000 frames, and an expert surgeon reviews one annotation set to establish the reference. Results show that instrument-set F1 ranges from 88.2 to 92.7,whereas mIoU ranges from 0.180 to 0.735, showing that comparable recognition can conceal large localization differences. A structured multi-stage annotation pipeline achieves 0.784 mIoU, compared with 0.735 for the best single-call baseline and 0.814 human-human agreement. Using the best accuracy pipeline, we create and publicly release a spatial extension of Cholec80 comprising 285,977 bounding boxes across all 184,498 annotated frames from the 80 videos. The annotations and human references are made available on GitHub

</details>


### [116] [CropReward: A Human-Preference Benchmark and Reward Model for Aesthetic Image Cropping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34221)
*Xiangfei Sheng,Xiaofeng Pan,Leida Li,Qian Zhang,Biao Wang,Johan Wagemans,Weisi Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究构建了CropBench基准，包含106,995个人类偏好对，旨在评估图像裁剪方法。研究发现当前评价标准与人类偏好一致性有限，并提出了基于MLLM的评价模型CropReward。利用CropReward构建了CropReward-300k数据集，并训练了CropAlign模型，结果显示CropAlign在人类偏好一致性方面优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AIC评价方法主要是基于几何度量和图像美学评估模型，这些方法在与人类偏好的一致性上存在问题。为提高AIC方法的评价标准，研究构建了一个大规模的手工偏好数据集CropBench，发现了现有评价标准的局限性，并提出了一种新的评价模型CropReward。

Method: 研究首先通过收集人类偏好数据集CropBench来评估现有评价方法的有效性，然后提出了一种基于MLLM的评价模型CropReward，该模型通过比较候选裁剪后的图像和原始图像来评估其美学改进或退化。进一步基于CropReward构建了最大的AIC数据集CropReward-300k，并训练了新的CropAlign模型。

Result: 研究发现现有的评价标准与人类偏好的一致性有限，而新提出的评价模型CropReward具有更强的人类偏好一致性。此外，利用CropReward训练的CropAlign模型在图像裁剪方面也优于现有的方法。

Conclusion: 研究通过构建CropBench和提出CropReward推进了AIC领域的评价方法发展，并展示了高人类偏好一致性的CropReward和CropAlign模型在优化图像裁剪模型方面的优越性。

Abstract: Aesthetic image cropping (AIC) aims to improve image composition and aesthetic quality by removing extraneous or distracting content. Over the past decade, AIC methods have evolved from specialized vision models to multimodal large language models(MLLMs). Reliable evaluation that reflects human preferences is essential for benchmarking AIC methods and guiding model optimization. However, the current AIC evaluation relies largely on geometry-based metrics such as intersection over union (IoU), as well as image aesthetic assessment(IAA) models. Although inconsistencies with human preferences have long been observed, the robustness and reliability of these evaluation criteria remain underexplored. To bridge this gap, we first construct CropBench, a large-scale benchmark comprising 106,995 human preference pairs for 1,019 images, with each candidate set containing the original image and candidate crops produced by 14 AIC methods. A systematic study on CropBench reveals that the existing criteria, ranging from IoU to off-the-shelf IAA assessment models, only exhibit limited alignment with human preferences. Building upon CropBench, we further propose CropReward, an MLLM-based reward model that evaluates a candidate crop by comparing with the original uncropped image and outputs a score indicating explicit aesthetic improvement or degradation relative to the original. In addition, we employ CropReward to construct CropReward-300k, the largest AIC dataset to date, and further develop CropAlign, a preference-aligned AIC model trained solely with CropReward supervision, without human-annotated crop boxes. Experimental results demonstrate that CropReward aligns with human preferences significantly better than existing criteria. CropAlign also surpasses the state-of-the-art AIC methods, demonstrating the advantage of CropReward in guiding AIC model optimization.

</details>


### [117] [BoundedGS: Memory-Efficient High-Resolution Training for 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34233)
*Xiaobin Deng,Changyu Diao,Min Li,Duanqing Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BoundedGS优化了3D GPU渲染，通过限制本地栅格化工作集和优化投影与梯度存储，实现了在不同分辨率下的高效渲染，同时保持高质量的重建效果并减少渲染工作集和训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对高分辨率3D渲染中存在内存使用量大、渲染效率低的问题，BoundedGS通过优化后处理过程中的内存管理和加速技术，提升渲染质量与效率。

Method: BoundedGS使用了限定本地栅格化工作集、紧凑的梯度存储、视图级峰值管理、CPU辅助结构重建以及有界图像供应等技术手段，优化了3D渲染的各个方面。

Result: 通过BoundedGS优化，渲染工作集从9.97 GiB减少到1.76 GiB（减少82.3%），单个图像的渲染时间从21.76秒缩短到19.79秒，训练时间从36.7分钟减少到33.9分钟。

Conclusion: BoundedGS通过一系列优化技术，在多种场景下显著提高了3D渲染的效率和质量，尤其是在高分辨率渲染时表现出色，为未来高分辨率3D场景的高效渲染提供了有效途径。

Abstract: High-resolution 3D Gaussian Splatting training increases pixel and Gaussian-tile intersection counts, expanding rasterization caches that coexist with projection and gradient state at peak memory. A complete-view update aggregates gradients across the view; each region's forward and backward caches can be released after its contribution is collected. BoundedGS separates rasterization and projection backward passes and bounds the active local rasterization working set according to its measured load. Candidate-indexed projection and compact gradient storage address the view-level peaks exposed by this change, while CPU-assisted structure rebuilding and bounded image supply manage resources outside rendering. In a resolution sweep at a fixed count of about 6M Gaussians, the measured rendering working set stays within 1.073-1.077 GiB from 1K to 16K; at 11K, a warm pass takes 19.79 seconds versus 21.76 for full-frame execution. Across five native 5K outdoor scenes, full training reduces the mean rendering working set from 9.97 to 1.76 GiB (82.3%), retains similar reconstruction quality, and shortens training time from 36.7 to 33.9 minutes.
  Project page: https://xiaobin2001.github.io/BoundedGS-Web/

</details>


### [118] [ParetoGS: High-Quality Continuous-Budget 3D Gaussian Splatting with Sparse Adapted Anchors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34235)
*Xiaobin Deng,Changyu Diao,Min Li,Duanqing Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ParetoGS 提出了一种新的 3D 质心表示方法，通过少量适应预算锚点和编码残差地图来处理不同预算下的质心变化和参数演进，实现更优的重建质量并在多个场景中表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 3D 质心表示方法在不同预算下的质量预算曲线可能滞后，且参数可能无法在低预算表示中良好适应。ParetoGS 旨在提供一种解决方案，以减少 Gaussian 数量同时保持高质量重建。

Method: ParetoGS 使用适应预算锚点和编码残差地图的方法，交替进行剪枝和固定成员适应，构建具有持久身份的嵌套锚点。参数变化相对于全模型进行编码，并在解码时逐步引入新成员的渲染贡献，形成连续预算表示。

Result: 在 13 个场景中，ParetoGS 以更少的 Gaussian 数量实现了比前缀方法更好的平均 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS。在一些场景中，其低预算下的重建质量接近独立优化 GNS 模型的参考重建。

Conclusion: ParetoGS 在保持较小 Gaussian 数量的情况下实现了更优的重建质量，为 3D 质心表示带来了新的可能。

Abstract: Scalable 3D Gaussian Splatting allows one scene representation to serve different Gaussian-count budgets, yet its quality-budget curve may lag behind models optimized separately for each budget. Reducing the number of Gaussians changes both the selected members and the reconstruction tasks carried by the survivors; parameters inherited from a high-budget model may fit a low-budget representation poorly. We propose ParetoGS, which describes member changes and parameter evolution with a small set of adapted budget anchors and decodes intermediate budgets without separate optimization at every requested count. ParetoGS alternates pruning and fixed-member adaptation to build nested anchors with persistent identities, and encodes their parameter changes relative to the full model in a compact residual atlas. At decoding, it interpolates the states of shared members and gradually introduces the rendering contributions of new members, connecting sparse anchors into a continuous-budget representation. Across 13 scenes, ParetoGS attains better average PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS with fewer Gaussians than the compared prefix methods at 10% of each method's own full model. From a shared full model, it also outperforms FlexGS-imp at its trained 1%, 5%, and 10% budgets and NanoGS-imp at the 1% and 0.1% budgets. On Garden, its non-anchor quality approaches an empirical reference from independently optimized GNS models at higher retention ratios and exceeds it at some lower-budget points. Across 13 scenes, encoding reduces mean additional state from 390.0 to 85.7 MB with an average PSNR change of 0.01 dB.
  Project page: https://xiaobin2001.github.io/ParetoGS-Web/

</details>


### [119] [RacerGS: Residual-Autoregressive Context for 3D Gaussian Splatting Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34263)
*Wenqing Wang,Huimin Zeng,Yun Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RacerGS 提出了一种用于 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）的压缩框架，通过投影锚点哈希编码和引入 FiLM 调制的自回归 GRU 上下文模型，实现了超过 150 倍的压缩比，同时保持了渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS 方法虽然能提供高速高质量的虚拟视图渲染，但其庞大的参数量限制了存储和传输效率。

Method: RacerGS 方法通过设计一种哈希投影模型，将锚点哈希编码投影至紧凑的上下文特征；并引入了 FiLM 调制的自回归 GRU 上下文模型，利用因果依赖优化熵模型参数；还根据上下文预测值编码残差，利用空间一致性降低符号熵。

Result: RacerGS 相比于传统 3DGS 压缩策略实现了超过 150 倍的压缩比，并且与 Scaffold-GS 相比有 28 倍的压缩比提升；并且在五个数据集上的实验结果表明，RacerGS 在存储减少和速率-失真性能方面优于先前的 3DGS 压缩方法。

Conclusion: RacerGS 成功解决了 3DGS 的大规模参数问题，提供了更优的压缩效率和渲染质量。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a promising approach for fast, high-quality novel-view rendering. However, its large parameter size remains a bottleneck for storage and transmission. We propose RacerGS, a compact 3DGS compression framework that achieves scene reconstruction at significantly reduced storage sizes with preserved fidelity. To obtain compact and spatially coherent features, we design a hash projection model that projects the anchor hash encodings into compact context features. Additionally, we introduce a FiLM-modulated autoregressive GRU context model that utilizes causal dependencies among anchor feature groups and uses recurrent hidden states to refine entropy-model parameters, improving bitrate efficiency. Furthermore, we adaptively entropy-code quantized anchor-attribute residuals relative to their context-predicted means, leveraging spatial consistency to reduce symbol entropy. Overall, RacerGS achieves more than 150x compression over vanilla 3DGS and 28x over Scaffold-GS, while providing comparable rendering quality. Extensive experiments across five datasets demonstrate that RacerGS outperforms prior 3DGS compression methods in both storage reduction and rate-distortion performance.

</details>


### [120] [Robust Single-Parameter Point Cloud Registration using Truncated Lp Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34271)
*Seong Hun Lee,Patrick Vandewalle,Javier Civera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TLP 提出了一种使用分段 $L_p$ 函数进行点云配准的新方法，仅需一个可调参数。该方法通过并行计算提升效率，适用于实际场景中的高异常值率，实现实时配准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前的方法往往对高异常值率的处理较差，需要多参数调优，且效率较低。

Method: TLP 使用分段 $L_p$ 函数评估对应关系，选择最佳假设，并对最终模型进行细化。

Result: TLP 在标准基准数据集上实现了更准确的效果，相对于多参数方法，它在三个数据集上表现出优越性，同时保持了竞争力。

Conclusion: TLP 提供了一种更实用、高效且准确的点云配准方法，特别适合实际应用中的高异常值场景。

Abstract: We propose a novel method for robust point cloud registration with only one tunable parameter. Our method, dubbed TLP, uses truncated $L_p$ functions with different values of $p$ to assign priority scores to correspondences, select the hypothesis, and refine the final model. By leveraging the robustness of truncated functions, TLP effectively handles the high outlier rates commonly encountered in real-world 3D feature matching. We also exploit GPU parallelization to evaluate hypotheses efficiently, enabling registration from thousands of correspondences in under a second on average. With only one tunable parameter, our method offers greater practicality than multi-parameter methods that require dataset-specific tuning of several parameters. Evaluations on public benchmark datasets demonstrate that TLP achieves higher accuracy than state-of-the-art single-parameter methods. Furthermore, it outperforms two widely used multi-parameter methods on three of the four evaluated datasets while maintaining competitive runtime.

</details>


### [121] [ChronoReplay: One Answer Interface Is Not Enough for Streaming Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34283)
*Yihao Hu,Yitong Lin,Pan Wang,Zhihao Wen,Hang Wang,Yiwen Zhao,Deyuan Liu,Yutong Li,Mingda Wan,Yuchen Mao,Tao Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ChronoReplay通过重播异构空间监督，作为按时间顺序排列的事件，保持来源固有的目标，并且平衡监督，来解决接口锁定问题；这提高了OVO-S-Bench、OST-Bench和UCS-Bench的性能，特别是在OST-Bench上取得了13.41点的优异成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接口锁定现象导致在特定接口上优化训练可能会弱化或甚至损害其他接口的表现。研究人员希望通过改进监督技术来缓解这一问题，增强模型在不同接口上的泛化能力。

Method: ChronoReplay采用重播按时间顺序排列的异构空间监督，平衡监督任务并将目标保持在原始形式，通过这种方式来调节和改进训练过程。此外，它还包括自适应帧选择以在测试时调整证据访问方式。

Result: 使用相同的观察能力，单个ChronoReplay检查点提高了OVO-S-Bench、OST-Bench和UCS-Bench的表现，OST-Bench的改进幅度达到了13.41点。并且通过相同的测试数据，详细分离ChronoReplay对结果的贡献，并评估了它在各种设置下的相对性能。

Conclusion: ChronoReplay实现了一种新颖的训练方法，不仅提高了模型在多个评估指标上的表现，还在一定程度上克服了接口锁定的限制。

Abstract: Training a spatial VLM to answer which side an object lies on does not require it to preserve the metric displacement that determines that answer, while supervision for a distance estimate may leave categorical relations largely unconstrained. When post-training emphasizes one readout, improvements can therefore concentrate on that interface while transfer to others remains weak or even degrades; we call this observed specialization interface lock-in. ChronoReplay addresses it by replaying heterogeneous spatial supervision as chronologically ordered episodes, retaining source-native targets, and balancing supervision across families. Under the same observation access, a single ChronoReplay checkpoint improves OVO-S-Bench, OST-Bench, and UCS-Bench together, including a 13.41-point gain on OST-Bench, and achieves the highest three-benchmark mean among the supervision settings compared here. Same-data controls further separate the ingredients of this transfer: answer serialization redistributes gains across OST and UCS, family-balanced learning improves over ordinary joint SFT and natural turn weighting, and chronological replay exceeds a shifted-order control by about 2.41 OST points across two paired seeds. Adaptive frame selection then changes evidence access while keeping the trained model fixed, providing an additional inference-time gain at lower visual cost. Streaming spatial performance depends on what distinctions supervision preserves, how heterogeneous histories are organized during learning, and what causal evidence inference makes available at test time.

</details>


### [122] [EditDistill: Is It Possible to Guide Video Editing with Image Editing?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34303)
*Guojun Lei,Hong Li,Hongbing Yang,Lixue Gong,Chi Wang,Zheng Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为EditDistill的框架，用于从图像编辑中提取视觉变换，以指导视频编辑。该方法通过轻量级融合模块和训练损失，确保视频轨迹与图像编辑一致，同时保持运动和布局。实验结果表明，该方法在标准基准上表现优异，能在多种场景下生成高质量的视频编辑结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前在视频编辑方面，实现与图像编辑一样精细和控制能力强的编辑仍然存在挑战，尤其是在精确局部编辑、动态时间效应和多帧一致性照明方面。

Method: EditDistill框架首先使用现成的图像编辑模型生成原始视频帧的编辑版本，然后通过轻量级融合模块提取原始编辑图像对的视觉变换，并将其表示为edit descriptor。该edit descriptor通过视频扩散模型注入，引导去噪过程朝向预设编辑效果。此外，通过编辑描述符对准损失和DINO结构一致性损失进行训练，确保视频轨迹与演示的图像编辑保持一致，同时保持运动和布局的一致性。最后还推导出了一种基于流匹配的等效推断时指导公式。

Result: 本文的方法在标准基准上取得了良好的性能，并在多种场景中生成了高质量的视频编辑结果。

Conclusion: 总体而言，EditDistill框架提供了一种有效的方法来实现对视频编辑的高度控制，通过从图像编辑中提取视觉变换并将其应用于视频编辑，从而提高了视频编辑的精度和质量。

Abstract: Recent advances in image editing have enabled fine-grained and highly controllable visual modifications. However, achieving similar levels of controllability in video editing remains an open challenge, particularly for precise local edits, dynamic temporal effects, and consistent lighting across frames.In this paper, we propose EditDistill, a framework that distills image-level visual transformations from edits to guide video editing.Specifically, given a source video and an edit prompt, we first generate an edited version of the initial video frame using an off-the-shelf image editing model. We then distill the visual transformation of this original-edited image pair into a compact representation termed an edit descriptor.This descriptor is injected into a video diffusion model through our lightweight fusion module, which steers the denoising process toward the desired edit. To align the video trajectory with the demonstrated image edit while preserving motion and layout, we train with edit-descriptor alignment and DINO structural consistency losses, and derive an equivalent inference-time guidance formulation under flow matching.Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves strong performance on standard benchmarks and produces high-quality video editing results across diverse scenarios. For more details and videos, please refer to the anonymous webpage: https://yu-shaonian.github.io/EditDistill-Web/.

</details>


### [123] [Real-Time Conveyor Belt Defect Detection via Edge TPU-Accelerated YOLOv11 on Raspberry Pi 5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34304)
*Muhammad Nur Bijak Bestari,Mulki Indana Zulfa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出并实施了一种基于低功耗边缘AI视觉系统的输煤皮带缺陷检测系统，该系统能够实现实时检测，并在有限的硬件资源下保持高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计一种能够在边缘设备上高效运行的深度学习模型，用于连续制造业中的输煤皮带缺陷检测，以降低维护成本，提高生产效率和安全性。

Method: 该研究采用了一种基于YOLOv11n的优化模型，训练数据来自运营中的水泥厂工业数据集、开源数据集以及自动抓取的数据。通过后训练全精度量化技术将模型优化，以便更好地运行于Raspberry Pi 5搭配Google Coral Edge TPU协处理器的平台上。

Result: 实验结果显示，该系统在四类缺陷上具有稳健的检测能力，精度为0.742，召回率为0.730，mAP@0.5为0.764。部署后，该系统能够在320x320分辨率下稳定达到30-40 FPS，并且端到端延迟在70-90毫秒之间。

Conclusion: 边缘AI技术成功地在输煤皮带缺陷检测系统中实现，该系统不仅提高了检测精度和实时性，还能有效降低边缘设备的功耗，为连续制造业提供了高效且经济的预测性维护解决方案。

Abstract: Conveyor belts are vital arteries in continuous bulk material handling, particularly in heavy process industries such as cement manufacturing. Undetected structural anomalies (longitudinal tears, holes, degraded patch repairs, and impact punctures) cause catastrophic belt snapping, costly downtime, and severe safety hazards. While deep learning offers high accuracy, existing models rely on power-hungry workstation GPUs, hindering practical deployment at remote industrial edge points. In this paper, we propose, implement, and validate an end-to-end, low-power edge AI vision system for real-time conveyor belt defect detection deployed on a Raspberry Pi 5 accelerated by a Google Coral Edge TPU coprocessor. The system leverages an optimized YOLOv11 nano (YOLOv11n) architecture trained on a multi-source industrial corpus exceeding 3,000 augmented samples from an operational cement plant in West Java, open-source datasets, and automated captures. The model undergoes post-training full integer quantization (INT8) compiled for systolic tensor execution. Experimental results demonstrate robust detection capability, achieving precision of 0.742, recall of 0.730, and mAP@0.5 of 0.764 across four defect classes. Deployed on-site in an IP-rated enclosure interfaced with an RTSP PoE industrial camera, the system achieves stable throughput of 30-40 FPS at 320x320 resolution with an end-to-end latency of 70-90 ms. Operational profiling under harsh clinker dust confirms thermal equilibrium at 55 +/- 5 deg C on the host CPU and ~65 deg C on the Edge TPU with zero frame loss. This demonstrates that edge AI bridges the gap between high-accuracy computer vision and cost-effective predictive maintenance in continuous manufacturing.

</details>


### [124] [Learning Discriminative Prototypes via Boundary Repulsion MixUp for Object Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34305)
*Athena Psalta,Vasileios Tsironis,Konstantinos Karantzalos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PBR-ReID 提出了一种基于原型的框架，通过学习类间几何结构来提升身份识别的鲁棒性。该方法利用了边界排斥混合（BRM）策略，将常规混合的弱点转化为区分性信号，从而改善了混叠身份之间的边界清晰度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的两两对比损失方法难以有效处理可混淆身份的边界区域，PBR-ReID 通过明确学习类间几何结构来克服这一问题。

Method: PBR-ReID 利用原型表示每个身份，并与 DiNOv3 骨干网络联合优化。通过原型相似性矩阵，该方法在每一步训练中都能识别最易混淆的身份对。进一步，提出了一种边界排斥混合（BRM）策略，该策略构建了明确的边界代理，并将阻碍样本排斥开来，从而将边界模糊转化为区分性信号。

Result: 在人员和车辆的重识别基准测试中，该方法表现出色，经过广泛的实验证明，各组件均有显著贡献。

Conclusion: PBR-ReID 方法通过明确学习类间几何结构和边界排斥混合策略，显著改进了重识别任务中可混淆身份的区分性能。

Abstract: Object re-identification requires embeddings that are robust to intra-class variation in viewpoint, illumination, and occlusion, yet preserve sharp separation between visually similar identities. The hardest errors arise precisely where confusable identities meet, a region that pairwise losses shape only implicitly. We present PBR-ReID, a prototype-based framework that makes this inter-class geometry an explicit learning target. Each identity is represented by a learnable prototype jointly optimized with a DiNOv3 backbone and the resulting prototype similarity matrix reveals, at every training step, which identities are most confusable.
