To this end, we developed a two-stage detection-segmentation framework that accurately segmented $n = 27664$ unique bone masks from a radiographic dataset of $n = 1456$ subjects with diverse ages and sexes (HD95 = $1.512 \pm 0.005$, ASSD $0.449 \pm 001$, Dice = $0.987 \pm 0.00004$, IoU = $0.975 \pm 0.0001$). Following SSM fitting, our follow-up analyses of stratified shape parameters highlighted the morphology of sexual dimorphisms for each bone and demonstrated sex-specific differences in shape development. Our results were consistent with existing literature and provided an unambiguous, data-driven methodology for characterizing tissue shape and its population-scale variation. This approach provides a potential methodological foundation for developing population-based models of anatomical variation and could be extended to investigate tissue growth and shape changes over time. Future work should evaluate the applicability of this methodology on alternative anatomical structures and imaging modalities, with the goal of validating these growth trajectories on longitudinal data.

</details>


### [194] [Temporal Slice Learning for AI-Generated Video Detection with 400$\times$ Fewer FLOPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35148)
*Wei Shang,Zhiyuan Li,Shengfeng He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种从表示角度再思考AI生成视频检测的方法，通过频率感知的时空切片一致性学习，将视频重新结构化为紧凑的切片表示，从而提高检测效率和性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检测方法依赖于复杂的全视频建模，导致计算成本高且可扩展性差，因此对从表示角度重思考视频检测方法的需求。

Method: 研究引入了一种基于频率感知的时空切片一致性的轻量级框架，通过时间聚合具有信息性的空间行和列形成切片域输入，这种方法能够抑制冗余并保留有区别的动态。

Result: 该方法在GenVideo和AI-Artist基准上的实验表明，该方法在模型前向计算量降低了400多倍和3.6倍的模型推理速度（端到端包括预处理情况下为2.9倍），同时仍能取得强大的检测性能。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一种有效的方法来检测AI生成的视频中的差异，这不仅提高了检测效率，还促进了更大规模部署的可能性。

Abstract: Recent advances in generative video models have improved visual realism, making detection increasingly dependent on subtle temporal inconsistencies. However, these signals are weak and spatially localized, while most of the video content is redundant. This creates a fundamental mismatch: existing detectors rely on heavy backbones to model full videos, which leads to high computational cost and limited scalability. In this work, we rethink AI-generated video detection from a representation perspective. Instead of modeling entire videos, we restructure them into compact temporal slice representations that isolate informative temporal evolution. We introduce a lightweight framework using frequency-aware temporal slice consistency learning, where informative spatial rows and columns are aggregated over time to form slice-domain inputs. This reparameterization suppresses redundant appearance while preserving discriminative temporal dynamics, enabling efficient and targeted detection. By constructing slices from both high- and low-frequency regions, our method exposes complementary temporal artifacts, including unstable details and abnormal motion smoothness. We instantiate this idea in a Temporal Slice Consistency Network, which integrates task-driven slice localization, hierarchical positional encoding, and a lightweight Transformer to model cross-slice and cross-frequency dependencies. We further introduce AI-Artist, a new benchmark with artist-curated videos from recent high-fidelity generators, including Seedance and Kling. Experiments on GenVideo and AI-Artist show that our method achieves strong performance while requiring over 400$\times$ fewer model-forward FLOPs and 3.6$\times$ faster model inference than the strong video-based baseline ReStraV (2.9$\times$ faster end to end, including preprocessing), enabling scalable and practical deployment.

</details>


### [195] [Complexity-guided Regularization for Generalizable Human Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35152)
*Gun Ryu,Gi-Mun Um,Won-Sik Cheong,Wonjun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种复杂性引导正则化方案，通过利用服装人体局部熵计算出的复杂性先验，优化了人类高几何和纹理复杂度区域的细节表示，提高了合成未见过人体的新视角的真实感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在表示人体的细粒度细节方面仍存在问题，尤其是在复杂几何和纹理区域，导致渲染结果模糊。为了解决这一问题，本研究提出了复杂性引导正则化方案。

Method: 该方案利用了服装人体局部几何和纹理特性的局部熵计算出的复杂性先验，防止在复杂区域粗略放置高斯体，同时根据此复杂性先验从复杂区域优先采样局部片段，以增强模型的局部细节监督。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法在保持实时推理速度的同时，实现了在通用人体高斯点云合成方面的最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 本研究提出的方法在合成未见过人体的新视角方面取得了显著的性能提升，验证了复杂性引导正则化方案的有效性。

Abstract: Recent studies on generalizable human Gaussian splatting have achieved the notable progress in synthesizing novel views of unseen human subjects from multi-view images. Despite this progress, existing methods still struggle to represent fine-grained details of human subjects, which inherently involve high geometric and textural complexity. This is because previous methods do not impose a constraint on how densely Gaussians are placed, which often leads to blurry rendering results in complex regions. To address this problem, we propose a complexity-guided regularization scheme. The key idea is to leverage a complexity prior computed via the local entropy in geometric and textural characteristics of a clothed human. This effectively prevents Gaussians from being coarsely placed in complex regions, which facilitates the faithful reconstruction of intricate structures. Furthermore, we sample local patches predominantly from complex regions according to this complexity prior, which allows the model to be sufficiently supervised by local details. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method delivers state-of-the-art performance while maintaining the real-time inference speed in generalizable human Gaussian splatting. The code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/DCVL-3D/CGR-GS_release.

</details>


### [196] [OrthoRF: Exploring Orthogonality in Object-Centric Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35203)
*Despoina Touska,Bastiaan Onne Fagginger Auer,Alexandru Onose,Tejaswi Kasarla,Luis Armando Pérez Rey,Maximilian Lipp,Lyubov Amitonova,Martin R. Oswald,Pascal Cerfontaine*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种新的同步特征模型——正交旋转特征（OrthoRF），通过在方向空间中强制正交性和结构化修改，提高了相位对齐的清晰度和分组的可靠性，能够更准确地发现对象并恢复被遮挡的对象部分，优于现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经同步性假说认为，神经同步有助于大脑将视觉场景组织成结构化的多对象表示。在机器学习中，同步模型通过在复值特征的相位中存储绑定来学习对象中心的表示。本文旨在通过强制正交性来改进同步特征模型，以提高其在对象发现任务中的性能。

Method: 通过引入正交旋转特征（OrthoRF），在方向空间中引入正交性约束，并通过内积损失和结构化修改来实现。该模型使用向量激活，对象存在通过幅度编码，关联通过方向编码。

Result: 实验表明，OrthoRF 在无监督对象发现任务中达到或超过了当前模型的性能，在重叠对象、噪声和离散分布测试中表现更优，产生更具可解释性的表示，无需使用许多同步模型后的聚类。此外，OrthoRF 还能够恢复被遮挡的对象部分，表明在遮挡情况下的更强的分组能力。

Conclusion: 正交性被证明是一种简单有效的归纳偏置，适用于基于同步的对象中心学习。

Abstract: Neural synchrony is hypothesized to help the brain organize visual scenes into structured multi-object representations. In machine learning, synchrony-based models analogously learn object-centric representations by storing binding in the phase of complex-valued features. Rotating Features (RF) instantiate this idea with vector-valued activations, encoding object presence in magnitudes and affiliation in orientations. We propose Orthogonal Rotating Features (OrthoRF), which enforces orthogonality in RF's orientation space via an inner-product loss and architectural modifications. This yields sharper phase alignment and more reliable grouping. In evaluations of unsupervised object discovery, including settings with overlapping objects, noise, and out-of-distribution tests, OrthoRF matches or outperforms current models while producing more interpretable representations, and it eliminates the post-hoc clustering required by many synchrony-based approaches. Unlike current models, OrthoRF also recovers occluded object parts, indicating stronger grouping under occlusion. Overall, orthogonality emerges as a simple, effective inductive bias for synchrony-based object-centric learning.

</details>


### [197] [Multi-Agent Relay Thinking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35219)
*Xu Liu,Jungang Qiao,Guikun Chen,Xiaojuan Qi,Wenguan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了Multi-Agent Confidence-guided Relay（MACR）框架，通过动态传递推理所有权来实现多代理协作。该框架提升了在数学视觉和多媒体星图基准测试中的准确性，并且相比于其他方法消耗更少的令牌。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体协同工作方法大多集中在集体思考协作拓扑结构上，而本文探索了一种新的接力思考拓扑结构，通过智能体之间的信心引导递和竞价机制，使得智能体能够动态传递并改进推理过程，实现互补知识的积累。

Method: 提出的MACR框架通过信心引导的递推触发机制和竞价机制，确定何时以及哪个智能体继续推理。该框架能够使不同的智能体在推理过程中逐步整合互补的见解。

Result: 实验表明，MACR方法在数学视觉和多媒体星图基准测试中的准确性超过了最强的单模型策略，并且在幻觉基准和多媒体星图中消耗的令牌数量减少了6.0倍。

Conclusion: 本研究通过MACR框架实现了多智能体之间的协作优势，证明了接力协作能够促进不同智能体在推理过程中积累互补的知识。

Abstract: Existing multi-agent collaboration (MAC) methods have primarily explored a group thinking collaboration topology, where agents independently generate solutions and aggregate their outputs. In this work, we investigate an alternative relay thinking topology, where reasoning ownership is dynamically transferred across agents, allowing subsequent agents to inherit and refine an evolving reasoning trajectory. We introduce Multi-Agent Confidence-guided Relay (MACR), a framework that enables dynamical relay collaboration among agents. The key challenge is determining when reasoning should be relayed and which agent should continue the process. method addresses this challenge through confidence-guided relay triggering and a bidding mechanism that selects the next agent based on its confidence. Experiments on four benchmarks show that method outperforms the strongest single-model strategies in accuracy, e.g., +3.3% on MathVista and +3.9% on MMStar, and remains on par with multi-agent strategies while consuming 6.0x less token overhead on HallusionBench and MMStar.Further analysis demonstrates that relay collaboration enables heterogeneous agents to progressively integrate complementary insights, combining heterogeneous capabilities across reasoning stages. Our source code is available at https://github.com/67L1/MACR.

</details>


### [198] [O2D-MedNet: An Optimization-Aware Dual-Domain Framework for Robust Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35220)
*Shipeng Hu,Miaohui Wang,Jing Qin,Sukun Tian,Yuchun Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的综合域优化意识框架（O2D-MedNet）用于医疗图像分割（MIS），它通过域间互动模块和融合机制及优化策略克服了现有单流和混合流方法的限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的单流框架将异构线索集中在单一表示路径上，而混合流方法往往依赖于通用或静态融合，这些方法难以有效地协调不同领域，且无法明确解决优化不稳定问题。因此，需要一种新方法来解决这些限制。

Method: 该方法包括三个主要部分：1）一个降级感知的域间互动（DDI）模块，结合傅里叶-小波域特征以抑制降级敏感反应同时保留结构和细节信息；2）一种跨骨干特征引导的融合（CGF）模块，实现基于CNN局部细节建模和视觉状态空间全局结构建模的有选择性互动；3）一种梯度上下文优化（GCO）策略，根据损失趋势和梯度统计自适应调整学习动态。

Result: 实验结果表明，O2D-MedNet在多个医学成像模态上在多种基准数据集上的一致性上都优于现有的MIS方法，显示出增强的敏感性、结构一致性和优化稳定性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的O2D-MedNet框架通过解决现有MIS方法中的缺陷，提高了在复杂和异构情景下的医疗图像分割性能与稳定性。

Abstract: Medical image segmentation (MIS) remains challenging due to composite degradations and multi-scale geometric variations, which jointly impair lesion-background separability, structural consistency, and optimization stability. Existing single-stream frameworks entangle heterogeneous cues within a single representation pathway, while hybrid-stream approaches often rely on generic or static fusion, limiting effective coordination across domains and failing to explicitly address optimization instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose a new optimization-aware dual-domain framework for MIS (O2D-MedNet). First, a degradation-aware dualdomain interaction (DDI) module integrates Fourier - and Wavelet-domain features to suppress degradation-sensitive responses while preserving structural and fine-detail information. Second, a cross-backbone contour-guided fusion (CGF) module enables selective interaction between CNN-based local detail modeling and visual state-space-based global structure modeling, improving boundary accuracy and representation consistency. Third, a gradient-context optimization (GCO) strategy stabilizes training by adaptively adjusting learning dynamics based on loss trends and gradient statistics, mitigating instability caused by class imbalance and heterogeneous sample difficulty. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art MIS methods across multiple imaging modalities. Further analyses confirm enhanced sensitivity, structural consistency, and optimization stability, validating the effectiveness of the proposed O2D-MedNet for robust MIS under heterogeneous conditions.

</details>


### [199] [Joint Latent Reasoning and Observation for Agentic Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35229)
*Junzhang Liu,Hao Yuan,Qi Zhang,Yiming Wu,Long Chen,Zhecan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LARVA 提出了一种框架，通过联合学习的潜在推理和视觉观察，使得小型模型能够学习不仅回答问题，还能指导后续的搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视频代理模型在学习回答问题的同时，也需学习如何确定下一步的观察行为。小型模型在这一过程中面临挑战，因为每个观察都具有两种功能：支持回答和引导后续证据的获取。LARVA 的动机在于解决这一问题。

Method: LARVA 通过构建一个紧凑连续的表示接口，将观察者与推理器连接起来，实现多轮的视频分析。观察者通过此接口传递观察到的信息，推理器据此选择下一步的行动或直接生成最终答案。LARVA 还引入了观察重建和推理分布对齐作为辅助监督。

Result: LARVA 在五个视频理解基准测试中表现出了强大的性能，使用 4B 和 7B 参数量的模型。在 VideoHolmes、Video-MME 和 LVBench 这三个基准上，7B 模型的表现优于基于相同教师轨迹训练的文本 CoT 学生模型，分别高出 5.1、2.5 和 3.7 个百分点。

Conclusion: LARVA 通过联合学习的方法，有效地解决了视频理解能力在小型模型中的转移问题，展示了其在多个视频理解任务中的优越性能。

Abstract: Effective video agents must learn not only how to answer, but also where to look next. Transferring this capability to smaller models is challenging because each observation serves two purposes: supporting an answer and guiding the search for further evidence. Textual descriptions may capture what is currently visible while omitting cues needed for subsequent acquisition. We introduce Latent Agentic Reasoning for Video Analysis (LARVA), a framework that distills multi-round video agents through jointly learned latent reasoning and visual observations. Rather than communicating through captions, an observer passes compact continuous representations to a reasoner that selects the next acquisition action or produces the final answer. Crucially, action and answer supervision propagate through this interface, training the observer to communicate information useful for downstream decisions. Observation reconstruction and reasoning-distribution alignment provide auxiliary supervision from textual teacher trajectories. Across five video-understanding benchmarks, LARVA achieves strong performance with 4B and 7B backbones. On VideoHolmes, Video-MME, and LVBench, the 7B model outperforms a textual CoT student trained on the same teacher trajectories by 5.1, 2.5, and 3.7 percentage points, respectively. These results highlight the value of jointly learning how agents represent evidence and act on it when distilling video-understanding capabilities.

</details>


### [200] [Reading Beyond OCR Noise: Robust Cross-Lingual RAG for Legislative Archives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35240)
*Radha Krishna Deshpande,Ajoy Mondal,Akash Manna,C V Jawahar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究介绍了用于处理印度历史档案中多页扫描文档的端到端框架，包括基于视觉的布局分割、多字体OCR以及检索增强生成（RAG）流水线，有效应对视觉退化和布局模糊带来的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文致力于解决印度议会记录等历史公共档案因视觉退化和复杂布局导致难以进行信息检索的问题。

Method: 提出了结合基于视觉的布局分割、多字体OCR及检索增强生成（RAG）流水线的端到端框架。

Result: 系统在处理包含视觉退化和复杂布局的20万页档案时表现出优越性，能够生成准确的答案。

Conclusion: 研究通过一个迭代的代理检索增强循环有效应对了视觉退化和布局模糊带来的问题，优于仅基于文本的传统基线。

Abstract: India's historical public archives present severe computer vision and document image analysis challenges: decades of parliamentary records survive only as degraded, multi-column scanned pages featuring mixed scripts, complex layouts, and dense visual noise where OCR failure is the primary obstacle to information retrieval. We present an end-to-end framework that couples vision-based layout segmentation and multi-script OCR with an agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline. Our approach specifically addresses how visual degradation and layout fragmentation propagate into text extraction errors, using an iterative agentic loop to navigate around OCR noise and layout ambiguities before generating answers. Evaluated on the 200,000-page Punjab Vidhan Sabha archive, our system demonstrates robust handling of historical document degradation, outperforming standard text-only baselines.

</details>


### [201] [Low-rank MERA Decomposition of 3D OCT Image Volume for Compression, Denoising, Feature Extraction and Diagnosis of Retinal Diseases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35271)
*Ivica Kopriva,Fei Shi,Marija Štanfel,Qin Peng,Jianhao Bao,Gaowei Li,Xinjian Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种低秩多尺度纠缠重归整化 ansatz（MERA）张量网络近似方法，用于三维 OCT 图像体积，旨在压缩、去噪和特征提取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光学相干断层扫描（OCT）虽然是一种非侵入性成像技术，可以可视化视网膜组织，但受限于图像噪声和大视场需处理的高分辨率要求，导致存储备份和远程眼科应用上存在挑战。

Method: 该方法通过将图像体积表示为核心因子的收缩，该因子编码全局特征，以及多个交互的低秩正交或半正交因子来建模不同 B 扫描间的相关性，实现了压缩、去噪和特征提取。

Result: 该方法在两个不同的 OCT 成像扫描仪获取的数据上进行了评估，与多种竞争方法相比，显示了更好的视觉质量和减少了视网膜层分割误差。提取 MERA 特征后，分类器在临床小样本设置中表现出色。

Conclusion: 研究提出的方法即使在数据较少的情况下也能有效分类眼底疾病，提供了一种在有限监督下高性能且具有良好可解释性的高维数据表示学习方法。

Abstract: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a non-invasive imaging modality used for visualization of retinal tissue. However, OCT volumes are affected by speckle noise, which degrades image contrast and obscures fine structural details. Furthermore, modern clinical practice requires large field-of-view, high-resolution OCT volumes, whose storage and transmission are demanding for archiving and teleophthalmology applications. To address aforementioned challenges, we propose a low-rank multi-scale entanglement renormalization ansatz (MERA) tensor network approximation of 3D OCT image volume, where the image volume is represented as contractions of a top core factor encoding global features and multiple interacting low-rank orthogonal or semi-orthogonal factors modeling inter- and intra-B scan correlations. This representation jointly enables compression, denoising, and feature extraction. Unlike deep learning approaches, the proposed approach is training-free and processes each OCT volume independently. We evaluate the proposed framework on OCT image volumes acquired by two different scanners and demonstrate improved visual quality and reduced retinal layer segmentation errors in comparison with several competing methods. We also extract MERA features from two clinical OCT volume datasets. They are subsequently classified using a Grassmann-manifold nearest-subspace classifier. With the subspace dimension as its only hyperparameter, the classifier is theoretically shown to be robust in small-sample clinical scenario. We demonstrate competitive accuracy of classification of retinal diseases in these small-sample settings, where deep learning methods are often limited by the scarcity of labeled data. The proposed structure-aware model-driven representation learning for high-dimensional data under limited supervision provides good generalization performance while maintaining high interpretability.

</details>


### [202] [OVM-Occ: Open-Vocabulary Monocular Occupancy Prediction via Geometry-Aware Vision-Language Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35312)
*Shuyang Yu,Haibo Qin,Shaohan Hu,Wei Shan,Xiaoqing Guan,You Wang,Guang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于高斯分布的实例感知视觉语言教师的开放词汇单目占用预测方法OVM-Occ，通过引入语言嵌入的高斯作为中间场景表示，提出了几何感知的可变形注意力模块来细化高斯语义特征，构建了实例级别的视觉语言嵌入以提供可靠的语义监督，并引入了几何感知的分离语义蒸馏以减轻几何学习与语义学习之间的干扰。通过OpenOcc-ScanNet和OpenOcc-Replica两个增强基准测试集，实验结果表明该方法在室内场景的开放词汇单目占用预测中取得了最先进的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前方法受到预定义类别限制，无法泛化到未见过的类别，特别是在室内场景中，对象具有高度多样的语义类别。因此，研究开放词汇单目占用预测以提高其泛化能力。

Method: OVM-Occ框架采用基于高斯分布的中间场景表示，结合了几何感知的可变形注意力模块和实例级别的视觉语言嵌入，以及几何感知的分离语义蒸馏来缓解几何与语义学习的干扰。

Result: 在OpenOcc-ScanNet和OpenOcc-Replica两个增强基准测试集上，该方法显著提升了单目占用预测性能，与之前最先进的方法相比，在Occ-ScanNet数据集上mIoU提高了12.2，IoU提高了0.6。

Conclusion: 该研究为开放词汇单目占用预测在室内场景的应用提供了新的解决方案，并展示了在开放词汇设置下的优越性能。

Abstract: Monocular occupancy prediction in indoor scenes aims to recover a scene's 3D geometry and semantics from a single RGB image. Existing methods are restricted to a closed set of predefined categories, limiting their ability to generalize to unseen categories. This limitation is particularly critical in indoor scenes, where objects exhibit highly diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. We study open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes and present OVM-Occ, a Gaussian-based occupancy framework with an instance-aware vision-language teacher. Specifically, we adopt Language-Embedded Gaussians as the intermediate scene representation, propose a geometry-aware deformable attention module to refine Gaussian semantic features, and construct instance-level vision-language embeddings to provide reliable semantic supervision. We further introduce geometry-aware decoupled semantic distillation to mitigate the interference between geometry learning and semantic learning. To evaluate open-vocabulary occupancy prediction performance, we introduce OpenOcc-ScanNet and OpenOcc-Replica, two extended benchmarks with more diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes, outperforming the previous state-of-the-art approach by 12.2 mIoU and 0.6 IoU on the Occ-ScanNet dataset, with consistent gains under new open-vocabulary evaluation protocols.

</details>


### [203] [Targeted Deep Regression - Initial Applications in Whole-Body Water-Fat MRI in UK Biobank](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35339)
*Filip Marttala,Taro Langner,Johan Öfverstedt,Nouman Ahmad,Håkan Ahlström,Robin Strand,Joel Kullberg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于从英国生物银行中水-脂肪MRI扫描估计数值属性的方法，通过结合自动图像分割和回归模型，实现高分辨率和高信息密度的信息提取，并通过显着性分析突出显示关键解剖区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在利用自动化方法从MRI影像中提取更多有效的生物标记，以补充现有的医学研究数据，增强对医学研究的理解。同时，通过突出显示关键解剖区域来提高预测准确性。

Method: 该方法利用针对特定解剖区域的手动定义子区域通过图像配准传播到大量采集扫描，构建ResNet50风格网络进行2D多通道拼接，最后输出高分辨率的密集信息用于回归分析。

Result: 该方法在肾体积、心室体积和年龄等回归指标上取得了优秀的预测性能，R2值在0.731至0.984之间，且通过显着性分析成功标识出具有医学意义的区域，进一步标准化并限制了深学习回归分析的信息输入。

Conclusion: 该方法有效提高了MRI影像的生物标志物提取能力和预测准确性，为医疗推断研究提供了广泛的应用前景。

Abstract: UK Biobank is a British clinical study which, in addition to large amounts of medical data collected, plans to include detailed Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) examina- tions from 100,000 participants. The image data can be analyzed for example by auto- mated analysis with neural networks for image segmentation or classification to expand the collection of image-derived phenotypes for medical research. In this work, we pro- pose, present and evaluate a methodology that uses image-based regression to estimate numerical properties from the collected neck-to-knee water-fat MRI scans. It applies a ResNet50-style network to 2D multi-channel collages that represent targeted and study- specific anatomical sub-regions from the MRI scan. The targeted sub-region sampling is achieved by propagating manually defined subregions from a reference scan to the other >30,000 analyzed scans using image registration. The resulting collages can be compact while retaining high-resolution, for example by providing multiple slices of kidney tissue for a kidney volume regression network. This approach also enables group-wise saliency analysis that highlight image and anatomical regions used by the network for the pre- dictions. The method was applied for the regression endpoints of kidney volume, heart volume, and age. Predictive performance was found between R2 = 0.731-0.984 and the group-wise saliency maps were found to highlight medically relevant regions. We con- clude that the method can be used to standardize and restrict the information presented to a deep regression analysis pipeline, increasing information density and opening up a wide range of future medical inference studies.

</details>


### [204] [CVTSplat: Multi-view Reconstruction Using an Adaptive Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35347)
*Briac Toussaint,Diego Thomas,Jean-Sébastien Franco,Edmond Boyer,Christian Theobalt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CVTSplat通过使用可变细胞大小的自适应CVT方法来加速多视图图像中的形状和外观重建，同时保持高效的计算特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的Voronoi镶嵌方法在恢复多视图图像中的形状和外观时由于不规则的单元导致重复优化成本较高，因此研究了自适应中心质量矢量分割（CVTSplat）来解决这个问题。

Method: CVTSplat通过调整随演变的符号距离场改变细胞大小，将采样点集中在零水平集附近，保留接近中心的质量单元，以便在整条管道中使用专门为小、几乎等轴向单元定制的GPU算法和拟图构造。

Result: CVTSplat在DTU和BlendedMVS数据集上的几何精度与最佳的高斯采样表面方法相当，而仅需约2.5分钟的单GPU训练时间。

Conclusion: CVTSplat提供了一种高效的多视图图像形状和外观重建方法，通过定制的GPU算法实现高速构建，并提供了与最佳高斯采样表面方法相竞争的几何精度。

Abstract: Voronoi tessellations have recently emerged as an adaptive, space-partitioning discretization for shape and appearance reconstruction from multi-view images. However, the irregular cells they produce make the repeated reconstruction of the tessellation during optimization costly. We therefore explore adaptive centroidal Voronoi tessellations (CVTs), which extend standard CVTs with non-uniform cell sizes while preserving the regular, well-shaped cells that make them efficient to compute. In CVTSplat, cell size is modulated by the evolving signed distance field, concentrating sites near the zero level set while keeping cells nearly centroidal. This regularity lets us specialize the whole pipeline, with GPU algorithms for nearest-neighbor queries and approximate Voronoi construction, and a rasterizer tailored to small, nearly isotropic cells. Our Voronoi construction is 5 to 10 times faster than general-purpose alternatives in this regime. On DTU and BlendedMVS, CVTSplat reaches geometric accuracy competitive with the best Gaussian-splatting surface methods while training in about 2.5 minutes on a single GPU.

</details>


### [205] [Evidence-Guided Selection of Retinal Vessel Segmentation Pipelines: A Cross-Dataset Benchmark of Performance, Structure, Failure Modes, and Reproducibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35357)
*Ruoyu Yan,Yuejia Liu,Shixin Xu,Xiaoyan Li,Xi Luo,Yuhui Deng,Huaxiong Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文对比了五种血管分割管道在六个公开数据集上的性能，通过多种评估指标发现没有单一模型在所有场景下表现最优，强调了依据任务条件选择合适管道的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的血管分割模型评估主要依赖综合重叠分数，容易忽略结构保真度、跨数据集鲁棒性及应用场景特定的错误成本。

Method: 文章采用了包含像素级一致性、跨数据集稳定性、细血管保留、结构度量、错误成分与可用计算证据等多种评估指标，对五种管道在244张来自六个公共数据集的图像上进行了性能评估。

Result: FSG-Net在多个评估指标上表现优异，如最大等数据集平均宏F1（0.77）、IoU（0.63）、clDice（0.83）、骨架F1（0.78），而SA-UNetv2在灵敏度（0.85）和细小血管灵敏度（0.63）上表现最佳。

Conclusion: 不同数据集间的差异往往大于领先管道间的差异，所有方法的共同错误集中在标注血管边界附近及微弱边缘血管处。研究结果表明，应根据任务条件选择合适的管道，而不仅依赖单一的普遍排名，同时也强调验证选定管道的适用性至关重要。

Abstract: Retinal vessel segmentation is widely used in retinal image analysis, yet model selection based only on aggregate overlap scores can overlook structural fidelity, cross-dataset robustness, and application-specific error costs. We evaluated five executable binary vessel-segmentation pipelines (FSG-Net, SA-UNetv2, DCP-1024, GAVE, and FR-UNet) on 244 images from six public datasets using pixel-level agreement, cross-dataset stability, thin-vessel retention, structural metrics, error composition, and available computational evidence. Results were aggregated with equal weighting across datasets. No pipeline was optimal in every setting. FSG-Net achieved the highest equal-dataset mean Macro-F1 (0.77), IoU (0.63), clDice (0.83), and Skeleton F1 (0.78), whereas SA-UNetv2 achieved the highest mean sensitivity (0.85) and Thin-Vessel Sensitivity (0.63). Differences across datasets were often larger than those among the leading pipelines, and errors shared by all five methods were concentrated near annotated vessel boundaries and faint peripheral vessels. In an ancillary analysis on 45 HRF images, segmentation masks were converted into 11 ring-wise vascular features for leave-one-out classification. Controlled perturbations showed that local mask errors can be amplified in downstream features, while targeted stabilization reduced sensitivity for five features. The results support task-conditioned, benchmark-relative pipeline selection rather than a single universal ranking and highlight the need to validate the selected pipeline on the intended target domain.

</details>


### [206] [SG-Splat: Stable Geometry Learning under Pose Uncertainty for Pose-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35361)
*Xiaohan Lu,Jiaqi Zhang,Weijia Jiang,Siwei Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了SG-Splat框架，通过解耦几何估计和高斯属性预测分支，并引入粗到细的校准管道（Flow-Guided Pose Refinement (FGPR) 和 Residual-Guided Geometry Correction (RGC)），提高了实时新颖视角合成和3D场景重建的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对现有的无姿态前馈3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）方法对残差姿态误差敏感的问题，本文提出了一种新的方法来稳定几何和属性的学习。

Method: SG-Splat框架将几何估计和高斯属性预测分离到两个专门的分支中，并引入了基于流引导姿态校准（FGPR）和残差引导几何校正（RGC）的粗到细校准管道。此外，它还引入了一种双路径策略，结合了真实和预测的姿态用于基准变换，以提供更清洁的高斯属性监督，同时提高几何对残差姿态误差的鲁棒性。

Result: 实验结果表明，SG-Splat方法在新颖视角合成和姿态估计上都取得了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: SG-Splat方法为实时新颖视角合成和3D场景重建提供了一种新的解决方案，提高了鲁棒性和训练的稳定性。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a promising representation for real-time novel view synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. For practical deployment, recent studies have explored pose-free feed-forward 3DGS, which reconstructs Gaussian representations directly from unposed input images. However, these methods remain sensitive to residual pose errors, which perturb canonical-space Gaussian transformation, introducing noisy supervision for geometry and attribute learning. To address this problem, we present SG-Splat, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that improves robustness to pose uncertainty and stabilizes the learning of Gaussian primitives. SG-Splat decouples geometry estimation and Gaussian attribute prediction into two dedicated branches, reducing error coupling between pose-sensitive geometry and Gaussian attributes. We further introduce a coarse-to-fine refinement pipeline, consisting of Flow-Guided Pose Refinement (FGPR) and Residual-Guided Geometry Correction (RGC), to improve geometric alignment before Gaussian attribute reconstruction. Specifically, FGPR refines camera poses with flow-based correlation features and differentiable bundle adjustment. RGC then corrects initial point maps using depth residuals derived from FGPR, producing more reliable Gaussian centers. To stabilize training, we introduce a dual-path strategy that mixes ground-truth and predicted poses for canonical transformation. It provides clean supervision for Gaussian attributes while improving geometry robustness to residual pose errors. Extensive experiments on DL3DV and RealEstate10K show that SG-Splat achieves state-of-the-art performance in both novel view synthesis and pose estimation.

</details>


### [207] [Shared-Factor-Conditioned Diffusion for Low-Rank Tensor Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35368)
*Zhengyun Cheng,Guanwen Zhang,Wei Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiffTR 提出了一种统一的无监督框架，通过坐标条件下的扩散，实现张量补全、去噪和超光谱超分辨率。该框架支持不同类型的输出，并在多种张量模式下展示了竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的张量恢复方法缺乏一种能在各种模态和任务中适应的表示方法，DiffTR 旨在解决这一问题。

Method: DiffTR 通过一种坐标条件下的扩散机制，统一了张量补全、去噪和超光谱超分辨率的任务。它使用共享因素条件下的紧凑评分网络，并通过评分匹配学习隐式张量表示。

Result: DiffTR 在多个张量模态和恢复任务上展示了竞争力，并且其无监督框架允许与不同的破坏模型兼容，并且可以轻松纳入任务特定限制。

Conclusion: DiffTR 的提出为张量恢复领域提供了一种新的方法，能够处理多种类型的数据，并且其框架具有较高的灵活性。

Abstract: Tensor recovery spans heterogeneous data structures and observation processes, calling for a representation that can adapt across modalities and tasks. We propose DiffTR, an unsupervised framework that unifies tensor completion, denoising, and hyperspectral super-resolution through coordinate-conditioned diffusion. Shared factors indexed by tensor coordinates condition a compact score network, and score matching jointly learns the factors and an implicit tensor representation from the available observations. Scalar and vector-valued outputs accommodate individual entries and entire tubes, enabling a common formulation for tabular tensors, images, and videos. The framework separates representation learning from task-specific observation modeling: reverse diffusion recovers missing values; estimation via Tweedie's formula, soft thresholding, and optional spatial consistency support mixed-noise denoising; and measurement-guided sampling transfers a prior learned from low-resolution hyperspectral observations to high-resolution reconstruction, followed by post-sampling refinement with data consistency and spectral subspace regularization. This separation makes the representation compatible with different corruption models and permits task-specific constraints to be incorporated within the same recovery framework. Experiments across multiple tensor modalities and recovery tasks demonstrate competitive reconstruction quality and the flexibility of a unified conditional generative representation. The code is available at https://github.com/CZY-Code/DiffTR

</details>


### [208] [GIFT: Representation Geometry Matters for Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35374)
*Yin Zhang,Yaoyue Zheng,Yongqiang Zhang,Bogdan Raducanu,Dan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了GIFT方法，通过几何不变性微调强化Vision Foundation Model的泛化能力，实验表明该方法在两个单域泛化检测基准上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法主要通过模拟未见域或抑制领域特定因素来应对分布偏移，但忽视了预训练Vision Foundation Models中的固有泛化能力。因此，需要一种方法来利用和强化这些模型的几何不变性。

Method: GIFT引入了一系列可学习的Householder反射到预训练权重中，以鼓励在领域变化下的几何一致适应。同时，提出了一种轻量级的通道级缩放来促进有效的任务特定适应。

Result: 在两个单域泛化检测基准上，GIFT方法显著优于现有最佳方法，Cityscapes-C和Diverse Weather Dataset的mPC分别提高了7.9%和2.9%。

Conclusion: 该工作的发现表明，保持表示的几何结构对于鲁棒跨域泛化至关重要，因此GIFT被认为是处理领域偏移的一种有原则且高效的方法。

Abstract: Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection (S-DGOD) aims to generalize from a single source domain to unseen domains under distribution shifts. Existing efforts mainly focus on simulating unseen domains or suppressing domain-specific factors. However, they largely overlook the intrinsic generalization capability embedded in Vision Foundation Models (VFMs). In this work, we show that unconstrained fine-tuning disrupts the geometric structure of pre-trained representations, which encodes domain-invariant semantics. Motivated by this, we propose Geometric-Invariance Fine-Tuning (GIFT), a geometric-aware fine-tuning method for VFMs. Specifically, we introduce a series of learnable Householder reflections to the pre-trained weights to encourage geometry-consistent adaptation under domain shift. In addition, we propose a lightweight channel-wise scaling to facilitate effective task-specific adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GIFT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches on two S-DGOD benchmarks. Notably, by introducing fewer than 1% additional trainable parameters into the frozen backbone, the proposed method achieves improvements of +7.9% and +2.9% in mPC over the previous SOTA on the Cityscapes-C and Diverse Weather Dataset, respectively. This finding highlights that preserving representation geometry is crucial for robust cross-domain generalization, establishing GIFT as a principled and efficient solution to domain shift.

</details>


### [209] [ACSAN: All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network Integrating Convolutional Operations with Vision Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35375)
*Zimian Wei,Tianqi Zhang,Hengyue Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 文章提出了一种新的深度学习模型ACSAN，通过结合多尺度空洞卷积和自注意力机制，减少训练数据需求，提高了学习效率，并且在三个常用图像分类数据库上实现了与标准ViT相当或更好的分类准确性，同时参数量较少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Vision Transformer (ViT) 模型依赖大量训练数据，这限制了其在资源受限环境下的应用。因此，为了解决这个问题，作者提出了All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network (ACSAN)，旨在减少数据需求并提高计算效率。

Method: ACSAN模型采用了动态卷积自注意力（DCSA）基模块，通过多尺度空洞卷积生成Query，Key和Value。DCSA模块中包含了空间自注意力和通道自注意力来生成注意力特征，最后将两种注意力特征合并作为DCSA模块的输出。基于DCSA模块构建的基本ACSAN块中，使用DCSA来替代常规的自注意力操作，用卷积层来替代MLP。

Result: ACSAN模型在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1k三个常用图像分类数据库上进行了从零开始训练。实验结果显示，相比于标准的ViT，ACSAN在较少或相似参数的情况下实现了相当甚至更好的分类准确率。消融研究还证实了每个组件对最终性能的正面贡献。

Conclusion: 总体而言，提出的方法ACSAN在保持高效性能的同时，通过减少训练数据依赖显著地提高了模型的适应性，为计算机视觉领域的轻量化模型研究提供了新的思路。

Abstract: In the past few years, Vision Transformer (ViT) has achieved excellent performance in the field of computer vision. However, there still some problems remain. For instance, ViTs heavily rely on large-scale training data since they simply contain a large number of trainable parameters, which slows down their learning efficiency and limits their applicability in resource-constrained scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel deep learning model, namely All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network (ACSAN), which applies convolution operations to replace fully-connected matrices multiplications in the ViT framework. To implement ACSAN, we firstly design Dynamic Convolutional Self-Attention (DCSA) as the basic module, which employs multi-scale dilated convolutions to generate Query, Key, and Value. We defined spatial self-attention and channel self-attention to generate attention features respectively. The two attention features are finally merged as the output of the DCSA module. Based on DCSA, we then construct the basic ACSAN block. Comparing with ViT, we use DCSA to replace the regular self-attention operations, and use convolution layers to replace MLPs. To evaluate the performance of the proposed method, we train ACSAN on three widely-used image classification databases, i.e. CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k, from scratch. Experimental results show that ACSAN achieves excellent classification accuracy comparing with standard ViT with comparable or fewer parameters, as well as other state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies verify that each component contributes positively to the final performance.

</details>


### [210] [Toward Clinical Translation of Deep Learning-Based Intracranial Super-Resolution 4D Flow MRI Using Multi-Cohort Transfer Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35396)
*Oliver Welin Odeback,Susanne Schnell,Patrick Winter,Johan Lundberg,Fredrik Piehl,Tobias Granberg,Alexander Fyrdahl,David Marlevi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究评估了合成预训练和多队列迁移学习在颅内4D Flow MRI深度学习超分辨中的效果，发现整合迁移学习在所有测试案例中的平均动脉流速归一化均方根误差（vNRMSE）最低，同时血管成像精度显著提高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在通过合成预训练和多队列迁移学习提高颅内4D Flow MRI的超分辨性能，以改善跨队列重建的准确性并与标准分辨率图像进行比较。

Method: 研究使用了18名参与者（12名健康参与者，3名患有 moyamoya 病，3名患有复发型多发性硬化症）的配对1.2-mm和0.6-mm 4D Flow MRI扫描。一个预训练在合成血管数据上的卷积神经网络进行微调，使用特定队列或整合多个队列的在体数据。使用高分辨率生成的输入进行体素级评估，原始标准分辨率扫描用于血管成像和血流动力学分析。

Result: 合成预训练降低了平均动脉流速归一化均方根误差（vNRMSE）（0.147 vs 0.166相比插值方法）。整合迁移学习在所有测试案例中取得最低的平均vNRMSE（0.119 vs 0.127对于特定队列模型以及0.147对于合成预训练），其95%差异限更窄（0.109-0.222 vs 0.154-0.278 m/s）。超分辨率相位对比血管成像在所有队列中获得了更好的精确查全率曲线下面积比原始标准分辨率成像高（0.848-0.896 vs 0.486-0.805）。

Conclusion: 研究结论表明，整合迁移学习在跨队列重建中具有更高的准确性，且超分辨可以改进血管显示，促进多中心验证以支持颅内血管成像。

Abstract: We evaluated synthetic pretraining and multi-cohort transfer learning for deep learning-based super-resolution of intracranial 4D Flow MRI across heterogeneous neurologic cohorts. This mixed prospective-retrospective study analyzed 18 participants (12 healthy participants, 3 with moyamoya disease, and 3 with multiple sclerosis) with paired 1.2-mm and 0.6-mm 4D Flow MRI scans. A convolutional neural network pretrained on synthetic cerebrovascular data was fine-tuned using cohort-specific or pooled multi-cohort in vivo data. High-resolution-derived inputs enabled voxel-wise evaluation; native standard-resolution scans were used for angiographic and hemodynamic analyses. Synthetic pretraining reduced mean artery-wise velocity-normalized root mean square error (vNRMSE) versus interpolation (0.147 vs 0.166). Pooled transfer learning yielded the lowest mean vNRMSE (0.119 vs 0.127 for cohort-specific models and 0.147 for synthetic pretraining), with narrower 95% limits-of-agreement widths than synthetic pretraining across all test cases (0.109-0.222 vs 0.154-0.278 m/s). Super-resolved phase-contrast angiography achieved higher precision-recall area under the curve than native standard-resolution imaging in all cohorts (0.848-0.896 vs 0.486-0.805). These results indicate that pooled transfer learning improves cross-cohort reconstruction agreement and that super-resolution can improve vessel depiction, supporting further multi-center validation for cerebrovascular imaging.

</details>


### [211] [Unveil the Mask: Jointly-Optimized Diffusion Masked Pretraining for Appearance-Agnostic Operator Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35414)
*Katsuya Ogata,Ryoya Yoshiyama,Kawachi Hodaka,Yuta Nakashima*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一个无需外部预训练模型的验证框架，结合了面部地标序列和视频帧两种模态，通过差分帧捕获精细面部运动，并将两者嵌入结合以增强识别准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统面部识别方法在分离开演员和渲染出的头像后变得不适用，因此需要一种新的非依赖于头像特征的验证方法。

Method: 框架包括两个模态：面部地标序列和视频帧。对面部地标序列进行混合地标预训练，该过程对地标进行分组并通过辅助任务指导，实现动态表示并转化为操作员嵌入。视频模态则通过相邻帧之间差异捕捉精细面部运动。两种模态的嵌入被结合以提高验证效果。

Result: 该方法在WBA2026基准上达到了整体AUC0.769，线性探针显示视频嵌入保留了少量的头像识别信息，而地标嵌入保留了一定的识别信息，结合两者在说话和倾听模式下尤其提高了验证效果。

Conclusion: 研究证明了这种基于两个不同模态的动态和视觉信息融合的方法的有效性，为身份验证提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Photorealistic avatar videos decouple the appearance of a rendered face from the person who operates it, which makes conventional face recognition unsuitable for identifying the operator. Verifying the operator therefore requires representations of how a face moves that are insensitive to what the avatar looks like. We propose a verification framework built without any external pretrained model. It uses two complementary modalities provided for each sample: facial landmark sequences and video frames. From the landmark modality, it learns motion representations by diffusion masked pretraining over grouped landmarks, guided by lightweight auxiliary tasks that predict behavioral cues such as motion intensity and eye openness, and turns them into operator embeddings with a contrastive linear probe. To generalize to unseen avatar generators, the pretraining input is randomly transformed to simulate how a generator may alter the operator's motion. From the video modality, it captures fine facial motion through differences between consecutive frames. The embeddings of the two modalities are combined into one. Our approach reaches an overall AUC of 0.769 on the WBA2026 benchmark. Linear probing shows that the video embedding retains little information about the avatar's identity, whereas the landmark embedding retains some, and fusing the two modalities improves verification in particular across speaking and listening modes.

</details>


### [212] [OBB-PBD: Extending Parallel Box Decoding to Oriented Bounding Boxes for Referring Expression Grounding in Aerial Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35450)
*Chang Woo Song,Yeong Jun Koh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过扩展平行框解码(PBD)方法至六槽定向表示，提升了无人机视觉接地（AVVG）基准测试中旋转的交并比（rotIoU），证明定向框不仅依赖于图像，还依赖于具体提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大多数定位模型按顺序发出框坐标，而PBD只预测了四坐标水平框，本文旨在扩展此接口以使用双角参数化实现六槽定向表示，从而更好地适用于空中的任意方向物体。

Method: 本文提出的方法是从PBD扩展而来，采用双角参数化将PBD的四坐标水平框扩展至六槽定向表示，并通过图像/提示混排控制和可见性/泄露探测验证了该模型的有效性。

Result: 在AVVG基准测试集上，扩展后的模型将零样本基线的rotIoU从0.1253提升至0.303±0.012，显示出定向框优于轴对齐框，并且改进效果在每次训练种子上均显著。

Conclusion: 本文的工作证明了定向框优于轴对齐框在空中的应用，扩展后的模型能够更好地适应真实物体的任意方向，为未来研究提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Referring expression grounding in overhead imagery requires oriented bounding boxes rather than horizontal ones, since aerial objects appear at arbitrary orientations. Most grounding models emit box coordinates sequentially; Parallel Box Decoding (PBD) instead predicts all geometry slots in one forward pass, but only for four-coordinate horizontal boxes. We extend this block-aligned interface to a six-slot oriented representation using a double-angle parameterization. Rather than assuming correctness from a decreasing loss curve, we verify the extension with image/prompt-shuffle controls and visibility/leakage probes, which show that the corrected model depends on both the image and the prompt rather than on prompt statistics alone. On the aerial vehicle visual grounding (AVVG) benchmark, whose targets are genuinely oriented, the extended model improves rotated intersection over union (rotIoU) from 0.1253 for the zero-shot baseline to 0.303 +/- 0.012 (mean +/- standard deviation over three training seeds) across the complete 6139-record test split spanning all 120 images. Learning oriented boxes rather than their axis-aligned envelopes adds 0.055 +/- 0.008 rotIoU beyond a matched control (per-seed 95% confidence intervals all excluding zero), whereas block expansion alone yields no rotIoU gain distinguishable from zero.

</details>


### [213] [TP-JSCC: Efficient Token Pruning and Joint Source-Channel Coding for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35489)
*Zhengxin Li,Chongzhen Tian,Hui Yuan,Hao Liu,Sam Kwong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为TP-JSCC的方法，用于在资源受限的物联网设备上进行基于大型视觉语言模型的3D视觉问答。该方法通过局部和全局语义混合令牌裁剪模块和轻量级令牌联合源信道编码模块，有效减少视觉令牌的数量和确保其在有误码率的信道中传输，保持较低的计算复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前资源受限的物联网设备上部署基于大型视觉语言模型的3D视觉问答需要云边协作，但将大量视觉数据上传到云会受到带宽有限和噪声信道的限制，导致严重的延迟和传输失真。

Method: TP-JSCC方法包括两个主要部分：(1) 局部和全局语义混合令牌裁剪（LGS-HTP）模块，通过分离前景和背景令牌并联合选择局部和全局语义来显著减少视觉令牌的数量；(2) 轻量级令牌联合源信道编码（T-JSCC）模块，采用轻量级级联线性层和信噪比自适应机制，进一步压缩裁剪后的令牌。

Result: 该方法在ScanQA和SQA3D数据集上的实验表明，LGS-HTP模块可以将视觉令牌数量减少90%，同时CIDEr损失不超过1%。T-JSCC进一步将令牌压缩18倍，总体数据量减少了180倍，计算复杂度减少了90%。与传统方法相比，TP-JSCC方法特别高效且具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: TP-JSCC为在受限设备上进行基于大型视觉语言模型的3D视觉问答任务提供了一种高效且鲁棒的解决方法。

Abstract: Deploying large vision-language models (LVLMs) on resource-constrained embodied agents for 3D visual question answering necessitates cloud-edge collaboration. However, offloading massive visual data to the cloud over bandwidth-limited and noisy channels introduces severe latency and transmission distortion. To address this, we propose TP-JSCC, an efficient token pruning and joint source-channel coding method for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration. First, we develop a Local and Global Semantics-based Hybrid Token Pruning (LGS-HTP) module to significantly reduce the visual token count. By decoupling foreground-background tokens and jointly selecting local and global semantics, LGS-HTP effectively reduces redundancy while preserving reasoning-critical tokens. Second, we introduce a lightweight Token Joint Source-Channel Coding (T-JSCC) module to further compress the pruned tokens and ensure their robust transmission over error-prone channels. By employing lightweight cascaded linear layers and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)-adaptive mechanism, this module adapts to fluctuating channel conditions while maintaining minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on ScanQA and SQA3D datasets indicate the exceptional efficiency and robustness of our approach. Specifically, on ScanQA validation set, the LGS-HTP module could achieve 90% pruning ratio while incurring less than a 1% CIDEr loss. Building on this, the T-JSCC further compresses the tokens by 18 times, resulting in an overall 180 times data volume reduction for robust transmission, while saving 90% in computational complexity for LVLM deployment. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuanhui0325/TP-JSCC.

</details>


### [214] [S$^2$-RL: Sample-Set Dual Reinforcement Learning for Generative Semantic Segmentation Dataset Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35491)
*Haoyu Wang,Fei Zhou,Qingqing Qiu,Lei Zhang,Wei Wei,Chen Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为S$^2$-RL的框架，用于生成语义分割数据集蒸馏。该框架通过文本提示生成具有丰富语义信息的图像，并通过策略优化实现语义和特征多样性。实验表明，S$^2$-RL在公开数据集上显著优于现有基线方法，为语义分割数据集蒸馏设定了一项新基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在语义分割数据集蒸馏中遇到两个主要瓶颈：基于梯度反向传播的方法计算成本高昂，而基于代理生成的方法则不能有效浓缩丰富的语义知识。

Method: S$^2$-RL框架采用了文本到图像生成的扩散模型，通过一组相对策略优化来生成多样且信息丰富的图像，并通过样本集合双奖励机制实现语义和内在特征的多样化。

Result: 实验结果显示，S$^2$-RL在ADE20K和COCO数据集上大幅超越现有基准，在语义分割数据集蒸馏方面设定了一项新基准。

Conclusion: S$^2$-RL框架成功解决了语义分割数据集蒸馏中的两个核心问题，提供了一种有效且高效的方法来生成多样化的高质量图像。

Abstract: While dataset distillation has witnessed significant advances in image classification, its extension to dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation is plagued by two core bottlenecks: bi-level optimization-based approaches suffer from prohibitive computational costs stemming from pixel-wise gradient unrolling, whereas proxy-based generative methods merely infuse visual textures into fixed semantic masks derived from real data, thus failing to condense rich semantic knowledge into a compact set of informative, novel scene generations. To address both bottlenecks simultaneously, we propose a novel Sample-Set Reinforcement Learning (S$^2$-RL) framework for generative semantic segmentation dataset distillation (SSDD). Specifically, S$^2$-RL formulates SSDD as a diffusion model based text-to-image generation paradigm, enabling flexible generation of images with informative, novel semantic distributions via a concise text prompt. Furthermore, we fine-tune a diffusion policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), leveraging a sample-set dual reward paradigm: for individual samples, it enforces semantic alignment with input text prompts and intra-class feature diversity; for sample sets, it maximizes inter-sample semantic distribution diversity by solving a contextual multi-armed bandit problem. These design choices enable S$^2$-RL to distill large-scale semantic segmentation datasets into a compact set of generated samples that encapsulate diverse, informative semantic knowledge without the need of pixel-wise gradient unrolling. Extensive experiments on the ADE20K and COCO datasets demonstrate that S$^2$-RL achieves substantial and consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, establishing a new benchmark for SSDD.

</details>


### [215] [Learning Scene Coordinate Reconstruction from Unposed Images via Pose Graph Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35501)
*Tze Ho Elden Tse,Jizong Peng,Angela Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将姿态图优化（PGO）集成到ACE-Zero中的混合框架，通过直接从ACE-Zero输出中提取相对姿态约束，并结合几何先验估算置信度得分，改进了姿态估计的稳健性和准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管ACE-Zero等基于学习的姿态恢复方法在无监督场景中表现优异，但缺少全局和多视图一致性约束可能导致姿态漂移和错位，特别是在复杂或含糊场景中。

Method: 本文提出了一种混合框架，将姿态图优化（PGO）融入ACE-Zero中进行相机姿态校正和抑制错误校正。通过从ACE-Zero的输出中直接构建姿态图，并利用几何先验（如单应性和视差一致性）估计置信度得分，优化策略得以增强。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法显著提高了姿态估计的稳健性和准确性，验证了全局几何推理在姿态恢复任务中的有效补充作用。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的方法证明了全局几何推理在基于学习的结构从运动中有效，可以通过引入几何先验和不确定性优化策略来提高姿态恢复的质量。

Abstract: Learning-based structure-from-motion methods such as ACE-Zero have demonstrated strong performance in estimating cameraposes and scene coordinates from unordered image collections without requiring ground truth supervision. However, the lack of global and multi-view consistency constraints in ACE-Zero can lead to pose drift and misalignment, particularly in complex or ambiguous scenes. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework that integrates pose graph optimization (PGO) into ACE-Zero to refine camera poses and suppress incorrect refinements. We construct pose graphs directly from ACE-Zero outputs by extracting relative pose constraints from predicted scene coordinates. Furthermore, we introduce an uncertainty-aware optimization strategy by estimating confidence scores using geometric priors, including epipolar and optical flow consistencies across views. Our approach improves the robustness and accuracy of pose estimation, demonstrating that global geometric reasoning can effectively complement learning-based inference in structure-from-motion.

</details>


### [216] [HiFiPix: Bringing High-Fidelity Real-World Super-Resolution Back to Pixel Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35515)
*Wenjie Li,Du Chen,Hui Wang,Linlong Fan,Youwei Lv,Zeyi Chen,Zehan Chen,Jinwei Chen,Heng Guo,Zhanyu Ma,Qingnan Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HiFiPix 提出了一种基于像素的空间真实世界图像超分辨率框架，通过跨尺度小波鉴别器和 Mixup 对比自蒸馏等方法克服了 patch 边界伪影和生成能力减弱的问题，实现了超高的重建保真度和细粒度的视觉生成效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在像素空间中的表现优于基于隐变量表示的模型，但现有方法仍存在 patch 边界伪影和生成能力减弱的问题，因此需要一种新的方法来提高真实世界图像超分辨率的重建保真度。

Method: HiFiPix 采用跨尺度小波鉴别器 (CWSD) 进行图像级别监督，抑制不现实的高频周期性成分；使用 Mixup 对比自蒸馏 (MixCSD) 进行中间表示正则化；针对低秩适配器 (LoRA) 的异质生成保真度折衷，提出了选择性 LoRA 剪枝 (LoRA-SP)，以最小化重建保真度损失。

Result: HiFiPix 在恢复准确性和感知质量方面比现有最先进的基于隐变量的空间方法有显著优越性。

Conclusion: HiFiPix 提供了一种新的基于像素的空间 RIR 方案，通过解决现有方法中的关键问题，成功地实现了高保真度的重建和精细的视觉生成效果。

Abstract: Diffusion-based real-world image super-resolution suffers from limited reconstruction fidelity due to information loss in VAE-based latent representations. Recently, pixel-space diffusion models offer a promising high-faithfulness alternative by avoiding latent compression, but adapting them to Real-ISR remains challenging due to inherent patch boundary artifacts and degraded generative capability. To address the issues and maximize the potential of pretrained pixel-space diffusion models, we propose HiFiPix, a pixel-space Real-ISR framework capable of ultra high-fidelity reconstruction and fine-grained visual generation effects. To suppress patch boundary artifacts, we penalize unrealistic high-frequency periodic components with a Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator (CWSD) for image-level supervision, and Mixup Contrastive Self-Distillation (MixCSD) for intermediate representation regularization. Furthermore, we uncover a heterogeneous generation-fidelity trade-off across low-rank adapters (LoRA) and propose Selective LoRA Pruning (LoRA-SP) to adaptively prune LoRA layers, enhancing generative capability with minimal deterioration of reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HiFiPix consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art latent space methods in terms of both restoration accuracy and perceptual quality by a large margin. Code and models will be released.

</details>


### [217] [Learning High-Quality Pseudo-Labels for Point-Supervised Temporal Action Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35516)
*Zhenying Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种结合先验引导初始化和共识引导精炼框架，在PTAL任务中生成高质量的伪标签，从而改进检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决现有方法中限制监督质量和检测性能的问题，尤其是在伪标签初始化和更新过程中未能充分利用边界证据。

Method: 提出的框架包括两个模块：先验引导初始化（PGI）和共识引导精炼（CGR）。PGI融合提案置信度和点衍生的先验，为初始伪标签选择和候选保留建立实例特定的可靠性。CGR持续使用保留的原始候选对象构建边界目标，并结合其共识与演化的检测预测在整个训练过程中精炼伪标签。

Result: 实验结果显示，该方法在四个基准上的检测性能与现有的方法相当，尤其在THUMOS14中，平均mAP在tIoU阈值0.1–0.7上达68.5%，比PseR高出3.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 该方法表明，通过整合初始化和精炼阶段，可以显著提升PTAL的检测性能。

Abstract: Point-supervised temporal action localization (PTAL) aims to recognize and localize action instances in untrimmed videos using only point-level annotations. Existing pseudo-label-based methods have made substantial progress in PTAL. However, confidence-based initialization can overlook well-localized proposals. Meanwhile, existing methods either keep pseudo-labels fixed during detector training or update them without fully exploiting alternative boundary evidence from the original proposal pool. These limitations constrain supervision quality, thereby hindering detection performance. To learn high-quality pseudo-labels, we propose a framework that integrates prior-guided initialization with consensus-guided refinement during detector training. Our framework comprises two modules: Prior-Guided Initialization (PGI) and Consensus-Guided Refinement (CGR). PGI combines proposal confidence with point-derived priors to establish instance-specific reliability for initial pseudo-label selection and candidate retention. CGR continually uses the retained original candidates to construct boundary targets, combining their consensus with evolving detector predictions to refine pseudo-labels throughout training. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive detection performance compared with existing methods. In particular, our method achieves 68.5\% average mAP over tIoU thresholds 0.1--0.7 on THUMOS14, surpassing PseR by 3.7 percentage points. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyingfang/LHQP

</details>


### [218] [Generative Structure from Motion with Native 3D Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35522)
*Haobin Duan,Binbin Huang,Mochu Xiang,Yiqun Zhao,Zibo Zhao,Yi Ma,Shenghua Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GenSfM通过结合基于图像的三维重建和原生三维扩散模型，提高未见视图的PSNR并减少Chamfer距离，同时无需额外的姿态估计组件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在解决三维重建与生成之间的误差累积问题，提出一种方法来生成与输入图像和三维分布都一致的物体。

Method: 使用多模态扩散变换器联合降噪形状和视角潜变量，利用对象级先验推断未观察区域。UV-volume标记保持联合序列大小随视图数量增加而紧凑，并通过恢复的相机姿势采样每个体素的图像特征进行几何和纹理的精细调整。

Result: 在Toys4k和GSO上，对于4个非校准视图，GenSfM将新型视图的PSNR提高3.2-4.5 dB，降低中值Chamfer距离2.8-3.8倍，同时在96%的无任何外部姿态估计附件的准确性超过5度。

Conclusion: 总体而言，GenSfM结合了重建和生成的优点，提高了未见视图的重建质量和未观察区域的推断能力。

Abstract: Recovering an object's 3D structure and camera motion from a few uncalibrated views is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Classical structure from motion methods recover 3D geometry consistent with the input images but cannot recover unseen regions; native generation methods produce plausible 3D objects which are related but not necessarily faithful to the input images. Methods simply concatenating reconstruction and generation allow error to cascade across the two stages, instead of producing a 3D object consistent with both the distribution and the input. We propose GenSfM, which integrates image-based 3D reconstruction with a native 3D diffusion model. In particular, we use a multi-modal diffusion transformer to jointly denoise the shape latent and per-view pose latents under shared self-attention, grounding generated geometry in the observed views while using object-level priors to infer unobserved regions. A compact 3D-native UV-volume tokenization keeps the joint sequence small as views are added, and a pose-aware stage refines geometry and texture by sampling per-voxel image features at the recovered camera poses. On Toys4k and GSO, for $4$ uncalibrated views, GenSfM improves novel-view PSNR by $3.2$-$4.5$ dB and reduces median Chamfer distance by $2.8$-$3.8\times$ over a strong native-3D generation baseline, while recovering input-view poses over $96\%$ Acc@$5^\circ$ without any external pose-estimation backbone, post-hoc optimization, or known intrinsics. Project page: https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/.

</details>


### [219] [EARS: Evidence-Aware Retrieval via Sound and Motion for Budgeted Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35536)
*Shih-Yao Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EARS 提出了一种无需训练和查询的前端，通过光流运动和音频能量对帧进行排序，并应用时间非极大值抑制，提高了在稀疏事件视频中的关键证据帧检索性能，尤其在K=1的场景下表现优于均匀抽样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的均匀帧采样方法可能忽略稀疏事件视频中的短暂证据。EARS旨在通过利用光流运动和音频能量来更有效地选择重要信息，并通过时间非极大值抑制避免重复选择。

Method: EARS 方法基于光流运动和音频能量对帧进行评分，然后通过时间非极大值抑制增加多样性。

Result: 在特定设置下，EARS 的帧级 AP 达到 0.39，而在均匀抽样的基础上使用时间多样性后，其局部化 AP 达到了 0.94。在匹配研究中，当 K = 1 时，EARS 达到 XD 子集 F1 约 0.660，优于中心均匀抽样的 0.614。但对于大部分无声的视频，EARS 的表现略逊于均匀抽样。

Conclusion: EARS 主要适用于低预算、关键证据与运动或音频重叠的视频，并且对于密集叙事或隐蔽事件，均匀或语义选择仍然更优。

Abstract: Uniform frame sampling can miss brief evidence in sparse-event videos when the VLM sees only K frames. We propose EARS (Evidence-Aware Retrieval via Sound and motion), a training-free, query-free front-end that ranks frames using optical-flow motion and audio energy, then applies temporal non-maximum suppression for diversity. The evidence score alone has frame-level AP 0.39; used only to select frames for the VLM, EARS with temporal diversity reaches localization AP 0.94, compared with 0.88 under Uniform sampling. In the updated matched study, at K = 1 EARS reaches XD-subset F1 0.660 versus 0.614 for centered Uniform (the paired interval includes zero); earlier backbone studies use separate protocols. On mostly-silent UCF-Crime, however, EARS slightly trails Uniform. A single configuration is used across both benchmarks; the new controls do not repeat the original held-out search. EARS therefore targets low-budget videos whose salient evidence aligns with motion or audio; on dense narratives or stealthy events, uniform or semantic selection remains preferable, and cheap modality statistics cannot reliably route between them. Code: https://github.com/mikeslin-ir/EARS

</details>


### [220] [Metric Scale for Insta360 Structure-from-Motion from the Camera's Embedded IMU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35554)
*Davide Cuttini,Diego Di Tommaso,Alessio Antoniacomi,Luca Simonetti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文探讨了使用内置于Insta360 X5和X6中的IMU传感器来替代智能手机ARKit或ARCore尺度，通过内部分析和尺度恢复，得出IMU尺度在误差上更小，同时通过多种实验验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的结构从运动（SfM）方法只能恢复几何相似性变换，而不能提供精确的尺度信息，为了提供更准确的尺度估计，本文提出了利用集成在设备中的IMU传感器进行尺度恢复的方法。

Method: 通过对IMU传感器的噪声密度、同步性、加速度计标度因子和偏差稳定性进行表征，从数据中估计相机-IMU旋转和帧时间，并通过线性视觉-惯性对齐SfM姿态来恢复尺度。

Result: 研究结果表明，标准公式平均高估了3.4%的尺度，通过分别估计每个连续片段并平均来消除偏差。在九次附带激光扫描仪的调查中，惯性尺度的平均绝对误差为0.74%，而智能手机尺度为1.94%。在公共基准的参考轨迹上，尺度恢复的均值误差为-0.07%，标准差为1.28%。在使用智能手机唯一的调查中，两种尺度的标准差为2.6%，惯性尺度平均低0.9%。

Conclusion: 根据实验结果，本文得出的结论是，使用IMU传感器进行尺度恢复的方法比使用智能手机更准确，特别是在没有其他参考的情况下，差值不依赖于窗口构成，并且不随智能手机锚点的扩展而增加。

Abstract: Structure-from-motion (SfM) from the dual-fisheye video of a consumer 360-degree camera recovers geometry only up to a similarity transform; in the pipeline considered here, metric scale is obtained from smartphone ARKit or ARCore poses captured alongside the camera. This paper evaluates a self-contained alternative: the IMU embedded in the Insta360 X5 and X6, recorded at 1 kHz. The sensor is characterised (noise density, camera-IMU synchronisation, accelerometer scale factor, bias stability), the camera-IMU rotation and frame timing are estimated from the data, and the scale is recovered by a linear visual-inertial alignment over the SfM poses of a whole survey. The standard formulation, with gravity and accelerometer bias shared across the survey, overestimates the scale by 3.4% on average; estimating each contiguous segment independently and averaging removes the bias. On nine surveys with a co-mounted LiDAR scanner the inertial scale deviates from the LiDAR by 0.74% in mean absolute error, against 1.94% for the smartphone scale; on printed fiducial markers both agree within the 1% uncertainty of the target. On the reference trajectories of thirty sequences of a public benchmark, brought to scales of 1/40, 1 and 40, the estimator recovers the metric scale with a mean error of -0.07% and a standard deviation of 1.28%. On fifty production surveys where the smartphone is the only reference, the two scales agree to a standard deviation of 2.6%, the inertial scale being 0.9% lower on average; the difference does not depend on window construction, grows with the extent of the smartphone anchor, and cannot be attributed to either reference. An ablation over window construction and a comparison with monocular metric-depth networks complete the study.

</details>


### [221] [Copying As Defense: Protecting Images from Editing By Eliciting Model Copying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35566)
*Salma Abdel Magid,Sanghyuk Chun,Eric Slyman,Kushal Kafle,Olga Russakovsky*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为Copy-as-Defense（CaD）的新防御方法，通过在早期Transformer块中最大化目标对参考图像的注意力质量来对抗基于DiT的照片编辑器。这种方法可以通过消除对编辑指令的依赖，有效减少编辑成功率达到81.4%到24.0%，并提高了优化效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对基于DiT的图像编辑器（如Flux Kontext），这些编辑器可以通过简单的文本指令生成虚假的操纵图像，而现有的防御方法无法完全阻止这种操作。因此，研究如何开发一种新的防御机制来应对这种新的挑战。

Method: CaD方法通过对早期Transformer块中目标对参考图像的注意力进行操控，增加参考图层的注意力质量，从而减少模型对文本指令的依赖性，以实现防护效果。同时，这种方法还减少了反向传播路径，降低了优化成本。

Result: 在多个编辑器和基准测试中，CaD方法将未保护图像的平均编辑成功率从81.4%降低到了24.0%，相比较DeContext（最强基线），它进一步降低了44.3%的相对成功率。此外，每一步优化时，CaD的效率也比其他同类方法提高了1.8到2.0倍。

Conclusion: Copy-as-Defense（CaD）方法通过在早期Transformer块中强化参考图像的注意力，成功地减少了基于DiT编辑器的图像编辑行为，并且该方法在性能和效率方面展示出了显著优势。

Abstract: Image editors built on diffusion transformers (DiTs), such as Flux Kontext, make it possible to turn a single photograph into a convincing manipulated image, including harmful and non-consensual edits. Proactive defenses aim to prevent such manipulations by adding an imperceptible perturbation before an image is shared. Existing defenses for DiT-based in-context editors make the output attend less to the protected reference image. But this leaves the model free to follow the edit instruction using the text and its own generated tokens, often producing a new, weakly grounded image rather than preventing the edit. We find that the opposite strategy is more effective: instead of leading the model to ignore the reference, we encourage it to copy it. Through controlled attention interventions, we show that concentrating target-token attention on the reference image in only a few early blocks is sufficient to collapse the editing behavior, causing the model to reproduce its input, often as a lossy copy, rather than execute the requested transformation. Based on this insight, we introduce Copying-as-Defense (CaD), which maximizes per-token target-to-reference attention mass in early transformer blocks. Since attention rows are normalized, increasing reference attention suppresses the attention allocated to the text and generated canvas. Restricting the objective to early blocks also lets us truncate the backpropagation path, keeping optimization cheap. Across editors and benchmarks, CaD reduces average edit success from 81.4% on unprotected images to 24.0%, a 70.6% relative reduction, and by a further 44.3% relative to DeContext, the strongest baseline (43.0%). CaD is also roughly 1.8-2.0x faster per optimization step than comparable methods.

</details>


### [222] [Hyperspectral Unmixing using a Structured Linear Mixing Model with Additive Spectral Variability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35580)
*Salah Eddine Brezini,Yannick Deville,Moussa Sofiane Karoui,Fatima Zohra Benhalouche,Abdelaziz Ouamri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种处理光谱变异性的线性混合模型，并设计了两种非负矩阵分解算法来优化包含SV惩罚的成本函数，实验表明与现有方法相比，这些算法在处理带SV的高光谱图像线性混合时更有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高光谱成像中，标准线性混合模型不考虑光谱变异性的现象，这会导致在高光谱解混过程中传播误差。因此，本文提出了一种考虑光谱变异性的参数模型，并基于非负矩阵分解设计了解混算法。

Method: 本文提出了一种新的线性混合模型：Structured Additive Variability LMM (SAV-LMM)，通过引入两个额外项来处理光谱变异。基于非负矩阵分解，设计了优化包含SV惩罚的成本函数的算法。还提出了一种考虑SV的改进初始化方案。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，提出的算法在处理带SV的高光谱图像线性混合时更有效。

Conclusion: 本文提出的算法有效地处理了光谱变异性的现象，提高了高光谱解混的准确性。

Abstract: Linear hyperspectral unmixing aims at retrieving pure material spectra present in an observed scene and their associated abundance fractions in each pixel. In most practical situations, hyperspectral images are affected by spectral variability (SV) also known as intra-class variability, which is caused by different physical phenomena including atmospheric effects, intrinsic variability of the pure materials and illumination or topographic changes. Nevertheless, the standard hyperspectral unmixing methods that rely on the Linear Mixing Model (LMM) do not consider these phenomena. Thus, neglecting them will spread errors throughout the linear hyperspectral unmixing process. To avoid this problem, this paper proposes two hyperspectral unmixing algorithms dedicated to a parametric model called Structured Additive Variability LMM (SAV-LMM). This mixing model handles SV in an additive manner by incorporating two terms into the standard LMM. Moreover, the designed algorithms are based on Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NMF) and optimize a cost function which integrates additional penalization accounting for SV. Furthermore, a novel improved initialization scheme, which takes SV into account, is proposed. Experiments conducted on both synthetic and real datasets show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms for linearly unmixing hyperspectral images with SV compared to the tested state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [223] [Beyond Distribution Matching: Self-Supervised Representation Forcing for Few-Step Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35594)
*Junyi Chen,Haiyu Zhang,Zhoujie Fu,Tengfei Wang,Chunchao Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究引入了Self Flow Forcing (SF$^2$) 方法，通过在 Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) 框架中加入预测表示损失，而不改变输出目标，实现了学生模型对学生和指数移动平均 (EMA) 教师的内部表示预测，从而在保持时空结构的同时提高运动质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的一些蒸馏方法尽管取得了较好的输出空间保真度，但仍然依赖于输出空间优化，缺乏对模型内部表示的显式正则化。这导致在学生模型过拟合和生成质量下降方面存在局限性。

Method: 方法是通过引入 Self Flow Forcing (SF$^2$)，在 DMD 框架中加入预测表示损失，同时保持 DMD 的输出优化目标。这通过为学生和 EMA 教师提供不同的噪声水平来创建信息不对称，从而使学生能够从更受污染的输入中预测教师的内部表示。

Result: 实验结果表明，SF$^2$ 可以有效减少时间模糊现象，并提升时空保真度和运动质量。此外，该机制适用于双向和因果模型，并且不需要额外的特征提取器。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的 Self Flow Forcing 方法在保持输出空间保真度的同时，通过增强模型内部表示的指导，提高了视频生成模型的时空保真度和流畅度。

Abstract: Few-step distillation is essential for deploying modern video diffusion models. Among existing approaches, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) has emerged as a highly promising paradigm by achieving strong output-space fidelity without adversarial training, while remaining flexible across various student architectures. We observe, however, that DMD fundamentally relies on an output-space objective, lacking explicit regularization on the model's internal representations. As the distillation step count aggressively shrinks, this output-only supervision becomes insufficient, causing the distilled student to degrade in both fine-grained spatial structures and coherent temporal dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce Self Flow Forcing (SF$^2$), which incorporates a predictive representation loss into the DMD framework without altering its output objective. By providing the student and an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) teacher with heterogeneous noise levels, we establish an information asymmetry. This formulation forces the student to predict the teacher's internal representations from a more corrupted input, effectively integrating self-supervised representation alignment into distribution matching. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SF$^2$ effectively mitigates temporal flickering and consistently improves both spatial fidelity and motion quality. Furthermore, the proposed mechanism is architecture-agnostic - seamlessly supporting both bidirectional and causal models - and requires no external feature extractors, introducing minimal computational overhead.

</details>


### [224] [Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark: A mechanically annotated dataset for evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35621)
*Íñigo Cirauqui-Viloria*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 介绍了合成可变形管形基准，包括5580张RGB图像，用于评估3D重建的摄像机运动、表面变形、材料对应和图像外观。该基准还提供了几何和机械检查，以及用于结构从运动、光流和几何变形的测试和验证工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了评估3D重建的准确性和可靠性，需要一个有真实世界参考点的数据集，但由于实际场景复杂多变，难以创建和验证，因此该工作提出了一个合成的可变形管形基准，旨在为3D重建提供一个可控的数据参考。

Method: 该基准使用LumenMorph开源工具生成，涵盖了五种类型的场景以及五种不同的表面运动条件。通过公开的接口，用户可以获取摄像机姿态、几何体、深度、变形场、持久材料对应和离散的有限元记录等信息。此外，还提供了几何准确性和一致性检查。

Result: 该基准结果显示，通过使用合成数据，可以清晰地区分注册覆盖率与几何准确性，揭示了相机和表面运动的影响，并测试了机械先验的优势和缺陷。并提供了一系列评估方法，如结构从运动、光流和提供的几何变形插值研究，以验证基准的有效性。

Conclusion: 合成可变形管形基准为3D重建提供了可靠的测试环境，通过对比真实和合成数据，可以更精确地评估3D重建方法的效果。

Abstract: Evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction requires ground truth linking camera motion, surface deformation, material correspondence and image appearance. We introduce the Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark, generated with LumenMorph, an open-source toolkit for creating, annotating and evaluating tubular scenes. The release contains 5,580 RGB images. Its baseline crosses three surface-motion conditions with moving and stationary cameras in six scene families; matched appearance variants cover only moving-camera finite-element actions in four families. Documented public and evaluation interfaces expose camera poses, geometry, depth, deformation fields, persistent material correspondences and discrete finite-element records. Persistent triangle identities and material weights let users track the same surface location across frames and query its three-dimensional trajectory. Separately implemented geometric and mechanical checks assess annotation consistency with the generating models. Structure-from-motion, optical-flow and supplied-geometry displacement-interpolation studies demonstrate how the resource distinguishes registration coverage from geometric accuracy, exposes camera- and surface-motion effects, and tests the benefits and mismatch of mechanical priors. Public readers, evaluation contracts and the configurable generator support reuse and extension. Data integrity, fixed-environment repeatability and retained-prediction score replay have distinct verification scopes. The benchmark provides a controlled synthetic reference without claiming anatomical or clinical realism.

</details>


### [225] [SeeRF: Learning to See Beyond Fields of View via Generative Image Registration and Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35637)
*Xunpeng Yi,Yibing Zhang,Qinglong Yan,Yifan Lu,Han Xu,Jiayi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于生成式配准-融合框架SeeRF，通过变形生成策略和多模态配准模块，实现了跨模态流估计和无重叠视场区域的有效完成与自然融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的融合方法难以在多模态传感器的视点差异和视野不匹配限制下实现场景级信息的完全整合，生成的方法往往包含模态特定区域和融合伪影。

Method: SeeRF框架结合了视觉基础模型的特征提取、基于伴随速度场的变形生成策略、模块化的粗细配准策略，以及生成扩散模型的多模态完成和融合机制。

Result: 该方法在多个公开数据集和实际场景中的实验表明，其在多模态图像融合方面表现出优越的性能和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 提出的SeeRF框架克服了共享视野限制，展示了在非重叠视场区域完成和自然融合的有效性。

Abstract: Due to the inherent discrepancies in imaging viewpoints and field-of-view mismatches among multi-modal sensors, existing fusion methods have long struggled to achieve complete scene-level information integration beyond the limitation in sensor fields of view. Consequently, the generated fusion results often contain modality-specific regions and fusion artifacts, limiting the comprehensive representation of scene structures and semantic information. To address this challenge, we propose a generative registration-fusion framework, termed SeeRF. Specifically, it first introduces a deformation generation strategy based on the diffeomorphic stationary velocity field, combined with visual foundation model-guided feature extraction and a coarse-to-fine progressive multi-modal image registration module, to achieve accurate cross-modal flow estimation and generate valid field-of-view masks. Subsequently, the registration module is tightly coupled with the generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion, where the cross-modal control encoding module and the control residual feature encoder-decoder mechanism provide effective guidance. By leveraging the powerful prior modeling capability of generative diffusion models, the proposed framework overcomes the limitations imposed by shared fields of view and enables effective completion and natural fusion of non-overlapping field-of-view regions. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets and real-world scenarios demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance, validating its effectiveness, superiority, and robustness. The code will be available at https://github.com/XunpengYi/SeeRF.

</details>


### [226] [Printed and Scanned: Exposing the Fragility of Single-Image Morphing Attack Detectors under Print-Scan Degradation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35682)
*Diogo J. Paulo,Hugo Proença,João C. Neves*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过引入印刷扫描版本的SYN-MAD22数据集，评估了用数字数据训练的最新S-MAD模型在印刷扫描处理后性能下降的情况，发现这些模型的等错误率平均提高了三倍，展示了数字基准性能与印刷扫描降解抗性之间的关键差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大多数S-MAD模型专注于数字环境下的检测性能，但实际应用场景中涉及印刷扫描过程可能导致降解，影响模型的准确性。

Method: 研究团队通过双倍分辨率（300和600 DPI）打印并扫描SYN-MAD22数据集中的真伪面部图像，使用八种最先进的S-MAD模型进行评估，并引入第二个扫描设备测试跨设备的鲁棒性。

Result: 结果显示，数字环境中表现接近最先进的检测器在印刷扫描后其平均等错误率增加了三倍以上，且这种质量下降在两个扫描设备中都出现了。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了S-MAD研究领域的一个关键问题，即数字基准性能与实际印刷扫描条件下的鲁棒性之间的差距，强调了未来研究中应更加重视这一实际应用需求。

Abstract: Face morphing attacks, in which the biometric traits of two or more identities are blended into a single face image, pose a severe threat to identity document issuance and automated border control. Consequently, a large body of work has proposed Single-image Morphing Attack Detection (S-MAD) algorithms and benchmarked them on datasets such as SYN-MAD22. However, the majority of these benchmarks operate exclusively in the digital domain, which contrasts with the real-world passport issuance pipeline in some countries, which still requires an applicant-supplied photograph to be printed and subsequently re-scanned before it is embedded in the identity document or fed into an automated verification system. This print-scan step introduces halftoning, resampling, color-space, and sensor noise that are absent from digital pipelines, and may mask the high-frequency artifacts that S-MAD models rely on. In this work, we introduce a print-scan version of the SYN-MAD22 dataset, obtained by printing and re-scanning all bona fide and morphed images at 300 and 600 DPI, and we use it to evaluate eight state-of-the-art S-MAD models trained exclusively on digital data. We additionally repeat the acquisition with a second scanner to assess cross-device robustness. Our results show that detectors that achieve near state-of-the-art performance in the digital domain suffer a more than threefold increase in average equal error rate, with the same qualitative degradation observed across both scanning devices, exposing a critical, previously under-reported gap between digital-benchmark performance and robustness to print-scan degradation.

</details>


### [227] [OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35684)
*Junyeong Ahn,Geonwoo Kim,Kinam Kim,Gihwi Kim,Hoonjin Jung,Hyojin Jang,Jaegul Choo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OmniShowcase 提出了一个新的数据合成管道和一种几何条件方法来生成视频，特别是在处理视角变化和三维结构时，优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的单图或多图到视频的方法在处理视角变化和三维结构不明确时表现不佳，OmniShowcase 通过合成多视角数据和提供表面法线图来解决这些问题。

Method: OmniShowcase 包含一个全自动数据合成管道，生成沿多种相机轨迹的训练视频，并且一种基于几何的条件方法，提供表面法线图供视频模型使用。

Result: 实验结果显示，OmniShowcase 在保持视频质量的同时，达到了最先进的主体身份和三维一致性。

Conclusion: OmniShowcase 通过其合成管道和几何条件方法，提升了视频生成的质量和三维一致性，特别是在多视角变化中。

Abstract: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do not explicitly specify the 3D structure that connects these observations. In addition, existing training data do not guarantee that viewpoint changes preserve the same underlying 3D subject. We present OmniShowcase, built on two components: (i) a fully automated data synthesis pipeline that produces training videos along diverse camera trajectories, with viewpoint variation driven by underlying subject geometry, even spanning full 360-degree orbits; and (ii) a geometry-conditioning method that provides the video model with a turntable of surface-normal maps reconstructed from the reference views without requiring temporal alignment with the generated frames. We construct Showcase-4K, a corpus of 3D-asset-based videos covering twelve camera motions across 88 trajectory configurations with reconstruction-derived surface-normal conditioning, and ShowcaseBench, a held-out evaluation set with the source meshes and camera parameters used to render each video. Experiments show state-of-the-art subject identity and 3D consistency while maintaining competitive video quality and motion. Project page: justin4ai.github.io/OmniShowcase

</details>


### [228] [MatAnyone-E: Sparse Memory Propagation for Efficient High-Resolution Video Matting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35724)
*Shuyun Wang,Shangchen Zhou,Peiqing Yang,Yuekun Dai,Xin Yu,Chen Change Loy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MatAnyone-E通过低分辨率传播识别需要细致检查的区域，并仅在这些区域进行高分辨率匹配，从而减少了需要详细匹配的位置数量和搜索内存的量，同时保持了生成完整前景的必要信息。此外，通过一个轻量级解码器进一步降低了生成高分辨率前景的需求，达到7.4倍的推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率视频需要保留精细细节，并保持帧间一致性，传统基于存储的方法成本随着分辨率增长增加。

Method: MatAnyone-E从低分辨率传播开始，识别不确定区域，进行高分辨率匹配，使用选择的存储信息，同时在其他地方重用低分辨率匹配结果。此外，使用一个轻量级解码器，针对测量的运行时瓶颈进行训练，以再现原始解码器的表示。

Result: MatAnyone-E保持与MatAnyone 2相当的抠图质量，但提高了约7.4倍的推理速度，将GPU内存使用率降低至MatAnyone 2的7.6%（4K分辨率下）。在单个NVIDIA H200 GPU上，1080p分辨率达到73.07 FPS，4K分辨率达到28.62 FPS。

Conclusion: 该方法通过智能匹配和轻量级解码减少资源消耗，同时保持高分辨率视频抠图的质量。

Abstract: High-resolution video matting requires preserving fine details, such as hair strands and soft transparency, while maintaining consistency across frames.
