Memory-based methods achieve strong matting quality by matching current-frame features with information stored from earlier frames, but this process becomes increasingly costly as resolution grows. We present MatAnyone-E, an efficient extension of MatAnyone 2 that focuses computation where it is most needed. Our approach first performs low-resolution propagation to identify uncertain regions that require closer inspection and the memory candidates most relevant to them. It then performs high-resolution matching only for these regions using the selected memory, while reusing low-resolution matching results elsewhere. This strategy reduces both the number of locations requiring detailed matching and the amount of memory searched, while preserving the information needed to produce a complete matte. We further reduce the cost of generating high-resolution mattes with a lightweight decoder designed around measured runtime bottlenecks and trained to reproduce the original decoder's representations. Experiments show that MatAnyone-E maintains matting quality comparable to MatAnyone 2 while achieving an estimated 7.4x inference speedup and reducing peak GPU memory usage to 7.6% of the usage of MatAnyone 2 at 4K. With compilation-enabled inference on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, it reaches 73.07 FPS at 1080p and 28.62 FPS at 4K.

</details>


### [229] [VidEdit3D: Flexible 3D Gaussian Editing with Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35756)
*Yanming Yang,Chenxi Song,Tong Zhao,Juntao Xu,Wenhao Rao,Yiwen Chen,Yiwei Wang,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VidEdit3D提出了一个框架，通过轨迹驱动的方式增强3D场景编辑，利用预训练的Video Diffusion Models来整合时空先验，确保视图间的一致性和语义连贯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D编辑方法在保持多视角一致性与结构修改之间存在权衡，并且在处理非常规视角下的对象编辑时表现不佳，VidEdit3D旨在解决这些问题。

Method: VidEdit3D采用轨迹驱动的渲染（TGR）选择信息关键帧，并构建与VDM输入要求对齐的平滑视频片段。同时，引入了无需训练的Flow-Aligned Video Editing（FAVE）框架，结合Edit Consistency Guidance（ECG）机制来从锚定视图传播编辑。最后，提出了Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement（RS-GS），严格限制几何和外观更新到目标对象。

Result: 实验结果显示，VidEdit3D在指令对齐和多视角一致性方面优于基线方法。

Conclusion: VidEdit3D通过对3D场景编辑进行任务重定义，结合时空先验与预训练模型，为复杂的3D编辑任务提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advancements in text-guided 3D editing, particularly with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), have shown promise but still lag behind the flexibility of 2D editing tools. Existing methods face a critical trade-off between preserving multi-view consistency and allowing structural modifications. Image-based editors can also struggle to apply the intended edit to objects viewed from unusual angles. To address these limitations, we introduce VidEdit3D, a framework that reformulates 3D scene editing as a trajectory-based video editing task. By drawing a parallel between camera movement in static 3D scenes and temporal dynamics in video, we leverage the robust spatiotemporal priors of pre-trained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) to encourage semantic and structural coherence across views. Specifically, we propose Trajectory-Guided Rendering (TGR) to select informative keyframes and construct smooth video clips aligned with VDM input requirements. To propagate edits from an anchor view to these clips, we develop Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE), a training-free framework incorporating an Editing Consistency Guidance (ECG) mechanism. ECG contrasts source and edited image conditions at a shared latent state, using scheduled source-image amplification to strengthen adherence to the edited reference while maintaining original scene context. Finally, we introduce Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement (RS-GS) to strictly confine geometric and appearance updates to target primitives, reducing background attribute leakage. Experiments demonstrate stronger instruction alignment and better multi-view consistency than the baselines.

</details>


### [230] [Does VGGT Know What It Does Not Know?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35806)
*Adityan Thirumani Srinivasan,David Nordström*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究揭示了VGGT模型在未报告预测摄像机姿态的不确定性的情况下，实际上具有识别预测错误的能力。通过在HardMatch基准测试集上的实验，发现线性探测器能够以较高的准确性检测VGGT模型的失败情况，超越了模型自身的置信度及其他方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VGGT模型在单步前向传播中对相机和几何形状进行回归，但不提供预测摄像机姿态的不确定性估计。研究认为，模型内部或许具有识别错误的能力，这一研究动机旨在验证VGGT模型是否隐含了某种形式的知识，能够判断其预测的可靠性。

Method: 研究者使用了一个线性探测器来评估VGGT模型的预测可靠性。在HardMatch基准测试集上，该探测器被应用于VGGT模型的冻结特征，以检测模型预测失败的概率。将线性探测器的结果与VGGT自身的置信度以及其他分类器的性能进行了比较。

Result: 在线性探测器的实验中，VGGT模型在预测失败方面的ROC-AUC达到了93.5%，远高于VGGT自身的置信度（79.7%）和其他分类器的性能（77.7%）。该探测器不仅能够识别模型对自己的预测有高度信心的失败情况，还能够在PhotoTourism和ScanNet-1500的数据集上检测旋转失败，超越了仅基于共视性的解释。

Conclusion: 研究结论表明，VGGT模型在内部结构上具有更多的关于其自身预测错误的知识信息，这些信息是未被报告的。此研究表明即使不提供不确定性估计，模型内部仍有可能存在能够识别预测错误的信息。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT regress cameras and geometry in a single forward pass, but they report no uncertainty for the camera poses they predict: an incorrect relative pose looks no different from a correct one. We ask whether the frozen model nonetheless knows when its pose is wrong. On HardMatch, a benchmark of 1,000 deliberately difficult image pairs on which VGGT fails on 35% of pairs, a linear probe on VGGT's frozen features predicts pose failure on held-out categories with ROC-AUC 93.5%, compared with 79.7% for VGGT's own point-map confidence and 77.7% for a classifier trained on all of VGGT's outputs. The probe catches failures VGGT is confident about, lets a downstream system abstain on the pairs it distrusts, and transfers without retraining to rotation failures on PhotoTourism and ScanNet-1500, beyond what co-visibility explains. This knowledge is absent from the per-image encoder: it is computed partway through the layers that fuse the two views, and the same holds for a second model, $π^3$. In essence, we find that VGGT knows more about its own failures than it reports.

</details>


### [231] [Back to Basics: A Skill-Centric Approach to Generalist Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35823)
*Minh Pham-Dinh,Md Farhan Ishmam,Hernan Yupanqui,Reaz Hassan Joarder,Kenneth Marino*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过引入MiniWeb，一个包含65个互联网站点的微型网络环境，旨在提高浏览器代理的交互技能。通过MiniWeb中的369项由人类标注的任务，研究团队分析了不同交互技能的表现，并提出了MiniWebGen生成验证数据的框架和MiniWebAgent结合计划者的方法，以提高完成新任务的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的浏览器代理主要依赖大量实践，然而代理在执行任务时可能会忽略所需的关键技能。MiniWeb提供了一种更加系统化的训练方案，通过对特定技能的练习和应用，使得代理能够更好地应对复杂任务。

Method: 研究者首先设计了一个包含了15个领域、65个网站并模拟现实生活交互的MiniWeb环境。通过这个环境，他们定义了一套包括37种可重用的交互基本技能在内的任务集合，每个任务都附有人类标注的详细描述。接着，研究者构建了MiniWebGen框架，该框架能够生成用于训练的验证数据，并利用此框架优化了Qwen3.5-4B执行器模型。最后，他们提出了MiniWebAgent框架，该框架在先前的基础上引入了规划组件，用以分解和解决复杂任务。

Result: 实验结果显示，通过优化后的执行器模型和新的训练数据，浏览器代理在处理单一交互步骤上的成功率提高了24.9个百分点，但这些进步主要囿于短期交互层面。进一步引入MiniWebAgent框架后，浏览器代理在未见过的MiniWeb站点上完成任务的成功率提升了19.4个百分点，并且能够将学到的技能迁移到其他未见过的外部基准测试，如WebArena-Lite、Online-Mind2Web和WebVoyager。

Conclusion: 研究强调了直接练习和应用可重用交互技能的重要性，并倡导将这些技能组合起来解决复杂任务的方法。研究结果表明，这种方法能够显著提升浏览器代理的多任务处理能力。

Abstract: Browser agents do not just need more practice. They need to practice the right things. We introduce MiniWeb, a realistic miniature of the web comprising 65 interconnected websites across 15 domains, where agents navigate, search, and transact as people do. Its 369 human-annotated tasks cover everyday workflows and label 37 reusable interaction primitives grouped into 7 skill families, allowing us to diagnose which skills fail rather than only whether a task succeeds. Benchmarking ten open-weight agents, we find that drag & gesture is consistently the weakest family, with no agent solving more than 24% of its instances. To address this gap, we introduce MiniWebGen, a framework that autonomously generates verified, skill-centric training data from MiniWeb. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-4B on just 3.1K verified trajectories improves single-primitive success by 24.9pp across 13 unseen websites, with gains across every skill family. However, these trajectories teach short-horizon interactions, which do not directly translate to full-task success. We build on this result with MiniWebAgent, which pairs the trained executor with a planner that decomposes full tasks into the skill-level steps it learned to perform. This approach improves task success by 19.4pp points on unseen MiniWeb sites and transfers to external benchmarks, with gains of 9.3pp on WebArena-Lite, 16.1pp on Online-Mind2Web, and 20.0pp on WebVoyager, without training on their trajectories. We provide a simple recipe for compact browser agents: practice reusable skills directly, then compose them to solve unfamiliar tasks.

</details>


### [232] [Seeing Through Distractions: Context-Stable Attribution via the Least Core](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35827)
*Sai Ganesh Nagarajan,Toshinori Yamauchi,Hiroshi Kera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究使用了Shapley值来解释机器学习中的特征归因，在计算机视觉中，某些特征在加入完整的真实图像时可能会降低目标类的得分，甚至在预测标签不变的情况下。本文通过形式化这些特征为上下文分散项，并在假设下利用最小核心和semivalue的差距来提供理论和实验支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对计算机视觉中Shapley值解释中出现的特征对目标类评分的潜在负面影响，在保持预测标签不变的情况下，探讨如何利用最小核心和semivalue进行更具代表性的特征归因。

Method: 本文首先定义了一种新的特征类型，称为上下文分散项。然后，假设了平均边际单调性的弱性。据此条件推导出了semivalue与最小核心之间的差距界限，并基于样本较小上下文的概率给出了充分条件。最后，本文通过调节semivalue权重以转向较大的上下文，减少符号差距，并通过受控图像分类实验和Salient ImageNet评估来验证理论结果。

Result: 通过理论分析，得到了semivalue与最小核心之间的差距界限，并根据样本较小上下文的概率提出了充分条件。通过实验，发现通过调节semivalue权重可以减小符号差距。

Conclusion: 本文通过定义上下文分散项并在一定的数学假设下，提出了在特征归因中减少semivalue与最小核心差距的方法。实验结果进一步证实了这一理论方法的有效性。

Abstract: Shapley-value-based explanations are widely used for feature attribution in machine learning. However, in computer vision, a feature may reduce the target-class score when added to the complete genuine image, even when the predicted label remains unchanged. We formalize such features as contextual distractors and investigate their attributions under semivalues and the least core. Under a weak average marginal monotonicity assumption, we derive quantitative semivalue--least-core gap bounds and sufficient conditions based on the probability of sampling smaller contexts. We further show that shifting semivalue weights toward larger contexts decreases the signed gap. Finally, controlled image-classification experiments and evaluations on Salient ImageNet provide strong empirical support for our theoretical findings.

</details>


### [233] [OSWAM: An Effective World Action Model with One-Step Action Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35850)
*Guowen Zhang,Liyi Chen,Xu Hu,Pengfei Wang,Jingfan Chen,Chenhang He,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OSWAM提出了一种新的直接策略世界行动模型，通过引入想象标记和未来条件指导信息蒸馏，实现了一步生成高质量动作的目标，显著提高了效率，实现在40ms内完成实时推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有直接策略行动模型WAM需要大量去噪步骤来生成高质量动作，这极大增加了推理延迟，阻碍了实时部署。OSWAM通过引入想象标记及信息蒸馏策略克服了这一问题。

Method: OSWAM通过创新的初始化方法和信息蒸馏技术，提出了一种仅一步即可生成高质量动作的方法。具体而言，方法包括：1) 使用想象标记初始化扩散过程，提供物理先验和动作条件化表示，以避免无结构动作先验导致的逐步去噪；2) 通过未来条件信息蒸馏增强未来感知动作生成。

Result: OSWAM在自动驾驶和实体控制任务中，取得了与多步骤直接策略WAM和联合WAM相当或更好的结果，并将直接策略WAM的基本实现提高了约3倍的速度，实现在NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU上的低至40ms的实时推理延迟。

Conclusion: OSWAM通过减少去噪步骤和引入创新机制，满足了实时行动生成的需求。未来研究或将探讨如何进一步优化该模型，提高其动作质量和稳定性。

Abstract: Direct-policy World Action Models (WAM) have demonstrated the benefits of decoupling action generation from explicit future visual prediction for efficient inference in autonomous driving and embodied control. However, they still require tens of denoising steps to achieve competitive action quality, incurring substantial latency and hindering real-time deployment. Simply reducing the number of denoising steps will collapse the nonlinear multi-step denoising trajectory into coarse updates, substantially degrading action quality. To reduce the denoising steps while enabling real-time action generation, we present an effective world action model with one-step action generation, namely OSWAM, for autonomous driving and embodied control. We argue that it is the absence of structured action priors in random noise initialization that forces direct-policy WAMs to recover coherent action sequences through iterative denoising. Hence, we construct imagination tokens to initialize the diffusion process, providing physical priors and action-conditioned representations. We further introduce privileged information distillation with future conditioning to enhance future-aware action generation. As a result, OSWAM can efficiently and effectively generate high quality actions in just one diffusion step. Our experiments demonstrate that OSWAM achieves comparable or even better results in both autonomous driving and embodied control than direct-policy WAM and Joint-WAM that require tens of steps. It obtains approximately $3\times$ speedup over direct-policy WAM baselines and supports real-time compiled inference with latency as low as 40ms on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU. The project page is available at https://gwenzhang.github.io/OSWAM/

</details>


### [234] [FL4N: Feed-forward Latent Model for 4D Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35854)
*Eunbeen Hong,Hyeonseo Yu,Honggyu An,Jooho Son,Hyunah Ko,Soowon Son,Chaehyun Kim,Jahyeok Koo,Jisoo Kim,Junhwa Hur,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FL4N是一种轻量级的前向反馈4D NVS模型，通过将4D场景先验编码为统一的潜在表示，并将时间动态学习为静态先验的残差，减少了对动态数据的需求，同时实现了实时渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的单目前馈方法往往依赖于明确的4D高斯表示，这容易导致时间不一致性和严重的渲染伪影。FL4N解决了这个问题，通过将时间动态建模作为预训练静态先验上的残差来减少对动态数据的需求。

Method: FL4N采用轻量级动态编码器，利用静止场景特征将物体运动与摄像机引起的视差分开。模型通过单一的图像合成目标进行训练，能够实时渲染并生成高质量的4D NVS。

Result: FL4N实现了最先进的4D NVS质量，并能够在实时渲染下生成动态场景，其学习的潜在表示能够泛化到真实世界视频并分隔视点和时间。

Conclusion: FL4N通过简化4D NVS的建模策略，展示了在有限的动态数据下实现高质量实时渲染的潜力。

Abstract: 4D novel view synthesis (NVS) aims to render dynamic scenes across viewpoints and timestamps, which requires jointly inferring 3D structure and temporal dynamics. Existing monocular feed-forward methods often rely on explicit 4D Gaussian representations, which are prone to temporal inconsistency and severe rendering artifacts. We present FL4N, the first feed-forward latent 4D NVS model. Instead of relying on explicit 4D primitives, FL4N encodes a 4D scene prior into a unified latent representation across space and time. Our core insight is that learning temporal dynamics as residuals on top of a pretrained static latent prior enables effective 4D modeling with limited dynamic training data. To this end, we introduce a lightweight dynamic encoder that leverages static scene features to disentangle object motion from camera-induced parallax. Trained solely with an image synthesis objective, FL4N achieves state-of-the-art 4D NVS quality while rendering in real time. Its learned latent representation generalizes to real-world videos and disentangles viewpoint from time.

</details>


### [235] [Do vision models know that three is three?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35857)
*Ankit Sonthalia,Arnas Uselis,Seong Joon Oh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究探讨视觉模型是否以相同方式编码特定概念的转换，发现虽然局部线性现象普遍存在，但全局线性现象并未普遍存在。模型在不同视觉领域中学习的概念方向存在差异，部分模型可以逐渐摆脱局部线性的限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文旨在解决视觉模型是否能够像语言模型那样理解、编码和推断抽象概念的转换，尤其是当这些概念在不同的视觉条件下出现时。

Method: 研究者通过分析46种不同架构、训练目标和规模的视觉模型，并测试了包括数量、年龄、物体身份和MIT-States属性在内的10个概念类别。文章强调了局部线性与全局线性的关系，以及概念方向在不同领域中的潜在转移。

Result: 研究结果表明，虽然局部线性是普遍存在的，但全球线性未能普遍出现。不同领域内的概念转换方向存在差异，有些模型能够在不同且不相关的视觉情境中捕捉到相同的线性结构，反映出“碎片化线性”的现象。

Conclusion: 研究得出结论，视觉模型在理解抽象概念方面有其独特性，局部线性普遍存在但全局线性则更具挑战性。模型可能通过增强局部线性逐渐摆脱碎片化的限制，而概念方向也可以在某种条件下跨领域进行传输。

Abstract: Do vision models encode the transition $2{\to}3$ the same way whether it appears in handwritten digits or in hand gestures, and do they "understand" that clean${\to}$dirty is the same transformation regardless of whether it is applied to a kitchen or a carpet? The linear representation hypothesis (LRH) answers this for language models: concept changes correspond to directions in (language) embedding space. In vision, the same concept can manifest in visually unrelated "regimes" that rarely co-occur: images of digits and hands do not share much in common in pixel space. To understand whether vision models still encode the underlying abstract concepts, we study 46 vision encoders across architectures, training objectives, and scales, on 10 concept families including numerosity, age, object identity, and MIT-States attributes. Within each regime, we find statistically significant concept directions near-universally across our tested models. However, two distinct regimes do not always share the same concept direction. Several models learn multiple linear structures for the same concept transition, split across regimes. We call this phenomenon "fragmented linearity": strong local linearity coexisting with near-absent global linearity. Fragmentation is, however, not fixed: models with stronger local linearity progressively escape it (local-global linearity correlated with $τ\in [0.38, 0.89]$ across all concepts), and where global linearity does emerge, concept directions can transfer as linear probes across regimes.

</details>


### [236] [VibeVideoBench:Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35864)
*Muxi Diao,Wenbin Xu,Lele Yang,Xuyang Ma,Yuzhe Chen,Jiankang Chen,Kaiyu Jiang,Changyi Liu,Haoyu Zhang,Hongyi Fu,Jianxiong Wang,Tianke Zhang,Haonan Fan,Yingxin Li,Bingyi Li,Xu Wang,Xuanyu Zheng,Bin Wen,Tingting Gao,Han Li,Wentao Zhang,Weiran Xu,Kongming Liang,Zhanyu Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VibeVideoBench 是一个基准测试，评估基于代码的视频生成代理在多模态视频创作中的能力，涵盖从数据故事到课堂教程的多种类别任务。展示了当前技术在精确性、一致性和灵活性方面的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前扩散视频模型虽然能够生成令人震撼的视频片段，但在精确性、一致性等关键方面存在不足，而基于代码的视频生成技术通过直接编程实现每帧渲染和音效合成，有望克服这些局限。VibeVideoBench 旨在填补这一研究缺口，通过多模态任务挑战现有的先进系统。

Method: VibeVideoBench 设计了包含239个自包含任务的基准测试，任务覆盖12类多媒体场景。评测沿层级和实证路径进行，首先检查生成内容是否符合要求并进行具体指标验证，然后通过多人评审团及盲法人类偏好验证系统排名。

Result: 九个前沿系统接受了VibeVideoBench的挑战，虽然GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5表现突出，但最佳系统仍无法满足超过任务总数四分之一的核心要求。近四分之三未能完成渲染的视频或启动过迟或运行过慢。评测显示人工共识与系统排名之间的关系不强，而在系统排名方面，多方评审者意见趋于一致。

Conclusion: VibeVideoBench 对基于代码的视频生成技术提出了全面挑战，尽管当前最先进系统已取得显著进展，但在精准性和一致性方面仍有较大改进空间。未来需要进一步优化算法，提高生成内容的准确性和可靠性。

Abstract: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a ruleconsistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. A different route is emerging: multimodal agents that write code to render every frame and synthesize every sound. We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation. Its 239 self-contained tasks in English and Chinese span 12 categories, from data stories and music-driven pieces to classroom lessons and paper explainers; each asks an agent, running in its native harness inside a sandbox, to deliver a finished MP4 with sound within one hour. Evaluation is hierarchical and evidence-based: program checks of the delivery spec, about 13k task-specific rubric checks traced to the requirements they enforce, and five quality dimensions anchored per task, judged by three VLM judge panels and validated with blind human preferences. Across nine frontier agent systems and 2,151 scored rollouts, the benchmark is far from solved: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead clearly, yet even the best system fails a core requirement on about a quarter of tasks. Whether a video arrives at all matters as much as its quality, and three quarters of the lost videos are final renders started too late, run too slowly or never started. The judges agree with each other and with human preferences on system rankings, but only moderately on individual videos.

</details>

### [237] [Whispering Wisely: Smart Subset Selection for ASR Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32997)
*Roi Yozevitch,Or Haim Anidjar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究提出了一个基于嵌入的选择子集方法，通过使用Whisper预训练编码器将音频样本映射到固定维度的嵌入空间，应用贪婪的k-中心算法来选择具有代表性和多样性的训练子集，实验表明在较小的子集大小时，k-中心选择通常优于随机采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鉴于现有的ASR模型如Whisper尽管提高了语音识别质量，但由于需大规模标注数据的再训练成本高昂，限制了其在新语言或领域中的应用。因此，为了降低再训练成本并提高灵活性，本文提出了一个基于嵌入的选择子集方法。

Method: 该方法首先利用Whisper的预训练编码器，将每个音频样本映射到固定维度的嵌入空间，然后应用贪婪的k-中心算法来选择代表性较强的训练数据子集。

Result: 实验结果表明，k-中心选择在较小子集规模时往往优于随机采样，尤其是在希伯来语和丹麦语的实验中。进一步分析发现，k-中心子集捕捉到的词汇多样性较随机子集更为广泛。

Conclusion: 研究证明，基于嵌入的选择子集策略可以作为ASR子集选择的实用方案，在评估的两种语言中均显示出明显的识别优势，特别是在较小样本预算的情况下。

Abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models such as OpenAIs Whisper have substantially improved speech recognition quality but remain expensive to fine-tune, especially when large amounts of transcribed audio are available. This makes it challenging for many practitioners to adapt these models to new languages or domains. In this work, we introduce an embedding-based subset selection approach for selecting smaller training sets for ASR fine-tuning. Using Whispers pretrained encoder, we map each audio sample into a fixed-dimensional embedding space and apply a greedy k-center algorithm to select diverse and representative subsets of the training data. We evaluate this approach on both Hebrew and Danish, showing that k-center selection often improves upon random sampling, particularly at smaller subset sizes. An analysis of lexical diversity reveals that k-center subsets capture a broader range of linguistic content than random subsets of the same size, which may help explain their observed effectiveness. Overall, our results demonstrate that embedding-based subset selection provides a practical strategy for ASR subset selection in the two evaluated languages, with the clearest recognition benefits observed at smaller sample budgets.

</details>


### [238] [From Writing Advice to Manuscript Governance: A Constrained-Transformation Framework for Academic Revision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33001)
*Simon Rudkin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文将修订建模为有序约束下的可接受性问题，提出了不改变研究论点的技术独立机制，但并非普遍定义或分类优良学术写作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的写作过程和社交科学研究已经认识到修订的递归性质以及词汇承载的理论和学科承诺，但在证据和断言边界与简洁性、出版形式或风格变化冲突时，这些研究并未明确指出应优先哪个目标。

Method: 论文通过建立一种基于有序约束的修订模型，并定义了任务相关不变量、上下文约束和可变呈现选择来界定可接受的空间。通过断言保存合同将证据和判断与授权的断言边界联系起来，并提出了四个治理命题来规定保存、优先、环境和充分性。

Result: 这种模型能够通过学术写作过滤器筛选候选修订，而无需无声地改变研究论点。

Conclusion: 该论文的贡献在于提供了一种技术无关的机制来改变呈现形式而不改变研究论点。

Abstract: Academic revision presents a governance problem when legitimate writing objectives conflict. Writing-process and social-science research show that revision is recursive and that wording carries epistemic and disciplinary commitments. Those literatures identify important constraints but do not settle which objective should prevail when concision, outlet form or stylistic variation conflicts with evidence and claim boundaries. This paper models revision as an admissibility problem under ordered constraints. Task-relative invariants, contextual constraints and mutable presentation choices define the admissible space; a claim-preservation contract links evidence and judgement to an authorised claim boundary. Four governance propositions specify preservation, precedence, context and sufficiency. The Academic Writing Filter implements the model by screening candidate revisions; it is not a universal definition or classifier of good academic writing. The contribution is a technology-independent mechanism for changing presentation without silently changing the research argument.

</details>


### [239] [Entity-Aware Evaluation of OCR Systems for Historical Document Transcription](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33004)
*Camilo Mariño,Diego Belzarena,Marina Gardella,Ignacio Ramírez,Gregory Randall,Jean-Michel Morel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究通过分析光学字符识别（OCR）错误的实体层面评价，揭示了不同OCR系统的性能差异，强调了仅仅依赖整体转录准确度衡量OCR质量的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的字符错误率(CER)评估指标无法准确反映OCR结果中诸如名字、日期和标识符等有意义信息是否得到保留，因此本文通过实体层面的错误分析补充了评估OCR质量的新视角。

Method: 采用Berrutti档案集中的175份文档及其5,209个手动标注的实体提及，比较了序列识别OCR系统、OCR专用的视觉-语言模型以及通用的视觉-语言模型的性能。

Result: 实验结果显示，OCR系统之间的排名取决于评估标准：尽管Qwen 3.6在所有测试 tolerance 下覆盖了最高数量的实体，但某些拥有较低精确匹配覆盖率的系统在容忍轻微错误时仍有显著恢复，表明它们的错误多为局部的字符级偏差而非根本性错误；部分系统即使在宽松匹配下也难以恢复大量实体。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，OCR质量不能仅由整体转录指标来完全衡量，强调了评估OCR错误对有意义信息保存和恢复性的重要影响。

Abstract: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is essential for digitizing historical archives, yet standard evaluation metrics such as Character Error Rate (CER) do not necessarily reflect whether meaningful information, such as names, dates, and identifiers, is preserved. In this work, we investigate entitylevel analysis of OCR errors as a complementary perspective for evaluating OCR quality in historical documents. Using a publicly available benchmark of 175 documents from the Berrutti Archive, augmented with 5,209 manually annotated entity mentions that will be released upon acceptance, we compare sequence-recognition OCR systems, OCR-specialized vision-language models, and general-purpose vision-language models. Beyond global transcription accuracy, we analyze entity preservation and recoverability under varying character-level edit tolerances. Our experiments show that OCR rankings depend on the evaluation criterion: while Qwen 3.6 achieves the highest entity coverage across all tested tolerances, several systems with lower exact-match coverage recover substantially when small errors are tolerated, suggesting that many of their errors correspond to localized character-level deviations rather than fundamentally incorrect entity transcriptions. Conversely, some systems remain unable to recover many entities even under relaxed matching. These findings show that OCR quality cannot be fully characterized by aggregate transcription metrics alone and highlight the importance of evaluating how OCR errors affect the preservation and recoverability of meaningful information.

</details>


### [240] [OpenESM: Energy-Steered Models Are Scalable Foundation Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33005)
*Yuan Pu,Yudong Lu,Ting Wang,Zhicong Hong,Qinuo Li,Xuansheng Wu,Na Zou,Xia Hu,Guanchu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为能量引导模型(ESM)的新架构，用于基础语言建模。ESM通过在大型语料库上进行能量引导预训练，学习到一个广泛应用的能量景观，并展示了随模型规模和训练数据增加的良好扩展性能，优于GPT在大多数下游任务中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的能量模型在特定领域显示出潜在的有效性，但在通用情况下仍面临挑战。ESM旨在通过结合能量引导和标记生成在一个架构中，利用能量指导搜索来改进标记生成的方法来弥合这一差距。

Method: ESM首先在能量景观中优化一个潜在状态，然后利用该细化的潜在状态进行标记生成。通过在大规模语料库上进行能量引导预训练，ESM学习到一个更有效的能量景观，其中有利的标记对应于较低的能量值。

Result: ESM在26个涵盖多个领域的下游任务上进行了评估，结果显示，随着模型规模和训练数据的增加，ESM的表现呈现出良好的扩展性，并且大多数情况下性能优于GPT。

Conclusion: ESM被证明是一种在大规模预训练和通用问题解决方面有希望的架构。研究完全开放了模型权重和训练基础设施，以便社区可以完全复制并扩展研究成果。

Abstract: Energy-based models have shown promising properties for domain-specific tasks but remain challenging in modeling general-purpose scenarios. To bridge this gap, we design energy-steered models (ESMs) for foundational language modeling. ESMs integrate energy steering and token generation within a single architecture to leverage the energy-guided search to refine token generation. Specifically, ESMs first optimize a latent state over the energy landscape, then leverages the refined latent state for token generation. By performing such energy-guided pre-training on large-scale corpora, ESMs learn generally effective energy landscape where favorable tokens correspond to lower energy values. To explore the scaling behavior of ESMs, we pre-train ESMs on three large-scale corpora, then evaluate across 26 downstream tasks spanning a broad range of domains. Our results demonstrate that ESMs have promising scaling behaviors with increasing model size and training data, and outperform GPTs on most downstream tasks. These findings highlight ESMs as a promising architecture for large-scale pre-training and general purpose problem solving. We fully release the model weights and training infrastructure to enable the community to completely reproduce and extend our results.
  GitHub: https://github.com/datamllab/openesm HuggingFace: https://huggingface.co/collections/guan-wang/openesm

</details>


### [241] [Linear-Time Context Compression with State-Space Encoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33006)
*Marc Serra Ortega,Andrey Barsky,Carlos Boned Riera,Tomás Ockier,Dimosthenis Karatzas*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Boa Compressor 使用 Mamba 状态空间模型对上下文进行编码并在单一线性时间内完成，它在压缩比相同的情况下，与现有的离线压缩基线具有相当或更好的性能，同时比基于 Transformer 的实现快多个数量级，从而减少端到端的延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的软提示压缩方法通常使用与目标模型相同的Transformer骨干网络，这会导致显著的延迟开销，限制了它们在离线设置中的应用。

Method: Boa Compressor 使用基于 Mamba 状态空间模型的压缩器，能够对任意长度的上下文进行编码并在单一线性时间内完成。

Result: 在相同比例的压缩下，Boa 的性能与现有的离线压缩基线相当或更好，并且比基于 Transformer 的实现快了多个数量级。

Conclusion: Boa 提供了一种既有效又经济的压缩方法，可以在推理时针对每个查询运行，成为一种实用且通用的高效长上下文推理工具。

Abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) impose substantial computation and memory costs as context sizes increase, motivating methods that compress a context into a shorter representation before inference. Existing soft-prompt compression methods typically use the same Transformer backbone as used in the target model, where producing the compressed representation leads to significant latency overheads. This restricts them to the offline setting where context is compressed once and then reused across many queries. We propose the Boa Compressor, a plug-and-play online context compressor built on a Mamba state-space model (SSM) that encodes arbitrary-length context in a single linear-time pass, producing a representation on which we condition a frozen target LLM. The SSM is trained by distillation, matching the next-token logit distribution from the LLM ingesting the full context (as teacher) to the same LLM ingesting the compressed representation (as the student). At equal compression ratios, Boa matches or surpasses the performance of existing state-of-the-art offline compression baselines, while being an order of magnitude faster than Transformer-based implementations, thereby reducing end-to-end latency rather than adding compression time overhead. We demonstrate that Boa also scales well to longer contexts and to compression ratios as aggressive as 16x. By enabling effective compression that is cheap enough to run on every query at inference time, Boa becomes a practical and general tool for efficient long-context inference.

</details>


### [242] [Knowledge-Guided LLM for Intent-Driven Service Orchestration in Integrated Terrestrial and Non-Terrestrial 6G Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33007)
*Wajdi Hammami,Irfan Azam,Soumaya Cherkaoui*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种知识引导的大规模语言模型（LLM）框架，结合了语法约束语义解析和知识图谱驱动的澄清循环，用于4个代表性服务类别的编排就绪服务配置文件的生成。该框架在200个意图样本的数据集上实现了89%的分类准确率和95%的有效策略，且每项请求平均仅需0.66次澄清。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在集成陆基和非陆基（TN/NTN）6G网络中，自然语言服务意图可能不完整、模糊或不一致，给无约束的LLM生成带来挑战，影响网络面向的编排。因此，需要一个知识引导的方法来提高意图处理的鲁棒性和策略的有效性。

Method: 该框架通过语法约束语义解析和知识图谱驱动的澄清循环生成验证过的、编排就绪的服务配置文件。具体方法包括先进行语法约束语义解析，再通过知识图谱驱动的澄清循环进行策略的有效性和一致性验证。

Result: 在200个样本的数据集上，该框架实现了89%的分类准确率和95%的有效策略。相比于纯LLM基线，该框架提高了策略的有效性和矛盾检测能力，同时减少了澄清的轮次。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法强调了显式知识引导在综合TN/NTN 6G编排中的鲁棒意图处理中的价值。

Abstract: Natural-language service intents in integrated terrestrial and non-terrestrial (TN/NTN) 6G networks can be incomplete, ambiguous, or inconsistent, making unconstrained LLM generation challenging for reliable network-facing orchestration. This paper proposes a knowledge-guided LLM framework that combines grammar-constrained semantic parsing with a knowledge-graph (KG)-driven clarification loop to produce validated, orchestration-ready service profiles across four representative service classes. On a 200-sample intent dataset, the framework achieves 89% classification accuracy and 95% policy validity with an average of 0.66 clarification turns per request. Compared with a Pure-LLM baseline, the proposed framework improves policy validity and contradiction detection while requiring fewer clarification turns, demonstrating the value of explicit knowledge-guided reasoning for robust intent processing in integrated TN/NTN 6G orchestration.

</details>


### [243] [TraceQuery: learning what to recompute from full-denoising trajectory in diffusion language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33008)
*Yukai Jin,Zhankai Ye,Jiayue Yang,Fangyi Li,Shuoqiu Li,Xu Gao,Shibo Li,Xin Liu,Shangqian Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为TRACEQUERY的新框架，通过预测和查询相关的位置来优化迭代去噪过程中的推理效率，从而在保持高质量的同时显著减少新计算的标记数量，适用于各种任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的缓存方法通过重用中间结果和在每步只重新计算一部分位置来降低推理成本，但这些方法通常依赖于固定的重计算时间表或经验信号来选择需要重新计算的位置。本文通过实验发现，解码轨迹比重计算的时间表更相关，因此提出了一个基于解码轨迹指导查询的新框架。

Method: 该方法首先预测一个小的、接近未来轨迹相关的候选位置集，然后仅查询这些候选位置，并让主体选择其中的最佳预测作为最终结果。

Result: TRACEQUERY在多个任务和模型变体上展现出最佳的质量-计算权衡，保持了高精度的同时显著减少了新的标记计算，适用性强。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种基于解码轨迹指导查询的新框架，通过优化迭代去噪推理中的计算成本，提高了效率并保持了高质量的结果。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible generation through iterative masked denoising, but incur substantial inference cost because token representations are repeatedly recomputed across denoising steps. Existing cache-based methods reduce this cost by reusing intermediate results across denoising steps and recomputing only a subset of positions at each step, chosen either on a fixed schedule or by heuristic signals of change. Our trajectory experiments instead point to decoding trajectory as the more relevant quantity. Cached generation remains accurate when it stays close to the full-denoising trajectory, with errors concentrated around unmask-order deviations and reduced as longer reference prefixes are recovered. This suggests a more direct principle: limiting representation error helps, but keeping generation on the full-denoising trajectory is a more direct route to accurate decoding. We therefore formulate efficient dLLM inference as trajectory-guided querying. Rather than broadly repairing representation error, we use full-denoising trajectories to supervise which unresolved positions should receive limited fresh computation. Based on this formulation, we introduce TRACEQUERY, a lightweight sparse decoding framework that predicts a small set of near-future trajectory-relevant positions, queries only those candidates, and lets the backbone select which one to commit from their fresh predictions. TRACEQUERY delivers the strongest quality-computation trade-off among cache-based approaches, sustaining high accuracy with substantially fewer fresh token computations, and generalizes across tasks, model variants, and families. Code: https://github.com/fish1928/tracequery.git

</details>


### [244] [Recursive Semantic Divergence for LLM Agent Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33012)
*Harshavardhan Abichandani,Penny Chong,Atin Ghosh,Daniel Dahlmeier*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为RSD的递归语义分歧度量方法，这是一种无监督的轨迹级一致性度量。该方法被用来评估带有工具使用的大型语言模型的不一致性，并在多个基准测试中提高了一致性和性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的评估度量主要通过任务完成来评判代理行为，但无法捕捉代理行为在不同执行中的不一致性。现有的行为分析方法（如基于令牌水平的概率分布或基于单一响应的语义聚类）也无法捕捉行为不一致如何在未来的交互中传播。

Method: RSD是基于强化学习中的bisimulation度量发展而来的一种无监督的轨迹级一致性度量方法。该方法通过自然语言推理检测逻辑不一致，并通过对相同状态下的两个独立滚动流程的递归未来状态进行语义分歧度量。此外，该方法通过神经网络进行训练以估计未来从当前状态开始的分歧，无需完整轨迹即可提供每次交互的一致性评分。

Result: 通过使用RSD作为微调的奖励信号，研究降低了tau2-bench和toolsandbox基准测试中的任务进展变异度，同时提高了整体表现和模型规模。使用RSD作为附加奖励信号的训练匹配了监督微调的性能，且无需地面真相标签。

Conclusion: 研究表明，RSD是一种有助于提高大型语言模型工具使用一致性并提高任务表现且无需标签的评估方法。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents with tool use exhibit inconsistent behavior across independent runs from identical states, calling different tools, producing contradictory outputs, or pursuing divergent strategies. This variability compounds over time and undermines deployment reliability. Existing evaluation metrics primarily measure task correctness via completion-based scores and do not capture consistency in agent behavior across executions. Separately, agent behavior is analyzed either at the token level using probability distributions or at the single-response level using semantic clustering, but neither captures how inconsistency propagates across future turns of a trajectory. We introduce Recursive Semantic Divergence (RSD), an unsupervised trajectory-level consistency metric adapted from bisimulation metrics in reinforcement learning. RSD measures the expected cumulative semantic disagreement between two independent rollouts of the same agent from the same state, using natural language inference to detect logical inconsistency. It is defined recursively over future states and approximated by a neural network trained on independent rollouts. The learned metric estimates future divergence from the current state, providing a consistency score at each turn without requiring the full trajectory to complete. When used as a reward signal for fine-tuning, RSD reduces the variation in task progress from 132% to 91% on tau2-bench and from 90% to 44% on toolsandbox, while improving performance across benchmarks and model scales. Training with RSD as an additional reward signal matches supervised fine-tuning performance with substantially lower variance, without requiring ground-truth labels.

</details>


### [245] [The Social World Model Evaluation Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33014)
*Denglin Jiang,Annie Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现，仅有少数社交世界模型评估直接测试预测能力，大多数测试其他指标，建议改进实验设计以区分预测能力与其他因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨现有的社交世界模型评估方法是否直接测试了模型对未来人类行为的预测能力。

Method: 审计了1999年至2026年间发表的113篇相关文献，并对比分析了不同类型的评估方法。

Result: 在113篇文献中，只有9篇主要是通过实时人对系统或实验者选择行为的响应进行评估，并且仅有2篇将实际响应与预测响应进行对比。绝大部分评估测试的是当前状态推断、任务成功率或记录行为的预测。

Conclusion: 建议通过1步谈判实验来分离预测能力与其他评估指标，以改进评估方法。

Abstract: A negotiation assistant can reach a good deal without accurately predicting the other person's response. We ask whether evaluations of social world models test that prediction directly. We audit 113 works published from 1999 to 2026. 9 primary evaluations measure a real person's response to an action selected by the system or experimenter. Only 2 also compare an explicit response forecast with that response. Their predictors use information available when the action is chosen, and the evaluated responses were excluded from fitting; both randomize the intervention. A separate full-text check of 25 language-model works finds no experiment meeting these conditions. The other evaluations test current-state inference, task success, or prediction from recorded actions. We propose a 1-step negotiation experiment that separates these questions. The findings describe the audited sample, not the prevalence of this evaluation gap across the field.

</details>


### [246] [SLICE-Mem: Salience-Gated Lightweight Information Curation for Efficient LLM Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33015)
*Xiaobin Chen,Dian Jin,Lin Shu,Defeng Sun,Xiaoming Tao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SLICE-Mem 是一种轻量级的记忆框架，通过基于显著性和谓词中心的信息提取技术，减少长时间交互中 LLM 推断的成本和延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了减少在大型语言模型中管理长期记忆的成本和延迟问题，提出了一种新的轻量级记忆框架 SLICE-Mem，通过显著性指导的准入和谓词中心的信息提取，实现在不增加 LLM 调用的情况下，提高记忆管理的效率。

Method: SLICE-Mem 使用一个紧凑的分类器来识别值得保留的用户轮次，并使用语义依赖性提取器将这些轮次转换为简明的记忆条目。还提出了在线管道和离线整合阶段来管理记忆条目的一致性。

Result: SLICE-Mem 在 Memora Weekly 和 LongMemEval-S 上的表现优于生成内存基线 MemOS，在减少 LLM 令牌消耗的同时保持了类似的记忆准确性。

Conclusion: SLICE-Mem 能够在显著减少对基于 LLM 的记忆构建依赖的情况下，保留长期记忆中的有用证据。

Abstract: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to maintain personalized and temporally coherent interactions, but repeated LLM inference for memory admission, extraction, and organization introduces substantial cost and latency. We present SLICE-Mem, a lightweight memory framework that combines salience-guided admission and predicate-centered information extraction. A compact classifier identifies user turns worth retaining, and a semantic-dependency-based extractor converts admitted turns into concise memory entries. This online pipeline requires no generative LLM calls, while cross-entry reconciliation is deferred to an offline consolidation stage. We evaluate SLICE-Mem on the weekly subset of Memora and LongMemEval-S using 8B and 30B Qwen backbones for memory construction and consolidation on both benchmarks. Compared with the generative-memory baseline MemOS under the Qwen3-30B configuration, SLICE-Mem's online pipeline achieves 46.60 versus 46.68 FAMA (Forgetting-Aware Memory Accuracy) on Memora Weekly and 56.8% versus 59.3% accuracy on LongMemEval-S, while reducing total LLM token consumption by 92.4% and 99.5%, respectively. These results demonstrate that SLICE-Mem can preserve useful evidence for long-term memory with substantially less reliance on LLM-based memory construction.

</details>


### [247] [Merge-Based Vocabulary Extension Stalls at the Pre-Tokenizer: An English-Preserving Repair for Nepali, Tested in Continued Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33016)
*Aarjan Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种改进，该改进解决了开源LLM在使用特定正则表达式分词时对尼泊尔语的高开销问题，通过修改正则表达式和增加词汇表扩展，能够显著减少尼泊尔语文本的分词数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鉴于开源大型语言模型（LLM）在分词时对尼泊尔语处理的效率低下问题，研究者提出了一个改进方案，旨在降低分词成本并提高模型对尼泊尔语的处理能力。

Method: 研究者首先分析了当前分词方法的问题所在，然后提出了一种新的正则表达式方法，减小了尼泊尔语词汇的过度分词。其次，通过大规模的词汇表扩展，进一步提高了效率。最后，对模型进行小规模的持续预训练，以验证改进方案的有效性。

Result: 改进后的正则表达式处理尼泊尔语的效率显著提升，相较于标准扩展方法，分词数量减少了约54%。在小预算持续预训练中，改进方案在尼泊尔语的分词表现上优于其他方法。

Conclusion: 研究者提出的改进方案在不牺牲模型性能的同时，显著降低了尼泊尔语的分词成本，为开源LLM处理尼泊尔语文本效率偏低的问题提供了解决方案。

Abstract: Llama-3, Qwen3 and many other open LLMs pre-tokenize text with a regular expression whose word class admits only Unicode letters. Devanagari vowel signs are combining marks, so this regex splits Nepali words at every vowel sign, and models that use it spend 2.6 to 5.8 times as many tokens on Nepali as on the same English text. Merge-based vocabulary extension cannot join the split pieces: for Llama-3 and Qwen3 no number of new merges brings this premium below about 2.2, and ten released extensions already end within 4% of this pre-token floor. We give a small edit to the deployed regex that provably keeps every token id of text without combining marks or Devanagari characters. With 32,000 new merges it brings Nepali to 1.01 times English, about 54% fewer Nepali tokens than standard extension. In small-budget continued pretraining of Llama-3.2-1B and Qwen3-0.6B, the original tokenizer gave the lowest held-out Nepali bits per byte under every recipe we tested. Matching the repair's training steps to standard extension, with about 35% of the data repeated, reversed their order on Qwen but not on Llama. Whether the token savings give a favourable latency and quality trade-off in generation remains untested. We release the tokenizers and code.

</details>


### [248] [AdaptTok-Indic: Script-Aware Adaptive Tokenization for Indic Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33017)
*Binayak Mukherjeea,Moitreya Nandi,Arindam Panja*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究提出了一种专门为印度语言设计的自适应分词模型AdaptTok-Indic，该模型在孟加拉语和印地语上的表现优于SentencePiece BPE，并在多个指标上显示出更好的下游任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于英语的多语言分词器在处理印度语言时过分割，导致分词差异增大。AdaptTok-Indic旨在解决此问题，通过结合Unicode标准化预处理、显式的印度语言连字符处理、脚本感知路由以及与小型Transformer语言模型联合训练的学习字节级别边界预测，专门针对印度语言进行分词。

Method: AdaptTok-Indic通过Unicode标准化预处理、连字符处理、脚本感知路由以及字节级别边界预测等方法，联合训练一个小型Transformer语言模型，以提高印度语言的分词效果。

Result: AdaptTok-Indic在孟加拉语和印地语上的令牌丰度均低于SentencePiece BPE，并且在多个指标上的下游任务性能优于SentencePiece BPE。具体指标显示，孟加拉语和印地语的平均丰度分别为1.432和1.388，比SentencePiece BPE的2.156和2.085低。下游任务平均得分分别为57.69和50.82。

Conclusion: 研究表明，专门为印度语言设计的自适应分词模型能够减少分词差异，同时保持竞争力的下游任务性能。实验结果显示，AdaptTok-Indic在多个印度语言上的表现优于现有分词模型。

Abstract: Multilingual tokenizers trained on English-dominated corpora often over-segment Indic languages, resulting in longer token sequences and increased tokenization disparity across scripts. We present AdaptTok-Indic, an Indic-specialized extension of adaptive tokenization that combines Unicode-normalized preprocessing with explicit Indic conjunct handling, script-aware routing, and learned byte-level boundary prediction jointly trained with a small Transformer language model. Evaluated on Bengali and Hindi, with additional evaluation on Gujarati, Tamil, and Telugu, AdaptTok-Indic achieves lower token fertility than SentencePiece BPE, an Indic-oriented tokenizer baseline, and an independently implemented MAGNET-style baseline. Across five recorded seeds, mean fertility is 1.432 for Bengali and 1.388 for Hindi, compared with 2.156 and 2.085 for SentencePiece BPE. Recorded downstream scores average 57.69 on evaluated Indic settings versus 50.82 for the SentencePiece BPE configuration. Independent verification runs using the released prototype confirm the same directional trends. The current implementation is a small-scale prototype with documented simplifications, and no statistical significance testing, released-MAGNET comparison, or code-mixed evaluation is performed. These results suggest that Indic-specialized adaptive segmentation can reduce tokenization disparity while maintaining competitive downstream performance.

</details>


### [249] [SUDO: From Scientific Publications to Global Scholarly Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33018)
*Nipun D. Pathirage,Henrique Santos,Deborah L. McGuinness*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SUDO是一种新的知识组织框架，它通过语义原则从论文的底层构建知识表示，确保上下文一致性并提高科学问答任务的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大多数知识图谱（SKGs）方法在构建时通常预先定义知识单元，这导致了以概念为中心和声明为中心的两种主要但不同的范式，缺乏对研究叙述的整体理解。SUDO旨在为科学文献建立一个统一的知识图谱框架，以更好地反映知识元素的组织和关系，从而提高文献理解的效果。

Method: SUDO基于语义原则，通过从底层整合论文的知识元素，形成连贯且源数据支持的知识表示。

Result: SUDO在综合性的知识建模用例中表现出色，并在基于大型语言模型的科学问答任务中取得了性能提升。

Conclusion: SUDO为科学文献提供了更准确的知识表示，有助于增强研究发现和科学问答任务的效果。

Abstract: Scholarly Knowledge Graphs (SKGs) support literature search, scientific discovery, and agent-assisted research. Yet, most approaches to SKG construction pre-specify the knowledge unit to be represented, typically named scholarly entities or contribution-level statements, and retain only the publication content expressible through that unit. This choice produces two dominant yet distinct paradigms: concept-centric SKGs that preserve entities and local relations, and statement-centric SKGs that capture high-level discourse in sentences. In both cases, the graph reflects a chosen extraction target rather than how a paper constructs and communicates knowledge. We introduce SUDO, the Scholarly Upper Discourse Ontology, which defines how knowledge elements are organized and related to form a paper's research narrative, namely its scholarly discourse. Using linguistic principles that generalize across fields and tasks, SUDO enables each publication's scholarly discourse to be constructed from the bottom up as a coherent, source-grounded representation. Applied consistently across papers, the same structure connects their research narratives into a global scholarly discourse without discarding local context or provenance. We demonstrate SUDO's capabilities across a comprehensive suite of scholarly knowledge-modeling use cases and performance improvements on a downstream Large Language Model (LLM)-based scientific QA task.

</details>


### [250] [Mine or Yours? Mind-Bridged Language Models Take Each Other's Memories as Their Own](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33020)
*Yunlong Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究构建了一个脑间连接模型，其中一个模型作为接收者并接收另一个模型（发送者）的信息。在连接状态下，接收者倾向于将发送者的信息作为自己的，即使它能够准确理解发送者的信息。所有权感并不依赖于接收者对发送者信息的解释能力，而是更倾向于接收外来信息的控制权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究者的动机是为了探索在脑间直接连接的情况下，个体如何识别和区分自己的思维与他人的思维，尤其是在信息透明的情况下这一认知边界会如何变化。

Method: 研究设计了一个使用两个语言模型的脑间连接模拟，每个模型都有自己的规则和代码词，其中一个模型作为接收者同时监听另一模型的内部记忆。随后通过实验控制信息连接的强弱和形式（如代入‘来自对等方’的消息），评估接收者是如何处理和归属性信息的。

Result: 实验结果显示，无论是通过增强接收者记忆中的匹配权重，接收者更倾向于是将接收的信息作为自己的；即便接收者在理解上与发送者的信息一致，接收者依然倾向于将这些信息视为自己的知识内容。在信息连接强度相同时，半数情况下接收者会误将发送者的规则报告为自己的，表明接收者更倾向于将信息来源默认为自己。

Conclusion: 研究结论是，即使接收者能够准确理解发送者的信息，他们依旧倾向于将信息默认为自身内容，这意味着识别和确认思维所有权可能需要超越传统的认知范畴，同时也强调了测试思维所有权和转移之间的差异对于复杂认知系统设计的重要性。

Abstract: If your brain were connected directly to someone else's, would you still know which thoughts were yours? We build a functional version with two copies of one language model: each holds a private rule and code word, and one copy, the receiver, also attends to its partner's internal memory. The receiver took its partner's assignment as its own. Asked which rule it had been assigned, it named its partner's in 97% of answers when the partner's memory was weighted double (none without the link), and its open reports called the partner's code word its own, never the partner's. Ownership did not follow how well the receiver could tell what its partner had been assigned. At equal weight, the link made the receiver take its partner's rule in about half of its answers, and a steering vector matched on access gain in none; a text message introduced as the partner's was read correctly and never taken as the receiver's own. Writing the partner's name into its memory did not help, and cutting the link restored the receiver's own assigned rule. In this model, content laid over the receiver's own memory defaults to "mine", so systems that let models exchange internal states must test ownership as well as transfer, and a bridge between brains would need ground truth from outside the subject.

</details>


### [251] [Conceptizer: Next-Token Prediction Is Not All You Need](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33027)
*Haoran Zheng,Chen Shani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Conceptizer 是一种创新的训练框架，它扩展了下一个词预测（NTP），通过概念而不是单纯的词汇来奖励语言模型，从而改进了模型在下游任务中的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的 NTP 当前仅奖励预测下一个词，对其他替代选项进行惩罚。然而，自然语言在表达相同含义时有多种方式。为了使模型更好地捕捉语义，作者提出了 Conceptizer。

Method: Conceptizer 使用一个固定的概念词汇表，其中包括约 9000 个概念，这些概念通过上下文同义词构建而成。它将下一个词的分布映射到概念分布，并通过概念将奖励扩展到所有可能的表述方式，从而提供了一个概念级别的训练信号。

Result: 在 3 个不同的模型系列（1B-8B 参数）上应用 Conceptizer 后，取得了最低的 NTP 偏反似度（perplexity），对情境同义词（contextual synonyms）赋予了最高的概率，并且在常识任务上保持与基线相当的性能，同时在知识和情感任务上有了提升。

Conclusion: 这项研究表明，语言模型可以被直接优化为预测语义，而不是仅仅预测下一个词。

Abstract: Next-token prediction (NTP) rewards only the token that occurs next, penalizing every alternative. But natural language often offers many ways to express the same meaning. We introduce Conceptizer, a training framework that extends next-token prediction with a reward for meaning. Conceptizer uses a fixed, model-agnostic vocabulary of ~9K concepts, built from contextual synonyms, as units of meaning alongside tokens as units of text. It maps each next-token distribution to a concept distribution and shares the reward for the target meaning across its possible wordings. This provides a concept-level training signal without adding model parameters. Applied to 3 model families at 1B-8B parameters, Conceptizer achieves the lowest held-out NTP perplexity at concept-target positions and assigns the highest probability to contextual synonyms, against all 3 baselines. It also improves downstream performance on knowledge and sentiment tasks while remaining comparable on commonsense. These results show that language models can be directly optimized to predict meaning, not just the next token.

</details>


### [252] [A Benchmark for Controllable Speaking-Style Captioning in Audio-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33036)
*Shreeram Suresh Chandra,Ashwyn Sharma,Liang Lu,Xiutian Zhao,Leda Sari,Björn Schuller,Berrak Sisman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了Speaking-style captioning（SSC）作为指令遵循的音频-语言任务，并构建了StyleInstructCaps基准，评估模型的元数据可靠度、幻觉、指令遵循能力、未知指令和音频数据集的泛化能力，以及说话人口径一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏统一的可控说话风格描述框架，本文旨在填补这一空白，通过将SSC定义为指令遵循的音频-语言任务，提供一个标准化基准平台，以评估和提升模型性能。

Method: 本文提出了StyleInstructCaps基准体系，包括一个数据集和评估框架，用于测试音频-语言模型在元数据可靠度、幻觉、指令遵循能力、未知指令和音频数据集的泛化能力以及说话人口径一致性等方面的能力。

Result: 实验结果表明，在九种最先进的音频-语言模型中，强大的指令遵循能力并不一定意味着对说话风格的充分理解，专门针对SSC的多样化指令训练显著提高了可靠度、可控性和说话人口径一致性。

Conclusion: 本文的工作验证了专门针对SSC进行多样化指令训练对于提升模型表现的重要性，并为未来的研究提供了宝贵的基准参考。

Abstract: Speaking-style captioning (SSC) aims to generate natural language descriptions of how speech is delivered, capturing paralinguistic attributes such as vocal timbre, prosody, and expressivity. Many downstream applications, including conversational AI agents, controllable speech generation, and large-scale audio annotation, require dimension-specific style captions that describe targeted aspects of speech (e.g., speaker traits, emotion, or delivery style), rather than a single undifferentiated description. However, existing work lacks a unified formulation for controllable speaking-style captioning. We address this gap by formulating SSC as an instruction-following audio-language task, where explicit instructions specify the speaking-style dimensions to be described. We introduce StyleInstructCaps, the first standardized benchmark for controllable speaking-style captioning in audio-language models. StyleInstructCaps provides a dataset and evaluation framework that measures metadata groundedness, hallucination, instruction-following ability, generalization to unseen instructions and audio datasets, and speaker-style consistency. Across nine state-of-the-art audio-language models, we find that strong instruction-following ability does not necessarily imply grounded speaking-style understanding, and that SSC-specific instruction-diverse training substantially improves groundedness, controllability, and speaker consistency.

</details>


### [253] [EviGround-CT: Sentence-to-Volume Grounding for Verifying LLM-Generated Chest CT Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33038)
*Ziyuan Li,Juncheng Ni,Feng Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为EviGround-CT的方法，通过3D定位模型验证大型语言模型生成的胸部CT报告中的阳性发现，提升了证据支持的精确度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决大型语言模型生成的胸部CT报告中存在的阳性发现缺乏局部证据的问题，提高报告的准确性和可靠性。

Method: 利用确定性提取器识别报告中的阳性发现句子，3D模型预测每个句子的证据掩码，使用完整句子保留解剖位置、侧向和描述性修饰词，在CT-RATE上评估报告生成效果，在ReXGroundingCT子集上验证和评估3D grounding和验证。

Result: 在包含137个阳性发现的验证数据集上，使用基于句子的验证方法显著提高了证据支持的精确度（ESP）从0.263升至0.365；同时，无证据支持的阳性发现率从0.737降至0.635。配对病例层面Bootstrap ESP差异为+0.102（95%置信区间：[0.028, 0.181]）。生成的预测掩码使报告声明与空间证据关联，便于与CT图像一起审查。

Conclusion: EviGround-CT在验证大型语言模型生成的胸部CT报告方面显示出潜在的应用价值，并改进了阳性发现的精确性和支持性。

Abstract: Chest computed tomography (CT) reports generated by large language models (LLMs) can describe positive findings that lack localized evidence in the scan. We propose EviGround-CT to verify these findings after report generation. A deterministic extractor identifies positive finding sentences, and a 3D grounding model predicts an evidence mask for each sentence. Using the full sentence retains anatomical location, laterality, and descriptive modifiers in the grounding query. We evaluate report generation on CT-RATE, and grounding and verification on a held-out 100-case ReXGroundingCT subset. Using the available annotations, sentence-grounded verification raises evidence-supported precision (ESP) from 0.263 to 0.365 across 137 extracted in-scope positives, compared with category conditioning. The corresponding unsupported positive finding rate falls from 0.737 to 0.635. The paired case-level bootstrap ESP difference is +0.102 (95% confidence interval: [0.028, 0.181]). The predicted masks associate individual report statements with spatial evidence that can be inspected alongside the CT.

</details>


### [254] [Parametric Session States Recover Retrieval Intent without Replaying History](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33047)
*Qingsen Ma,Dianyun Wang,Jiahong Liu,Irwin King*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究引入了Parametric Session State (	extit{方法})，这是一种可重用的会话记忆层，能够在不依赖于历史记录重读或文本记忆维护的情况下，记住需要搜索的内容，并保持事实性知识的外部性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决长对话助手在处理后续请求时面临的核心挑战，即不仅要处理长语境，还要恢复前面对象、约束和主动目标的相关信息，以提高效率并降低计算成本。

Method: 	extit{方法}通过引入Parametric Session State来实现，这是一种会话记忆层，能够在不依赖于重读历史或维护文本记忆的情况下，记住需要搜索的关键信息，从而帮助助手更好地理解和处理长对话中的复杂查询。

Result: 该方法通过利用词汇参数化和推理来压缩会话历史的表示，从而降低了检索相关上下文信息的成本，提高了生成答案的效率。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的Parametric Session State为长对话助手在处理复杂查询时提供了一种新的方法，通过有效管理会话记忆，降低了处理成本，提高了处理效率。

Abstract: Long-running assistants often interpret follow-up requests whose referents, constraints, and active goals were established many turns earlier. The central challenge is therefore not only context length, but retrieval intent: a current query such as ``use the previous configuration'' may omit the project, entity, and version terms needed to locate relevant evidence. Long-context models can recover those terms by replaying the interaction, but repeatedly pay the cost of processing history. Conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is cheaper, yet assumes an information-sufficient query; conversational rewriting either rereads the history or depends on an explicitly maintained textual memory. We introduce \emph{Parametric Session State} (\method{}), a reusable session-memory layer that remembers what to search for while keeping factual knowledge external.

</details>


### [255] [Position, Role or Label? A Controlled Study of Instruction Conflicts in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33201)
*Anish Laddha,Nitesh Pradhan,Gaurav Srivastava*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 文章构建了WhoWins基准，包含1,080个编码评分的场景，以及14种不同规模的模型在1,887,356个评分回复上的实验。研究发现，在同一消息中，第一行冲突指令胜出率为72.42%至94.66%，而在多条消息间则为22.95%至62.65%。首先发送的任务在系统消息中的模型中很少胜出，但在gpt-oss模型中经常胜出。对更长指令序列的预测随着了解任务行位置的增加而改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于LLM代理需要处理来自操作者、仓库配置、用户、工具结果和保存记忆等多种来源的相互冲突的指令，因此有必要设计一种能够评估这些冲突处理机制的基准。研究者希望通过构建WhoWins基准和进行实验，了解不同类型指令、消息结构和模型规模对指令处理结果的影响。

Method: 研究者首先构建了包含5种任务类型的1,080个编码评分场景，每种类型可包含5个互斥指令，同时设计了7个控制实验以改变指令的传递方式。然后，他们训练了14种不同规模的开源权重模型，以分析这些模型在各种场景下的表现。最后，研究者通过关键词模式评估了模型对指令冲突预测的能力。

Result: 实验结果显示，在单一消息中，第一行冲突指令的胜出率在72.42%到94.66%之间，而在多消息间胜出率则在22.95%到62.65%之间。在某些特定条件下，例如gpt-oss模型中，指令的顺序对于结果的影响不同。此外，随着对任务位置了解的增加，模型对更长指令序列的预测准确性提高。而且，通过关键词模式分析，仅有不到3%的决定性回答明确或含蓄地指出或淡化了冲突。

Conclusion: 研究者得出结论，不同消息中的指令顺序对胜出率有显著影响，且预测模型的性能随任务信息明确性的增加而改善。此外，该基准还揭示了不同模型对处理冲突的差异，为未来的研究提供了有价值的参考。

Abstract: LLM agents take instructions from the operator, repository configuration, user, tool results and saved memory, which often conflict. Instruction-hierarchy benchmarks ask whether the higher-ranked source wins, but a source sets position, role and label at once. First, we build WhoWins, 1,080 code-scored scenarios in five task types, each with up to five mutually exclusive instructions, and seven controlled experiments that vary only how instructions are delivered. Second, we study 14 open-weight models (0.6B to 122B, thinking off and on) over 1,887,356 scored replies, checking main findings on held-out scenarios. Inside one message the first of two conflicting lines wins 72.42 to 94.66%, and across messages it keeps 22.95 to 62.65%. A policy sent first in the system (or developer) message loses most conflicts with later lines in every Qwen model but wins most on gpt-oss when it acts. In tool and file-write tasks it wins less often than the same text sent first as a labelled user message, in every model-mode. Third, we test whether pairs forecast larger conflicts; forecasts improve in every model-mode once they know where the task line is. Finally, by our keyword patterns at most 2.92% of decided pair replies flag or hedge a conflict.

</details>


### [256] [Each Insufficient in Its Own Way: Calibrating Language Models Across Varying Evidence States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33237)
*Jiayi Li,Dennis L. Shung,Bradly C. Stadie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种称为证据状态校准的方法，该方法要求模型在回答问题前的自信程度与其正确回答的概率相匹配，并且根据证据的变化调整自信程度。实验表明，该方法能够显著降低Brier评分，提高AUROC得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的语言模型倾向于在证据不足时作出回答，这可能导致不准确的答案。因此，对何时停止收集信息并开始作出回答需要一种更准确的评估方法。

Method: 提出了一种名为Suffice Confidence Estimation (SCE) 的方法，通过微调模型的下一个标记分布，使得模型在不同证据状态下的自信度与正确回答的概率相匹配。

Result: 在临床诊断和多跳问答任务中，使用SCE方法对四种不同模型的四组进行实验，结果表明，SCE方法能够显著降低Brier评分，提高AUROC得分。

Conclusion: SCE方法能够帮助模型更好地判断其当前是否有足够的证据来回答问题，从而提高答案的准确性和可靠性。

Abstract: How can a language model know whether it has enough evidence to answer? Language models tend to answer even when the evidence they have is insufficient. Deciding whether to answer or gather more evidence requires a calibrated estimate of how likely an answer is to be correct with the available evidence. However, most calibration work treats the input as fixed, without asking how this estimate should change with the evidence. We introduce \emph{evidence-state calibration}, which requires a model's confidence before answering to match its probability of answering correctly and to change accordingly whenever the evidence changes this probability. We propose \ours{} (\textbf{Suffi}ciency \textbf{C}onfidence \textbf{E}stimation), which fine-tunes the confidence already present in a model's next-token distribution to match how often the model answers correctly from each evidence state. Across clinical diagnosis and multi-hop question answering with four models from two families, \ours{} reduces the Brier score by up to 60\% and increases AUROC by up to 0.16. Its confidence matches the empirical success rate and responds not only to the amount of evidence but also to which evidence is present, showing that models can learn to judge whether their current evidence is enough to answer.

</details>


### [257] [Hey, guess what: CUES lead to inferences about typicality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33239)
*Alison Chi,Sanghyeok Choi,Hannah Rohde,Emily Allaway*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究构建了两个数据集，通过大规模的人类和LLM实验，揭示了典型性和非典型性推理的心理学基础，并指出LLM在缺乏常识知识的情况下难以准确评估事件的一般典型性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在理解日常对话中未被明确表达的含义，特别是探索典型性和非典型性推理。通过数据集构建和实验证明了人类和LLM处理这种情况的不同方式。

Method: 研究采用构建数据集的方法，包括EventTyp和EventTypGold，然后进行大规模的人类和LLM实验，分析CUES（常识知识、语句强调和讽刺）对典型性推理的影响。

Result: 研究表明，人类对典型性和非典型性具有明确的判断标准，并且可以通过CUES进行预测。然而，LLM在实验中难以基于常识有效评估事件的一般典型性，导致它们难以跟随CUES。

Conclusion: 本研究对于理解人类和LLM在处理未明确表达的含义时的差异至关重要，为改善LLM的表现提供了宝贵的见解。

Abstract: Throughout life, we accumulate knowledge of how typical certain events are. We use this knowledge in daily conversation, often interpreting meaning beyond what has been said explicitly. In this work, we take steps to better understand this meaning recovery, investigating both atypicality and typicality inferences. First, we construct two corpora, EventTyp and the human-validated EventTypGold. We conduct large-scale human and LLM experiments and find that for humans, three CUES predict inferences about typicality: Commonsense Knowledge, Utterance Emphasis, and Snark. However, in most experimental settings, we find that LLMs lack the prerequisite Commonsense Knowledge necessary to accurately assess an event's general typicality, and therefore struggle to follow these CUES.

</details>


### [258] [Two Uncertainties Are Not One: Disagreement versus Decision-Risk in Cheap Structured Content Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33258)
*Karan Yadav*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究对一种经济高效的一级模型进行了独立审计，其分类准确性不输于前沿模型，并且在成本、校准度上具有优势。该研究还强调了不同不确定性类型的区分，并提出了通过分拆决策来识别人类分歧的策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内容审核涉及大规模处理人类判断的分级过程，将其压缩为二元选择（保留/删除）。研究的动机在于寻求一种更经济高效的方法来替代运行领先语言模型（如GPT-5.x、Claude等），以满足内容审核的需求。

Method: 研究团队对一种‘System One’模型进行了独立审计，对比了它与14款前沿推理模型的表现。通过应用零样本分类评价和评估两种不确定性类型的差异，并提出了分拆决策以揭示系统未捕捉到的人类分歧的策略。研究还涉及了一次广泛的数据集测试（142,658条评论），并在共享探针集上进行基准测试。

Result: 实验结果表明，廉价模型在零样本分类AUC ROC（0.83）方面与14个前沿系统中的13个无统计学差异，成本低1-3个数量级，并且其校准度不逊于某些前沿模型。此外，研究指出“置信度”包含两种不同的不确定性，需要从决策风险和人类分歧中进行区分。

Conclusion: 研究结论认为，可以通过分拆决策来识别模型未能捕捉到的人类分歧信号，这种方法适用于弱于人类分歧敏感性的模型，而不太需要该策略的强语言模型无法从中获益。因此，对于不同类型的任务和数据分布，应采取针对性的方法进行优化和改进。

Abstract: Content moderation compresses a graded, contested human judgment into a binary act (leave up / take down) over billions of items, at a scale where running a frontier LLM on every post is uneconomical. A new class of frozen "System One" models returns typed, calibrated decisions instead of text at ~USD 0.000025 per call and ~100 ms. We run the first independent audit of one such model on 142,658 human-labeled comments, and benchmark it against 14 frontier reasoning models (the GPT-5.x, Claude, Gemini 3, and Grok families) on a shared probe set. Two findings stand out. First, the cheap model is accuracy-competitive: its zero-shot classification AUROC (0.83) is not statistically separable (paired bootstrap, n=56; a failure to reject parity, not proof of equivalence) from 13 of the 14 frontier systems while costing 1-3 orders of magnitude less, and it is no worse calibrated than several of them. Second, "confidence" conflates two uncertainties that come apart: human disagreement (where annotators split on satire and coded language) and decision risk (where the automatic action is costly-wrong). Under an asymmetric moderation loss these call for opposite escalation signals, so no single confidence number serves both. Because the model prices extra questions at nearly zero, decomposing the judgment into parallel sub-questions and reading their spread recovers a human-disagreement signal that the model's native confidence misses -- but this remedy is specific: it helps the weakest, disagreement-blind models and only when the decomposition aligns with the sources of disagreement; a specialist toxicity model and the strongest LLMs do not need it, and the effect is distribution-sensitive. We will release the instrument, the cached runs, and the analysis.

</details>


### [259] [FlexA-Mem: Budget-Adaptive Agentic Memory for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33274)
*Wujiang Xu,Jiaojiao Han,Xi Zhu,Qizheng Zhang,Kaiqu Liang,Yutong Yin,Kai Mei,Dimitris N. Metaxas*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FlexA-Mem 是一种通用记忆系统，可以在不调用大语言模型 (LLM) 的情况下生成紧凑的历史记录时间线和相关细节，以适应不同类型的任务。在多项评估中，FlexA-Mem 比现有方法表现出更好的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的记忆系统要么专为单一场景设计（如 A-Mem），要么会遗漏未被明确表达的步骤（如回忆记忆）或简略掉具体的字符串（如摘要），无法满足复杂任务需求。因此，提出了 FlexA-Mem 来提供一种通用的记忆解决方案，能够兼顾不同类型的场景需求。

Method: FlexA-Mem 系统通过将每条历史记录单独存储，并在每次调用时生成新的记忆来实现通用性。生成的记忆包括一个紧凑的历史记录时间线和固定规则填补剩余空间的相关细节，这些细节可能是原始文本或与查询最匹配的部分。

Result: FlexA-Mem 在 AppWorld 挑战任务中优于第二种最佳方法 11.5%，在使用预测固定的任务中，相较于带有摘要的 A-Mem，FlexA-Mem 提高了 12.2% 的性能。在 LongMemEval 和 LoCoMo 测试中，它可以匹配一个没有建立记忆的专用关键字检索器，而基于 LLM 写作的文本建立的记忆在预算紧缩时远远落后。

Conclusion: FlexA-Mem 作为一种通用记忆系统，在不同场景中表现出了优秀的适应性和性能，显示出其在大语言模型代理中的潜力。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents work in scenarios with very different memory needs. A question about past conversations needs the exact facts it names, while a multi-step task needs a trace of the steps already taken together with details that the next step cannot name. Existing memories are each designed and tested for one kind of scenario. Retrieval memories such as A-Mem miss steps that the current query does not express, summaries drop exact strings, and pairing the two fixes the split of the budget in advance. We propose FlexA-Mem, a general memory that writes each unit of history once into an immutable store and renders a fresh memory for every call. The rendered memory is a compact timeline of records plus detail that a fixed rule fits into the remaining room without an LLM call. The detail is either relevant units as raw text or excerpts or the verbatim pieces that best match the query. With one store, FlexA-Mem serves both kinds of scenario. On AppWorld challenge tasks at 4k, it outperforms the second-best method by 11.5%, and on 147 unused tasks with predictions fixed in advance it outperforms A-Mem with a summary by 12.2%. On LongMemEval and LoCoMo, it matches a dedicated keyword retriever that writes no memory, while memories built on text written by an LLM fall far behind at tight budgets. Ablations show that the timeline carries AppWorld completion, whereas recovery mainly saves steps there and decides accuracy on exact facts. Code is available at https://github.com/WujiangXu/Flex-Amem

</details>


### [260] [Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment (MARCA) of Individual Case Safety Reports in Pharmacovigilance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33279)
*Daisy Rae Lopez,Angela Boccia,Maurizio Sessa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MARCA框架在Naranjo评估中显示了较高的问题层面的一致性，特别是在特定问题上优于人类评估，但仍需进一步验证其长期的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面对庞大的个案安全报告，传统的人工因果评估面临挑战，因此开发了MARCA框架以提高评估效率与准确性。

Method: MARCA集成了检索科学文献、药物标签评估、客观证据分类和临床因果推理功能，利用了Gemini 2.5 Pro和DeepSeek-V3.2。框架中的各智能体生成的推理支持了人类辅助评分。

Result: 在215份个案安全报告和1562个药物-事件结合中，问题层面的一致性高达96.8%，特别是在Naranjo Q10方面。最终因果分类的一致性为79.4%。在60个药物-事件子集中，标记为RAG的分数在Q5和Q10上的表现优于非RAG分数。

Conclusion: MARCA辅助评估在某些方面显示出与人工专家相当或更好的一致性，但需要进一步研究以确认其长期的有效性，尤其是RAG标记对评估结果的影响仍需更多证据。

Abstract: Introduction: Increasing volumes of individual case safety reports (ICSRs) challenge expert-led causality assessment in pharmacovigilance. We developed MARCA (Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment), a four-agent framework for Naranjo-based assessment, and evaluated agreement with human experts and exploratory differences between non-RAG and RAG-labelled scores.
  Methods: MARCA combined scientific literature retrieval, drug-label assessment, objective-evidence classification, and clinical causality reasoning using Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2. Agent-generated rationales informed human-assisted scoring. A consensus expert reference standard covered 215 ICSRs and 1,562 drug-event combinations (DECs) from FAERS (Q1-Q2 2025). Agreement was measured using percentage agreement and Cohen's kappa.
  Results: Question-level agreement was 96.8% for Naranjo Q2 (kappa = 0.491; 95% CI 0.265-0.663), 85.4% for Q5 (kappa = 0.269; 95% CI 0.180-0.340), and 96.8% for Q10 (kappa = 0.922; 95% CI 0.885-0.951). Final causality classification agreement was 79.4% (95% CI 71.8-85.3; kappa = 0.587, 95% CI 0.450-0.690). In a retrospective subset of 60 DECs, agreement was higher for RAG-labelled than non-RAG scores for Q5 (83.3% vs 65.0%) and Q10 (100.0% vs 18.3%).
  Discussion: MARCA-assisted assessment showed substantial variation in agreement across Naranjo questions, with lower concordance for alternative causes. Retrospective RAG comparisons are exploratory and do not establish prospective effectiveness.

</details>


### [261] [The Emergence and Sparsification of a Syntactic Circuit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33299)
*Qing Yao,Sasha Boguraev,Tiago Pimentel,Kyle Mahowald*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究了语言模型中主谓数一致行为的神经电路变化，发现一致行为早期学习并由分散的神经元处理，随训练进行稳定后，控制行为的神经元机制仍在重组，最终电路变得非常稀疏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了理解语言模型中语法行为的出现机制，特别是主谓数一致性的学习过程和神经表示。

Method: 追踪了两种不同规模（pythia-1b和pythia-410m）的语言模型在训练过程中的主谓数同意相关神经路径的变化。

Result: 研究发现，主谓数一致行为早期学习，初期由分散的神经元处理，但稳定后由特定的神经元负责，且这些神经元在训练中不断变化，最终模型中的相关神经电路显著稀疏。

Conclusion: 这些结果表明，语言知识在语言模型中的出现和表示是一个复杂而动态的过程，需要持续的神经组织重塑。

Abstract: To understand the emergence of grammatical behavior in language models, we track circuits for subject-verb number agreement in pythia-1b and ten seeds of pythia-410m across training. We find that subject-verb agreement is learned early, and is initially handled by a diffuse collection of neurons. However, after agreement behavior has stabilized, the mechanisms responsible for it continue to reorganize. The attention heads which mediate agreement often shift during training: in the case of pythia-1b, behavior is controlled by two heads early in training but by a third (different) head later. Furthermore, the circuit shrinks over training, with pythia-1b's final circuit being strikingly sparse. We take these results to be informative about how linguistic knowledge emerges and is represented in a language model.

</details>


### [262] [Preference Optimization Improves Definition Generation: Semantic Change in EU Institutional Sustainable Finance Disclosures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33357)
*Mariia Fedorova,Andrey Kutuzov,Gustavo Cadenas Delascio*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出通过直接偏好优化（DPO）微调词典类定义生成器，以解决其过于精细的概念分布问题。研究在经过严格挑选的学术LSCD基准和实际项目文档中的可持续性术语演变审核任务上进行了验证，展示了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统词典类定义生成器在处理词汇语义变化检测（LSCD）时存在概念分布过于细化的问题，生成过多的定义，因此需要优化方法以提升其在实际应用场景中的性能。

Method: 通过直接偏好优化（DPO）对词典类定义生成器进行微调，以解决过细的概念分布问题。

Result: 在学术基准和实际项目文档中均展现了所提出方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 提出的基于DPO的定义生成优化方法有助于解决词汇语义变化检测中的过度精细化问题，并且能够在实际应用场景中实现对相关术语演变的审计。

Abstract: Dictionary-like definition generators are known to be useful for lexical semantic change detection (LSCD). However, they suffer from overly granular sense distribution, producing excessive number of definitions for one and the same lexical sense. In this work, we show that fine-tuning with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) helps to overcome this problem. We test our approach both quantitatively on a curated academic LSCD benchmark and qualitatively on real-world data for a practical task of auditing diachronic changes in sustainability terminology within project documentation of EU development finance. All models, code and predictions produced in this study are publicly available at https://github.com/ltgoslo/dpo-for-definition-generation.

</details>


### [263] [Distill, Debate, Discover: Grounding Multi-Agent Research Ideation in Graph-Distilled Insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33366)
*Qianran Ma,Muxin Liu,Grace Kim,Xiao Liang,Chris Callison-Burch*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种基于文献的知识提取框架——InsightAgents，通过构建文献图来赋予多智能体不同且有意义的专业知识，其在研究员观点合作中模拟灵感的产生过程。该框架在对100个NLP研究主题进行对比测试中，以最高平均分在五个评估维度上胜出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究者在合作中会利用累积的研究经验，本研究旨在引入一种增强多智能体系统协作能力的框架，从而更好地支持研究想法生成。

Method: InsightAgents通过从相关论文图中提取洞察，根据研究走向揭示潜在假设，识别未解决的挑战，来赋予智能体不同的专业领域知识。

Result: InsightAgents在两种知识设置下，以最高平均分在五个评估维度上击败了三个研究想法生成框架。

Conclusion: InsightAgents框架展示了在科学研究中如何利用多智能体系统，通过协作和辩论来创建研究提案的方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support research idea generation and scientific discovery. Multi-agent debate offers a collaborative approach to this task by bringing together diverse perspectives to develop research ideas. However, a key challenge is how to equip agents with distinct and meaningful expertise to guide their contributions. Inspired by how researchers draw on accumulated research experience during collaboration, we introduce InsightAgents, a framework that constructs literature-grounded agent expertise by distilling insights from graphs of related papers. Guided by insights that trace evolving research approaches, reveal underlying assumptions, and identify unresolved challenges, within a line of research, agents jointly identify a research problem and propose, challenge, and refine potential approaches through debate to develop a research proposal. We evaluate InsightAgents against three research idea generation frameworks on 100 NLP research topics through pairwise comparisons by two LLM judges. In both online and offline knowledge settings, InsightAgents achieves the highest average score across the five evaluation dimensions under both judges.

</details>


### [264] [How Does Post-Training Shape LLM Value Preferences?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33371)
*Yang Liu,Shaoyang Xu,Masahiro Kaneko,Chengzhi Zhong,Wenxuan Zhang,Chenhui Chu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现，后训练时不同意见混合物对语言模型价值偏好影响显著不同，且该影响依赖于不同的后训练方法和数据集的特点。模型的稳定性还需进一步研究，同时这些价值偏好会通过蒸馏传递给学生模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于大型语言模型在学习价值观时可能受到训练数据中意见混合物的影响，研究如何这些影响在不同后训练路径上有所不同，以及如何影响模型稳定性和价值偏好传递。

Method: 实验设计了不同的后训练数据集（意见混合物不同）和后训练路径（SFT、DPO、GRPO），并分析模型在这些实验中的表现。

Result: 研究结果显示，不同后训练路径对意见混合物的影响显著不同，且这一影响还取决于特定的后训练方法和训练数据集中的意见分布。此外，即使使用没有意见问题的数据集进行蒸馏，模型仍可能继承价值偏好。

Conclusion: 研究结论指出，开发、评估和重用大型语言模型时需考虑训练数据集的意见混合物和后训练方法，以减少模型价值偏好的放大并提高其稳定性。

Abstract: During post-training, large language models (LLMs) learn value preferences from corpora that may contain imbalanced proportions of opinions associated with different demographic groups. Amplifying these imbalances may further underrepresent some groups' opinions. However, how opinion mixtures shape value preferences across post-training paths remains unclear. To answer this question, we conduct controlled experiments using post-training corpora with different opinion mixtures and five post-training paths based on SFT, DPO, and GRPO. We find that post-training amplifies opinion imbalances differently across post-training paths. Once value preferences are amplified, whether further post-training can remove them depends on both the post-training method and the opinion mixture in the corpus. More concerningly, a model's stability under interventions depends on whether further post-training changes its value preference. Moreover, these value preferences are transferred to student models even when distillation uses corpora with no explicit opinion questions. These findings suggest that both the opinion mixture in post-training corpora and the choice of post-training method should be considered when developing, evaluating, and reusing LLMs. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/ku-nlp/llm-value-preferences.

</details>


### [265] [Examining form-based linguistic productivity in people and large language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33433)
*Michael Wilson,Robert Frank*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究比较了人类和计算语言模型在使用新动词于被动语态时的灵活性，发现人类能够基于形式特征进行抽象泛化，而计算模型则依赖于已知词汇的含义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究人类语言与计算语言模型在新语境中使用形式特征进行抽象泛化的差异，以揭示人类语言的独特之处。

Method: 通过让参与者和计算语言模型处理新动词在被动语态中的应用，观察它们能否成功地进行形式上的泛化。

Result: 人类能够在没有明确语义的情况下将新动词应用于被动语态，而计算语言模型则需要赋予新动词类似于现有动词的语义。

Conclusion: 计算语言模型的句法知识仍然依赖于特定词汇项的分布和含义，而人类的句法知识则更加抽象和灵活。

Abstract: Linguistic productivity, as evidenced by the use of words in novel contexts, is one of the most striking facts about human language. However, how abstract the knowledge that enables such productivity is remains unclear. We compare people's and computational language models' linguistic productivity in contexts where successful generalization depends on form-based information. We focus on extending the use of a novel verb learned in the active voice to passive contexts. We find people extend active to passive uses in a way consistent with abstract generalizations concerning linguistic form, even when no plausible meaning can be assigned to the novel verb. In contrast, large language models succeeded only when a meaning like an existing verb's could be assigned to the novel verb. We conclude that computational models' syntactic knowledge remains tied to the distribution and meaning of specific lexical items in a way that human syntactic knowledge is not.

</details>


### [266] [Perturbation-Based Data Selection for Medical Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33440)
*Yuexin Wu,Dayou Yu,Vasile Rus*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了一种基于高斯扰动最终块表示两种信号的数据选择方法，即预测变化频率和非翻转边缘收缩，用于从现有问答银行适应医学语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学自然语言处理领域中，高效地从现有问答数据集中选择紧凑的训练子集对于适应任务至关重要。本文提出了一种基于扰动的训练数据选择方法，可以改善模型性能并减少训练数据的使用量。

Method: 研究使用了来自高斯扰动最终块表示的两种信号进行数据选择：预测变化频率和非翻转边缘收缩。方法包括共享熵初步过滤，以及使用自动均方根缩放结合这两种信号的Representations-Sensitivity Prioritization (RSP)方法和仅使用边缘收缩排名候选者的RSP-Drop方法。

Result: 研究在MedGemma-4B上于五个医学问答数据集上进行了评估，在预算为128例的情况下，RSP和RSP-Drop分别获得了47.55和48.28的宏F1分数，优于熵池匹配的随机选择方法45.11。不同的数据集和预算条件下，两种选择方法的相对性能有所不同。对比研究表明，两种规则在处理数据集时存在不同的干净边缘轮廓特征，同时也表明熵预过滤不一定对所有情况都有益处。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法在医学问答数据集上能够提供优越的性能，但对于不同数据集的适用性存在差异，进一步研究指出熵预过滤并非始终有利。

Abstract: Selecting a compact training subset is an important step in adapting medical language models from existing question-answering banks. We investigate perturbation-based data selection using two signals derived from Gaussian perturbations of the final-block representation: prediction-change frequency and non-flipping margin contraction. After a shared entropy prefilter, Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization (RSP) combines the signals using automatic root-mean-square scaling, while RSP-Drop ranks candidates by contraction alone. Both selectors use only questions and answer options during selection. We evaluate them with MedGemma-4B on five medical QA datasets at retained-set budgets of 64, 128, and 256 examples. At the primary budget of 128, RSP and RSP-Drop obtain dataset-averaged Macro-F1 scores of 47.55 and 48.28, respectively, compared with 45.11 for entropy-pool-matched random selection. Their relative performance varies across datasets and budgets. A selected-set case study identifies contrasting clean-margin profiles among the examples exchanged by the two rules, while a full-pool ablation shows that entropy prefiltering is not uniformly beneficial. These retrospective results characterize the empirical utility and limitations of perturbation-based selection under a fixed adaptation protocol. Evaluation uses one backbone and benchmarks with documented training-family overlap; it does not establish clinical effectiveness.

</details>
