Base models displayed little of the linguistic competence assessed by the benchmark, whereas their post-trained versions performed markedly better, suggesting that post-training plays a central role in making linguistic knowledge accessible and usable. Parameter count, by contrast, showed no statistically significant association with partial-credit performance, and competencies remained unevenly distributed across linguistic domains. We interpret this pattern as evidence that post-training adds linguistic competencies piecemeal, without producing a general linguistic intelligence capable of extending them beyond the learned policies that support them. Models performed best on logical relations between statements and selected discourse-level tasks, while even the strongest post-trained models continued to struggle with ambiguity, literary style, reference, and misleading assumptions. Human and Sol evaluations produced nearly identical model rankings in both the original and ReliableEval runs, supporting the replicability of the comparative results.

</details>


### [305] [T2D: Target-to-Draft Model Pruning & Adaptation for Efficient Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34103)
*Shahriar Kabir Nahin,Xiao Ye,Muhao Chen,Ben Zhou,Anshuman Chhabra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: T2D框架通过在目标模型中应用延迟感知结构化剪枝和知识蒸馏，直接构造出兼顾实际推理延迟和目标模型响应交叉熵损失的草稿模型，实现超卓的推测性解码性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的推测性解码方法要么使用独立预训练的小型草稿模型，要么手动选择剪枝的目标模型架构，无法明确平衡草稿模型对齐和token生成效率之间的权衡。

Method: T2D框架采用了延迟感知结构化剪枝和知识蒸馏的方法，从目标模型中直接构建草稿模型，同时优化实际推理延迟和目标模型响应的交叉熵损失。

Result: 经过大量实验，T2D可将目标模型剪枝高达92%，相比竞争基线获得高性能的草稿模型。此外，通过T2D获得的草稿模型也适用于其他推测性解码方法，进一步提升性能。

Conclusion: 这些发现强调了同时导航草稿模型架构对齐前沿的重要性，以充分发挥推测性解码在大型语言模型中的潜力。

Abstract: Speculative decoding significantly accelerates autoregressive text generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), but its efficacy depends largely on two key factors: the distributional alignment between the draft and the target model, and the draft model's latency during inference. However, existing approaches typically utilize independently pretrained small draft models or seek to prune the target model to a manually chosen architecture, thereby failing to explicitly balance the trade-off between draft model alignment and token generation efficiency. To address this gap, we formulate draft model design as an optimization problem and propose T2D, a framework that constructs draft models directly from the target model using latency-aware structured pruning and knowledge distillation. In this manner, T2D obtains draft models that are jointly optimized for both measured inference latency and cross-entropy loss on the target model's responses, resulting in superlative speculative decoding performance. Through extensive experiments on multi-domain speculative decoding benchmarks and across several target model families of differing scale, we demonstrate how T2D prunes up to 92\% of the target model to obtain highly performant draft models compared to competitive baselines. Moreover, draft models obtained via T2D can also be utilized by other speculative decoding token-alignment and knowledge distillation methods in a plug-and-play fashion, leading to further gains. Our findings underscore the importance of jointly navigating the draft model architecture-alignment frontier to unlock the full potential of speculative decoding for LLMs.

</details>


### [306] [Rethinking Retrieval in the Long-Context Era: Training-Free Semantic Trees for Adaptive Context Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34146)
*Zhe Xu,Tianhao Liao,Zhenqing Ling,Ying Shen,Yaliang Li,Daoyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一个名为\ours的框架，通过语义抽象指导证据的选择和组织，以改进问答系统的性能。该框架在三个LongBench任务上提高了平均QA-F1分数，并减少了答案上下文长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究的动机在于解决全文档作为背景时，如何从文档中精选并组织有效的证据来更好地回答问题。

Method: 研究提出了一种无需训练的框架（\ours），该框架利用语义抽象来引导证据的选择，同时保留原始文本用于回答。框架的特点是个别生成一个可复用的语义层次结构，并将节点描述与源跨度链接起来。对于每个查询，框架会基于结构性-语义得分和精细的词汇归因提名共享源节点，然后将其与祖先背景上下文结合，以保留结构性关系和完整的局部文本。

Result: 通过该框架，研究者在四个前沿的问答模型上，相比全背景提示在三个LongBench任务上提高了1.72个点的平均QA-F1分数，并且在四个模型的平均表现上超越了评价的对照基准。同时，该框架还成功减少了答案上下文的长度比例达58.55%。

Conclusion: 该研究的工作极大地改进了利用全文档进行问答的效果，证明了在全文档背景下，通过精炼和组织有效信息来增强答案生成的可行性。

Abstract: Long-context language models can increasingly process entire documents, making full-context prompting a practical alternative to passage retrieval. However, greater capacity determines how much information a model can receive, but not which information best supports a query. This distinction motivates rethinking retrieval: when the full document already fits, can selecting and organizing its evidence improve answering? The challenge is to retain supporting facts and relations while keeping the context focused on the question. To reconcile these goals, we introduce \ours, a training-free framework that uses semantic abstraction to guide selection while retaining original text for answering. \ours constructs a reusable semantic hierarchy from the full document in a single generation, linking node descriptions to source spans. Given a query, structural--semantic scoring and fine-grained lexical attribution nominate shared source nodes; their union with ancestor context preserves structural relations and complete local text. Across four frontier answer models, \ours improves average QA-F1 by 1.72 points over full-context prompting on three LongBench tasks, surpassing the evaluated baselines on the four-model average while reducing answer-context length by 58.55\%. Our code is available at the $\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/treefuse-ECFE}{repository}$.

</details>


### [307] [Write What Matters: Disentangling Token Selection from Slot Allocation in Recurrent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34180)
*Chen Chen,Rui Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了Factorized Write Routing（FWR），它首先决定保留或忽略每个token，然后选择固定的或token自适应数量的槽位。实验表明，在信息密集的上下文中应总是写入，并在干扰因素占主导时进行选择性写入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长序列模型需要保留早期信息，但全注意机制代价高昂，而循环记忆模型虽然处理时间线性增长，但存储容量有限。现有方法将每个token写入相同数量的槽位，混淆应存储与否与需更新的槽位数。本文介绍了一种新的写入路由机制（FWR），提高了模型在密集信息和稀疏信息场景下的性能。

Method: 本文提出了一种新颖的写入路由策略，称为Factorized Write Routing (FWR)。FWR首先决定每个token是否保留或跳过，然后选择固定的或token自适应数量的槽位。通过这种方式，模型可以在不同的上下文中采用不同的策略来处理信息。

Result: 在两个合成任务上进行实验，结果显示，在信息密集的上下文中应总是写入（Feature Recall任务准确率0.472 vs 0.337），而在干扰因素占主导的场景中可以进行选择性写入（Passkey任务准确率0.222 vs 0.048）。同时，FWR的自适应规则在两个任务上表现均劣于固定的槽位分配。

Conclusion: FWR提出了一种有效的方法来处理信息密集和干扰因素占主导的上下文，避免了漏写，并在某些条件下消除了存储干扰信息的问题。

Abstract: Long-sequence models must retain earlier information. Full attention keeps all past tokens but grows expensive, and recurrent-memory models compress history into fixed slots for linear-time processing. Limited capacity makes writes consequential: distractors can interfere with useful content, while skipped evidence cannot be recalled. Existing multi-slot memories write every token to the same number of slots, merging whether to store it with how many slots to update. We introduce Factorized Write Routing (FWR), which first keeps or skips each token and then chooses a fixed or token-adaptive number of slots. Queries still read all slots. Across ten seeds on two synthetic tasks that query facts after long contexts, we observe a density-dependent reversal. With four slots per write, long-context accuracy favors always writing on dense Feature Recall (0.472 vs 0.337), but learned selective writing on sparse-fact Passkey (0.222 vs 0.048). The tested adaptive rule underperforms fixed allocation under the learned gate on both tasks. A diagnostic oracle given fact labels unavailable at deployment reaches 0.372 on Passkey, showing headroom in filtering distractors. The results suggest avoiding missed writes in information-dense contexts and filtering distractors when they dominate.

</details>


### [308] [Higher Reasoning Effort Improves Reference Verifiability and Changes Reasoning Summaries in GPT-5.5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34212)
*Melika Mobini,Andres Algaba,Vincent Ginis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过对比GPT-5.5在低努力和高努力模式下生成1000篇论文参考文献的效果，发现高努力模式下生成的参考文献更易于验证，且推理总结更长。高努力模式显著提高了某些预定义特征的评分，但未发现一致的验证率随评分提高的趋势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究指出大型语言模型在科学知识生产中的应用，如参考文献建议，并探讨增加推理努力是否能提高生成参考文献的可验证性和揭示模型行为的变化。

Method: 研究者使用GPT-5.5在低努力和高努力条件下生成1000篇论文的参考文献，并通过外部引文记录匹配验证生成的参考文献，同时评估推理总结的特征评分。

Result: 高努力模式下的参考文献验证率为84.8%，较低努力模式的78.3%有所提高；推理总结更长；四个预定义特征评分在高努力模式下更高；发现的新特征在两种模式下的出现频率不一致。

Conclusion: 研究结论表明增加推理努力可以提高生成参考文献的验证率和增加推理总结的详细程度，尽管某些预定义特征和新特征的评分提高趋势不一致，但验证率并未随着评分的提高而系统性增加。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly being used in different stages of scientific knowledge production, including the suggestion of references. These models can operate at different levels of reasoning effort and provide summaries of their reasoning processes. This raises two questions: Does increasing reasoning effort improve the verifiability of generated references, and do the resulting reasoning summaries reveal how the model's behavior changes with greater effort? We examined summaries from GPT-5.5 as it generated scholarly references for 1,000 papers under paired low- and high-effort settings. Generated references were matched to external bibliographic records, and reasoning summaries were scored for four predefined features and explored for additional features discovered by GPT-5.5. High effort increased the mean paper-level resolver-verified reference rate from 78.3% to 84.8%, and produced longer reasoning summaries. All four predefined features received higher scores under high effort. The discovered features changed less uniformly: some appeared equally often in both conditions, whereas others were more common under high effort. Within each effort condition, neither feature set showed a consistent increase in verification rates with higher scores.

</details>


### [309] [Synthetic linguistic data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34215)
*Giuseppe Samo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了合成数据的两种类型及其区别，即合成丛林数据和合成灌木丛数据，强调了合成数据对语言研究的独特价值及其分析时需考虑的生成条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 介绍了Bresnan (2016) 提出的‘语言花园’和‘灌木丛’理论，提出了新的‘人工植物温室’概念，用于区分合成数据类型，以促进对合成数据在语言研究中的价值和适用性的理解。

Method: 通过引入新的比喻来区分合成数据中的不同数据集类型，并讨论了如何将这些数据与自然语言数据进行比较。

Result: 在引入合成数据类型的基础上，讨论了合成数据的使用情况及其与自然语言数据的比较。揭示了两者之间的共性和差异。

Conclusion: 合成数据作为语言研究中的独特对象，提供了新的视角来理解语言模式和趋势，并强调了在分析合成数据时需注意生成条件，以及将其与自然语言数据进行对比的重要性。

Abstract: Synthetic linguistic data have become increasingly prominent in linguistic research, from the analysis of large collections of AI-generated texts to controlled experiments investigating grammatical and lexical preferences. This glossary entry extends Bresnan's (2016) distinction between the linguistic garden and the bush by introducing an artificial plant nursery as a metaphor for synthetic data. We distinguish between synthetic bush data, consisting primarily of corpus-like collections of model-generated language, and synthetic garden data, in which model outputs are elicited under controlled conditions to investigate specific linguistic hypotheses. We argue that synthetic data constitute a distinct object of linguistic investigation: comparing them with natural language data can reveal both shared patterns and divergences, but their interpretation requires careful consideration of the conditions under which they are generated.

</details>


### [310] [$Δτ$-Bench: Pushing Agents Toward a Moving Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34238)
*Shuofei Qiao,Xuanguang Pan,Yijun Chen,Wendi Feng,Bin Wu,Runnan Fang,Yuqi Zhu,Shumin Deng,Emine Yilmaz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文介绍了Δτ-Bench，一个用于评估智能代理在大型工具生态系统中学习和适应能力的基准测试工具，展示了现有方法在生态系统演进中的局限性，并提出了一种新的生态系统管理系统Steward，能够更好地处理工具和程序知识的变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生态系统中的工具不断演化，导致任务执行方式和工具使用路径发生变化。现有的基准测试未能评估智能代理如何在这些变化中发现高效的工作流程和更新其知识。

Method: Δτ-Bench通过引入1,588个多轮任务，覆盖42个领域和六个生态系统状态，来评估智能代理的能力。还提出了Steward作为生态系统管理者，利用增量技能维护和动态提供服务来优化任务执行。

Result: 实验结果显示，现有模型或方法在任务成功率上仅为42.3%，而Steward在生态系统变化中保持了更高的任务成功率，同时降低了技能维护的开销。

Conclusion: Steward能够更有效地管理工具和程序知识，提高从中断的工作流中恢复和采用更高效的替代方案的能力。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce $Δτ$-Bench, an executable agent benchmark that models the structural evolution of large tool ecosystems. In $Δτ$-Bench, independently evolving services continually reshape how tasks can be accomplished: familiar tools may disappear or be replaced, while more efficient alternatives emerge amid overlapping functionality and noisy documentation. Against this moving capability frontier, we evaluate whether agents can proactively discover efficient tool-use paths and promptly revise their accumulated procedural knowledge, bringing together demands that existing benchmarks fail to examine. $Δτ$-Bench comprises 1,588 validated multi-turn tasks across 42 domains and six successive ecosystem states generated through capability-preserving transformations. Our evaluation shows that even the strongest evaluated model or harness achieves only 42.3% task success, while initial gains from existing skill-learning methods can not consistently translate into better adaptation as the ecosystem evolves. These findings motivate Steward, an ecosystem manager that jointly manages tools and procedural knowledge through incremental skill maintenance and dynamic provisioning during task execution. Experiments show that Steward sustains higher task success across ecosystem changes with lower skill-maintenance overhead, while improving both recovery from disrupted workflows and adoption of more efficient alternatives.

</details>


### [311] [A Russian, a Brazilian, and a German Walk into a Bar, Ask the Same Question-- And Get Three Different Answers: Profiling LLM Perspective Diversity on Contested Topics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34278)
*Wiem Ben Rim,Yao Lu,Pontus Stenetorp,Emine Yilmaz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究创建了一个多语言数据集，涵盖了全球争议性话题，涉及18种语言，旨在研究大型语言模型（LLMs）在不同语言中的视角差异，发现LLMs在不同语言中回答问题的态度有所差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基准测试主要集中在英语上，而忽略了全球用户持有的多样观点。研究旨在系统性地研究LLM在不同语言中的视角差异，丰富LLM评估方法。

Method: 研究团队创建了PerspectivesQA数据集，并开发了ROOTS框架来评估不同规模模型在多种语言环境中的表现。

Result: 研究发现，LLMs在英语中倾向于含糊其词，但在低资源语言中则坚定立场。大型模型保持更一致的世界观，而小型模型则更容易受影响。所有模型对输入细微变化高度敏感，即使在大模型中也表现出明显的立场。

Conclusion: 研究确立了不同规模、不同来源的LLM在不同语言环境下的表现特点，提出了评估LLM多样性的新框架。

Abstract: Large Language Models(LLMs) have shown strong performance on tasks with verifiable answers, but many real-world queries involve subjectivity, disagreement, and conflicting evidence. Most existing benchmarks for such queries remain English-centric, overlooking the vast diversity of perspectives held by users worldwide. To systematically study how LLM perspectives vary across languages, we curate PerspectivesQA, a manually verified multilingual dataset of globally contested topics covering 18 languages, and propose ROOTS, a framework that profiles linguistic, perspective, and framing diversity. We evaluate a diverse set of eight models covering both open-source and proprietary families at varying scales, establishing that LLMs hedge their answers in English but commit to positions in lower-resource languages. Larger models maintain a more consistent cross-lingual worldview, while smaller models are more easily swayed. All models also exhibit high sensitivity to minor surface-level input variations, producing notable stance even in larger models.

</details>


### [312] [Transformer to GPT-5: Advancements, Limitations, and Future Directions in Large Language Model Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34281)
*Harsidak Singh Banwait,Chander Prabha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）的分类，并讨论了从早期Bert到现代模型如GPT、Gemini、Claude和Grok的发展历程。研究涵盖了训练数据集、计算力、硬件规格、架构和参数等内容，揭示了优化架构复杂性和数据质量比例的模型在推理稳定性和对齐性方面表现出色的特点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于近年来关于LLMs的研究工作非常丰富，但对这些模型的系统分类研究却较少，本文旨在填补这一空白，详细分类LLMs并探讨其发展历程，旨在帮助读者更好地理解和利用这些模型。

Method: 该研究回顾了LLMs的研究进展，特别是从Bert等早期模型到GPT、Gemini、Claude和Grok等现代模型的演变。研究还分析了训练LLMs所使用的数据集、计算资源、硬件配置以及其架构和参数等因素。

Result: 研究发现，优化架构复杂性和数据质量比例的模型在推理稳定性和对齐性方面表现出色，但不会显著增加计算负担。这种在扩展性和可持续性之间的平衡是当前AI模型的主要特征。

Conclusion: 本文详细分类了LLMs，并通过分析其发展脉络，揭示了优化架构复杂性和数据质量比例的模型在推理稳定性和对齐性方面表现出色的特点，这对于理解和利用这些模型具有重要意义。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized Artificial Intelligence (AI) by their extraordinary capabilities, like contextual understanding, few-shot/zero-shot learning, code generation, ability to reason and problem-solving. Recent studies have shown immense work on LLMs. Yet, there is limited work on the thorough taxonomy of LLMs. This study would showcase a detailed classification of LLMs, starting with the earlier models like BERT and leading to LLMs like GPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok. We would delve into topics like datasets used to train LLMs, computational power used during training, their hardware specifications, architecture and parameters. Further, we would also look at the limitations, computational challenges and open problems as well. This study would primarily focus on the timeline of LLMs, signifying their growth over the period. Findings reveal a clear pattern: models that optimize the ratio between architectural complexity and data quality exhibit stronger reasoning stability and better alignment, without proportionally increasing the computational load. This desired balance between scaling and sustainability is the defining characteristic of the current generation of AI.

</details>


### [313] [Factual Yet One-Sided: Stance Poisoning and Evidence Balancing in Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34294)
*Puyuan Yang,Shaoxuan Dong,Liujie Wu,Xiaochun Cheng,Bo Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了在检索增强生成系统中的立场平衡问题，提出了一个立场平衡中间件，通过检测立场、固定平衡及去偏见提示，减少了立场偏差，特别是在处理有一定比例污染文档时效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的知识投毒研究主要集中在事实错误上，而该研究关注的是正确事实但立场偏颇的问题，旨在改善生成系统对争议性话题的立场偏差。

Method: 引入一种名为Stance-Balancing Middleware的中间件，包含立场检测、固定平衡（2支持 + 2反对 + 1中立）和去偏见提示，而不增加额外的大语言模型调用。

Result: 该方法在所有八个浓度方向设置中显著降低了立场偏差的幅度，特别是在11.9%-18.9%污染份额下的六种设置中，在Holm调整后p值≤0.009。跨模型实验中，所有八个模型方向组合沿立场轴向矫正方向移动，大部分组合表现出明显的绝对距离从0的趋势缩短。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法在处理存在一定比例污染文档时能够有效减少立场偏差，且立场检测的处理时间在合理范围内，具有较好的实用性和效果。

Abstract: The stance expressed in responses from retrieval-augmented generation systems is significantly influenced by the stance distribution of the retrieved materials. Existing research on knowledge poisoning has primarily targeted factual errors. In contrast, this study focuses on injection attacks in which the facts are correct but the stance on a controversial issue is one-sided. At a mean topic-level poisoning share of 18.9% within the post-injection ProCon documents, all four generation models from different vendors exhibited stance shifts aligned with the poisoning direction; across four concentration levels, the shifts increased monotonically.
  This paper proposes a Stance-Balancing Middleware positioned between the retriever and the generator. It consists of stance detection, fixed balancing (2 supporting + 2 opposing + 1 neutral), and a debiasing prompt, without introducing additional large language model calls. Across all eight concentration-direction settings, the complete method reduced the magnitude of stance deviation by an estimated 0.106 to 0.350; the six settings at poisoning shares of 11.9%-18.9% remained significant after Holm adjustment (adjusted p <= 0.009). In the cross-model experiment, all eight model-direction combinations moved along the stance axis in the corrective direction, and seven of eight showed a clearly detected reduction in absolute distance from 0. In the concentration sweep, the post-defense intervals included 0 in all eight settings, while the cross-model pro-poisoning results retained small positive residual point estimates of +0.045 to +0.063. For 20 candidate documents, stance detection took approximately 1.5% of the median generation time on a single GPU and approximately 16% on CPU.

</details>


### [314] [CoLink: Global Compression and Knowledge Linking for Multi-Turn Dialogue Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34335)
*Lian Yan,Zhenbo Xia,Haotian Wang,Chen Tang,Yi Guan,Jie Liu,Jingchi Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CoLink框架通过联系和压缩历史对话内容与外部知识，增强了LLMs在特定领域多轮对话中的全局上下文意识，实现了效率和有效性的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的LLM方法在处理长期对话历史时存在信息丢失、检索冗余和短视注意力的问题，CoLink框架旨在通过信息链接和压缩来解决这些问题。

Method: CoLink框架首先将历史上下文聚类为话题图以建立跨语义关联，然后通过结合语义相关性和图结构拓扑来检索和激活知识。最后，通过基于信息理论的优化目标压缩历史和知识，使用一个竞争性插槽机制将全局语境凝结成专门的记忆和知识插槽。

Result: CoLink方法在公共数据集和自建的MMD数据集上都展示了其在知识链接和意义建模方面的优越性和可扩展性。

Conclusion: CoLink提供了一种有效的LML增强框架，它通过信息链接和压缩来改善在特定领域内多轮对话中的全局上下文理解。

Abstract: Extracting salient information from long-horizon dialogue histories remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to the restricted context windows and efficient retrieval challenges. Current methods typically rely on history organization or local token-level optimization, suffering from information loss, retrieval redundancy, and myopic attention. Inspired by the view in cognitive science that dialogue constitutes sense-making and memory association, we propose CoLink, a framework that enhances LLMs' global context awareness in domain-specific multi-turn dialogues through information linking and compression. CoLink first clusters historical contexts into topic graphs to establish cross-semantic associations with external knowledge. Guided by the adaptive control of thought, it then retrieves and activates knowledge via synergizing semantic relevance and graph-structural topology. Crucially, to achieve effective compression of history and knowledge, we ground multi-turn dialogues in information theory and derive a principled optimization objective for extracting the core sense-making information. Coupled with a competitive slot mechanism, CoLink condenses the global context into dedicated memory and knowledge slots, efficiently distilling lengthy, redundant inputs into an extremely compact latent representation. Extensive empirical results on both public and our MMD datasets validate CoLink's superiority and generalizability in knowledge linking and sense modeling.

</details>


### [315] [Improving the Chain-of-Thought Compressibility of Pruned Reasoning Models via Long--Short Contrastive Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34336)
*Tao Jing,Chen Kang,Feifei Zhai,Pengyuan Liu,Dong Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了对比集差异（CSD）方法，该方法通过对比激活找出冗余推理的神经元，并优先进行剪枝，同时扩大偏好调整对剪枝后模型无法或总是解决的问题进行训练。结果显示，在四个数学测试基准上，相较于带有推理感知校准（RAC）的剪枝方法，该组合方法能减少8-22%的思考令牌数量，同时保持接近的准确度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对大型推理模型的高效服务需求，当前的剪枝和长推理链压缩方法存在相互干扰的问题，本文旨在提出一种新的解决方案以提高大型推理模型的服务效率。

Method: 本文提出了一种新的剪枝方法——Contrastive Set-Difference（CSD），通过对比激活来识别冗余推理的神经元，并且扩展了偏好调整范围，使其能更好地处理剪枝模型解决或无法解决的问题。

Result: 实验结果显示，使用20%的剪枝量，该组合方法（CSD结合偏好调整）在四个数学测试基准上减少了8-22%的思考令牌数量，同时保持了接近的准确度。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法取得了良好效果，能够有效减少大型推理模型的服务成本，为实现高效推理提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Large reasoning models are costly to serve because they are large and because they generate long chains of thought (CoT). Weight pruning and CoT compression address these two costs separately, but they interfere in that pruning adds redundant reasoning on problems the model still solves and incomplete reasoning on those it no longer solves, and on harder problems makes the model less compressible by subsequent length-preference optimization. We trace this to a blind spot on each side: pruning criteria do not distinguish necessary from redundant reasoning, and preference-based CoT compression receives no training signal on problems a pruned model always or never solves. We propose Contrastive Set-Difference (CSD), which identifies neurons enriched in redundant reasoning by contrasting their activations on long and short correct solutions of the same problem and prunes them preferentially, and we extend preference pairs to the problems a pruned model always or never solves. Pruning 20\% of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, the combination uses 8--22\% fewer thinking tokens on four math benchmarks than pruning with reasoning-aware calibration (RAC) followed by the same compression, with accuracy within 0.5 points.

</details>


### [316] [Xing USP: A Cross-Family Semantic Contract for Information Extraction and Intent-Slot Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34343)
*Zhongqiu Li,Boyang Wang,Ruiyu Fang,Shiquan Wang,Di Wu,Jiayi Liang,Feilong Zhang,Hongfeng Du,Xiaomeng Huang,Mengjiao Bao,Luwen Pu,Xuewei He,Yu Zhao,Chao Wang,Kaidong Yu,Bingkai Yang,Qingjun Zhu,Shaoyi Du,Shuangyong Song,Yongxiang Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: USP提供了一种跨家族语义合同，用于统一61个数据集，并通过五种诊断匹配视图评估模型效果，展示结构一致性的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的结构化语义解析评价主要关注类别标注的准确性，而忽视了语义值恢复和实例级别的关联。

Method: USP定义了一个跨家庭的语义合同，使用一个共同接口对命名实体识别、关系提取、事件抽取和意图槽解析进行建模，提出五种匹配视图进行具体评估。

Result: USP将61个数据集统一为一个共享架构的语料库，基于此比较了六种模型，结果显示微调后的Xing4.0-29B-Intent表现出最佳性能，特别是在完整实例恢复方面。

Conclusion: USP为社区提供了一个共享表示、统一的61个数据集语料库和一种诊断评价标准，使得结构一致性可测量且可比对跨抽取和意图槽任务。

Abstract: Structured semantic parsing is typically judged by whether the correct category is assigned, which leaves value recovery and instance-level associations unexamined: a system may recognize an event yet bind an argument to the wrong instance, or identify an intent yet supply an incorrect slot value. We present USP, a cross-family semantic contract that represents categories, fields, values, and instance associations through a common interface for named-entity recognition, relation extraction, event extraction, and intent-slot parsing. The contract is paired with five diagnostic matching views---category agreement, field recognition, field-value pairing, instance-bound assignment, and complete-instance recovery---that ask distinct questions about the same output. Using this contract, we normalize 61 datasets into a unified corpus with shared schemas, prompts, and matching rules, and compare six models on a fixed test subset. Our fine-tuned Xing4.0-29B-Intent attains 57.70 task-balanced Field-Value Micro-F1 (equally weighted across the four task families) and ranks first in every family and on all five views; its margin over the strongest alternative widens from 2.93 points for category matching to 20.73 points for complete-instance matching. This widening gap shows that category agreement alone understates structural deficits. USP thus offers the community a shared representation, a normalized 61-dataset corpus, and a diagnostic evaluation protocol that make structural agreement measurable and comparable across extraction and intent-slot tasks.

</details>


### [317] [Beyond the Opening: Tracing the First Token's Persistent Influence on Reasoning Length](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34350)
*Ruochen Liu,Hao Yan,Ziluowen Luo,Senzhang Wang,Sihong Xie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现，改变推理序列的第一词（即初始词）会持续影响后续推理的长度，即使其他词保持不变。这种影响集中在几个敏感的位置，通过这些位置的注意力可以维持初始词对推理长度的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解个体词的选择如何影响推理长度对于描述推理模型至关重要。鉴于先前研究发现改变推理序列的第一个词可以显著影响推理长度，本研究聚焦于这一初始选择如何在后续生成中起作用。

Method: 研究通过改变现有推理前缀的第一个词并重新生成，观察推理长度的变化，同时使用不同初始词条件下的下一个词分布进行对比分析。

Result: 研究发现，尽管其他词保持不变，只改变第一个词可以使推理长度显著变化。进一步的分析揭示，这种影响集中在几个敏感位置的生成上，通过这些位置阻止对第一个词的注意可以减小不同初始词条件间的长度差异。使用不同初始词条件下这些位置的下一个词分布也会显著改变后续推理长度。

Conclusion: 结果表明，对几个敏感位置的初始词的关注有助于维持其对推理长度的影响，展示了局部词选择如何持续影响序列级结果。

Abstract: Understanding how individual token choices affect reasoning length is important for characterizing reasoning models. Building on prior findings that changing the first reasoning token (hereafter, the first token) can substantially alter reasoning length, we focus on this initial choice to investigate how its influence operates during subsequent generation. One possibility is that the first token changes the early text that follows, which in turn affects reasoning length. However, replacing only the first token of an existing reasoning prefix and resuming generation substantially changes the remaining reasoning length, even though all other prefix tokens are unchanged. To trace this persistent influence, we compare next-token distributions while varying only the first token and find that sensitivity is concentrated at a small set of generation positions. Blocking attention from these positions to the first token reduces the length gap between first-token conditions. Using next-token distributions from a different first-token condition at these positions also substantially changes subsequent reasoning length. Together, these findings suggest that attention to the first token at a few sensitive positions helps sustain its length effect, illustrating how a local token choice persistently influences a sequence-level outcome.

</details>


### [318] [Efficient Proof Generation for Lean Statements with Multiple Candidate Answers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34490)
*Pengzhen Lin,Ke Zhang,Maziar Raissi,Zhouxing Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种联合推理框架，将候选答案选择、答案补充和形式证明生成整合为统一过程。该框架在单次调用中为至少一个答案生成证明，并降低了证明成本。在多个数学问题数据集上，此框架展示了与单独为每个候选答案生成证明相当的成功率，但成本仅为六分之一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在自动数学推理中，从形式系统如Lean 4中高效找到数学问题的答案并生成可验证的证明是重要的任务。传统的逐个验证每个候选答案的方式导致了冗余的计算成本。

Method: 该联合推理框架的核心是一个训练有素的证明器，它可以选择给定的或提出新答案，并在单次调用中为至少一个答案生成证明。这种方法还能够复用生成的证明来检查忠实性错误。

Result: 在MATH-500、AMC 2023 和 AIME 2024-2026 数据集上，该框架与逐个候选答案生成证明的成功率相同，但仅使用约六分之一的标记成本。此外，它还能够识别至少6.1%的非忠实形式陈述，且无需额外的人工评审。

Conclusion: 这是一种有效的联合推理框架，有望在自动数学推理领域减少计算成本并提高证明生成的效率与准确性。

Abstract: In formal systems such as Lean 4, efficiently finding answers to mathematical problems and generating verifiable proofs is an important task in automated mathematical reasoning. In the traditional way where an upstream solver provides multiple candidate answers, the common workflow requires searching for proofs for each candidate separately, incurring redundant computational cost. To this end, we propose a joint proof framework that integrates candidate answer selection, answer supplementation, and formal proof generation into a unified reasoning process. At its core is a trained prover that selects given or proposes new answers and generates a proof for at least one answer in a single call. Joint proof can also reuse generated proofs to check for faithfulness errors. For problems with a unique answer, if two distinct answers both obtain verifiable proofs under the same formal statement, this confirms the statement does not faithfully preserve the original problem semantics. On MATH-500, AMC 2023, and AIME 2024/2025/2026, our framework achieves the same formal proof success rate as per-candidate proof generation with about one sixth of the token cost, and identifies at least 6.1% of the formalized statements as unfaithful without requiring additional judges. Our model and code are available at https://github.com/Linppz/Gobble-Prover.

</details>


### [319] [Does the Voynich Manuscript Mean Anything? Calibrated Tests Find Little Trace of Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34499)
*Xin Zhang,Victor S. Sheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究分析了《伏伊琴手稿》中的文字来源，试图通过编码和重复词汇对来探究其隐藏信息的可能性。研究发现，字统计信息不足以明确区分两种假设，而特定词汇对频繁出现在同一行的现象，以及多次解密尝试未能找到可读信息，这些证据指向了一种含词义的密码或字典编纂者的可能性，尽管仍存在加密系统复杂的解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨《伏伊琴手稿》中文字的真实意义和起源，以及它是否包含密码或加密信息的问题。

Method: 通过编写程序模拟两种理论：抄写过程和单一密钥及多密钥的编码，使用统计数据分析预测结果，以及对照16种语言中的28个文本来验证规律。

Result: 单一密钥的编码预测统计结果不如抄写过程好，但多密钥及编码特定类别的词的编码可达到类似效果。特定词汇的对在《伏伊琴手稿》中出现的频率与多种语言实验中的规律性相同。解密尝试未能揭示手稿中的任何形式可读文本，且缩写的拉丁文本解密可以更清晰地显示词汇间的关联，但高错误率仍可能掩盖信息。

Conclusion: 尽管进行了多次分析和尝试解密，手稿仍保留了一种尚未完全解释的语言机制或可能是含词义的密码或字典编纂者的可能性。

Abstract: The Voynich manuscript is a fifteenth-century book in a script that no one can read. One account holds that its text means nothing and that a scribe made it by copying his own words and changing them a little. The other holds that a real language lies hidden behind a cipher. We write each account as a program that fills the pages of the manuscript, fit every program with the same budget, and check it on statistics the fit never saw. The copying process of Timm and Schinner predicts these statistics far better than any cipher with one key. But ciphers that switch keys between the manuscript's two dialects, or that encode only the word classes of a real text, predict them equally well. Word statistics alone cannot decide. We look for a trace of language that needs no decipherment. In 28 texts in 16 languages the same word pairs keep sharing a line. The manuscript shows this pattern at half the strength of the weakest of these texts. A word code keeps the pattern above the manuscript unless its plaintext has a weak pattern or many words are miscopied. Solvers that decipher control texts find no readable text in the manuscript under a letter cipher, a word code or 28 codes with one letter, letter pair or syllable per word. Word codes of abbreviated Latin, the plaintext their fits prefer, show which word follows which more clearly than the manuscript unless two words in five are miscopied. One cipher remains possible, a nomenclator with a second key whose scribe miscopies more than half of the words, and our solvers cannot exclude it in 9 of 16 languages. Most of the structure a solver finds comes from how the end of one word shapes the start of the next, which reflects how tightly glyphs are bound to each other. Planted messages are found reliably only when they are long, each letter always becomes the same word and these words are adjacent, so other messages could hide.

</details>


### [320] [The Price of Scale in Proactive Memory Recall](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34507)
*Yichuan Chen,Xin Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨了一种长时记忆助理在不断选择是否打断用户的决策过程，这是一个多变量假设检验问题，随存储内容的增多难度增加。分析表明，闸门的误报率与其对每个项目的误报率成正比，导致其召回率位于单次比较ROC曲线的最左侧，并随着存储项数的增加呈幂律衰减。这解释了为什么词汇和语义通道需要随存储项数增加的阈值，并且表明基于线索的标准化可以显著提高召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文的主要动机是开发一种长寿命的记忆储存系统，能够在不被明确要求的情况下唤醒用户记忆。研究目标是解决如何在大规模记忆存储中，高效地管理中断问题，防止不必要的中断同时保持有效唤醒。

Method: 通过实证和理论分析的方式证明了决策机制的有效性。在长时记忆评估（LongMemEval）和LoCoMo等数据集上，通过调整误报率确保召回率，构建了基于线索的阈值门控机制，并通过实验证明了基于线索的标准正常化可以显著提高召回率。此外，还提出了一个无标签的自适应误报控制机制。

Result: 研究发现，误报率与闸门的误报率成正比，导致召回率位于单次比较ROC曲线的最左侧，并随着存储项数呈幂律衰减。通过这种方法，可以保持90%以上的召回率同时将误报率控制在5%。实验结果显示，词汇和语义通道需要随存储项数增加的阈值，并且表明基于线索的标准可以显著提高召回率。此外，无标签自适应误报控制机制在实际应用中表现优异，能够保持较低的误报率。

Conclusion: 本文的研究结论是，对于大规模长时记忆存储，采用上述基于误报率的门控机制和自适应误报控制机制能够有效管理中断问题。这种方法不仅对不同嵌入模型和记忆类型有效，还能够在保持较高的召回率的同时将误报率控制在较低水平，适用于各种应用场景。

Abstract: A long-lived assistant that brings up memories without being asked must decide at every turn whether anything in its store is worth an interruption. We show that this decision is a multiple-testing problem whose difficulty grows with the store size $N$. On streaming replays of LongMemEval and LoCoMo, a similarity threshold tuned to 5% false alarms at $N=8$ reaches 87-100% at $N=2048$, across embedding models and for explicit and implicit cues; LLM judges show the same growth from a lower base. We prove that a gate with false-alarm rate $α$ operates at a per-item false-positive rate of about $-\ln(1-α)/N$, which pins its hit rate to the far left of the single-comparison ROC curve and, under regular variation, makes it decay as a power of $N$ with an explicit constant. The resulting prediction matches the hit rate of a per-$N$ oracle threshold to within one percentage point. The analysis explains why lexical and semantic channels need thresholds growing like $\ln N$ and $\sqrt{\ln N}$, and why per-cue normalisation roughly doubles the hit rate at matched false alarms. A cue-swap conformal gate, which compares the current cue with the user's other cues on the same store, needs no labels and has a finite-sample false-alarm guarantee under exchangeability; on LongMemEval it holds false alarms near 5% at the hit rate of a label-tuned threshold. Three annotators (Fleiss' $κ=0.63$) find that about nine in ten false alarms are genuine interruptions. Code and data: https://github.com/RiverChenStillCompiling/price-of-scale

</details>


### [321] [STEP: Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction Correctness via Per-Step Probability Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34537)
*Chenyang Yu,Zifan Zeng,Qunli Zhang,Feng Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: STEP 提出了一种无需训练的框架，通过轻量级前向传递每个推理步骤，生成软概率分布，并提取时序特征来评估预测的正确性，展示出在 AUROC 等指标上的显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的预测正确性评估方法（如熵和困惑度）仅基于最终输出统计信息，忽略了蕴含在推理步骤中的丰富信息。因此，提出了 STEP 框架来提高高风险应用中大型语言模型部署的可靠性。

Method: STEP 不需要训练即可通过轻量级前向传递每个推理步骤生成软概率分布，从而获取每步置信度及其向最终答案进展的软轨迹特征。

Result: 在多个基准测试上，STEP 在 AUROC 等指标上不仅超过了基于输出的方法，还优于基于硬指标的轨迹方法，特别是在分配更多重要性给答案稳定性较高的后期推理步骤时，取得了最大的提升。

Conclusion: 研究表明，持续的概率信号比二元离散化更具有优势。这进一步验证了保留连续概率信号的重要性。

Abstract: Estimating the correctness of large language model (LLM) predictions without access to ground truth is critical for reliable deployment in high-stakes settings. Existing approaches, such as entropy and perplexity, operate solely on final output statistics, discarding the rich information encoded in intermediate reasoning steps. To address this limitation, we propose STEP (Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction correctness), a training-free framework that scores each reasoning step via lightweight forward passes to obtain a soft probability distribution qi over candidate answers, from which we derive a set of soft trajectory features capturing per-step confidence and its progression toward the final answer. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements, particularly in AUROC, over output-based baselines and hard-indicator trajectory methods. Notably, Temporally-Weighted Consistency, which assigns higher importance to later reasoning steps where answer distributions have stabilized, contributes the largest gains, highlighting the importance of temporal structure in reasoning trajectories. These results further validate the advantage of preserving continuous probability signals over binary discretization.

</details>


### [322] [RefinedGAW: A Refined German Academic Web Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34572)
*Maximilian Idahl,Oleh Astappiev,Benedikt Droste,Robert Scholz,Björn Plüster,Jan Philipp Harries,Robert Jäschke,Wolfgang Nejdl*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RefinedGAW是一个从德国学术网络中提取并标注的大型资源，包含12200万文档和3140亿个词元，学术研究内容占84%，超过了同类其他资源，适用于细粒度数据选择和访问


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的德语开放文本数据集大多是通过广泛网络爬取建立的，能够提供规模但覆盖面有限，尤其是针对特定领域。因此，研究人员需要一个更大规模且更专门针对学术领域的资源来弥补现有资源的不足。

Method: 通过26次半年度德国学术网络爬取，构建了一个包含12200万文档和3140亿词元的数据集。数据处理过程中，特别标注了学术研究内容。

Result: RefinedGAW包含大量学术研究、教育、数学和专家导向的内容，且几乎无近似重复文档，优于现有其他同类资源。研究人员可以通过查询元数据索引和重新填充工具选择并访问这些文档。

Conclusion: 该研究通过开发RefinedGAW，显著提高了德语学术领域资源的规模和质量，为学术研究提供了新的数据支持。

Abstract: The largest open German text datasets are built from broad web crawls, which provide scale but limited coverage of specific domains. We introduce RefinedGAW, a processed and annotated resource derived from 26 semi-annual crawls of the German Academic Web, totaling 122 million documents and 314 billion tokens, with full crawl and capture history of every text. Documents labeled as academic research account for 84% of German RefinedGAW tokens across HTML and PDF. At 87.6 billion tokens, this exceeds the 64.9 billion tokens in the German subsets of FineWeb2 and FinePDFs, despite their almost five-times-larger combined size. RefinedGAW also contains substantial amounts of educational, math-heavy, and expert-oriented content with minimal commercial bias. Across HTML and PDF, 88% of German RefinedGAW documents have no near-duplicate candidate match in the three evaluated reference datasets, supporting complementary coverage. We release a queryable metadata index for fine-grained data selection and a rehydration tool for retrieving and processing source documents.

</details>


### [323] [Large Language Models: A Plain-Language Overview for Engineers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34585)
*Bahaeddin Türkoğlu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 文章全面介绍了大规模语言模型（LLMs）的训练过程，从Transformer预训练到各种调优技术，例如RLHF、RAG、闪存注意和量化低秩适应。还提供了一个生命周期图和方法对比表，并提出了评估LLMs的指标，包括数据污染、模型评分、长输入和虚假信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者旨在帮助工程师和研究人员深入理解生成式人工智能工具的训练机制和改进方法，以便更有效地评估和使用这些技术。

Method: 文章按照从基本概念到高级技术的顺序，逐步解释了LLMs的训练过程。首先介绍了预训练阶段的Transformer模型，然后讲解了细调和评估过程中的各种技术，包括强化学习、检索增强生成、闪存注意和量化低秩适应。

Result: 研究人员获得了关于LLMs训练和调优方法的详细信息，并通过图表和表格对比了不同技术的优劣。

Conclusion: 文章提出了判断LLM评估声明的标准，涵盖了数据污染、模型评分、长输入和虚假信息等问题，并强调了单独检查事实准确性而非表面帮助性的重要性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are neural networks trained on huge text collections to generate text by predicting what comes next. Engineers using ChatGPT and other generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools need a clear picture of what training changes and prompts add. The article starts with the Transformer, which connects words in context, and pre-training, where models learn to predict text. It then explains how fine-tuning adapts models to requests, with reinforcement learning from human feedback using human answer rankings. Next, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supplies documents, while chain-of-thought prompting encourages intermediate steps and agents use tools. FlashAttention lowers training and running costs by reducing data movement during attention; quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) saves fine-tuning memory. Readers get a life cycle figure and tables comparing methods and their limits. A short checklist for judging LLM evaluation claims flags test material in training (data contamination) and model-based grading (LLM-as-a-judge). It also covers very long inputs (long context) and hallucination, meaning false or unsupported claims. Check factual accuracy separately from whether an answer sounds helpful.

</details>


### [324] [HARP-LoRA: Hierarchy-Conditioned Rank Projection for Low-Rank Adaptation in Scientific Table Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34589)
*Hossein Sholehrasa,Mohammadhossein Amini,Doina Caragea,Remya Ampadi Ramachandran,Dan Wu,Zihang Shi,Zelin Li,Lindsey Hulbert,Eder Martinez,Xuan Xu,Majid Jaberi-Douraki*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HARP-LoRA 提出了一种基于表头层次结构的轻量级适配器方法，用于在维持参数效率的同时从科学表格中提取信息并处理更平坦的一般域表格，优于 LoRA 和 TableLoRA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学应用中使用的表格数据复杂且包含多级表头、合并单元格、标题、脚注等，这使得信息提取变得困难。特别是在药代动力学领域，正确关联药物、物种、剂量、给药途径、单位和实验条件至关重要。

Method: HARP-LoRA 扩展了投影 LoRA 方法，通过从每个数据单元的行-列表头层次结构中构造特定于令牌的固有表示，使低秩投影适应具有层次上下文，同时冻结预训练模型和随机投影张量。

Result: 使用 Llama~3.1 8B 模型，HARP-LoRA 在 PK F1 分数上取得了 57.64% 的成绩，提高了 1.42 点；在 WikiTQ 上达到了 53.15% 的准确率，提高了 6.56 点。使用 Gemma~3 27B 模型，它在 PK F1 分数上达成了最优的 70.63%，准确率为 56.87%。

Conclusion: HARP-LoRA 的改进不仅证明了其在科学表格理解中的优越性，还展示了在更平坦的一般领域表格上的能力，所有这些仅使用了 172,000 到 547,000 个可训练参数。

Abstract: Tabular data is widely used in scientific applications, where complex layouts, including multi-level headers, merged cells, captions, and footnotes, make information extraction difficult. This is particularly important in pharmacokinetics (PK), where values must be correctly associated with the drug, species, dose, administration route, unit, and experimental condition. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) reduce adaptation cost but do not explicitly incorporate relationships between table values and surrounding headers. We introduce HARP-LoRA, a hierarchy-conditioned rank projection method for low-rank adaptation in scientific table understanding. HARP-LoRA extends projected LoRA by constructing token-specific intrinsic representations from the row- and column-header hierarchies of each data token. These representations condition the low-rank down-projection, incorporating hierarchical context while keeping the pretrained model and random projection tensors frozen. We evaluate HARP-LoRA on 950 manually annotated PK tables from 587 scientific articles and on WikiTableQuestions (WikiTQ) using Llama~3.2 3B, Llama~3.1 8B, and Gemma~3 27B. With Llama~3.1 8B, HARP-LoRA achieves a PK F1-score of 57.64\% and WikiTQ accuracy of 53.15\%, improving over LoRA by 1.42 and 6.56 points, respectively. With Gemma~3 27B, it achieves the best PK F1-score of 70.63\% and WikiTQ accuracy of 56.87\%. These results use only 172K, 197K, and 547K trainable parameters, far fewer than LoRA and TableLoRA. Overall, conditioning lightweight adapters on table-header hierarchies improves extraction from scientific tables and reasoning over flatter general-domain tables while maintaining parameter efficiency. Code is available at: https://github.com/hosseinsholehrasa/HARP-LoRA

</details>


### [325] [Does the Outfit Change the Price? Context Halo in Vision-Language Model Valuation of an Identical Low-Cost Necklace](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34591)
*Brianne Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究团队通过六种前沿的语言模型对同一手链在不同拍摄场景下的价格估计进行了研究，发现正式场合的照片会导致估价较高，而简单放置的照片估价较低。实验发现环境和服装描述对估价影响显著，但模型在忽略这些因素时估价仍然较高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨不同描述环境对价格感知的影响，并探索通过机器学习模型进行价格估价的方法。

Method: 使用六种前沿语言模型对同一手链在四种不同场景中的价格进行估计，分别拍摄正式场合、派对、回收场与无佩戴者的情况下，通过API调用记录价格估计结果。

Result: 在正式场合的照片中，价格估计通常会提高1.9到3.3倍；而在回收场的照片中，价格估计提高了1.23到3.57倍。文本描述环境的任务没有显著影响。忽略场景描述在一定程度上减少了价格估计的差异。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了对物品价格的感知受环境和描述影响显著，为后续在更复杂情况下进行价格估价的模型设计提供了依据。

Abstract: A chunky gold-tone chain necklace bought online for 2.43 USD was photographed four ways: worn with formal attire against a wood-panelled wall, worn at a party, worn with casual clothing in a recycling yard, and laid flat with no person present. We asked six frontier language models to estimate its price in 1,164 independent and sequential API sessions (4,604 logged rows) and compared estimates across settings. Among the four models that answered image prompts, the same necklace was priced 1.9 to 3.3 times higher in the formal photograph than in the flat-lay (all p < 0.01). Against the yard photograph, the ratio ranged from 1.23 (Grok 4.5, not significant) to 3.57 (Kimi K3), with Claude Fable 5 at 3.32. A text-only version of the task, in which the setting is described in words, produced formal-to-yard ratios of 2.2 to 3.9 in all six models, so the effect does not require pixels. Flat-lay estimates themselves were 7.8 to 18.7 times the receipt price, so part of any headline "outfit multiplier" computed against the receipt is baseline overestimate, not a context effect. A single instruction to ignore clothing and setting significantly reduced the effect in one model (ratio of ratios 0.77, 95% CI 0.65 to 0.91) and not detectably in the others; telling the model the photo came from a company website or a personal account changed nothing significant. Asked afterward whether a different outfit would have changed their number, Claude Fable 5 said yes in 24 of 24 sessions, GPT-5.6 in 69%, and GPT-4o in 18%, while GPT-4o also refused 79% of image estimation prompts. The study isolates a mechanism with one object and one wearer at about 10 sessions per model and condition; we outline the replication needed next, with multiple objects and a human benchmark. Data, code, and raw outputs are released.

</details>


### [326] [Entity Matching using Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34626)
*Aaron Steiner,Ralph Peeters,Christian Bizer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究评估了决策模型在实体匹配任务中的表现，发现不需特定任务训练数据的最强决策模型的表现接近于生成式大模型GPT-6 Luna，并在六个基准测试中优于PLM匹配器Ditto。决策模型比生成式大模型更快且成本较低。模型级联进一步提高了最强决策模型的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的实体匹配方法依赖于需要特定任务微调的预训练语言模型或无需微调的生成式大语言模型，但后者匹配大规模记录集速度慢且成本高。本文旨在探索基于决策模型的方法，作为一种替代生成式大模型和微调预训练语言模型的实体匹配方法。

Method: 研究者在零样本设置下评估了六个决策模型在八个基准测试中的表现，将其与生成式大模型GPT-6 Luna和基于预训练语言模型的匹配器Ditto进行了比较。

Result: 实验结果显示，不需特定任务训练数据的四个最强决策模型的平均F1分数接近于GPT-6 Luna，并在六个基准测试中优于Ditto。这些决策模型比生成式大模型更快且成本较低。对于最强的四个决策模型中的三个，预测的匹配概率无需特殊调整就已校准良好。模型级联将最不自信的记录对路由到生成式大模型的集成，提高了最强决策模型的平均F1分数1.9-4.0个百分点。使用每个基准测试中的最强决策模型和最有效提示，级联超越了文献中四个基准测试中的最高F1分数。

Conclusion: 决策模型可以作为一种有效的替代方法用于实体匹配，无需特定任务训练数据，且比生成式大模型更快成本更低。模型级联进一步提高了决策模型的表现，为实体匹配任务提供了一种有前途的方法。

Abstract: Entity matching is the task of deciding whether two records describe the same real-world entity. Current entity matching methods rely on pre-trained language models (PLMs) which require task specific fine-tuning or generative large language models (LLMs) which do not require task-specific fine-tuning but are slow and expensive at matching large record sets. Decision models are a new class of LLM-based models that return a probability for each predefined answer option rather than generate text. This paper investigates decision models as an alternative to generative LLMs and fine-tuned PLMs for entity matching. We evaluate six decision models in a zero-shot setting across eight benchmarks and compare their performance with that of the generative LLM GPT-6 Luna and the PLM-based matcher Ditto. Our experiments show that, without task-specific training data, the four strongest decision models achieve mean F1 scores close to that of GPT-6 Luna, with the best model slightly surpassing it. This model also outperforms Ditto on six of the eight benchmarks. All decision models are faster than GPT-6 Luna, and most are less expensive. For three of the four strongest decision models, the predicted match probabilities are well calibrated without requiring any task-specific recalibration. A model cascade that routes the least confident record pairs to an ensemble of generative LLMs improves the mean F1 scores of the four strongest decision models by 1.9-4.0 percentage points. Using the best decision model and its best-performing prompt for each benchmark, the cascade surpasses the highest published F1 scores from literature on four of the eight benchmarks.

</details>


### [327] [Heard Enough to Act: Early Tool Calling in Spoken Dialogue Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34653)
*Yizhou Peng,Chen Chen,Donghang Wu,Hexin Liu,Eng Siong Chng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文介绍了一个合成的对话流水线，用于监督最早可操作点，构建了包含786小时对话的大型数据集，用于训练一个多模态语言模型，从而实现边听边做的语音代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的语音代理和对话语料库无法定义请求何时变成可操作的最早时间点，这导致了在语音代理执行请求时必要的等待时间，从而影响了性能。本文提出了一个新的解决方案来解决这一问题。

Method: 通过有控制的任务生成、语音合成和对齐、以及标记，构建了包含48个领域的26,694个对话，并训练了一个多模态语言模型。

Result: 所训练的模型在验证集和外部基准上的工具状态宏-F1得分为0.48和0.47，对于正确的呼叫，在领域的延迟比一个回合结束的级联延迟大约1.8-2.0秒，在τ^2-基准上则为1.1秒。

Conclusion: 本文的研究成果展示了基于数据驱动的方法来实现实边听边做的语音代理的可行性，并将开源该流水线和训练脚本。

Abstract: Latency-sensitive spoken agents must know not only which tool to call, but also when they have heard enough to act. Waiting for the turn to complete delays execution even when the request is already actionable. However, neither existing spoken agents nor spoken dialogue corpora define the earliest point at which a request becomes actionable. We introduce a synthetic spoken-dialogue pipeline that provides earliest-actionable-point supervision, marking when the observed speech grounds a tool and its required arguments. Through controlled task generation, speech synthesis and alignment, and gated annotation, we construct 26,694 dialogues totaling 786 hours across 48 domains, with disjoint training and test argument values. We additionally create an audio rendering of $τ^2$-bench for external evaluation. We train an omni-modal language model on this corpus, enabling causal, chunk-level decisions and partial-transcript generation for downstream call completion. The model achieves tool-state macro-F1 scores of 0.48 and 0.47 on held-out dialogues and the external benchmark, respectively. For correct calls, the estimated mean lead over a turn-end cascade, using the same formatter, is 1.8-2.0 seconds in-domain and 1.1 seconds on $τ^2$-bench. These results demonstrate a data-driven path toward spoken agents that act while listening. We will open-source the pipeline and the training scripts.

</details>


### [328] [iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34735)
*Yuting Ning,Ruijia Cheng,Sushobhan Ghosh,Peitong Duan,HungShi Lin,Abhishek Sundararajan,Shreyash Pandey,Huan Sun,Jeffrey Nichols,Eldon Schoop*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: iPrefBench 是一个基准测试，用于评估个人移动代理在 iOS 环境中的推理和询问能力，通过130个欠定用户任务在26个应用中进行评估，旨在帮助构建更了解用户并有效与用户交互的代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有个人代理在处理用户未完全指定的任务时存在缺陷，它们可能基于不支持的假设或导致不必要的用户干预。iPrefBench 的目的是提供一个工具来评估和改进代理的推理和询问能力以更好地服务用户。

Method: iPrefBench 针对个人移动代理构建了一个在 iOS 环境中的执行基准测试平台。该基准测试使用了一个由3051个过去事件构成的共同人物，涵盖了跨26个应用的130个欠定用户任务。

Result: 对7种前沿代理的评估显示，它们在执行动作方面的得分较高（最高可达91.6%），但在全面任务成功方面较弱（最高仅为47.7%），主要问题在于它们在询问用户必要信息方面存在困难。

Conclusion: iPrefBench 露出的挑战在于代理需要更好地知道何时以及如何推理和询问。研究人员希望这一基准测试能成为构建更了解用户并能有效与其交互的代理的有价值的测试平台。

Abstract: An agent that truly knows and acts on behalf of its user has been a long-standing promise of AI assistants. Computer-use agents bring this promise within reach by capably executing fully specified tasks across apps. However, real-world user requests are often underspecified. To act correctly for the particular user, an agent must infer some missing information from the user's activity history and ask for other information that only the user can provide, without making unsupported assumptions or burdening the user with unnecessary questions. We present iPrefBench, a benchmark for evaluating the infer and ask capabilities of personal mobile-use agents in an executable iOS environment with an interactive simulated user. Grounded in a coherent persona with 3,051 past activity events, iPrefBench comprises 130 underspecified user tasks across 26 apps. Each omitted user-dependent requirement is, by construction, either history-inferable or ask-only. iPrefBench evaluates personalized mobile agents on both whether agents complete tasks correctly for the user (i.e., personalized task completion) and whether they seek user input when necessary (i.e., user-agent interaction). Evaluation of 7 frontier agents reveals a substantial gap between execution and personalization. Agents achieve high action completion scores (up to 91.6%) but low full task success (up to 47.7%) because personalization lags behind. They especially struggle with ask-only information, failing to request enough necessary information. Our findings highlight a challenge for personalized agents in knowing what to infer and when to ask. We hope that iPrefBench can serve as a valuable testbed for building agents that know their user and work with them.

</details>


### [329] [LADDER: Diagnosing Domain-Level Self-Assessment Under Noisy Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34737)
*Zhenshuai Yin,Jianshu Liang,Xuyue Xiong,Yongxin Guo,Mingda Zhang,Zhongze Luo,Haoyue Liu,Lianmin Zhang,Xiaoying Tang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究旨在探索语言模型在不可靠反馈下的自我评估能力，发现模型能够准确报告性能信息，但仍难以形成可靠自我评估。准确的自我评估可能掩盖能力差异，并不能预测未来任务表现。研究建议自我评估应与实际任务表现及其预测价值进行比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在人机协作中，了解模型的可靠性至关重要。研究旨在探讨在不可靠反馈条件下，语言模型如何评估自己的能力，以支持更可靠的人工智能辅助的人类决策过程。

Method: 研究通过引入LADDER方法，观察模型在面对不可靠反馈时的自我评估情况。

Result: 研究结果表明，模型能够准确报告其性能信息，却难以从互动经历中形成可信的自我评估。准确的自我评估可能隐藏能力差异，不一定能预测未来任务表现。

Conclusion: 研究为评估语言模型的能力意识设定了新的标准，强调自我评估应该与实际任务表现和预测能力进行对比。

Abstract: Knowing when they are reliable is essential for language models to support human-AI collaboration. Yet interaction feedback is not always complete or correct, and may mislead models' understanding of their own capabilities. We introduce LADDER to study how language models assess themselves under unreliable feedback. Our findings show that models can accurately report supplied performance information while still struggling to form trustworthy self-assessments from interaction experience. Apparently accurate assessments can obscure capability differences and do not necessarily predict future task performance. These findings suggest that trustworthy self-assessment should be evaluated against observed task performance and its predictive value. Our study provides empirical evidence of the limits of model self-knowledge and a basis for evaluating capability awareness in reliable human-AI collaboration.

</details>


### [330] [DecisionTraceBench: Tracking Decision-Critical Information in Multi-Party Spoken Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34746)
*Wenchao Du,Fangxin Shang,Long Wu,Runze Cui,Qing Yang,Yehui Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了DecisionTraceBench，这是首个专门针对决策关键信息状态跟踪的语音状态跟踪基准。它评估多说话人口头决策事件序列、归属、范围和时间证据。实验结果显示，当前模型在完全事件链恢复方面仍存在不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前的语音基准主要关注转录、局部理解及轮流状态预测，对于说话人决策的集体演变评估不足。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过引入DecisionTraceBench解决决策关键信息的状态跟踪问题。

Method: 该基准使用轨迹级别的F1分数来衡量完整的事件链恢复情况，并基于中国金融市场中的对话数据集进行评估。

Result: 在固定的人工录制数据集上，五个级联系统和两个直接音频模型的决策过程得分范围为5.73%-21.35%，而使用演讲者标签的参考脚本和去除时间定位要求的最大得分为38.72%。音频扰动实验进一步表明，总体转录错误率并不能反映完整的轨迹恢复程度。

Conclusion: 这些发现揭示了在大规模语音应用场景中同时理解信息来源及状态演变的局限性，并为评估决策过程理解和决策追溯提供了基准。

Abstract: In high-stakes domains such as finance, critical information evolves through multi-party interaction. Recovering these changes and their sources is fundamental to reliable speech understanding. Existing speech benchmarks focus on transcription, local understanding, and turn-level state prediction, leaving joint decision evolution across speakers insufficiently evaluated. We introduce DecisionTraceBench, a speech state-tracking benchmark for Decision-Critical Information State Tracking (DCIST). It jointly evaluates decision event sequences, speaker attribution, scope, and temporal evidence, using trajectory-level F1 to measure complete event-chain recovery. Our dataset comprises Chinese financial dialogues involving two to four speakers, with 100.39 hours of synthetic audio and 8.61 hours of human-performed recordings. On a fixed cohort of human-performed recordings, five cascaded systems and two direct-audio models achieve DCIST scores of 5.73% to 21.35%. Ablations with speaker-labeled reference scripts and no temporal localization requirements yield a maximum score of only 38.72%. Audio perturbation experiments further show that overall transcription error rates do not adequately reflect complete trajectory recovery. These findings reveal limitations in jointly understanding information provenance and state evolution, providing a benchmark for evaluating decision-process understanding and decision traceability in high-stakes speech applications.

</details>


### [331] [From Belief Inference to Task Action: A Multi-Level Evaluation of Theory of Mind on Verifiable Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34759)
*Zhenshuai Yin,Yongxin Guo,Mingda Zhang,Zhongze Luo,Haoyue Liu,Lianmin Zhang,Xiaoying Tang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过扩展现有任务，提出了一种多层次评估方法，旨在让语言模型更好地理解他人知识和信念，并应用于实际协作任务。结果显示，模型在视角推理方面表现不一，部分模型能够在特定条件下恢复和使用信念，但在执行任务时表现参差不齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前许多理论推理（ToM）基准测试通过故事问题评估心理状态推理，但未确保模型能够将这些判断应用到后续任务中。该研究旨在填补这一空白，提供一个多层次评估框架，更好地测试语言模型的社会认知能力。

Method: 研究扩展了家庭协作和日历调度任务，引入了不对称信息和独立界面，评估模型的世界理解、信息访问、信念、决策和执行能力。同时也引入了控制实验来区分状态恢复和状态使用。

Result: 实验结果显示，不同模型在处理相同的调度案例时，正确复述所有代理信念的比例不同，但选择最优行动计划的成功率较低。在家庭协作任务中，提供初始信念可以提高模型完成任务的成功率，但未提供初始信念的模型难以完成任务的延续条件。

Conclusion: 研究证明，ToM评价必须将视角推理与独立验证的决策和任务结果联系起来，以确保模型真正应用了这些推理能力。

Abstract: Effective collaboration requires language models to understand what others know and believe, and to act accordingly. Models that assume others share their information may omit necessary communication and undermine coordination. Many theory-of-mind (ToM) benchmarks assess mental-state inference through story questions, but correct answers do not establish that models can use these judgments in subsequent tasks. We introduce a multi-level evaluation built on existing, verifiable tasks. We extend household collaboration and calendar scheduling with asymmetric information while retaining their original constraints and validators. Independent interfaces assess world understanding, information access, beliefs, decisions, and execution. Controls supply personal evidence or correct beliefs to distinguish state recovery from state use. Across six model configurations, these abilities diverge. On matched scheduling cases, Claude recovers all agent beliefs correctly but produces subjectively optimal plans in only 67.9% of cases. In household collaboration, supplying beliefs raises Qwen-27B success from 55.0% to 75.0%, yet Qwen-4B answers every fixed supplied-belief source question correctly while completing only 20.0% of the corresponding continuation condition. These results show why ToM evaluation must connect perspective inference to independently verified decisions and task consequences.

</details>


### [332] [DynEdit: Dynamic Entropy-Guided Sequential Editing for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34768)
*Jinhu Fu,Yan Bai,Yihang Lou,Li Sun,Jiahong Wu,Xiangxiang Chu,Sen Su*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DynEdit 提出了一种动态框架，通过使用token层级的熵来指导非均匀滑动，并在每个编辑窗口中对信息密集的token进行熵导向的优化，从而有效地更新大语言模型中的长序列知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的参数编辑方法在处理长序列知识时效果有限。单点编辑器覆盖不足，而固定区间编辑器则无法优先编辑具有高编辑难度和语义重要性的高熵区域。

Method: DynEdit 使用 token 水平的熵来指导非均匀滑动，增加对困难高熵区域的覆盖范围，并进一步应用熵导向的 token 水平优化，加强更新每个编辑窗口内的信息密集 token。

Result: 在三个基准测试和两个骨干模型上的实验表明，DynEdit 在各种长形式编辑设置中表现出色，相较于竞争性基线模型取得了高达 +14.0 BLEU 点的增益，并在多种知识领域上达到了接近饱和的语义分数。

Conclusion: DynEdit 是一种高效编辑大型语言模型长序列知识的动态框架，具有广泛的适用性和显著的效果提升。

Abstract: Knowledge editing aims to update outdated or incorrect knowledge in large language models without full retraining. Existing parameter-editing methods remain limited for long-sequence knowledge: single-point editors provide insufficient coverage for extended targets, while fixed chunk-based editors distribute editing effort uniformly across rigid predefined windows, failing to prioritize difficult, information-dense tokens. In this work, we show that token entropy is closely associated with both editing difficulty and semantic importance: high-entropy regions are harder to edit and often contain key factual content. Motivated by this observation, we propose DynEdit, a dynamic framework for long-sequence knowledge editing. DynEdit uses token-level entropy to guide non-uniform sliding, increasing the coverage of difficult high-entropy regions, and further applies entropy-guided token-level optimization to strengthen updates on information-dense tokens within each editing window. Experiments on three benchmarks and two backbone models show that DynEdit consistently outperforms competitive baselines across diverse long-form editing settings, achieving gains of up to +14.0 BLEU points on challenging paraphrase queries and near-saturated semantic scores on several diverse knowledge domains.

</details>


### [333] [BehaviorMem: Building and Evaluating User Memory from Real-World E-Commerce Behavior Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34790)
*Sizhe Wang,Xinghao Fang,Rui Qiu,Zhenjia Ma,Dagui Chen,Kun Kuang,Hongcheng Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了BehaviorMemBench，这是一个基于真实电商平台日志的基准，覆盖超过三年时间的1,194位用户和17,462批次的行为，并开发了一种名为BehaviorMem的记忆设计，以分别评估记忆和推理能力。实验表明，BehaviorMem在记忆和推理能力上优于其他方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆方法主要针对基于语言的交互，缺乏从行为日志中联合支持并独立评估记忆和推理的能力。因此，研究旨在提出一个更全面的评估框架和记忆设计来解决这一问题。

Method: 研究提出了一个名为BehaviorMemBench的基准，该基准包括来自实际电商平台的大量用户行为数据。同时，研究还开发了一种名为BehaviorMem的记忆设计，该设计可以在长短期范围内组织明示行为事实和推断的用户特征，并通过基于证据的形成、持续维护和查询独立的读取来实现。

Result: 实验结果表明，BehaviorMem在记忆和推理能力上优于其他方法。此外，它在公共数据集上的验证也支持了其作为行为历史驱动下游任务的有用性。

Conclusion: 该研究通过开发一个全面的基准和记忆设计，解决了现有方法在联合支持和独立评估记忆与推理能力方面的不足。BehaviorMemBench和BehaviorMem为未来相关研究提供了有价值的资源。

Abstract: User memory helps personalized systems build on their understanding of users over time. In e-commerce, users convey their preferences and needs through both explicit language and implicit interactions with products. We study memory built from logs of these interactions, examining how it can \emph{remember} concrete evidence and established interests, and use that evidence to \emph{infer} underlying needs and preferences that inform judgments beyond well-observed product domains. Existing memory methods primarily target language-based interactions, and evaluations offer limited real behavioral data and limited separation of these capabilities. This leaves open how to jointly support and separately evaluate remembering and inference from behavioral logs. We formulate the problem of continual behavioral user memory around these joint requirements and develop a dedicated evaluation framework and memory method to address them. \textbf{BehaviorMemBench} is a benchmark built from real e-commerce logs covering 1{,}194 users and 17{,}462 behavioral batches over more than three years, with automatic future-behavior labels and a task-independent memory interface to separately evaluate remembering and inference under a common protocol. \textbf{BehaviorMem} is a memory design that organizes explicit behavioral facts and inferred user characteristics across long-term and short-term scopes in a two-axis state, with evidence-grounded formation, continual maintenance, and query-independent readout. Experiments across two builders and two task readers show that BehaviorMem leads the evaluated agentic memories on remember and infer, and reveal different method rankings across the two capabilities and competitive statistical baselines. Validation on a public dataset further supports its usefulness for downstream tasks based on behavioral histories.

</details>


### [334] [Text Is the Bottleneck: A Small-Scale Replication of LLM Game Playing in Riichi Mahjong](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34791)
*Mingge Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 我们以较小的预算复制了大型语言模型在复杂纸牌游戏中的技术，使用至多2亿参数的模型和一个16GB的消费级GPU运行。实验显示，文本是瓶颈，而图像编码器的表现优于文本提示的LLM。参数增加对表现提升有限，且很少赢得明显优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了评估大型语言模型在复杂纸牌游戏中的表现，特别是在资源有限的情况下，我们复制了前人的研究并进行了简化版本的实验。

Method: 我们使用至多2亿参数的模型，运行在一个16GB的消费级GPU上约5天。并通过训练图像编码器，与文本提示的LLM进行对比，评估它们在游戏中的表现。

Result: 结果显示，图像编码器在训练数据和标签匹配的情况下，取得了80.6%的决策一致性，超过了所有训练的文本提示LLM。随着参数数量增加，一致性的提升有限，而与老师对手的训练提高了2.5个百分点，只有1.5个百分点的参数增加，这一差异在实际游戏中变得不明显。我们还揭示了原始研究中的代码与实际实验不符的问题，并改进了模板生成的日语理由。

Conclusion: 我们的研究表明，对于复杂纸牌游戏来说，纯模仿的局限依然存在，而在人类行为数据上的一致性并不一定能够转化为游戏中的胜率优势。

Abstract: We replicate the riichi-mahjong track of "Can Large Language Models Master Complex Card Games?" (arXiv:2509.01328) under a drastically smaller budget: models of at most 2B parameters, one 16 GB consumer GPU, about five GPU-days. (1) With matched data and labels, text is the bottleneck: on the same 100k-decision training set, a 2.6M-parameter convolutional board encoder agrees with the strong AI Mortal on 80.6% of test decisions, above every text-prompt LLM we train (best 77.8%), and places better at the table (2.85 over 1,000 games vs. ~3.0 for the LLMs; paired difference at n=100 not significant). Scaled to 1.71M decisions, a 4.9M-parameter Transformer reaches 94.7% agreement, beats the 0.8B LLMs on identical seeds (-0.45 ranks, sign test p=0.005), and is statistically equivalent to parity against three Mortal champions (TOST within 0.10 ranks, p=6e-4); parity against a teacher-opponent is roughly the ceiling of pure imitation. (2) Training toward the teacher raises teacher agreement more than a 2.5x parameter increase does (+2.5 vs. +1.5 points); on human-record agreement both effects are +1.0, and neither is visible at the table. (3) Few-point agreement differences do not resolve into playing strength within a family: +2.5 agreement points coincide with a paired placement difference of +0.02 +/- 0.12 ranks (p=1.0), and +2.0 points at 2B with -0.06 (p=0.37) - both below the ~0.25-rank resolution of 100 paired games. We also document a paper-code mismatch in the original winner filter, reconstruct its two private engine patches, and show that a divide-and-conquer pipeline makes template-generated Japanese rationales 93% sentence-exact (43% without facts). Per Tenhou's terms we release no trained weights - only code, configurations, and evaluation protocols.

</details>


### [335] [Position Matters More Than Channel: Talking a Language Model Out of a Correct Answer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34809)
*Xinyi Ni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了如何说服模型放弃其独立正确回答的方法，通过改变建议的位置（系统提示、用户消息）、建议者身份（权威或参与者）及建议呈现方式，来影响模型的响应。结果显示，建议的位置对于无理由和有理由的陈述影响相反，而建议者的权威性和坚定呈现会显著增加错误率。预先展示正确的解答可以保护正确回答不受错误建议的破坏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究旨在深入理解大型语言模型如何受到外部干预的影响，特别是在它们给出正确答案时，外部的反驳或建议能否影响其决策过程。

Method: 研究者使用Qwen3.5-27B和四个选项的MMLU-Pro问题，固定其他建议内容，仅改变建议的位置、来源和呈现方式，来对比不同条件下的模型响应错误率。

Result: 研究发现，建议的位置对无理由和有理由的陈述有相反的影响，前者的负面影响发生在模型回答后，而后者则在问题之前增大了模型的错误率。建议的权威性和坚定呈现会显著提升错误率，但不同权威间的差异较小。预先展示正确的解答能够保护正确答案不受错误建议的影响。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了在模型给出正确答案时，外部建议的干预机制，强调了建议的位置、权威性和呈现方式对模型决策的重要影响，同时也提出了一种保护正确答案的方法。

Abstract: Language models now answer questions alongside other claims: a note in the system prompt, a message from another agent, their own earlier answer. We ask what it takes to talk a model out of an answer it gets right on its own, and separate three factors that earlier studies vary together: where the advice sits in the prompt, who is said to have written it, and what the model has already written. On Qwen3.5-27B and four-option MMLU-Pro items, with the rest of the advice held fixed in each comparison, we find three things. First, position matters far more than the API channel, in opposite directions for a bare claim and an argument: a bare "the answer is X" does most harm just before the model answers, while the same claim with a false rationale does most harm before the question, where it raises error on items the model otherwise almost never misses from 1% to 67%; moving the claim between the system message and the user message at the same position changes error by a few points. Second, attributing the note to an authority rather than to another participant, and phrasing it assertively, each raise error by 10-27 points, while the two authorities we tested differ by under two. Third, replaying a correct worked answer before the advice protects it whether the text is shown as the model's own or as someone else's, and the same replay keeps wrong answers from being corrected by a bare correct note. The position result replicates under an independently written prompt. Code, items and all result tables are released at https://github.com/coolkillercat/safety.

</details>


### [336] [Semantic Atoms for Scalable Text Analysis in Data Analytics in the Era of LLM-Based Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34860)
*Jinxiang Xie,Zihao Li,Rui Ding,Bartuer Zhou,Shi Han,Dongmei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为TADA的工作负载，其中文本数据的处理对于后续的数据分析至关重要。研究设计了两种基于查询的语义原子操作：标记和分类，以动态适应用户的需求。研究通过TADA-Agent实现了这些操作，并在包括40个完整的分析请求的TABench基准测试上进行了评估，结果显示TADA-Agent在保持完整的分析结果上表现优秀，同时减少了语义模型的请求次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前数据分析中许多有用信息都埋藏在文本列中，而处理这些文本数据分析是TADA工作负载的核心。

Method: 研究通过设计标记和分类两种基于查询的语义操作，动态适应用户的需求。TADA-Agent在生成的Python程序内部处理输入，并能够处理超出可靠上下文窗口的输入。

Result: TADA-Agent在四个不同维度上超越了现有方法，包括完成的分析制品保留率和每条语义操作的数量。

Conclusion: 该研究通过TADA-Agent实现了对包括40个完整的分析请求的基准测试，表现出了在保持完整分析结果和减少语义模型请求方面优于基准性能。

Abstract: Much of the information needed for data analysis is buried in text columns: an analyst may infer customer frustration from complaint text and use it to explain resolution time. We call workloads in which processing text columns is central to subsequent data analysis TADA (\emph{Text Analysis in Data Analytics}). In an agentic setting, the user's query dynamically specifies this processing, and answering it interleaves LLM-based semantic steps with exact SQL or Python operations. This mixed execution raises two design questions: which work should be neural and which symbolic, and which semantic outputs later steps can reuse. We address them for agent-planned TADA workflows with two complementary, query-driven semantic atoms. Each atom takes a sequence of text items and a natural-language query specifying the semantic task: \textbf{Tagging} returns one string per input item, while \textbf{Categorization} returns $M$ category objects over $N$ input items. Tagging results are materialized as a row-aligned column and Categorization results as a category table; SQL or Python then performs exact computation over this exposed state. We realize this interface in TADA-Agent, whose atoms run inside generated Python programs and internally handle inputs beyond a reliable context window. We evaluate TADA-Agent on TABench, a benchmark of 40 complete analysis requests over spreadsheet tables spanning workflow composition, input--output structure, and literature-grounded analytical scenarios. Against a semantic-operator baseline and relative to a held-out TADA reference run, TADA-Agent delivers comparable row-level semantic quality, has higher complete-artifact preservation estimates, and uses over an order of magnitude fewer semantic-model requests under the evaluated native execution paths.

</details>


### [337] [Adaptive Retrieval, Selective Answers: Evaluating Conformal Factuality in Agentic RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34872)
*Muhammad Aimal Rehman,Chi-Kuang Yeh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究了在自适应检索增强生成（agentic RAG）中应用可靠性的方法，通过评估不同模型和数据集配置，探讨了目标水平对非空回复覆盖率、声明保留率和完整支持率的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨在自适应检索增强生成模型中，如何在生成回复的同时确保符合事实性的可靠性，并分析不同目标水平对模型性能的影响。

Method: 比较了六种不同的模型与数据集配置，使用了60个固定问题，100个分隔的30/30校准测试集，五种可信度目标水平，并与无可信度预测基线进行了对比。

Result: 结果显示，更高的目标水平伴随更高的完整支持率和更低的可用答案比例。95%的目标水平下，非空回复覆盖率从17.23%到60.17%，声明保留率从10.72%到43.16%，非空输出中的完整支持率从89.14%到95.56%。

Conclusion: 提出了自适应检索轨迹的显式表示，并分析了在自适应检索生成中，在代理终止后应用可信事实性时，可靠性和信息量之间的权衡。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve factual grounding without guaranteeing that every generated claim is supported. Previous work has studied claim-level conformal factuality in single-stage RAG and, more recently, multi-hop RAG. We examine its behavior in agentic RAG, where a language-model policy adaptively issues follow-up retrieval queries or terminates retrieval before response generation. We retain the retrieval-based relevance-scoring formulation and post-generation conformal filtering and evaluate six model-dataset configurations: GPT-6 Luna and Llama 3.1 8B on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA. Each configuration uses 60 fixed questions, 100 seeded 30/30 calibration-test partitions, five conformal target levels, and a no-conformal-prediction baseline. Across the six configurations, higher target levels are accompanied by higher observed full-support rates and reduced answer availability. At the 95% target, non-empty response coverage ranges from 17.23% to 60.17%, claim retention from 10.72% to 43.16%, and full support among non-empty outputs from 89.14% to 95.56%. We formulate the adaptive retrieval trajectory explicitly and characterize the reliability-informativeness trade-off when conformal factuality is applied after agent termination.

</details>


### [338] [RubriX: A Fast, Fine-Tunable Non-Autoregressive Rubric Judge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34875)
*Balamurugan Paramasivam,Sudalai Rajkumar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RubriX 是一种基于对比语言模型架构的评估工具，通过嵌入输入和每个级别描述来计算概率，避免生成文本，相较于现有的评判工具，RubriX 在准确性和响应速度上都有显著优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于大型语言模型的评判方法需要逐字生成文本和阅读每个级别描述，导致成本增加。为解决这一问题，作者提出了 RubriX，利用对比语言模型的架构进行评估。

Method: RubriX 采用 LoRA 调整的编码器嵌入输入和每个级别描述，使用软最大概率分布对每个级别的概率进行评估，避免了生成过程。

Result: RubriX 在多种基准测试集上的准确性达到了 75.4%，优于 Jev 和 Qwen3-8B 判定工具，并且在某些指标上超过了 G-Eval 使用 GPT-3.5 的结果。此外，即使面对更长的级别描述（最多 3,000 个标记），RubriX 的延迟也保持在约 28 毫秒，而 Jev 和 Qwen3-8B 的延迟显著增加，使得 RubriX 相比于 Jev 快 7.7 倍，相比于 Qwen3-8B 快 18.8 倍。

Conclusion: RubriX 提供了一种高效、准确的评估工具，尤其在处理长级别描述时具有显著优势，为评判任务提供了更强的性能和更低的成本。

Abstract: Rubric-based evaluation asks which level of a rubric a response meets. It is usually done by prompting a large language model (LLM) as a judge, which needs a generative call per judgment and reads every level description, so its cost grows with the rubric. We present RubriX, a rubric judge whose architecture is inspired by contrastive language models (CLM): a LoRA-adapted encoder embeds the input and each level description, and a softmax over scaled cosine similarities gives a probability for every level without text generation. Trained on public rubric data and proprietary synthetic data, RubriX reaches 75.4% exact accuracy on held-out rubrics, against 57.1% for TypeSafe's Jev and 49.8% for a Qwen3-8B judge. On eight human-labelled benchmark sets it is within 6 percentage points of Jev's accuracy on most of them, while Jev keeps a larger lead on two and ranks responses best on average; against the results reported in the G-Eval paper, RubriX outperforms G-Eval with GPT-3.5 on every SummEval dimension and both QAGS subsets. With level embeddings cached, RubriX's latency stays at about 28 ms per judgment as level descriptions grow from 10 to 3,000 tokens, while Jev's (approximate network time subtracted) rises from 44 ms to 211 ms and the Qwen3-8B judge's from 32 ms to 516 ms, making RubriX 7.7x faster than Jev and 18.8x faster than the Qwen3-8B judge at 3,000 tokens per level.

</details>


### [339] [NumTrace: Auditing the Number Provenance of Financial Analyst Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34887)
*Tianlei Zhu,Matt White,Xue Liu,Xiao-Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了NumTrace这一新的基准，旨在追踪金融分析师生成的数值声明的来源和金融语义，能够检测数值正确但账户错误的错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的检查方法只能将错误的答案标记为错误，但无法解释错误原因，因此需要一个更详细的基准来审计财务分析师生成的数值声明的来源和金融语义。

Method: NumTrace基准建立在2163份SEC EDGAR文件上的540个问题之上，通过冻结这些文件的快照并根据会计规则构建参考答案，给每个声明提供了价值、约束和支撑三个独立的判断。

Result: NumTrace能够检测数值正确但账户错误的错误（RNWA错误），并量化了数值检查和联合数值-约束检查通过率之间的差距。在测试的三个代理上，RNWA错误占失败声明的67.5%-81.8%。

Conclusion: 研究表明，代理生成的财务陈述中存在大量的数值账户错误，并且对代理性能的评估表明，价值判断不足以保证数值声明的准确性，必须同时考虑账户约束。

Abstract: A numerical claim generated by a financial analyst agent can match a number in a company filing but refer to the wrong entity, concept, period, unit or scope. A check based on reference answers can mark such an answer as wrong but does not explain why it fails. In this paper, we present NumTrace, a new benchmark that audits the provenance of each numerical claim made by financial analyst agents: its source and financial semantics. NumTrace currently has 540 questions over 2,163 SEC EDGAR documents. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first numerical benchmark about who holds a company's shares (Form 13F) and what its executives are owed (Item 402(i)). On a frozen snapshot of these documents, we build the reference answers according to accounting rules. NumTrace then gives each claim three separate verdicts: value, binding and support. By retaining separate value and binding verdicts, NumTrace detects right number, wrong account (RNWA) errors: a claim has an RNWA error when it passes the value check but fails the binding check. The RNWA rate quantifies the gap between value-only and joint value-and-binding pass rates. Finally, we audit three agents, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. RNWA errors make up 67.5-81.8% of each agent's failing claims. In particular, on 13F co-filing group questions, about 91% of claims pass the value check, but fewer than half pass the binding check.

</details>


### [340] [FATE-5: Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for Continuous Big Five Personality Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34889)
*Gunhee Cho,Hongyeob Kim,Yun-Gyung Cheong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FATE-5 是一个两阶段框架，通过分离人格编码和自然性对齐来实现强人格表达和自然对话生成的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的人格控制方法往往在人格特质表达和自然对话生成之间存在权衡。FATE-5 提出的方法旨在解决这一问题，通过两个阶段来实现强人格表达和自然对话生成的平衡。

Method: FATE-5 采用两阶段框架：首先使用对话监督和辅助调查目标学习 Big Five 人格特征的连续软提示表示；其次通过对话质量和人格一致性进行偏好对齐来提高对话自然度。该方法在三种语言模型基座上进行测试。

Result: FATE-5 维持了强大的人格表达，同时在对话自然度上取得了显著提高，超越了其他强人格表达方法。在问卷调查中，FATE-5 达到了 0.97-0.99 的单调性相关性和 8.9-12.4 的恢复 RMSE，均优于对照基线。

Conclusion: FATE-5 提出了一种有效的方法，能够在保持自然对话行为的同时实现连续的人格控制。

Abstract: Controlling personality in large language models is important for building conversational agents that can be customized to different users and interaction settings. However, existing personality control methods often face a tradeoff between strong trait expression and natural dialogue generation. We introduce FATE-5, Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for the Big Five, a two-stage framework that separates personality encoding from naturalness alignment. FATE-5 first learns continuous soft prompt representations of Big Five profiles using dialogue supervision and an auxiliary survey objective.
