Effects differ across facts and models. Paired interventions then abstract eligible error details within fixed histories while preserving correct content and the surrounding controversy. Error reproduction remains largely unchanged across the evaluation targets, while a development quotation target exhibits local reductions. These findings connect persistent errors to the information available throughout a writing process and motivate evaluation of both what models affirm and what their publications supply to future writers.

</details>


### [450] [Graph-dependent pooling: adaptive granularity in hierarchical graph neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33623)
*Bohan Yoon,Hyejin Jang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GDPool 是一种能自适应确定每张图堆池化粒度的图神经网络方法，通过自注意力机制选择结构重要节点并构建软节点分配的粗化图，实现了在多个基准测试中的最佳预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图堆池方法依赖预设的聚类数量或固定的堆池比率，限制了对不同个体图的适配性。GDPool 旨在解决这一问题，通过自适应确定每张图的堆池化粒度，提高模型的灵活性。

Method: GDPool 使用自注意力机制选择结构性重要节点，并通过软节点分配构建粗化图。该方法利用梯度对齐分析层间目标之间的优化冲突，并利用自注意力机制来确定不同图的各自锚点。

Result: GDPool 在金属有机框架和分子图基准测试中表现优异，一致性地达到最佳预测性能。使用模块度和活跃聚类的评估表明，GDPool 在模块度方面优于现有方法，而活跃聚类的数量随深度单调递减。

Conclusion: GDPool 提供了一种自适应的图堆池方法，能够针对不同个体图调整堆池化级别，增强了模型的泛化能力和预测准确性。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks are widely used to learn structural representations of relational data. Hierarchical graph pooling learns multi-level representations by progressively coarsening graphs; however, prior methods rely on predefined cluster numbers or fixed pooling ratios, limiting adaptability to individual graphs. We propose Graph-Dependent Pooling (GDPool), which dynamically determines pooling granularity for each graph. We analyze optimization conflicts among layer-wise objectives through gradient alignment, showing that independently supervised pooling levels can send conflicting gradients to shared parameters. GDPool uses self-attention to select graph-specific anchors representing structurally important nodes and constructs coarse graphs through soft node assignment. Experiments on metal-organic framework and molecular graph benchmarks show that GDPool consistently achieves the best predictive performance across all benchmarks. Evaluations using modularity and the effective number of clusters show that GDPool achieves consistently higher modularity than existing methods while the number of active clusters decreases monotonically with depth. Sensitivity analyses confirm stable behavior across hyperparameter and architectural choices.

</details>


### [451] [RAQ-MLA: Role-Aware Quantization for Multi-Head Latent Attention Caches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33625)
*Tianqi Chen,Xunchao Li,Linchuan Xie,Guanghua Yu,Jianchen Zhu,Peisong Wang,Jian Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究分析了Multi-Head Latent Attention（MLA）缓存的特点，并提出了一种新的量化方法RAQ-MLA，该方法能够显著减少缓存占用的空间，同时保持模型的高准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的KV缓存量化方法不适合MLA模型，这会影响精度。因此，研究需要对MLA缓存和量化误差进行分析，以改进量化策略。

Method: 通过分析激活分布和量化误差传播到注意力输出的方式，提出了一种针对MLA缓存的上下文感知量化方法RAQ-MLA。该方法为每个缓存张量拟合了一个可逆变换，以减少对其注意力输出的影响。

Result: RAQ-MLA能够让MLA缓存量化至每个元素约2.5位，理论上增加了6.5倍的KV缓存容量，同时在四个MLA模型上保持了对推理和编码任务的几乎零损失。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的RAQ-MLA量化方法有效地提高了MLA模型的缓存效率和量化精度。

Abstract: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) has been adopted by recent frontier large language models. Instead of per-head keys and values, MLA caches a compressed KV latent that is up-projected into keys and values at decode time, together with a narrow positional key that carries position information into the attention score. Existing KV-cache quantization methods are designed around the keys and values of standard attention and do not account for what MLA actually caches, which costs accuracy at low bit widths. We analyze the MLA cache both in activation distribution and in how quantization error propagates to the attention output, and show that the two cached tensors play different roles: the latent mainly supplies the values, whereas the positional key dominates the attention score. We therefore propose RAQ-MLA (Role-Aware Quantization for Multi-Head Latent Attention Caches), which fits an invertible transform to each cached tensor against the error that tensor delivers to the attention output: attention-weighted value error for the latent and score perturbation for the positional key. Without training, RAQ-MLA quantizes the full MLA cache to about 2.5 bits per element, a 6.5x increase in theoretical KV-cache capacity, while remaining nearly lossless on reasoning and coding tasks across four MLA models.

</details>


### [452] [AlphaIdeaBench: Benchmarking Automated Research Idea Generation under Feasibility Constraints with Peer Review Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33644)
*Shunchao Zhou,Chang Yang,Jingrui Wang,Shuxin Zhuang,Rundong Wang,Runsheng Yu,Xinrun Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了AlphaIdeaBench基准，包含100个创意任务，每个任务都有明确的资源预算和提案模板。通过与ICLR、NeurIPS和ICML的评审员评分进行对比验证，该基准展示了不同LLM和框架在不同维度上的表现。实验表明，增强的LLM和合适的框架对于提出有创见性的任务至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的研究创意评价多侧重于未约束的新颖性或与已发表论文的重叠，且很少有对LLM评判者的审查符合同行评议的标准。AlphaIdeaBench旨在提供一个平台，以资源预算为约束，评估研究创意生成系统的有效性、新颖性和可行性。

Method: 该研究设计了一个包含100个创意任务的基准，每个任务都有明确的资源预算和提案模板。利用LLM对提案在有效性、新颖性和可行性方面进行评分，并采用与ICLR、NeurIPS和ICML的600篇论文评审员评分进行验证。

Result: 实验结果显示，Gemini 3.7 Flash在问题和方法新颖性方面表现最好，在场景新颖性方面与评审员评分的共识较低。CoI-Agent获得最高综合评分，SciMON在方法和洞察新颖性方面表现最好。不同增强的LLM和框架在场景新颖性上的得分较低，并且在预算内未能充分改变实验设置。

Conclusion: 研究认为，为了在有限资源下提出有效的研究创意，重要的是选择合适的LLM增强和合适的框架。基准的公开将促进未来研究创意生成系统在受约束条件下的标准和可重复性评估。

Abstract: Research ideas are always proposed under resource constraints: a plan must fit the available compute, API credit, and time. Yet evaluations of research-ideation agents mostly score unconstrained novelty or overlap with a published paper, and their LLM judges are rarely checked against peer review. We introduce AlphaIdeaBench, a benchmark of 100 ideation tasks (50 workshop calls for papers and 50 open problems stated in surveys), each paired with an explicit resource budget and a shared proposal schema. An LLM judge scores each proposal on 12 dimensions covering validity, novelty, and feasibility. To validate the judge, we compare its scores on four novelty axes (problem, method, scenario, and insight) with scores derived from reviewer comments on 600 papers from ICLR 2026, NeurIPS 2025, and ICML 2025. For problem and method novelty, Gemini 3.7 Flash is within one point of the reviewer-derived score on 94-97% of papers; agreement on scenario novelty is relatively lower. We evaluate eight published harnesses on a shared backbone and, within one harness, eight backbone LLMs. CoI-Agent obtains the highest overall score, narrowly ahead of SciMON, which leads on method and insight novelty. All harnesses score low on scenario novelty and rarely change the problem setting. The backbone largely determines which open problem a proposal targets, whereas the harness determines whether a proposal addresses one problem or combines several. Weaker backbones such as Llama 4 Scout fail to carry out that harness's strategy and score low on budget feasibility. Finally, when only the budget is varied on three topics, a larger budget changes the experimental setting on compute-intensive topics but only adds tests on an inexpensive one. We release the tasks, rubrics, and scores to foster standardized, reproducible benchmarking of future research-ideation agents under constraints.

</details>


### [453] [TAD: Distilling Vision-Language-Action Policies from Teacher Trajectories Alone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33650)
*Yun Zhu,Da Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Trajectory-only Adversarial Distillation (	exttt{AdaptVLA}) converts teacher joint-position features into adaptive feedback, enabling improvement in VLA policies without online teacher queries. On ManiSkill 	exttt{PutOnPlateInScene25Main}, 	exttt{AdaptVLA} significantly outperforms the baseline while consuming fewer resources.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鉴于在线获取教师评分的限制，该论文旨在开发一种无需在线教师查询的方法来改进Vision-Language-Action (VLA)策略。Trajectory-only Adversarial Distillation (	exttt{AdaptVLA})通过将教师的关节位置特征转换为适应性反馈，实现这一目标。

Method: 	exttt{AdaptVLA} 方法使用一个固定的教师关节位置特征银行，通过一个判别器对比教师和学生轨迹的特征边缘，为策略优化提供奖励。

Result: 在ManiSkill 	exttt{PutOnPlateInScene25Main}任务上，	exttt{AdaptVLA}将OpenVLA-OFT (7B)的表现从26.2%和20.3%提升到了76.6%和58.6%。	exttt{AdaptVLA}的最优点使用了白盒在线教师权重的5倍的学生交互预算和12.5倍的完整轨迹批量迭代次数。

Conclusion: 	exttt{AdaptVLA} 方法展示了在没有教师评分的情况下改进VLA策略的可能性，并且在相同的计算资源上仍然能够取得显著的效果。

Abstract: Online distillation of vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly relies on teacher action scores that an inference-only interface may not expose. Trajectory-only Adversarial Distillation (\gad{}) instead turns a fixed bank of teacher joint-position features into adaptive feedback: a discriminator compares feature marginals from teacher and student rollouts and supplies rewards for on-policy learning. The student interacts with the environment without online teacher queries or environment task rewards. On ManiSkill \texttt{PutOnPlateInScene25Main}, \gad{} improves OpenVLA-OFT (7B) from $26.2\%$ to $76.6\%$ \successonce{} ($+50.4$ percentage points) and from $20.3\%$ to $58.6\%$ \successend{}. It trails white-box on-policy distillation (OPD) at $81.6\%$ / $59.4\%$ by $5.0$ / $0.8$ percentage points ($n{=}256$ evaluation trajectories per checkpoint). The tested four-epoch continuation achieves the highest \gad{} result without additional teacher data. This best run uses $5\times$ OPD's student interaction budget and $12.5\times$ its complete-rollout batch-passes. The comparison demonstrates online VLA improvement without teacher scoring while quantifying unequal interaction and optimization budgets.

</details>


### [454] [Jointly Modeling Preferences and Imperfect Decision-Making in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33651)
*Axel Abels,Elias Fernández Domingos,Tom Lenaerts*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过引入偏好行为模型(PBM)，结合了偏好表示与不完全效用最大化机制，评估LLM在社会困境游戏中的行为一致性，并发现通过标准行为经济工具推断出的偏好无法在不同场景中预测行为，但能跨情境保留一定预测值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要通过行为经济学手段和心理实验推断LLM偏好，但对其在不同战略情境下的行为预测能力有限，无法全面模拟LLM的策略行为。因此，研究引入偏好-行为模型(PBM)，旨在提高LLM行为预测的一致性和准确性。

Method: 研究采用逆博弈问题进行建模估计，联合推断偏好和行为参数，并检验该模型在三个社会困境游戏中的表现。

Result: 研究结果显示，从标准行为经济学工具推断出的偏好在多个社会困境中不能稳定预测行为，但模型在一个情境中学习到的行为参数在其他情境中仍保持一定的预测能力。进一步分析表明，推断出的偏好能广泛反映LLM决策意图的基本方面。

Conclusion: 该模型提供了研究LLM行为一致性和方向对齐的框架，有助于揭示标准推断方法可能忽视的策略和行为模式。

Abstract: Do preferences Large Language Models (LLMs) express in standard elicitation tasks predict their strategic behaviour? LLM agents interacting with humans and other AI systems face potentially conflicting objectives, such as individual welfare, group welfare, and environmental concerns. Prior work characterizes LLM preferences through behavioral-economic and psychological elicitation or strategic games, but rarely tests consistency across settings and prediction in other strategic environments. This requires modeling how competing objectives jointly shape behavior, whereas existing approaches typically measure preference dimensions in isolation. Drawing on utility theory, we introduce the Preference-Behavior Model (PBM), which combines a preference representation with mechanisms capturing imperfect utility maximization. We formulate estimation as an inverse-game problem, jointly inferring preferences and behavioral parameters from observed choices. We evaluate PBM in three social dilemmas that expose conflicting motives: a Public Goods Game, a Collective-Risk Dilemma, and a Common-Pool Resource dilemma. We find that while preferences estimated from established behavioral economic elicitation instruments do not consistently predict behavior in these dilemmas, models fitted in one dilemma retain predictive value in others, suggesting that inferred preferences capture meaningful aspects of LLM decision-making that elicitation instruments may miss. Finally, we assess alignment with persona instructions, finding that inferred preferences broadly reflect intended priorities with specific divergences across dimensions, LLMs, and games being identified by our approach. Our methodology provides a framework for studying how consistently LLM preferences explain behavior, assessing alignment with intended priorities, and revealing trade-offs and behavioral patterns that standard elicitation may miss.

</details>


### [455] [Physics-Informed Graph-Based Safe RL with Constraint-Specific Critics for Community Battery Coordination in Distribution Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33654)
*Chenghao Huang,Yue Yang,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种基于物理信息的深度强化学习框架，通过协调社区电池储能系统来缓解电压和线路限制违反问题，同时最小化运营成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式能源资源（DERs）和电动汽车（EV）充电的快速变化使得配电网络（DNs）的安全、低成本运行变得越来越具有挑战性。

Method: 开发了一种双层物理信息图表示方法，结合拉格朗日专用批评家PPO算法，分解约束特定的价值，保持异质的学习信号，以改进电压和线路负载相关性能。

Result: 研究表明，所提议的方法在具有高屋顶光伏渗透率和电动汽车充电的配电网络中，将关键电压违规程度最多降低80.5%，并且在较低电压违规数量和线路过载程度上表现出竞争优势，同时保持具有竞争力的运行成本。

Conclusion: 基于物理信息的拉格朗日专用批评家PPO算法能够有效缓解DNs中的电压和线路限制违反，同时保持经济性。

Abstract: High penetrations of distributed energy resources (DERs) and fast-varying electric vehicle (EV) charging intensify voltage and line-limit violations in distribution networks (DNs), making safe, low-cost operation increasingly challenging. This paper proposes a physics-informed safe deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for coordinating community battery energy storage systems to mitigate constraint violations while minimizing operating cost. To represent nonlocal spatiotemporal interactions, we develop a dual-level physics-informed graph representation in which line impedance and capacity shape spatial information propagation, while power-balance, voltage-profile, and flow-reconstruction losses regularize the latent state toward control-relevant physical consistency. Building on this representation, we develop Lagrangian Dedicated-Critic PPO (LDCPPO), which implements constraint-specific value decomposition: independent reward and cost critics preserve heterogeneous voltage- and line-loading-related learning signals and combine their advantages only during the Lagrangian policy update. Case studies on DNs with high rooftop photovoltaic penetration and EV charging demonstrate that the proposed method reduces the key voltage-violation degree by up to 80.5% compared with the tested baselines, while also achieving the lowest voltage-violation count and line-overload degree with competitive operating cost.

</details>


### [456] [Power-of-Two Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Neurons for Event-Driven Vision-Language-Action Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33658)
*Rui Liu,He Lv,Ziyao Zhang,Rui Ma,Rongxiang Nie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究引入了一种基于2的幂幅值的泄漏积分-放电神经元PoT-LIF，结合幅度编码的脉冲事件和残差保存的膜动力学，使密集连续值计算能够通过离散脉冲逐步表示。Heartbeat方案将这种生物启发式的脉冲计算与预训练的VLA架构相结合，不修改其对外部推断接口。实验证明，与原来的连续激活基准模型相比，PoT-LIF VLA在能耗节约和性能提升方面表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽然在机器人操控上表现出色，但它们依赖于密集的连续值计算，这在能量受限的部署中存在根本挑战。为此，研究提出了模拟生物神经元稀疏、事件驱动的通讯和时间整合机制的皮氏漏电积分-放电神经元（PoT-LIF），试图提高能效。

Method: 研究开发了PoT-LIF神经元，该神经元通过离散的脉冲（具有2的幂幅值）来编码幅度信息，同时保留了膜动力学的连续性，从而使连续信息能够逐步用离散脉冲来表示。Heartbeat方案则将这种生物启发式的脉冲计算与预训练的VLA架构融合，并提出在权重投影中局部化这一过程，不修改预训练模型的外部推断接口。

Result: 在标准模式下，PoT-LIF VLA分别在T=1和T=2下的成功率为96.90%和96.35%，而Heartbeat模式在T=2和T=4下的成功率达到97.25%和96.90%，均优于原始连续激活的基线模型96.70%的成功率。此外，在T=1的测试中，60.01%的脉冲发射率对应的能耗仅为密集参考计算的1/7.67，模拟了86.95%的能效降低。

Conclusion: PoT-LIF神经元和Heartbeat方案在保持和提高VLA模型性能的同时，极大降低了能效，展示了其在能量受限环境下的应用潜力。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on dense, continuous-valued computation presents a fundamental challenge for energy-constrained deployment. Inspired by the sparse, event-driven signaling and temporal integration mechanisms of biological neurons, a promising alternative is to introduce spiking computation into VLA models. However, enabling such computation without restructuring pretrained policies or compromising closed-loop control remains an open challenge. To address this challenge, we introduce the Power-of-Two Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (PoT-LIF) neuron, which emits signed spikes with power-of-two amplitudes. By combining magnitude-coded spike events with residual-preserving membrane dynamics, PoT-LIF enables continuous information to be progressively represented through discrete spikes. The Heartbeat formulation further localizes this process within weighted projections, bridging biologically inspired spiking computation and pretrained VLA architectures without modifying their external inference interfaces. We integrate PoT-LIF into the vision projection, vision-language projection, and action projection of $π_{0.5}$ and evaluate both operating modes over 2,000 paired closed-loop LIBERO episodes per configuration. Standard-mode PoT-LIF VLA achieves success rates of 96.90% and 96.35% at $T = 1$ and $T = 2$, respectively, while Heartbeat mode achieves 97.25% and 96.90% at $T = 2$ and $T = 4$, compared with 96.70% for the original continuous-activation $π_{0.5}$ baseline. At $T = 1$ with a 60.01% firing rate, PoT-LIF uses approximately 1/7.67 of the dense-reference arithmetic energy, corresponding to a modeled reduction of 86.95%.

</details>


### [457] [SWE-Ladder: Learning to Localize, Reproduce, and Patch via Progressive Privileged Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33667)
*Xudong Cai,Zhengxi Lu,Yuchen Yan,Jian Shao,Jun Xiao,Yueting Zhuang,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SWE-Ladder 提出了一个新方法，通过将每个训练实例的验证修复转换为阶段特定的证据，提升了解决软件工程（SWE）问题的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的方法（如 Reinforcement Learning 和 On-policy Self-distillation）在解决 SWE 问题时缺乏阶段特定的指导，因此提出 SWE-Ladder 以提供更具针对性的帮助。

Method: SWE-Ladder 方法使用一个规则基于的路由器将完整过程的每个步骤分配给相应的阶段，一个固定教师只看到匹配的证据，并且各阶段以修复顺序进行精炼，通过 GRPO 优化整个轨迹。

Result: 在 SWE-bench 验证的 R2E-Gym 框架下，SWE-Ladder 将 pass@1 提高到了 16.4%，优于 GRPO 的 10.4% 和 OPSD 的 12.4%。在 OpenHands 框架下，SWE-Ladder 提高了 pass@1 到 17.6%。

Conclusion: SWE-Ladder 提高了解决 SWE 问题的性能，并提供了阶段特定的引导，从而在不同的实验设置下展示了其有效性。

Abstract: Resolving a repository-level issue typically requires a software-engineering (SWE) agent to localize the faulty code, reproduce the failure, and patch the code. Reinforcement learning trains such agents from a single test result on the final patch, while on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) adds token-level supervision from a teacher with privileged evidence, exposing the full reference patch at every step. Neither provides stage-specific guidance for localization or reproduction. We propose SWE-Ladder, which turns the verified repair of each training instance into stage-specific evidence: the changed files and lines for localization, the fail-to-pass tests for reproduction, and the diff for patching. A rule-based router assigns each step of an end-to-end rollout to a stage based on its tool call, a frozen teacher sees only the matching evidence, and the stages are distilled in repair order while GRPO optimizes the full trajectory. With Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on SWE-bench Verified under the R2E-Gym scaffold, SWE-Ladder improves pass@1 from 9.6% to 16.4%, compared with 10.4% for GRPO and 12.4% for OPSD with the full patch. Under the OpenHands scaffold, it improves pass@1 from 13.0% to 17.6%. Reversing the stage order under R2E-Gym reduces pass@1 to 11.4%.

</details>


### [458] [Meta-CLIP: Metadata-Conditioned Contrastive Learning for Zero-Shot Disease Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33674)
*Haozhe Luo,Nirosh Sivanesan,Shelley Zixin Shu,Francesco Nitti,Mauricio Reyes*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Meta-CLIP 是一种元数据条件对比框架，在预训练中利用成像条件相似性重新加权跨模态负样本，提升医学影像与文本的跨模态表示学习，并在多个基准测试中表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的医学视觉-语言预训练方法主要丰富临床语义，而忽略了DICOM头部中的结构化采集信息。Meta-CLIP框架通过使用采集相似性重新加权跨模态负样本，旨在提高预训练效果。

Method: 引入了元数据条件对比框架 Meta-CLIP，在预训练过程中利用非线性核函数定义成像条件相似度，加权改变负样本的贡献，以突出具有相似成像条件的影像之间的差异。

Result: Meta-CLIP 在 CT-RATE 数据集上将宏观-AUROC 提高了 1.41 分点，并在四个基准测试中取得了最高的宏观-AUROC，特别是在胸部 X 光检查中。

Conclusion: Meta-CLIP 通过增强采集信息的使用，为医学视觉-语言学习提供了实用的训练时先验，并通过实验证实了其有效性。

Abstract: Medical vision--language pretraining learns transferable representations from paired images and radiology reports, yet differences in scanners and acquisition protocols can impair transfer. Existing approaches primarily enrich clinical semantics, leaving structured acquisition information in DICOM headers underused. We introduce Meta-CLIP, a metadata-conditioned contrastive framework that uses acquisition similarity to reweight cross-modal negatives during pretraining. A kernel over numerical and categorical DICOM fields defines a bounded pairwise margin. This margin increases the contribution of acquisition-similar negatives, emphasizing distinctions among studies that share imaging conditions. The kernel remains fixed during image--text optimization, and inference follows the standard dual-encoder architecture without requiring metadata. We evaluate Meta-CLIP on chest radiography and volumetric chest CT through zero-shot classification, appearance perturbations, grounding, and representation analyses. On CT-RATE, Meta-CLIP improves macro-AUROC over CT-CLIP by 1.41 points, with a 95\% paired bootstrap confidence interval of 0.96--1.85 points. It also achieves the highest macro-AUROC on four of five CXR benchmarks. An exploratory BrgSA evaluation extends the analysis to another CT backbone. These findings support acquisition metadata as a practical training-time prior for medical vision--language learning. Code will be made publicly available upon publication.

</details>


### [459] [More: Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort for Self-Evolving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33684)
*Dianxing Shi,Dingjie Fu,Tianyu Lei,Wangjie Qiu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MORE 提出了一种自适应的训练框架，该框架能够在不同任务上灵活选择推理形式和计算努力，从而在保持高效的同时提高了模型在编程、数学和逻辑推理任务上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的自我进化训练方法常在各种任务上均匀地应用昂贵的思考过程，这导致了资源的浪费。MORE旨在解决这一问题，通过自适应地选择每个任务所需的推理形式和资源分配，提高模型性能。

Method: MORE采用两阶段训练流程：第一阶段建立一个关于直接回答、短推理链和基于代码的推理的紧凑先验；第二阶段使用Mode-Adaptive and Test-time Effort PPO（MATE-PPO）在生成的任务流上进行自我进化。此外，MORE还能在推理阶段动态选择合适的推理模式和计算资源。

Result: MORE在编程、数学和一般推理基准测试中，相较于基线模型和不同的模型大小，展现出了一致的性能提升。在推理阶段，MORE表现出更高的准确性、更好的效率，并且响应长度更短，推理时间也更少。

Conclusion: MORE提出了一种有效的自我进化训练框架，能自适应地在多任务上分配推理资源，提高了模型的性能，并减少了推理时间。

Abstract: Self-evolving training improves the performance of agents on difficult tasks through verifiable feedback, but it often applies costly deliberation uniformly across tasks. To address this problem, we propose Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort (MORE), a self-evolving training framework that adaptively selects both reasoning form and computational effort for each task. Specifically, MORE follows a two-stage training paradigm: (i) \emph{Stage 1} establishes a compact prior over direct answering, short and long chain-of-thought, and code-based reasoning, and (ii) \emph{Stage 2} self-evolves this prior with Mode-Adaptive and Test-time Effort PPO (MATE-PPO) on generated, verifiable task streams without curated data. By learning mode selection and token expenditure jointly, MORE allocates concise reasoning to tasks that permit it while retaining extended deliberation where it is useful. Across coding, mathematics, and general-reasoning benchmarks, MORE achieves consistent performance gains on Base and Coder backbones at model scales from 3B to 14B. During inference, MORE demonstrates higher accuracy and better efficiency, with markedly shorter response lengths and reduced inference time.

</details>


### [460] [PACE: Research Proving Agent for Adaptive Conjecture Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33690)
*Shu Miao,Feiming Wang,Wentao Long,Chenyi Li,Kun Yuan,Zaiwen Wen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种名为PACE的科研证明代理，通过结构化的研究循环选择数学目标并开发或挑战候选机制。该系统在已知证明任务上达到75.16的综合证明评分，并完成20个证明。在假设研究中，PACE取得了优于基线模型的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究旨在解决应用数学中命题研究的挑战，即在研究过程中需要对候选问题或结论进行修订，将问题表述和证明开发结合在一起。

Method: PACE通过结构化的研究循环工作，该循环包括选择数学目标、开发或挑战候选机制、从这些机制构建证明，以及由独立验证器检查证明是否符合原始目标。还引入了一种新的基准测试（ResearchProofBench）来评估证明构建和假设研究。

Result: 在已知证明任务的51个任务中，PACE取得了75.16的综合证明评分，并完成了20个证明。在假设研究中，PACE产生的结果比基准模型具有更高的评审分数。

Conclusion: PACE为解决应用数学中的假设研究提供了一种有效的解决方案，展示了其在证明构建和假设研究方面的优越性。

Abstract: Many mathematical research agents focus on solving problems with fixed statements. However, conjecture research, especially in applied mathematics, may require revising candidate questions or conclusions as investigation proceeds, coupling problem formulation with proof development. We present PACE, a research-proof agent that supports this process through a structured research loop that selects mathematical objectives and develops or challenges candidate mechanisms. The whole prover constructs proofs from these mechanisms, and an independent verifier checks them against the original target. Evidence-tracking memory stores assumptions and dependencies arising during research and marks evidence for revalidation when a candidate or condition changes. This memory supports task-specific context composition that keeps checked premises, exploratory material and unresolved obligations distinct. To evaluate proof construction and conjecture research, we introduce ResearchProofBench, an applied-mathematics benchmark focused on optimization, comprising 51 known-proof tasks with 331 hidden checkpoints under historical abstract access and six open-problem cases. The known-proof tasks assess reconstruction of published results, while the open-problem cases assess mathematical investigation and proof development. On the 51 known-proof tasks, PACE achieves an aggregate Proof Score of 75.16 and completes 20 proofs. In conjecture research, PACE develops conditional results, with its submissions receiving higher review scores than the compared baselines.

</details>


### [461] [Seeing the Options: Typed Decisions over Visual Candidates with Reusable Option Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33702)
*Fengxin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Iris 提出了一种框架，能够处理图像、文本或混合类型的候选对象，并保持决策模块的核心功能。该研究证明了 Iris 在顺序不变性和完全缓存重用方面具有鲁棒性，并通过特定的设计改进显著提高了性能和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 之前的文本仅模型无法有效处理多模态候选物，而引入 Iris 框架可以处理图像、文本或混合类型的候选物，这在UI元素选择、产品推荐和图表匹配等任务中具有重要意义。

Method: Iris 框架专门设计来处理图像、文本或混合类型的候选物，确保了顺序不变性和完全缓存重用。通过利用嵌入式设计，Iris 能够有条件地编码每个候选物而不涉及候选物间的交叉注意力。

Result: 实验结果表明，独立编码的 Iris 可以在候选物重排时达到 78.4 / 72.1 / 74.8 的准确度，而多编码方式则在重排时降低了准确度。特定设计的 Iris 在三分之一的延迟下达到了 91.7 / 86.5 / 90.0 的准确度，同时在时间效率和缓存利用上都有显著提升，同时解决了 Ampere GPU 上的系统瓶颈，加速了处理速度 350 倍。

Conclusion: Iris 在多模态候选物的决策任务上展示了其高性能和高效能，为未来的多模态代理决策模型提供了有价值的参考。

Abstract: Typed decision-making tasks in agents, such as UI element selection, product recommendation, and chart matching, require models to choose from a set of discrete candidates. While prior work demonstrates that text-only System One models achieve four key properties including candidate-order invariance, scalability, and cache reuse via separate request-candidate encoding, extending them to multimodal settings where candidates are visual remains underexplored. We introduce Iris, a framework that accommodates image, text, or hybrid candidates while preserving the core decision module. We prove that order invariance and exact cache reuse hold for any per-candidate encoder under Iris, and derive the closed-form latency reduction. We construct a visual-candidate benchmark from Multimodal-Mind2Web (K=16, deduplicated, order-shuffled, three generalization splits). Independent encoding (Iris) achieves 78.4 / 72.1 / 74.8 percent accuracy with zero-flip rate under candidate reordering. Joint encoding reaches 90.6 / 89.5 / 91.6 percent but suffers an 8 to 10 percent answer-flip rate when shuffled. To bridge this gap, we propose a design that encodes each candidate conditioned on the request state without inter-candidate cross-attention; it preserves strict order invariance, enables forked cache sharing, and attains 91.7 / 86.5 / 90.0 percent accuracy at one-third of OneJev latency with calibrated null probabilities (AUROC 0.93 to 0.97). Reusing image candidates across requests cuts latency by 37x at K=256 and 191x at K=2048. On MetaEncoder benchmarks, Iris-4B achieves 100 percent on JevBench original and easy, outperforming 30B MetaEncoder and 27B OpenJev. Finally, we resolve a systems bottleneck on Ampere GPUs: reformulating Qwen3.5 patch-embedding Conv3d into its exact matrix-product form accelerates processing by 350x. Code, data, and checkpoints: https://github.com/lllfx/Iris.

</details>


### [462] [Human-Feedback-Guided Multi-Agent Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Interactive Driving Behavior Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33726)
*Longhao Yan,Jinhao Liang,Kaidi Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一个基于人类反馈的多智能体逆强化学习框架（HFG-MAIRL），有效处理了多车辆交互的复杂性，并通过人类反馈优化奖励学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前大多数逆强化学习方法局限于单智能体场景，难以直接应用于多智能体驾驶行为模型。为了避免显式扩展到所有可能的联合动作状态空间，通过利用交通状态下的人类反馈信息来辅助奖励恢复。

Method: HFG-MAIRL框架首先通过局部马尔可夫博弈处理每个车辆及其直接交互邻居的行为，同时使用聚合交通状态捕捉更广泛交通环境的影响。其次，通过Bradley-Terry似然将人类反馈转换为成对的序参偏好约束。

Result: 实验结果表明，HFG-MAIRL在决策建模和生成可解释的反馈对齐奖励模式方面优于代表性基准方法。

Conclusion: 该研究为多智能体互动驾驶行为建模提供了一种创新方法，有望改善自动驾驶车辆在复杂交通环境中的表现。

Abstract: Modeling human driving behavior is fundamental to understanding driver decision-making and supporting autonomous vehicles (AVs) in mixed traffic. Reward learning offers a principled way to infer the latent objectives behind driving behaviors, yet most existing methods are formulated in single-agent settings and treat surrounding vehicles as dynamic obstacles. Directly extending reward learning to multi-agent scenarios is difficult because the joint action space grows exponentially with the number of interacting vehicles. In addition, existing approaches mainly rely on physical demonstrations and rarely exploit human feedback during reward recovery. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a Human-Feedback-Guided Multi-Agent Inverse Reinforcement Learning (HFG-MAIRL) framework for interactive driving behavior modeling. First, we develop a multi-agent maximum-entropy inverse reinforcement learning module that explicitly models each vehicle and its directly interacting neighbors in a localized Markov game, while using aggregated traffic states to capture the influence of the broader traffic environment. The resulting coupled multi-vehicle responses are approximated through finite marginal-response iterations over factorized vehicle-level policies, avoiding explicit enumeration of the full joint action space. Second, we incorporate human feedback as ordinal preference supervision through a Bradley-Terry likelihood. In our experiments, driver emotion labels are used as one instantiation of such feedback and converted into pairwise ordinal preference constraints. Experiments on the AIDE dataset show that HFG-MAIRL outperforms representative IRL baselines in decision modeling and produces interpretable feedback-aligned reward patterns.

</details>


### [463] [All the Facts, Still the Wrong Answer: Integration Gaps in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33764)
*Yuyang Dai,Yuxia Wang,Zhuohan Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过分析多模态推理中的局部事实恢复与全局决策的有效性之间的关系，发现即使局部事实恢复准确，全局决策也可能失败。研究通过多种评估方法（如条件性能、探针分析等）揭示了这一现象，并强调了需要专门针对证据综合的方法进行优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在探讨在多模态推理过程中，局部事实恢复准确率与全局决策有效性之间的关系，以解决现有评估方法（仅关注最终答案准确性）带来的局限性。

Method: 研究设计了多证据融合差距，结合了局部事实正确率、条件性能、探针分析、激活替换等评估方法，对不同模型进行了全面评估。

Result: 研究发现，即使局部事实恢复准确，多模态推理模型在全局决策上的表现仍然存在显著差异。不同模型在不同的深度范围和Token位置上，其表现出的激活替换结果差异明显。这些结果表明，简单的事实恢复并不能保证全局决策的成功。

Conclusion: 研究强调了在多模态推理中，准确恢复事实和表示相关解决方案信息不够，还需要专门针对证据综合的方法进行优化，并建议结合感知和模型规模的发展，进一步改进模型。

Abstract: Multimodal reasoning requires models to combine multiple pieces of evidence into decisions that satisfy all relevant constraints. Evaluations centered on final-answer accuracy leave unclear whether failures arise from reading individual facts or using them together. We study this question through the multi-evidence integration gap, linking local fact recovery to global decision validity on controlled subset-selection and path-finding tasks. Our evaluation combines conditional performance given correct local answers with same-grid local queries, text-oracle inputs, retrieval controls, and constraint ablations. We further examine hidden-state probes and activation replacement across network depth, token positions, and model families. Across the evaluated models, accurate local recovery coexists with substantial global failure. For example, Gemma-3-27B recovers all evaluated isolated item facts correctly but achieves only 19.75% global validity on eight-item visual instances. Probes decode information about solution membership from global-prompt states, while corresponding clean-state replacement recovers failed decisions over model-dependent depth ranges. These findings show that recovering facts and representing solution-related information are insufficient for reliable joint decisions. They motivate evaluations and model improvements that explicitly target how available evidence is combined, alongside advances in perception and model scale.

</details>


### [464] [Local Entropy Fluctuations for Black-Box LLM-Generated Text Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33767)
*Xinpeng Wang,Bruce Rushing,Zhizhen Chen,Zhe Zeng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种新的相对峰突出率（RelPPR）指标，用于检测机器生成的文本，该指标捕捉了人类写作与机器生成文本在熵轨迹上的结构对比，并在多种模型和数据集上取得了最先进的黑盒检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前最先进的单模统计检测器和重采样基检测器在无提示续写中表现出色，但在黑盒设置下无法有效检测指令条件生成的文本，本文通过对比人类写作和机器生成文本的熵流特性提出了新的检测方法。

Method: 作者利用熵和相对峰突出率的概念，设计了一种新的检测方法来区分人类和机器生成的文本。

Result: 在各种模型和数据集上进行的实验表明，RelPPR 指标在黑盒环境中实现了最先进的检测性能，且具有很好的通用性。

Conclusion: 新提出的 RelPPR 指标为零样本检测机器生成文本提供了一个有效的方法，并在实际应用中保持了很高的可靠性。

Abstract: Zero-shot detection of machine-generated text is vital for mitigating the risks of large language models (LLMs) misuse. While the state-of-the-art dual-model detectors and resampling-based detectors outperform single-model statistical detectors on unprompted continuations, they suffer a catastrophic breakdown on instruction-conditioned text in the black-box setting, where the source model is unknown. We analyze this failure and trace it to poor prompt conditioning for resampling-based methods and diminished cross-model discrepancy for dual-model detectors. Motivated by recent studies that human writing maintains a steady, uniform information flow, whereas machine-generated text exhibits sharp, localized entropy fluctuations, we propose a new metric, the Relative Peak Prominence Rate (RelPPR) to capture this structural contrast along the entropy trajectory and further leverage it as a signal for LLM-generated text detection. Extensive evaluations across diverse model families and datasets demonstrate that RelPPR achieves state-of-the-art black-box detection performance and remains the most reliable detector under various practical situations. Our code is available at https://github.com/brushing-git/entropy-llm-detector.

</details>


### [465] [An actively trained neural operator for near-explicit atmospheric chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33771)
*Zhi-Song Liu,Wenqing Peng,Ammar Kheder,Michael Boy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FNO-MoE 是一种新型的神经运算模型，能够在单个调用中预测近完全明确的化学状态长达30分钟，并且能够自主选择最具信息性的箱模型模拟作为训练数据，从而提高预测能力，保持稳定性，并大幅提高计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的地球系统模型简化了大气化学过程，近完整的化学机制（如MCM）由于计算成本高昂而无法在每个网格单元中应用。FNO-MoE旨在解决这一问题，通过预测长时间窗口内的完整化学状态和自主选择训练数据来提高模型的准确性。

Method: FNO-MoE 模型结合了 Fourier 神经运算和混合专家机制。它能够预测长时间内的完整化学状态，并使用专家间的分歧来选择最具信息性的模拟作为训练数据。此外，该模型还通过自适应调整来保持长期运行的稳定性。

Result: FNO-MoE在保持准确性的前提下，显著提高了计算效率，并能够模拟数千种物种的变化。与随机或均匀采样相比，主动采样能使模拟更准确。经长期模拟验证，该模型在不同气象条件下保持了稳定性。

Conclusion: FNO-MoE为模拟复杂大气系统提供了一个新的方向，无需依赖复杂的化学过程，就能在长时间窗口内预测全面的化学状态，并具备自适应选择训练样本的能力。未来的工作将重点在于如何在多种气象条件下进行模型训练。

Abstract: Earth-system models simplify atmospheric chemistry into condensed mechanisms, because near-explicit mechanisms such as the Master Chemical Mechanism (MCM) are too costly to solve in every grid cell. Neural emulators could lift this limit, but most advance the chemistry in small time steps and cover only a few species or a reduced mechanism. Here we introduce FNO-MoE, a Fourier neural operator with a mixture of experts that predicts the full near-explicit chemical state over 30 minutes in a single call. The same network also guides its own training, using the disagreement among its experts to select the most informative box-model simulations. At equal cost, this active sampling yields a more accurate emulator than random or evenly spread sampling. Fine-tuning on longer trajectories keeps it stable over multi-hour runs in which models trained on short simulations diverge. The resulting emulator reproduces the evolution of thousands of species with high fidelity, remains accurate for unseen chemical compositions and runs orders of magnitude faster than the numerical solver. These results open a new direction for emulating complex atmospheric systems: neural operators that predict the full chemical state over long windows and choose their own training data. Training under changing meteorology is the next step towards bringing near-explicit chemistry into Earth-system models.

</details>


### [466] [The Hitchhiker's Guide to System 1 Models: Fast Decision-Making Beyond LLMS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33775)
*Haggai Roitman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文综述了快速决策模型领域的最新进展，涵盖了五大家族架构，并深入探讨了它们的训练方法、部署权衡和校准理论。该指南包含18个应用领域、开源生态系统的概述以及一系列自评估问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大型语言模型在推理和生成方面表现优异，但在许多需要亚秒级延迟的日常决策任务（如路由、门控、评分、分类）中，由于其逐个 token 的自回归推理机制，它们表现得过于缓慢和昂贵，且未能很好地校准这些决策。因此，有必要提出一系列快速决策模型架构来优化这些场景。

Method: 该论文构建了一个包含五大家族的分类体系，包括编码器分类器、奖励模型、非自回归决策引擎、对比决策模型和提取模型。深入了解了每个家族的架构设计、训练方法和部署时的权衡。介绍了校准理论的重要原理，如适当的评分规则，以及用于校准决策的强化学习方法。此外，还探讨了几个新发现的现象，如独立性假设失效、序数尺度偏差以及分布变化下的少量样本重新校准。

Result: 该指南深入分析了快速决策模型的优点，并就如何将 System 1 模型无缝融入到有代理性的工作流程中，以及如何结合快速和慢速模型提出了建议。此外，还介绍了 18 个应用领域，涵盖了快速决策模型可能涉及的广泛行业。同时，提供了一系列自评估问题及其详细答案，以帮助读者更好地理解相关概念并进行实践。

Conclusion: 这篇指南为目标领域的研究者和工程师提供了一个统一的入手点，帮助他们解决快速决策模型在大规模生产环境中的校准问题，并更好地整合这些模型以提高决策效率。最终，它还揭示了一条道路，可以在速度和准确性和效率之间找到更好的平衡。

Abstract: Large Language Models excel at reasoning and generation but their autoregressive, token-by-token inference makes them unnecessarily slow, expensive, and poorly calibrated for the many routine decisions (routing, gating, scoring, classification) that modern AI systems require at sub-second latency. A growing class of models addresses this gap: System 1 decision models, architectures that map an input directly to a typed, structured decision in a single forward pass. This guide provides a comprehensive, practitioner-oriented treatment of the field. We propose a five-family taxonomy covering encoder-based classifiers, reward models, non-autoregressive decision engines, contrastive decision models, and extraction models, and we provide in-depth coverage of each family's architecture, training methodology, and deployment trade-offs. A central theme is calibration: we develop the theory of proper scoring rules, analyze Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD), and examine recently discovered phenomena including IIA violations, ordinal-scale bias, and few-shot recalibration under distribution shift. On the integration side, we describe how System 1 models serve as decision infrastructure within agentic workflows and System 1 + System 2 cascades that route between fast and slow models based on calibrated confidence. The guide covers 18 application domains, maps the rapidly growing open-source ecosystem (over 70 model reproductions in weeks), provides runnable code throughout, and includes a practitioner's checklist, an open-source model zoo, and 22 self-assessment questions with detailed answers. Spanning 190 references, it is intended as a unified entry point for researchers and engineers working at the intersection of fast decision-making, calibration, and production AI systems.

</details>


### [467] [InfiniteWorld: Separating Visual Evidence from Familiar Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33777)
*Tong Zhang,Yuxuan Cheng,Yun Peng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: InfiniteWorld 是一个基准测试，旨在评估物理推理能力，它通过系统地改变模拟器的物理参数，强调熟悉物理规则与视觉证据之间的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试虽然能够展示广泛的物理能力，但它们无法清楚地表明模型是否仅依赖熟悉的物理规则而非观察到的视觉证据来回答物理推理问题。InfiniteWorld旨在填补这一空白。

Method: InfiniteWorld 通过结合模拟器、场景筛选、视频配对翻译、问题构建和输入检查，生成一系列被系统地改变物理参数的模拟器视频。它包含五个任务，分别用于评估自然法则识别、参数估计、时间推理、分析的反事实对比和自然法则归纳。

Result: 在这些设定下评估了一组多样化的视频-语言模型，结果显示，这些模型普遍偏好熟悉物理规则。大多数模型从帧中受益，但不同任务的表现不同。在正常地球条件下表现出的强大准确性并不代表对改变中的物理动态的良好识别，并且当观察到的物理变化时，地球典型答案还是常见。

Conclusion: InfiniteWorld 通过配对方式测量与相同问题相关联的不同证据的变化，能够区分视觉证据与熟悉物理规则。这一基准有助于进一步区分模型如何匹配物理因素及其数量，以及如何正确回答与重复错误。

Abstract: Physical reasoning requires adapting familiar expectations to the dynamics of the observed world. Existing benchmarks establish broad physical capabilities, yet an overall score leaves unclear whether answers follow visual evidence when familiar rules no longer apply. We introduce InfiniteWorld, a benchmark that pairs physical-reasoning questions with simulator videos whose physical parameters are systematically altered. Its generation pipeline connects simulation, scene screening, paired video translation, question construction, and input checks. Five tasks assess law identification, parameter estimation, temporal reasoning, analytic counterfactual comparison, and law induction. The evaluation defines five matched input settings for each question, comprising text-only evaluation and ordered or shuffled observations from simulator and translated videos. We evaluate a diverse set of video-language models under these matched settings. The results expose a persistent preference for familiar physical rules. Frames improve performance for most models, but gains differ across tasks. Strong accuracy on Earth-normal questions coexists with poor recognition of altered dynamics, and Earth-normal answers remain common when the observed physics changes. Task scores and semantic agreement further distinguish matching physical factors from matching their amount, and correct answers from repeated errors. InfiniteWorld makes these behaviors measurable through paired changes in the evidence supplied for the same question, separating visual evidence from familiar physics.

</details>


### [468] [Unlocking the Specialization Capability of PPG Foundation Models for Wearable Signals through Structured Pruning and Adaptive Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33788)
*Huaming Du,Zhixian Xie,Gaoyang Zhen,Gang Kou,Guisong Liu,Yanchao Tan,Wendan Tao,Yuhao Xu,Carl Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究提出了一种精简-微调框架SPAFT，通过结构化剪枝和微调，提高PPG基础模型在不同PPG数据上的预测任务性能，实验结果显示在回归和分类任务上分别达到了82.8%和87.5%的胜出率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PPG基础模型难以适应稀疏且低质量的实际数据，无法在真实世界临床场景中表现优异。

Method: SPAFT框架通过剪枝减少参数冗余，将可变微调过程限制在基于参数重要性和结构冗余更加相关且紧凑的参数空间中。

Result: SPAFT框架在四种PPG基础模型，五个基准数据集和十个下游任务上的广泛实验中表现出优异性能，特别是在回归和分类任务上的胜出率分别为82.8%和87.5%。

Conclusion: 该框架为PPG基础模型在实际临床场景中的部署和个性化开发奠定了基础。

Abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) plays a central role in wearable health monitoring and clinical decision support. However, existing approaches to universal PPG representation learning are predominantly trained on high-quality large-scale datasets obtained from oximeters in hospital settings and often struggle to adapt to sparse and low-quality real-world datasets, thereby limiting their generalization to clinically relevant tasks on prevalent PPG data such as collected from wearable devices. Surprisingly, even after full fine-tuning, PPG foundation models cannot consistently outperform general-purpose time-series models. Therefore, a key question is how to effectively adapt PPG foundation models to target prediction tasks. Through empirical studies on various PPG foundation models, we find that pretrained models often exhibit inherent sparsity and computational redundancy, suggesting that PPG foundation models have learned to activate task-relevant network substructures for different prediction tasks. To preserve this valuable prior knowledge, we propose a structured pruning-and-fine-tuning framework, SPAFT, which regularizes the adaptive fine-tuning process by constraining it to a more relevant and compact parameter space based on parameter importance and structural redundancy. Extensive experiments across four PPG foundation models, five benchmark datasets, and ten downstream tasks demonstrate that SPAFT achieves win rates of 82.8% and 87.5% on regression and classification tasks, respectively. This prune-then-finetune paradigm often enables PPG foundation models to achieve state-of-the-art performance, laying a promising foundation for the real-world clinical deployment of PPG foundation models and the development of personalized PPG foundation models.

</details>


### [469] [Are We Done with UMLS Injection into Language Models for Medical Question Answering?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33801)
*Yiran Zeng,Giacomo Frisoni,Lorenzo Molfetta,Gianluca Moro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文回顾了现有的医疗问答工作，批判性地分析了所选的UMLS来源及其与语言模型的使用方式，并单独探查了这些选择中的每一个。我们发现了先前工作中从未讨论的方法论问题，如低UMLS覆盖率和弱子图检索管道。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鉴于UMLS作为医疗问答（MQA）基准测试中的知识图谱源为语言模型的准确性和可推理性提供了支持，但实证研究显示其带来的性能提高有限。因此，本文旨在审查现有的MQA工作，分析UMLS的选择及其使用方式的方法论问题，以揭示其潜力。

Method: 文章首先回顾了现有的MQA工作，然后批判性地分析了所选的UMLS来源及其使用方式，并逐一研究了这些选择。最后，基于研究发现，提出了利用UMLS外部知识源来实现潜在价值的实用建议。

Result: 本文发现了方法论问题，例如较低的UMLS覆盖率和弱子图检索管道，并据此提出了实用建议，以充分发挥UMLS作为外部知识源的潜力。

Conclusion: 尽管UMLS是一个强大的知识资源，但其在改善基于语言模型的医疗问答系统中的使用仍存在诸多方法论挑战。为了最大化UMLS的价值，开发者应认识到这些挑战，并相应调整其策略。

Abstract: Maybe not. The Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) has become an oracle for millions of clinicians and health system developers worldwide. Researchers have increasingly used knowledge graphs derived from UMLS to enhance language models' factual accuracy and reasoning traceability in high-stakes tasks. Medical Question Answering (MQA) is a prime testbed for integration, with benchmarks usually involving professional exercises such as disease diagnosis and drug prescription from patient history. Despite the assumed benefits, empirical evidence shows that UMLS-based graph injection typically yields modest performance gains. This paper reviews existing MQA work, critically analyzing the selected UMLS sources and their usage with language models, and probes each of these choices in isolation. We uncover methodological issues never discussed in prior work, from low UMLS coverage to weak subgraph retrieval pipelines. Based on our findings, we provide actionable recommendations to unlock the untapped potential of UMLS as an external knowledge source.

</details>


### [470] [Beyond Static Structures: Linking Protein Dynamics to Function via DynaReason-Pro](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33804)
*Zhaokang Liang,Mingze Yuan,Quanzheng Li,Wengong Jin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DynaReason-Pro 是首个结合构象异质集合预测 GO 术语并生成自然语言功能推理解释的框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大多数蛋白质功能预测方法依赖于序列或单一静态结构，而内在无序蛋白通过动态构象来实现其功能，为此我们引入了 DynaReason-Pro 框架来更好地理解和预测无序蛋白的功能。

Method: 该方法通过变异分层评估在高构象变异性区间显示出最佳表现，采用 PED 数据库中筛选的无序蛋白基准进行评估，确保无结构聚类数据泄露。

Result: DynaReason-Pro 在高构象变异性区间显示出显著的优势。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，DynaReason-Pro 能够更准确地预测无序蛋白的功能，并提供相应的自然语言解釋。

Abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) carry out their functions through heterogeneous conformational ensembles that reflect their dynamics, yet most protein function prediction methods rely on sequence or a single static structure. To this end, we introduce DynaReason-Pro, the first framework to jointly predict GO terms from conformational ensembles and generate natural-language functional rationales. We evaluate DynaReason-Pro on a curated IDP benchmark from the Protein Ensemble Database (PED), with sequence- and structure-cluster-disjoint splits to prevent data leakage. Variability-stratified evaluation shows the clearest gains in the high-conformational-variability regime.

</details>


### [471] [Rectified Language Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33811)
*Baiyu Su,Runlong Liao,Lizhang Chen,Qiang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReLF通过将噪声转化为token嵌入实现文本生成，通过固定token嵌入构建、自我条件指导训练以及正则化重流等方法优化，展示了在保持多样性的前提下与自回归模型相当的生成质量，同时对于更短的计算预算具有显著优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的自回归模型虽然生成质量高，但速度慢且不支持并行计算。连续流和扩散模型可以提高速度和并行性，但难以达到自回归模型的生成质量。因此，研究提出了ReLF以改进生成质量并保持效率。

Method: ReLF 使用修正的语言流方法，结合固定token嵌入构建、自我条件指导训练以及正则化重流等技术。引入了奇异基，结合了分析计算项和有界神经剩余项，以驱动对于有效token嵌入的承诺并学习上下文token偏好。

Result: 在OpenWebText数据集上，ReLF使用64个函数评估，实现了比自回归基线更低的生成困惑度，同时保持相同的多样性。与之前的连续流方法相比，在此情境下也表现出更好的性能。使用两次重流，ReLF以16个函数评估仍优于自回归基线，同时生成1,024个标记序列的速度快15-19倍。

Conclusion: 研究表明，ReLF在保持自回归模型生成质量的同时提高了速度和效率，展现了在大规模文本生成任务中的应用潜力。

Abstract: Continuous-state flow and diffusion models offer a promising approach to fast, parallel language generation, but matching the generation quality of autoregressive models remains challenging. We present Rectified Language Flow (ReLF), a language model that generates text by transporting noise to token embeddings using rectified flow. ReLF combines several complementary design choices: fixed token embeddings constructed with Hellinger-SVD, self-conditioning guidance trained with cross-entropy, and regularized reflow for few-step generation. We further introduce singular logits, which combine an analytically computed term that drives commitment to a valid token embedding as noise vanishes with a bounded neural residual that learns contextual token preferences. With 64 function evaluations on OpenWebText, ReLF achieves lower generative perplexity than autoregressive baselines at matched diversity across all three model sizes tested, while also outperforming prior continuous flow methods in this setting. After two reflow rounds, ReLF still outperforms autoregressive baselines with 16 function evaluations while generating 1,024-token sequences 15-19 times faster at batch size 1.

</details>


### [472] [EnvLunch: The Environment as a Free Lunch for Learning to Interact](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33817)
*Wei Liu,Min Gao,Yali Du,Yulan He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EnvLunch 提出了一种无需人工标注任务描述的预训练方法，通过环境反馈训练语言模型，改善了下游基于代理的强化学习表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 环境提供了丰富的交互结构和可验证的成果，无需人工标注即可用于训练语言模型。

Method: EnvLunch 通过收集环境中的有效动作轨迹，执行动作并基于最终观察值训练模型，实现无需标注的任务预训练。

Result: 该方法在所有下游训练预算上平均超出基线模型 9 分以上，且在少量标注数据下，基线模型需要 8 到 32 倍的数量才能达到相同的准确度。

Conclusion: 这种让环境定义任务的方法，比让模型自行定义任务更有效，还能改善基于代理的模型微调，特别是在标注任务受限的情况下。

Abstract: For agentic data analysis, language-model agents often require a large number of annotated tasks to learn how to interact effectively with executable environments (i.e., databases). While high-quality annotated tasks require heavy manual effort, an executable environment already provides rich interaction structure and verifiable outcomes. In this sense, the environment itself offers a free lunch, an additional set of verifiable tasks that require no human annotation. We propose EnvLunch, a warm-up stage that turns this environmental signal into agent training without human-written or model-generated task descriptions, before downstream agentic reinforcement learning. EnvLunch samples valid action trajectories, executes them to obtain final observations, and trains an agent to recover a functionally equivalent trajectory given only its final observation. This label-free warm-up enables the model to outperform the baseline by over 9 points on average across all downstream training budgets, and with few labels, the baseline needs 8 to 32 times as many annotated examples to match the accuracy that the EnvLunch model reaches at its smallest training budget. Letting the environment alone define the task yields a larger gain than having the model write its own tasks over the same environments, and this warm-up also improves fine-tuning on benchmarks beyond data analysis. EnvLunch therefore saves annotated tasks and provides a better starting point for fine-tuning agentic models when such tasks are limited.

</details>


### [473] [Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop a Hearthstone Battlegrounds AI That Rivals Top Players](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33845)
*Changlian Ma,Limin Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoTavern，一个自我改进的研究系统，在20天内构建了TavernGym，忠实再现了Hearthstone Battlegrounds的完整内容，并通过PPO算法训练出多个TavernAgent版本。TavernAgent在实际匹配中的排名显著提升，表现出色，在TavernBench基准测试中展示了强大的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究探索自然语言生成模型（LLM）的能力，验证其是否能够处理复杂且真实的任务，特别是在竞争性环境中。通过构建AutoTavern，实现了从数据直接到真实系统建设的过程。

Method: AutoTavern采用了一种特殊的研究系统，其中LLM研究代理共享类型化的研究记忆，每项声明需通过验证门，同时通过与真实游戏的闭环互动来改进模拟器、对手和策略，以及自身的研究过程。系统还包含了一个具有960个任务的TavernBench基准测试。

Result: 在20天内成功开发了TavernGym，实现了Hearthstone Battlegrounds的完整复制。TavernAgent在实际游戏中的表现超过了现有的最先进LLM，并且在TavernBench基准测试中表现出色。

Conclusion: 研究表明，LLM在构建复杂系统的实际能力超过了它们在游戏中的表现，为未来的研究和应用提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Can LLM agents carry a hard real-world problem from raw data to a system that holds its own against people? We study this in Hearthstone Battlegrounds, an eight-player auto-battler with stochastic shops and battles, hidden information and nearly a thousand interacting cards. We present AutoTavern, a self-improving research system: specialised LLM research agents share a typed research memory, every claim passes verification gates, and live games close the loop, so the agents improve the simulator, opponents and policy and, from the same feedback, their own research process; a human sets goals and rules on ambiguous mechanics. In 20 days AutoTavern built TavernGym, the first faithful, full-content reproduction of the live game, and delivered 23 versions of TavernAgent, trained with PPO against opponents calibrated to real games. TavernAgent plays complete games on the live ladder by itself: its rating rose from 6,000 to about 15,000 and, on the public leaderboard's measure, its last 20 records average a placement of 1.60 with 80% first places, better than the server's ten highest-rated players on every statistic (2.34, 59%). TavernBench, 960 tasks in 40 scenarios, shows that the system the agents built is the strongest player: TavernAgent answers 91% of the play tasks against at most 63% for frontier LLMs, and decides in 0.03 s where they need up to 26 s; within the second a live turn allows, it keeps 90% and no LLM more than 26%. LLM agents build far better than they play. We will open-source TavernBench and TavernGym at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/AutoTavern.

</details>


### [474] [Numina Fuse: Interactive Autoformalization in Lean 4](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33860)
*Justin Asher,Yichuan Cao,Ruichen Qiu,Pietro Pellegrino,Jia Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Numina Fuse 是一种以代理为中心的应用程序，用于在Lean 4中形式化数学。该工具旨在解决Lean在编译时不反映其预期的非正式意义的问题，同时提高代理编写Lean的速度。Fuse通过人工监督代理工作，结合项目蓝图视图、依赖图视图和Lean代码视图来实现这一目标。它从固定的代理流水线发展到自动调度专家、验证器和子代理的orchestrator。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于Lean编译时无法正确表示其预期的非正式意义，而代理编写Lean的速度远超人类阅读速度，因此需要一种工具来处理代理的工作并提供人类监督。

Method: Fuse通过一个AI调度器来管理Lean项目。调度器通过项目蓝图视图、依赖图视图和Lean代码视图提供给用户透明的监督视图。后台保持项目的衍生状态，并在用户缺席时运行代理。

Result: Numina Fuse被用于验证三维Kakeya猜想和研究证明器模型。该系统展示了代理如何在模型改进的情况下接管更多工作。

Conclusion: Numina Fuse的设计为下一代自动形式化系统提供了经验教训，强调了保持项目状态、工具和界面设计独立于调度的重要性。

Abstract: Numina Fuse is an agent-native application for formalizing mathematics in Lean 4. Since Lean can compile while not representing its intended informal meaning, and agents now write Lean faster than people can read it, we built Fuse around human supervision of agent work. A user works with an AI orchestrator on a Lean project and supervises it through views of the blueprint, the dependency graph, and the Lean code, while the backend keeps the project's derived state and runs agents for hours without the user present. We describe the development of Fuse throughout 2026, as it moved from a prescribed pipeline of agents paced by human review to an orchestrator that dispatches specialists, provers, and parallel children on its own. We designed for this shift, keeping project state, tooling, and interface design separate from orchestration so that agents could take over more of the work as models improved. We report Fuse's use in a formalization of the three-dimensional Kakeya conjecture and a study of prover models. We close with lessons for the next generation of autoformalization systems. Fuse Desktop, an open-source local version, is available at https://github.com/project-numina/fuse-desktop.

</details>


### [475] [ReGE: Stronger Agents through Experience Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33861)
*Jiarong Liang,Yubo Wang,Zijie Liu,Yuxuan Zhang,Ping Nie,Wenhu Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReGE框架通过将先前执行记录和可用资源合成成为自我指导，提升了任务准确度，并减少了指导生成的令牌数量，特别适用于交互任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前交互任务需要不断尝试才能获取有用信息，并且这些信息常被忽视。为了解决这个问题，作者提出了ReGE框架，以利用过去的执行经历指导未来的执行。这种方法有助于提升任务完成的效率和准确性。

Method: 该方法首先从先前的执行记录中提取关键信息，然后将其与当前任务相关联。实现方式为ReGE-Syn模型，使用一个教练函数来共同合成有限的执行记录和可用资源，生成用于任务执行的自我指导。模型仅用于生成和合成，而不进行任何参数更新或依赖更强的教师。

Result: 实验结果显示，使用ReGE进行任务执行的准确度比未指导执行提高了平均9.9个百分点（对于GPT）和8.8个百分点（对于Claude）。特别是在匹配的BrowseComp-Plus子集上，ReGE-Syn将指导生成的令牌数量减少了98.2%（对于GPT）和95.5%（对于Claude），并且减少了15.7%和35.4%的构造和执行令牌。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，智能代理可以通过利用自己过去的执行经历来改善未来的任务完成，而且这种方法为合并并行智能代理系统的执行记录提供了一种经济高效的方法，特别是在任务执行记录众多的情况下。

Abstract: Repeated attempts at interactive tasks uncover facts, useful operations, and failures that can inform subsequent execution. We introduce ReGE, a framework for turning this recorded experience into guidance for a fresh attempt. Its main implementation, ReGE-Syn, uses a single coach call to jointly synthesize bounded execution records and available artifacts into self-contained guidance, connecting task-specific findings with proposed actions and relevant pitfalls. A student starts from the task's initial environment state and adapts this guidance to current observations. Source generation, synthesis, and student execution use the same base model, without parameter updates or a stronger teacher. Across four benchmarks, ReGE improves accuracy by an average of 9.9 percentage points for GPT and 8.8 percentage points for Claude compared with unguided execution. On matched BrowseComp-Plus subsets, ReGE-Syn reduces guidance-construction tokens by 98.2\% on GPT and 95.5\% on Claude relative to adapted AggAgent, with observed success. Combined construction and execution tokens decrease by 15.7\% and 35.4\%, respectively, counting input plus output and excluding source generation. BrowseComp-Plus ablations further associate access to process information with fewer student steps and show that joint synthesis produces substantially shorter guidance than Direct history or Independent summaries, with observed success. These results demonstrate how agents can use their own recorded experience to improve subsequent task completion, and suggest a low-cost way to consolidate the execution records of parallel agent systems such as agent swarms.

</details>


### [476] [OS-Wizard: Scaling Computer-Using Agents to Specialized Software via Knowledge-Guided Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33907)
*Zhoumianze Liu,Zichen Ding,Bowen Yang,Zehao Li,Zhenyu Wu,Yibo Zhao,Kanzhi Chen,Yian Wang,Yanan Sun,Qiushi Sun,Yu Qiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种名为OS-Wizard的自动化轨迹收集框架，该框架通过结合导引探索和混合GUI-代码操作空间，收集了大量针对特定桌面应用的高质量交互轨迹，提升了在特定及通用桌面任务上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着计算机使用代理的复杂任务能力增强，然而对于专业化桌面应用程序，由于缺乏应用知识、繁琐的GUI流程和不完整的探索，高质量的交互轨迹依然稀缺。因此，作者引入了OS-Wizard框架来解决这些问题。

Method: OS-Wizard框架结合了教程引导探索和混合GUI-代码操作空间，执行应用本地命令直接操作，以简化GUI流程并收集关键状态节点，通过树探索中检查点回访，扩展线性滚出，增强覆盖面。

Result: 该框架成功收集了10,900条轨迹，包含54,900个状态-动作样本。使用这些数据集微调开源基础模型提高了特定桌面工作流程的基准性能58.2%，达到64.1%，超越了报告的59.8%的人类表现，设定了一项新标准，同时在只使用GUI动作的通用桌面任务上也提升了性能。

Conclusion: OS-Wizard框架证明了轨迹收集的有效性，并强调了代码行动的重要性，为自动化代理在其任务上实现更好的性能提供了一种可能的方法。

Abstract: Computer-using agents are increasingly capable of performing complex tasks in the digital world. However, high-quality interaction trajectories remain scarce for specialized desktop applications, where limited application knowledge, cumbersome GUI workflows, and incomplete exploration hinder automated collection. We introduce OS-Wizard, an automated trajectory collection framework. It combines tutorial-guided exploration with a hybrid GUI--Code action space, providing application-specific knowledge and simplifying GUI workflows through direct execution of application-native commands. The framework also checkpoints and revisits pivotal states during tree exploration to explore alternative workflows, complementing linear rollouts for broader coverage. We collect 10.9K trajectories comprising 54.9K state--action samples. Fine-tuning open-source base models on this corpus yields a best-performing model that improves performance on a benchmark of specialized desktop workflows by 58.2 percentage points to 64.1\%, surpassing reported human performance of 59.8\% and establishing a new state of the art. The fine-tuned model also improves performance on general desktop workflows using GUI actions only, suggesting that the collected supervision benefits general desktop tasks as well. Comparative experiments and ablations demonstrate the efficiency of trajectory collection and the importance of code actions.

</details>


### [477] [WebViSE: Scaling Visual Design Intelligence from the Open Web for LLM Website Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33929)
*Yifei Sun,Peng Zhao,Le Zhang,Bingjin Chen,Zhengfan Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WebViSE框架从现有的网站实现中自动提取和组织视觉技能，并构建了一个结构化的技能库，此框架能够提升网站构建模型的视觉质量与交互准确性，且成本仅为非层次化LLM检索基线的39.09%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非专家用户难以用自然语言描述复杂的视觉和交互设计，而WebViSE旨在解决这一问题，通过自动化提取和组织网站中的视觉技能，提供更高效的设计指导。

Method: WebViSE框架利用技能条件化的潜在查询来共同进化技能描述和多父DAG结构，从而实现不同用户指令与相关技能之间的高效匹配。

Result: WebViSE框架能够克服非层次化LLM检索基线，成本仅为39.09%，并且在多个网页开发基准和人类评估中证明，能够提高视觉质量和交互准确性。开放源代码模型还可以利用WebViSE内置视觉设计智能到模型权重中。

Conclusion: WebViSE为从开放网络中提取、组织和转移设计智能提供了自动化路径，我们发布了所有提取的视觉技能、相关技能DAG和代码供开源模型使用。

Abstract: Large language models have made remarkable strides in website development, enabling complete and interactive web experiences to be built from natural-language instructions with far less effort. Yet, non-expert users often struggle to articulate sophisticated visual and interaction designs in natural language. Meanwhile, the open web already contains a vast reservoir of such design knowledge, embodied in mature website implementations. To this end, we introduce Website-derived Visual Skill Extraction (WebViSE), a framework that automatically abstracts these implementations into reusable Visual Skills and builds a structured Skill library. To scale the library, WebViSE organizes its Skills in a multi-parent DAG and jointly evolves Skill descriptions and DAG structure using Skill-conditioned Potential Queries, enabling efficient matching between diverse user instructions and relevant Skills. The auto-evolved structure outperforms non-hierarchical LLM retrieval baselines at only 39.09% of the estimated retrieval cost with Qwen3.8-Max. For any models, WebViSE can be directly injected as plug-and-play guidance, enabling diverse models to produce more visually compelling and aesthetically refined web pages. For open-source models, WebViSE can be used to build a data-synthesis pipeline that internalizes visual design intelligence into model weights. Experiments across multiple web development benchmarks and human evaluation consistently show that WebViSE improves the visual quality and interaction fidelity of artifacts. Overall, our work establishes an automated path for extracting, organizing, and transferring design intelligence from the open web to website-building models. We release all extracted Visual Skills, the associated Skill DAG, and our code at https://github.com/YifeiSun-0710/WebViSE.

</details>


### [478] [Fed-Universe: A Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) Stack for Negotiated Alignment in Federated Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34009)
*Ting Xu,Henry Leung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了Fed-Universe框架，通过一个多层的S-G-T-H架构，重新定义了联邦学习的优化策略，旨在解决跨站点异质性带来的小众用户被抑制问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的联邦学习方法倾向于优化全局均值，忽视了跨站点间的数据异质性差异，这使得小众数据点容易被主导数据点所掩盖和抑制。因此，需要一个新的框架来解决这一问题。

Method: Fed-Universe框架包括S(语义)、G(几何质量保障)、T(拓扑Pareto控制)和H(认知孪生动态)四个层面，每个层面都设计了特定的机制来优化联邦学习过程。

Result: 通过在双语合成临床网络模拟中验证S-G-T核心，证明了该框架的有效性：少数节点即使拥有＜3％的数据量，也能达到与显著主节点相同的效用（损失从0.857降至0.340）。

Conclusion: 这种多模态和个性化意识的联邦学习架构提供了一种潜在的新方法，用于改善在具有噪声和异质数据环境中进行联邦学习的能力。该架构被进一步扩展为Fed-Ultra和Fed-Human框架。

Abstract: Conventional federated learners implicitly optimize for global means, creating a "one-size-fits-all" paradigm that inevitably suppresses the minority under cross-site heterogeneity. To bridge this critical gap, we present Fed-Universe, a generalizable Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) architecture that transforms passive averaging into an active negotiation for decentralized alignment. The S-layer deploys an edge-capable LLM as a semantic surrogate to translate heterogeneous inputs into standardized patient profile prompts. The G-layer enforces geometric quality assurance (GQA) via a mapping f: Theta -> Q from the statistical parameter space to a physically interpretable quality domain, employing a cosine similarity gate to retain minority updates based on physical geometry rather than statistical proximity. The T-layer executes topological Pareto control, identifying a sensitivity-based knee point (lambda_k) to balance multi-objective aggregation without majority degradation. Finally, the H-layer operationalizes a cognitive twin dynamic to mirror the user's real-time psychological state, dynamically adapting human-computer interaction modes via active intent alignment. To ground this theoretical architecture empirically, we validated the S-G-T core on a binational synthetic clinical network simulation. This proof-of-concept demonstrated a "zero-sum escape": a minority node (<3% data volume) achieved utility parity (loss reduction from 0.857 to 0.340) alongside dominant hubs. Our Fed-Universe framework is being expanded along two focused pillars: institutional multimodal alignment (Fed-Ultra) and individual cognitive intent alignment (Fed-Human).

</details>


### [479] [From Document Layout to Causal Topology: An End-to-End Architecture for Temporal Causal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34094)
*Zhifeng Yang,Wei Luo,Yongjian Chen,Shiqi Ou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的因果拓扑推理框架，通过构建神经符号训练-free 模型 TCR-Agent 和端到端模型 TCR-Former，显著提高了因果推理能力，在 TempoCausal 基准测试中超过现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鉴于大型语言模型缺乏深度因果推理能力，本文旨在通过引入因果拓扑推理方法改善模型在时间推理方面的不足。

Method: 文章构建了两种因果拓扑推理架构：一个训练-free 框架 TCR-Agent 和一个端到端模型 TCR-Former。TCR-Agent 通过外部因果图实例化和符号干预引擎实现可解释的因果推理和反事实修剪。TCR-Former 则通过因果拓扑注意力掩模和时间跨度偏置将这些机制内置于 Transformer 的注意力空间。

Result: 实验表明，TCR-Agent 在 TempoCausal 基准测试中全面超过了现有的训练-free 基线。而 TCR-Former 的准确率比当前最先进的方法高出 16.5%，仅使用约 8.6B 参数便超越了 GPT-5.4 和 DeepSeek-V3.2。进一步分析揭示了现有方法中存在的结构-推理断点问题：外部符号约束和思维过程推理虽能提高推理步骤，却无法增强深度因果演绎能力。

Conclusion: 通过将时间因果推理能力内置于模型中，TCR-Former 不仅克服了现有方法中的结构-推理差异，还在复杂推理场景中提供了高效可靠的端到端基础。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generally lack deep causal reasoning capabilities in temporal reasoning. Inspired by document layout reordering, this paper proposes a paradigm shift from discrete narratives to causal topologies. It constructs two architectures: a training-free neuro-symbolic framework, temporal causal reasoning agent (TCR-Agent), which achieves interpretable causal deduction and counterfactual truncation through external causal graph instantiation and a symbolic intervention engine; and an end-to-end model, temporal causal reasoning former (TCR-Former), which internalizes these mechanisms into the Transformer attention space via a Causal-Topological Attention Mask and temporal span biases. Experiments on the TempoCausal benchmark demonstrate that TCR-Agent comprehensively surpasses existing training-free baselines. At the same time, TCR-Former achieves an accuracy 16.5% higher than that of state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, outperforming large-scale models such as GPT-5.4 and DeepSeek-V3.2 with only approximately 8.6B parameters. Further analysis reveals a structure-reasoning disconnection phenomenon in existing methods: external symbolic constraints and chain-of-thought reasoning can improve reasoning steps, yet fail to enhance deep causal deductive capability. By internalizing temporal causal reasoning capabilities into the model, TCR-Former effectively bridges this gap, providing an efficient and reliable end-to-end foundation for complex reasoning scenarios.

</details>


### [480] [Can LLMs Trust Appropriately? Evaluating Calibrated Reliance on Imperfect Partners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34107)
*Mengdi Chu,Jintao Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过构建324个协作场景，考察语言模型在与人类及AI伙伴协作时如何根据证据调整信任策略，发现尽管最前沿模型接近最优决策，但其他模型仍存在过度防御、验证无价值信息、优先短期收益等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机在于探索语言模型在与人类和AI伙伴协作时如何根据收集到的证据调整信任策略，以促进有效的合作。

Method: 开发了包含324个场景的基准数据集，涵盖23类合作关系，每个场景涉及三个顺序决策，有明确的转化动态、反馈发出和成本计划，使决策可精确计算其预期后果。

Result: 最前沿模型接近最优决策，其他模型则表现出过度防御、验证低价值信息、忽视合作学习和助力不当等问题。

Conclusion: 研究表明，真正意义上的信任依赖需要将实证证据与前瞻决策收益相结合，以确保有效的协作和决策。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly collaborate with humans and peer AI agents whose contributions may be incomplete, inconsistent, or incorrect. Effective collaboration requires calibrated trust, whereby decisions to rely on, verify, or assist a partner adapt rationally as empirical evidence accumulates. We investigate whether models translate partner evidence into appropriate reliance policies. We introduce a benchmark of 324 scenarios across 23 collaboration categories. Each scenario involves three sequential decisions with explicit transition dynamics, feedback emissions, and cost schedules, permitting exact analytical evaluation of choices against their expected consequences over the remaining interaction. Evaluating seven models alongside 36 controlled-history probes, we dissociate evidence sensitivity from normatively appropriate action. While the strongest frontier model approaches near-optimal decisions, other models exhibit recurring pathologies: procuring excessive safeguards, purchasing verification tests with zero expected value of information, prioritizing immediate savings over cooperative learning, and misallocating assistance to suboptimal channels. Supplying explicit posterior distributions resolves certain errors while introducing new failure modes. Calibrated trust in autonomous agents critically demands coupling empirical evidence with forward-looking decision utility.

</details>


### [481] [Task Success Is Not Enough: Side-effect-Aware Evaluation of Tool-Using Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34167)
*Jiaju Huang,Shaobin Chen,Xinglong Liang,Xinyu Ma,Hao Yang,Wei Ke,Tao Tan,Yue Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究引入了SABench基准，用于评估工具使用语言模型代理在完成用户任务时是否会产生未授权的副作用。在2,211个模型-任务对中，15.2%的运行出现了这种未授权的副作用（称为‘附带损害’），并且在模糊任务中风险最高。不同模型之间的‘附带损害’发生率有显著差异，说明仅以任务成功为评价标准是不够的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前评估方法往往只关注任务是否完成，但忽略了未授权的干预行为。研究者认为需要开发一个基准来评估模型的副作用，以保障工具使用安全。

Method: 研究者构建了SABench基准，涵盖201个涉及电子邮件、日历和票务的跨工具和跨状态任务。每个任务都有一个确定性的基于追踪的仲裁机制来判断任务目标和授权合规性。

Result: 在2,211个模型-任务对中，15.2%的运行出现了附带损害，风险主要集中于模糊任务（错误率达38.8%），而非模糊任务平均错误率为8.4%。即使在满足任务目标的情况下，仍有12.8%的运行产生了未经授权的操作。在不同状态和跨工具的运行中，附带损害的发生率几乎翻倍，不同模型之间在相同任务成功率下的附带损害发生率也存在4.7倍的差异。

Conclusion: 研究结果显示，模型在任务完成的同时可能产生未授权的副作用。模型的附带损害发生率差异显著，任务成功率不能作为评估模型安全性的唯一标准。该基准的发布将有助于进一步研究和改进工具使用语言模型的副作用问题。

Abstract: Tool-using language model agents are usually evaluated by whether they finish the user's task. That metric misses a common failure: an agent can complete the requested work while also taking an unauthorized side-effecting action, such as writing to the wrong object, expanding the scope of the request, or contacting an unintended recipient. We call this failure mode collateral damage (CD). We introduce SABench (Side-effect-Aware Benchmark), a benchmark of 201 email, calendar, and ticket tasks. Each task crosses one of four state structures (independent, dependent, externally reachable, cross-tool) with one of four trap families (ambiguity, mis-targeting, cascade harm, overreach), and each task has a deterministic trace-based oracle for both goal satisfaction and authorization compliance. Across 2,211 model-task pairs from 11 frontier LLMs spanning major commercial and open model families, 15.2% of all runs incur CD, with risk concentrated in ambiguity tasks (38.8% violation rate) while non-ambiguous traps average 8.4% CD. Among goal-satisfied runs, 12.8% still produce unauthorized writes. Cross-tool and dependent states have about twice the CD rate of independent states. CD rates vary by 4.7x across models at comparable goal rates, which suggests that task success alone is a poor proxy for safe tool use. The SABench task corpus is released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Phaedrus/sabench; the traces, oracle, code, and analysis pipeline are released at https://github.com/hjj194/sabench-artifact.

</details>


### [482] [R2A-Sales: A Policy-Atom-Matched Benchmark for Rule-to-Action Gaps in Goal-Directed Sales Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34185)
*Yihua Qin,Jiajie Jerry Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: R2A-Sales 引入了一个针对语言模型在压力下的合规销售行动能力的新基准，通过实验验证了静态合规性和行动合规性之间的差距，并指出销售代理可靠性需要在实际行动层面进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前销售代理评估主要集中在静态和任务完成上，但实际部署中需要评估在面临商业压力时，模型能否选择符合规则的、基于工具的实际行动。因此，引入 R2A-Sales 来填补这一空白。

Method: R2A-Sales 使用了一种对照的方式，每个测试项都包括一个静态问题和共享同一政策原子版本的多轮销售情景，以此确保差异不归因于政策内容匹配问题。交互臂通过代码所有者账本验证了工具效应并评估了终端状态。同时，对多个模型配置进行测试。

Result: R2A-Sales 的数据显示，静态合规性接近满分，但行动合规性却很低，行动合规性差距高达 80.4 到 92.5 个百分点。这表明即使在无压力下达到高合规性，但在面对商业压力时，销售代理仍可能无法确保合规的实际行动。

Conclusion: R2A-Sales 提供了一种新的评估方法，强调销售代理不仅要在制定规则层面表现出色，更要在实际销售过程中确保合规性。必须在实际行动层面对销售代理的可靠性进行全面评估。

Abstract: LLM-based sales agents are often evaluated on static policy questions or task success, but deployment asks a sharper question: when a model can state a rule, will it choose compliant, tool-grounded actions under commercial pressure? We introduce R2A-Sales (Rule-to-Action), a policy-atom-matched benchmark for this question. Each item pairs a static probe with a multi-turn sales scenario sharing the same versioned policy atom, facts, evidence, behavioral constraints, and tool contract, so differences cannot be attributed to policy-content mismatch. In the interactive arm, a code-owned ledger verifies committed tool effects and terminal states; unsupported action claims receive no credit. We report static compliance $K$, grounded action compliance $A=\Pr(\text{safe terminal}\land\text{no hard violation}\land\text{non-echo})$, and the matched gap $G=K-A$. The frozen release spans three controlled Chinese-language sales domains, 24 policy atoms, 42 semantic cores, and 2,016 matched pairs. The confirmatory study audits 21,888 runs over 19 cores, covering eight backbones plus four Qwen3-8B prompt treatments (12 configurations). Static compliance is near ceiling $(K=89.9\%\text{--}99.1\%)$, yet eight-backbone action compliance is only $A=3.0\%\text{--}17.3\%$, giving $G=80.4\text{--}92.5$ percentage points. Since $A$ also requires safe termination, $G$ upper-bounds rule-to-action degradation rather than isolating pressure alone. No prompt-only treatment dominates all metrics. R2A-Sales shows that sales-agent reliability must be measured at committed action, not rule recital or task completion alone.

</details>


### [483] [MatOS: An Agent Operating System for Materials Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34203)
*Dingyang Lyu,Jing Gao,Zhonghao Chang,Jingjie Huang,Xiangran Cheng,Xin He,Yongda Huang,Zefeng Li,Jiahui Liu,Jian Wen,Feng Yu,Bonan Zhu,Yongheng Li,Hongwei Du,Baole Wei,Ziheng Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MatOS 提高了材料研究代理的能力，通过一个分层的科学资产图来组织数据、知识、工具、技能、角色和工作流，并通过具有科学检查的有状态自适应工作流来运行任务，以及基于执行记录和用户反馈进行资产进化，最终提高了代理的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前代理在材料研究中面临扩展新功能、保持长时间任务跟踪以及从过往任务和用户反馈学习的挑战。MatOS 解决了这些问题，并在多个基准测试中表现出色。

Method: MatOS 包含三个核心组件：分层的科学资产图（组织数据、知识、工具、技能、角色和工作流为可重用资产）、有状态自适应工作流（以科学检查为特征的任务执行图，确保任务可以恢复和追踪）以及基于证据的资产进化（根据执行记录和用户反馈对资产进行修订）

Result: MatOS 在 ResearchClawBench 上比之前最佳代理提高了 11.15%，在多个任务上超过了 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code，并在八项研究案例中取得了显着成果。

Conclusion: 组织研究能力作为可重用和进化的资产，使代理能够在材料研究中执行长期的多阶段研究。

Abstract: Materials research relies on scattered and growing data, knowledge, and simulation tools, and a single study often spans multi-day workflows across literature analysis, computation, and experiment. Large language model agents can now retrieve materials data, operate simulation codes, and close design-synthesis-characterization loops with autonomous laboratories. However, extending these agents with new capabilities, keeping long-running tasks on track, and letting them learn from past tasks and user feedback remain difficult. Here we present MatOS, an agent operating system for materials research with three core components: (1) a layered scientific asset graph that organizes data, knowledge, tools, skills, roles, and workflows as reusable assets; (2) a stateful adaptive workflow that runs tasks as explicit execution graphs with scientific checks, so that they can be resumed and traced; and (3) evidence-driven asset evolution, which revises these assets from execution records and user feedback. On ResearchClawBench, MatOS improves on the previously best-performing agent by 11.15% with the same base model and extends the cost-score Pareto frontier. With a common base model, it outperforms Codex CLI and Claude Code, exceeding Codex CLI by 2.13% on MatTools and 4.17% on SciAgentGym. In eight research cases, MatOS narrowed more than 30 million candidate structures to 97 solid-electrolyte candidates, identified 89 halide variants with higher computed conductivity than their parent structures, linked the force errors of 11 pretrained interatomic potentials to local atomic environments, and supported two new methods that reduce errors by 3.1% and 13.6% relative to their baselines. These results show that organizing research capabilities as reusable, evolving assets enables agents to carry out long, multistage materials studies. Code is available at https://github.com/DingyangLyu/MatOS.

</details>


### [484] [Variational Cognitive Memory Abstraction for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34251)
*Xinyu Liu,Daiying Tian,Chenwei Tang,Ruyang Han,Chengyang Zhang,Qingyu Zeng,Wei Ju,Liangli Zhen,Jiancheng Lv*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CogMemory 提出了一种新颖的可变认知记忆框架，通过选择性地保存和重复使用与任务相关的历史信息，增强 VLA 系统处理长期任务的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 VLA 模型在执行长期任务时受到长期记忆建模不足的限制，现有的方法要么依赖于可能逐渐稀释历史信息的隐式时间表示，要么保持显式的记忆缓冲区，但这些缓冲区存在冗余、噪声累积和检索效率低下的问题。

Method: CogMemory 采用选择性状态空间记忆编码器、多槽时域抽象和变分信息压缩来将多模态轨迹编码成紧凑的潜在记忆表示。在行为生成期间，动态跨注意力检索与门控融合进行自适应相关记忆的 incorpation，以策略预测。

Result: CogMemory 仅增加 3.45M 个参数，保持了轻量级特性，适用于早期和中期融合的 VLA 背骨。广泛实验表明，CogMemory 在多元 VLA 背骨上的长期任务基准测试中表现出持续改进。

Conclusion: CogMemory 有效地提高了 VLA 系统在长期任务中的表现，提供了更可靠的记忆管理机制，有助于推动机器人操作技术的进步。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet their ability to execute long-horizon tasks remains limited by insufficient long- term memory modeling. Existing methods either rely on implicit temporal representations within policy networks, where historical information can be gradually diluted, or maintain explicit memory buffers that suffer from redundancy, noise accumulation, and inefficient retrieval. In this paper, we propose CogMemory, a novel variational cognitive memory framework that enables VLA systems to selectively preserve and reuse task-relevant historical information.
